en.description: Activations primarily fall on several specific subword fragments: Int in biomedical texts, Wh in email names or place names, and isolated fragments such as electroluminescence, Dance, and active. They have no clear common semantics.

patterns.name: Word-initial/in-word substring “Int”
patterns.context: Activations cluster on letter fragments beginning with Int, followed by varied word forms; in these examples, they usually occur at the beginning of a phrase or title.
patterns.domain: Journal names, paper titles, and biomedical texts

patterns.name: Wh fragment in specific names
patterns.context: Occurs in personal or place names, specifically Canary Wharf and Whalley; both are in business email bodies.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in electroluminescence
patterns.context: Occurs in a patent background section describing methods for manufacturing electroluminescent displays; the same term is repeated.

patterns.name: Title word Dance
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the repeated book-title-like phrase “…And a Time to Dance”.

patterns.name: active in the phrase redox-active
patterns.context: Occurs in an abstract describing conjugated organometallic polymers containing redox-active centers.

5_427.description: 激活主要落在若干特定词片段：生物医学文本中的 Int、邮件姓名或地名中的 Wh，以及 electroluminescence、Dance、active 等孤立词片段；它们没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 词首/词内子串「Int」
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Int 开头的字母片段，后续词形各异；在这些例子中通常处于短语或标题开头。
patterns.domain: 期刊名、论文标题及生物医学文本

patterns.name: 特定姓名中的 Wh 片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名或地名中，分别为 Canary Wharf 与 Whalley；均处于商务邮件正文。

patterns.name: electroluminescence 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在专利背景部分描述制造电致发光显示器的方法时；同一术语重复出现。

patterns.name: 标题词 Dance
patterns.context: 出现在重复书名式短语 “…And a Time to Dance” 的末尾。

patterns.name: redox-active 短语中的 active
patterns.context: 出现在描述含氧化还原活性中心的共轭有机金属聚合物的摘要中。

en.description: Activations do not follow a single semantic pattern: the most consistent is sentence-initial a; there are also responses to a fixed title phrase, active and luminescence terminology in scientific texts, patent electroluminescence terminology, and prime-factor questions.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial lowercase article a
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of passages in various corpora, followed by different words or punctuation; there is no stable semantic collocation.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase in the title Dance
patterns.context: “And a Time to Dance” occurs in a title or repeated title; activations also occur at the end of the phrase and across line breaks.

patterns.name: Chemical term active center
patterns.context: active follows a hyphen, forming the term “redox-active center”; activations concentrate on active.

patterns.name: Electroluminescent display terminology
patterns.context: The latter part of electroluminescence activates strongly in descriptions of methods for manufacturing electroluminescent displays and devices.

patterns.name: Bioluminescence imaging terminology
patterns.context: Bioluminescence-related words activate strongly in descriptions of luciferases, in vivo imaging, and transplanted neural stem cells.

patterns.name: Prime-factor questions and answers
patterns.context: Occurs when asking about or listing the prime factors of integers, often with a line break between the question and answer.

5_427.concept: 混合的词形与格式特征
5_427.description: 激活并非单一语义模式：最稳定的是句首 a；另对固定标题短语、科学术语中的 active／发光术语、专利电致发光词及素因数问答有响应。

patterns.name: 句首小写冠词 a
patterns.context: 多种语料中出现在片段开头，后接不同词或标点；没有稳定的语义搭配。

patterns.name: Dance 标题中的固定短语
patterns.context: 标题或重复标题中出现“And a Time to Dance”，短语末尾及换行也有激活。

patterns.name: 化学术语 active center
patterns.context: 连字符后接 active，构成“redox-active center”中的术语；激活集中在 active。

patterns.name: 电致发光显示术语
patterns.context: 在描述制造电致发光显示器及其装置的方法时，术语 electroluminescence 的后半部分激活很强。

patterns.name: 生物发光成像术语
patterns.context: 描述 luciferases、体内成像及移植神经干细胞时，bioluminescence 相关词强烈激活。

patterns.name: 素数因数问答
patterns.context: 在询问或列举整数的素数因数、并伴随题目与答案换行时出现。

en.concept: Diverse proper names and subword fragments
en.description: Activations show varied local subword fragments and layout cues: especially San place names, legal document headings, and court names; there are also responses to biological subword fragments, chemical abbreviations, and individual proper names or punctuation.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragment San
patterns.context: Occurs in place or institution names, usually followed by the rest of the name.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research project descriptions, place-name lists, Wikipedia entries, real estate articles

patterns.name: Legal document layout and court headings
patterns.context: Court document headings formed by line breaks and spaces; court names include Court of Appeals and Fifth District.

patterns.name: vesicular subword in a specific term
patterns.context: Occurs in a project abstract describing the active transport of vesicular cargo.

patterns.name: Bioluminescence imaging-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in the word bioluminescence, near imaging.

patterns.name: Chemical abbreviation CTFE
patterns.context: Appears in the final part of the abbreviation CTFE; the text introduces a process for preparing chlorotrifluoroethylene.

patterns.name: Ag in a personal or proper name
patterns.context: Occurs in the name Colegio San Agustin – Bacolod.

patterns.name: Local subword position in a common word
patterns.context: Occurs at the possessive apostrophe in Trump’s; no clear connection to other strong triggers is evident.

5_427.description: 激活呈现多种局部词片段与版式线索：尤见 San 地名、法律文书抬头及法院名称；另对生物学词片段、化学缩写和个别专名或标点有反应。

patterns.name: San 的专名片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名或机构名中；通常后接地名其余部分。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研项目简介、地名列表、维基条目、房地产文章

patterns.name: 法律文书中的版式与法院标题
patterns.context: 换行和空格构成的法院文书抬头；法院名称包含 Court of Appeals、Fifth District。

patterns.name: 特定词内的 vesicular 子词
patterns.context: 出现在描述囊泡货物主动运输的项目摘要中。

patterns.name: 生物发光成像相关词
patterns.context: 出现在 bioluminescence 一词中，邻近 imaging。

patterns.name: 化学缩写 CTFE
patterns.context: 作为 CTFE 缩写的末段出现，文本介绍氯三氟乙烯的制备工艺。

patterns.name: 人名或专名中的 Ag
patterns.context: 出现在 Colegio San Agustin – Bacolod 这一名称中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科条目、学校名称

patterns.name: 普通词中的局部子词位置
patterns.context: 出现在 Trump’s 的所有格撇号处；未见与其他强触发形成明显联系。

en.description: All passages contain place names made up of San, often San Francisco, San Diego, and similar names; there are also several isolated activations involving treaties, energy prices, real estate sayings, toplessness regulations, video conferencing, and proper-name fragments, with no shared semantics evident.

patterns.name: Place names beginning with San
patterns.context: “San” occurs in a place name, followed by the name of a city or geographical entity; most examples are at the beginning of a word or in a list of proper names. This trigger can cross tokenization boundaries, and activation strength varies by instance.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, news commentary, business emails, and other texts containing place names

patterns.name: Treaty phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in a treaty name or an encyclopedia sentence describing a treaty; “San” also appears in the same passage, but there is no evidence that Treaty itself is a strong trigger.

patterns.name: Price controls and supply terminology
patterns.context: Energy market regulatory emails discussing price caps and the release of short-term capacity; several related economic or industry terms occur in sequence.

patterns.name: Repeated emphasis on “location”
patterns.context: Repeated in a discussion of the real estate market and an old saying; the same passage also contains the place name San Francisco, so the sample cannot distinguish activation from the repeated word or the place name.

patterns.name: Word forms related to “topless”
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of beach or community toplessness regulations; the passage also contains the place name San Diego, so attribution is uncertain.

patterns.name: Remote meeting terminology
patterns.context: Lists employee locations for attending a meeting via video conference; the same passage also contains the place name San Ramon, so the individual contribution cannot be determined.

patterns.name: Sporadic proper-name words in entity names
patterns.context: Part of a publication title and an editor’s name, in surrounding context about an artist’s project and exhibition; these activations have no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Unclear subword fragment
patterns.context: The beginning of the word is truncated and may be the ending of a group name; the fragment is insufficient to reliably identify the trigger word or context.

patterns.name: Unclear Bengali-script word fragment
patterns.context: A Bengali-script personal name or word fragment at the start of a biographical entry, followed by an English biography; it has no clear connection to other triggers.

patterns.name: Unclear fisheries-related word fragment
patterns.context: A sentence about Georges Bank waters and catches; the target word fragment appears to be a proper name or truncated word form and cannot be reliably interpreted.

5_427.description: 所有片段都出现 San 组成的地名，常为 San Francisco、San Diego 等；另有若干孤立激活，涉及条约、能源价格、房地产格言、裸露规定、视频会议及专名词片段，未见共同语义。

patterns.name: San 开头的地名
patterns.trigger: «San»，包括后续组成的地名，如 «San»10« Ag»5«ust»1«in»1、«San»10 Francisco、«San»10« Diego»2、«San»10 Jose、«San»10« Le»1«andro»5、«San»9 Ramon
patterns.context: “San”出现在地名中，后接城市或地理实体名；多数例子在词首或专名列表中。该触发可跨越分词边界，且激活强度随实例而异。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻评论、商业邮件及其他含地名的文本

patterns.name: Treaty 短语
patterns.context: 出现在条约名称或描述条约的百科句子中；此处还与 “San” 同段，但没有证据表明 Treaty 本身是强触发因素。

patterns.name: 价格管制与供给术语
patterns.context: 电力市场监管邮件中，讨论价格上限及短期容量释放；多个相关经济或行业术语连续出现。

patterns.name: “location”重复强调
patterns.context: 在说明房地产市场及旧格言时重复出现；同段另有 San Francisco 地名，无法由样本区分激活来自重复词还是地名。

patterns.name: “topless”相关词形
patterns.context: 讨论海滩或社区裸露规定时出现；段内也有 San Diego 地名，因此触发归因不确定。

patterns.name: 远程会议术语
patterns.context: 列出通过视频会议参加会议的员工地点；同段另有 San Ramon 地名，无法单独确定贡献。

patterns.name: 实体名称中的零散专名词
patterns.context: 出版物标题及编辑姓名的一部分，周围语境涉及艺术家项目与展览；这些激活没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 难以判定的词片段
patterns.context: 词首被截断，可能是某个群体名称的词尾；片段不足以可靠判断触发词或语境。

patterns.name: 难以判定的孟加拉文字词片段
patterns.context: 人物简介开头的孟加拉文字姓名或词片段，后续转为英文生平；与其他触发无明显联系。

patterns.name: 难以判定的渔业词片段
patterns.context: 有关 Georges Bank 海域及捕获物的句子，目标词片段疑似专名或被截断词形，无法可靠解释。

en.concept: San place names and proper names
en.description: Strong triggers cluster around San/San… place names or proper names (San Diego, Sebastian, Raffaele, Sanandaj, San'a, San Paolo, San Francisco), but also include paper-title separators, mathematical terminology/metadata, and railway-entry formatting, making them difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: San Diego place name
patterns.context: “San” begins a place name, followed by Diego; occurs in descriptions of locations, institution names, or event contexts.
patterns.domain: Location descriptions, academic papers, news/emails, encyclopedias

patterns.name: San Sebastián place name
patterns.context: In research-site or population descriptions, “San” is followed by Sebastian.

patterns.name: San Raffaele institution name
patterns.context: Occurs in the name of the institution approving the clinical trial’s ethics.

patterns.name: Sanandaj address
patterns.context: Occurs as the name of an Iranian city in an author address; the original marking spans San and subsequent characters.

patterns.name: San'a place name
patterns.context: Occurs as a place name in the alias of a historical treaty.

patterns.name: San Paolo institution name
patterns.context: Occurs in the funding institution name Università di Torino and Compagnia di San Paolo.

patterns.name: San Francisco place name
patterns.context: Occurs in an encyclopedia-style parenthetical note about a band’s origin.

patterns.name: Separator lines and title formatting
patterns.context: A title or section heading is followed by a separator made of repeated punctuation; occurs in only a few passages.

patterns.name: Mathematical proper names and classification formatting
patterns.context: Specialized terminology or classification metadata occurs in a mathematics paper; activations are not limited to San place names.

patterns.name: San in a non-place name or other proper name
patterns.context: San is followed by a place name, but the full name is embedded in contexts about research activities and regulatory litigation, respectively.

patterns.name: Railway entry and band name
patterns.context: The entry begins with a headword title and definition/listing format; it occurs in the same passage as San Francisco but is not the same trigger.

5_427.description: 强烈触发点集中在 San/San… 地名或专名（San Diego、Sebastian、Raffaele、Sanandaj、San'a、San Paolo、San Francisco），但也见论文标题分隔线、数学术语/元数据及铁路词条格式，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: San Diego 地名
patterns.context: “San”作为地名开头，后接 Diego；出现在地点描述、机构名称或事件语境中。
patterns.domain: 地点介绍、学术论文、新闻/邮件、百科

patterns.name: San Sebastián 地名
patterns.context: 研究地点或人口描述中，“San”后接 Sebastian。

patterns.name: San Raffaele 机构名
patterns.context: 临床试验伦理审批机构名称中出现。

patterns.name: Sanandaj 地址
patterns.context: 作者地址中，作为伊朗城市名出现；原文标记跨越 San 与后续字符。

patterns.name: San'a 地名
patterns.context: 历史条约名称中，作为条约别名所含地名出现。

patterns.name: San Paolo 机构名
patterns.context: 资助机构名称 Università di Torino and Compagnia di San Paolo 中出现。
patterns.domain: 学术论文致谢/资助说明

patterns.name: San Francisco 地名
patterns.context: 乐队来源地的百科式括注中出现。

patterns.name: 分隔线与标题格式
patterns.trigger: ========================================、MATERIAL AND METHODS、Trial design and sample size calculation
patterns.context: 标题或小节标题后接由重复标点构成的分隔线；只有个别段落出现。

patterns.name: 数学专名及分类格式
patterns.context: 数学论文中出现专门术语或分类元数据；激活并非仅限于 San 地名。

patterns.name: 非地名或其他专名中的 San
patterns.trigger: San Diego（作为组织/活动名称组成部分）、San Diego complaint
patterns.context: San 后接地点名，但整体分别嵌在研究活动介绍和监管诉讼语境中。
patterns.domain: 机构简介、能源监管邮件

patterns.name: 铁路条目与乐队名
patterns.context: 条目开头以词条标题及释义/列举格式出现；与 San Francisco 同段但不构成同一触发因素。

en.description: Activations are scattered across specific abbreviations or in-word fragments (especially CM and AMPATH), as well as legal document headings, case citations, medical terminology, and table formatting; there is no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: CM string
patterns.context: Occurs in proper names or abbreviations with mixed capitalization, possibly across subword tokenization; no specific semantic domain is required
patterns.domain: Energy emails, medical research, campus research, drug research

patterns.name: Legal document heading format
patterns.context: Headings, tables of contents, and numbering in court decisions or appellate court documents

patterns.name: In-word fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Continuous terms in medical abstracts; activations fall on substrings within words rather than whole words

patterns.name: AMPATH in an institution name
patterns.context: Name of a Kenyan healthcare collaboration, especially when the project abbreviation is mentioned repeatedly

patterns.name: Twin B column in a table
patterns.context: Birth data tables in twin studies, with headings and numerical columns formatted using spaces

patterns.name: Case citations and quotation beginnings
patterns.context: Quotation text follows a Pennsylvania case citation

5_427.concept: 特定字符串与格式片段
5_427.description: 激活分散于若干特定缩写或词内片段（尤其 CM、AMPATH），以及法律文书标题、判例引注、医学术语和表格排版；没有统一语义主题。

patterns.name: CM 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在不同大小写混杂、可能跨子词切分的专名或缩写中；不要求特定语义领域
patterns.domain: 能源邮件、医学研究、校园研究、药物研究

patterns.name: 法律文书标题格式
patterns.trigger: 换行与编号后出现「RULE 17 DOCKET CONTROL」；另有「APPENDIX」「RULES OF THE UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS」
patterns.context: 法院判决或上诉法院文书的标题、目录及编号格式

patterns.name: 医学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中的连续术语；激活落在词内子串而非完整词上

patterns.name: 机构名称中的 AMPATH
patterns.context: 肯尼亚医疗合作项目名称，尤其在项目缩写被重复提及时
patterns.domain: 全球健康／医疗项目介绍

patterns.name: 表格中的 Twin B 栏
patterns.trigger: 「Twin B (Gestational age range in weeks +/- 2 SD)」附近的空白对齐与列标题
patterns.context: 双胎研究的出生数据表格，标题与数值列采用空格排版

patterns.name: 判例引注与引文开头
patterns.context: 宾夕法尼亚州判例引注之后接引文文字

en.description: Activations often fall on uppercase abbreviations, split in-word fragments, or patent terminology, but also cover common words, formatting markers, and several unrelated topics; no single semantic pattern explains all examples.

patterns.name: Uppercase letter sequence TRI
patterns.context: Activations fall on uppercase abbreviations or their segmented spellings; they occur in varied contexts and do not necessarily refer to the same abbreviation
patterns.domain: Academic, research, email, web, and technical patent texts

patterns.name: Segmented in-word spelling
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on character or morpheme fragments within words, especially split spellings
patterns.domain: Film descriptions, web texts, patents, cleaning product instructions

patterns.name: Phrase fragments in patents
patterns.context: In the background section of an invention, polymer/chemical terms and their constituent fragments are marked

patterns.name: Vehicle collisions and passenger compartments
patterns.context: Describes the forces and deceleration acting on a vehicle and the dashboard deforming toward the passenger compartment

patterns.name: Contract names and agreement abbreviations
patterns.context: Agreement names and company suffixes occur in intercompany contracts or business correspondence

patterns.name: Film titles and plot descriptions
patterns.context: A chase scene is introduced, followed by film information presented as a title and brief plot synopsis

patterns.name: Other common words and formatting
patterns.context: There is no consistent semantic condition across passages; activations are scattered across common words, formatting markers, and domain terms
patterns.domain: Academic texts, web pages, emails, patents

patterns.name: Disinfectant/cleaning solution descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses quaternary ammonium disinfectant solutions and their dilution, bacterial growth, and surface cleaning

patterns.name: Barcodes and airport security screening
patterns.context: Discusses reading barcodes to learn a passenger’s airport security screening level and mentions modifying a boarding pass

5_427.concept: 大小写及词内片段特征
5_427.description: 激活常落在大写缩写、词内拆分片段或专利术语上，但也覆盖普通词、格式标记及多个互不相同的主题；无法用单一语义模式解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 大写字母序列 TRI
patterns.context: 激活落在大写缩写或其分段拼写上；出现于多种不同语境，未必指同一缩写
patterns.domain: 学术、科研、邮件、网络文本、技术专利

patterns.name: 词内分段拼写
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内部的字符片段或词素片段，尤其是被拆分的拼写
patterns.domain: 电影描述、网络文本、专利、清洁用品说明

patterns.name: 专利中的词组片段
patterns.context: 在发明背景部分，聚合物/化学术语及其构词片段被标记

patterns.name: 车辆碰撞与乘员舱
patterns.context: 描述车辆受力、减速及仪表板向乘员舱变形的情形

patterns.name: 合同名称及协议缩写
patterns.context: 公司间合同或商业往来中出现协议名称、公司后缀

patterns.name: 电影标题及剧情描述
patterns.context: 先介绍追逐场景，随后以标题和简短剧情梗概呈现电影信息

patterns.name: 其余普通词语及格式
patterns.context: 没有跨段一致的语义条件；激活散落在常用词、格式标记及领域词上
patterns.domain: 学术文本、网页、邮件、专利

patterns.name: 杀菌剂/消毒液描述
patterns.context: 讨论季铵盐消毒液及其稀释、细菌滋生和表面清洁

patterns.name: 条码与登机安检
patterns.context: 讨论读取条码以获知乘机安检等级，并提到修改登机牌

en.description: The most consistent pattern is the StackExchange answer marker “A:” followed by a line break, especially at transitions in Q&A body text. A few legal quotations also activate near commas, colons, and the beginning of provisions; isolated Portuguese word fragments and mathematics or bibliographic contexts are difficult to group into the same pattern.

patterns.name: Statutory quotation after a comma
patterns.context: A legal opinion or decision introduces a regulation or contract provision, followed by “in relevant part:” and the start of a quotation.

patterns.name: Legal transition after a comma
patterns.context: A legal argument uses a comma after “however” to introduce a subordinate clause; high activation is concentrated on the comma and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: Contract provision quotation after a comma
patterns.context: A legal document says an agreement or document “provides, in part, that,” followed by a quotation of the provision.

patterns.name: Q&A post answer marker
patterns.context: In a StackExchange post, a line break and answer label “A:” appear after the question body or comments; activations occur near the colon and following line break.

patterns.name: Answer numbering and body beginning in Q&A posts
patterns.context: An extra line break or number follows the answer label, then the answer body begins; activations include the label, line break, and nearby opening word.

patterns.name: Opening quotation mark and provision number at paragraph start
patterns.context: A legal quotation begins with a quotation mark and parenthesized number after a colon.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Brazilian Portuguese
patterns.context: In Portuguese body text, activations fall on an in-word fragment split across tokens; a StackExchange answer marker also appears later in the passage.

patterns.name: Q&A marker near a mathematical expression
patterns.context: After a mathematical derivation or formula, the text enters the StackExchange answer section; activations occur near the answer label and the beginning of the following formula.

patterns.name: Quotation colon and bibliographic link
patterns.context: An answer recommends a paper, with a URL immediately after a colon; the passage also contains a common answer label.

5_427.description: 最一致的模式是 StackExchange 答案标记“A:”及其后换行，尤其在问答正文切换处。另有少数法律引文中逗号、冒号及条款起始附近激活；个别葡语词片段和数学、书目上下文难以归为同一规律。

patterns.name: 逗号后的法条引述
patterns.context: 法律意见或判决在介绍法规、合同条文时，逗号后接“in relevant part:”并开始引文。

patterns.name: 逗号后的法律转折
patterns.context: 法律论述中“however”后用逗号引出从句；高激活主要落在逗号及其邻近 token。

patterns.name: 逗号后的合同条款引述
patterns.context: 法律文书称协议或文件“provides, in part, that”，随后开始引用条款。

patterns.name: 问答帖答案标记
patterns.context: StackExchange 帖子中问题正文或评论后出现换行的答案标签“A:”，其冒号和后续换行附近激活。

patterns.name: 问答帖答案编号及正文起始
patterns.context: 答案标签后有额外换行或数字，随后开始答案正文；激活包括标签、换行及起始词附近。

patterns.name: 段首引号与条款编号
patterns.context: 法律引文冒号后以引号和括号编号开始条款。

patterns.name: 巴西葡语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语正文中，激活落在跨 token 拆分的词内片段；同时该段后续出现 StackExchange 答案标记。

patterns.name: 数学表达式附近的问答标记
patterns.context: 数学推导或公式后进入 StackExchange 答案区，答案标签及其后的公式起始附近激活。

patterns.name: 引文冒号及书目链接
patterns.context: 答案中推荐论文，冒号后紧接 URL；该段还出现常见答案标签。

en.concept: Introduction and markers for numbered lists
en.description: Primarily responds to colon-introduced lists, especially the colon and parenthesized numbering before specific aims in research applications; the same list structure also occurs when legal documents enumerate issues.

patterns.name: Colon in a research plan
patterns.context: Introduces specific aims, research questions, or subsequent items in the body of a study or proposal; commonly follows wording such as “aims” or “propose”.

patterns.name: Opening parenthesis for numbered aims
patterns.context: After a colon, a list of aims or items begins, usually with a number such as “(1)” or “(1-3)”.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis for numbered aims
patterns.context: Closes the parenthesis after a number as part of a list item number.

patterns.name: Number in an aim-list item
patterns.context: Occurs in a parenthesized number after a colon or as the number of a Specific Aim; the number itself varies.

patterns.name: List of issues in legal documents
patterns.context: An appellate brief summarizes issues for discussion one by one, beginning a parenthesized list after a colon; the structure resembles research aims, but the context is not research.

5_427.concept: 编号列表的引出与标记
5_427.description: 主要响应冒号引出的条目列表，尤其是科研申请中具体目标前的冒号及括号编号；同一列表结构也出现在法律文书列举争点时。

patterns.name: 研究计划中的冒号
patterns.context: 研究或提案正文中引出具体目标、研究问题或后续条目；常见于“aims”“propose”等措辞之后。

patterns.name: 编号目标的左括号
patterns.context: 冒号之后开始列举目标或条目，通常紧接数字编号，如“(1)”或“(1-3)”。
patterns.domain: 科研计划、项目目标列表

patterns.name: 编号目标的右括号
patterns.context: 数字编号之后关闭括号，作为列表条目编号的一部分。
patterns.domain: 科研计划、项目目标列表

patterns.name: 目标条目编号数字
patterns.context: 出现在冒号后的括号编号中，或作为 Specific Aim 的编号；编号内容并不固定。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的争点列表
patterns.context: 上诉意见概述待逐项讨论的争点，冒号后以括号编号开始列举；结构类似科研目标列表，但并非科研语境。

en.concept: Aims and list introductions in research plans
en.description: Primarily responds to sentence structures that introduce research aims, tasks, or item lists in NIH biomedical texts: proposal/propose followed by an objective or colon, Specific Aim headings, and numbered lists introduced by include/These are.

patterns.name: Numbered aims or tasks in a research plan
patterns.context: Researchers introduce a research plan, specific aims, or proposed tasks, especially structures with a colon followed by a number and a base-form verb.
patterns.domain: NIH biomedical research applications and project abstracts

patterns.name: Numbered aim headings in a research project
patterns.context: Specific Aim(s) labels research aims, followed by a list of aims or their contents.

patterns.name: Listing research features or questions
patterns.context: Introduces a list of project features, questions to be addressed, or research items, followed by parenthesized numbers.

5_427.concept: 研究计划中的目标与列表引导
5_427.description: 主要响应 NIH 生物医学研究文本中引出研究目标、任务或事项清单的句式：proposal/propose 后接目的或冒号，Specific Aim 标题，以及 include/These are 引出的编号列表。

patterns.name: 研究计划中的编号目标或任务
patterns.context: 研究者介绍研究计划、具体目标或拟开展的任务，尤其是冒号后接编号和动词原形的结构。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究申请书及项目摘要

patterns.name: 研究项目的编号目标标题
patterns.context: 以 Specific Aim(s) 标出研究目标，随后列出目标或其内容。

patterns.name: 列举研究特点或问题
patterns.trigger: “Unique aspects of the study include: (1)”；“These are: (1)”；“issues to be addressed include: (9)”
patterns.context: 引出项目特点、待解决问题或研究事项的列表，后接括号编号。
patterns.domain: 研究申请书或项目说明

en.description: Primarily responds to structures introducing numbered lists: an overview of goals, tasks, features, or questions followed by a colon or similar lead-in, especially parenthesized numbering. Also responds to a single instance of a comma after asks in literary criticism.

patterns.name: Introducing numbered research objectives
patterns.context: After research objectives or hypotheses, a colon introduces numbered research tasks, experimental steps, or items to be assessed; activation is concentrated on the colon and the immediately following numbers or parentheses.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans, medical and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Introducing and numbering list items
patterns.context: An overview of goals, research features, or questions is followed by a colon or similar structure introducing parenthesized numbered items.

patterns.name: Introducing a question
patterns.context: A comma and form of address follow the verb asks, then a question is posed; this example has no numbered list.

5_427.description: 主要响应引出编号列表的结构：目标、任务、特点或问题的概述后接冒号或近似引导语，尤其是括号编号；另对文学评论中 asks 后的逗号有单例响应。

patterns.name: 研究计划引出编号目标
patterns.trigger: “propose to: 1)”；“aim to: 1)”；“aims to determine: (1)”；“will be tested by: (a)”
patterns.context: 研究目标或假设之后，以冒号引出编号的研究任务、实验步骤或待测内容；激活集中在冒号及紧随其后的编号、括号。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划、医学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 列举条目引出与编号
patterns.trigger: “Specific Aims include (1)”；“study include: (1)”；“raises the following five general issues, which we discuss in turn: (1)”
patterns.context: 先概述将要列举的目标、研究特点或问题，随后用冒号或类似结构引出带括号的编号条目。

patterns.name: 引出提问
patterns.context: 动词 asks 后接逗号及称呼语，随后提出问题；本例没有编号列表。

en.concept: First numbered item in a research objectives list
en.description: All passages occur in the context of listing scientific proposal or academic research objectives. The salient trigger is a parenthesized number after a colon (e.g., (1), (i), (l)), as well as preceding cues such as aims, objectives, or questions; content after the number often begins with an interrogative, infinitive, or action noun.

patterns.name: Parenthesized numbered-list marker
patterns.context: A research plan, proposal, or paper introduces questions, objectives, or specific aims, then uses a colon followed by the first parenthesized item number; letter case and subsequent numbers vary.
patterns.domain: Scientific project abstracts, research proposals, and academic papers

patterns.name: Lead-in to objectives or research questions
patterns.context: States the questions a study aims to answer, its objectives, or specific aims, usually immediately before a colon and parenthesized number; exact wording varies across passages.
patterns.domain: Scientific project abstracts and academic writing

patterns.name: Objective content beginning after a number
patterns.context: An item after the number begins with an interrogative, infinitive, or nominalized action, elaborating an individual question or research objective; these words are not shared by all passages.

5_427.concept: 研究目标列表的首项编号
5_427.description: 全部段落都处于科研提案或学术研究目标的列举语境，显著触发点是冒号后括号编号（如 (1)、(i)、(l)），以及前文引出的 aims、objectives 或 questions；编号后的内容常以疑问词、不定式或行动名词开头。

patterns.name: 括号编号列表标记
patterns.context: 研究计划、提案或论文先引出问题、目标或具体 aims，随后以冒号接括号中的第一项编号；编号的字母大小写及后续数字有所变化。
patterns.domain: 科研项目摘要、研究提案及学术论文

patterns.name: 目标或研究问题的引出语
patterns.context: 说明研究旨在回答的问题、研究目标或具体 aims，通常紧邻冒号和括号编号；各段具体措辞不一。
patterns.domain: 科研项目摘要与学术写作

patterns.name: 编号后目标内容的动词开头
patterns.context: 编号后的条目以疑问词、不定式或名词化行动开头，展开单项问题或研究目标；这些词并非所有段落共有。

en.concept: Lead-in to objectives and enumerated items
en.description: Primarily responds to structures introducing research plans, objectives, or questions, especially purpose/task wording before a colon and parenthesized numbers or item markers after it; also covers similar structures introducing grounds for litigation in legal documents.

patterns.name: Research objective lead-in phrase
patterns.context: Introduces the purpose of a research plan or proposal, usually followed immediately by a specific research action or objective; may appear on either side of a colon.

patterns.name: Enumerated marker after a colon
patterns.context: Introduces numbered or lettered items listing objectives, questions, or grounds, often with parenthesized numbers.

patterns.name: Lead-in to research questions or tasks
patterns.context: Appears before specific questions, objectives, or testing methods are listed, often adjacent to a colon and subsequent items.

patterns.name: Listing claims in legal pleadings
patterns.context: In judicial narratives, states that a party has raised several legal grounds, followed by numbered items.

5_427.description: 主要响应研究计划、目标或问题的引出结构，尤其是冒号前的目的/任务表述及其后的括号编号或分项标记；也覆盖法律文书中引出诉讼理由的类似列举结构。

patterns.name: 研究目标引导短语
patterns.context: 研究计划或提案中引出研究目的，通常紧接具体研究动作或目标；冒号前后也可能出现

patterns.name: 冒号后列举标记
patterns.context: 引出目标、问题或理由的编号/字母分项，常出现括号编号

patterns.name: 研究问题或任务引出
patterns.context: 在列出具体问题、目标或检验方法之前出现，常与冒号及后续分项相邻

patterns.name: 法律诉状中的主张列举
patterns.context: 司法叙述中说明当事人提出若干法律理由，随后以编号分项

en.concept: Colon introducing a list or question
en.description: Primarily activates on colons and other markers that introduce lists, especially numbered items, commonly in research plans listing objectives, questions, and specific tasks; also occurs in legal grounds, project questions, and descriptions of technical effects.

patterns.name: Lead-in to objectives/research content
patterns.context: Introduces objectives, questions, or specific research content in a research proposal or plan, often immediately followed by a colon.

patterns.name: Numbered items after a colon
patterns.context: A colon introduces a list of objectives, questions, or grounds; the neuron activates near the colon and list-opening marker, including items in research plans and legal grounds.

patterns.name: Question posed after “asks:”
patterns.context: A project introduction uses a colon to introduce a research question, rather than numbered objectives.

patterns.name: Project explanation after “effects:”
patterns.context: A technical background statement uses a colon to introduce an explanation of effects; the colon is followed by a space and the letter “A”.

patterns.name: List of grounds for criminal legal relief
patterns.context: A court document lists legal grounds raised by the applicant.

patterns.name: Question list in a study of children's imagination
patterns.context: A research proposal organizes its content around questions in multiple domains.

5_427.concept: 引出列表或问题的冒号
5_427.description: 主要对冒号等引出的列表起始标记（尤其编号条目）激活，常见于研究计划的目标、问题和具体任务；也出现在法律理由、项目问题及技术效果说明中。

patterns.name: 目标/研究内容引出语
patterns.trigger: “The goal of this proposal is to”, “The objectives of this proposed research are”, “Our three specific aims are”, “the proposed project has three major aims”, “Specific objectives of this research plan include”
patterns.context: 在研究提案或计划中引出目标、问题或具体研究内容，常紧接冒号

patterns.name: 冒号后的编号条目
patterns.context: 冒号引出的目标、问题或理由列表，神经元在冒号及列表起始标记附近激活；包括研究计划条目和法律理由条目

patterns.name: “asks:”后提出问题
patterns.context: 项目介绍后以冒号引出一个研究问题，而非编号目标

patterns.name: “effects:”后解释项目
patterns.context: 技术背景陈述后以冒号引出效果说明；冒号后为空格并开始字母“A”

patterns.name: 刑事法律救济理由列表
patterns.trigger: “alleged three grounds of ineffective assistance of counsel: (1) that”
patterns.context: 法院文书中列举申请人提出的法律理由

patterns.name: 儿童想象研究中的问题列表
patterns.context: 研究提案以多个领域的问题组织研究内容

en.description: Primarily responds to colons introducing lists of objectives, hypotheses, claims, or effects, often accompanied by numbered markers after the colon; this structure occurs in both research plans and legal documents.

patterns.name: Colon introducing items or an explanation
patterns.context: The preceding text presents objectives, hypotheses, claims, or an explanation, followed by numbered items, lettered items, or explanatory content after a colon; activation is concentrated on the colon and the immediately following list marker.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans and patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Numbered grounds introduced after legal claims
patterns.context: A legal opinion or pleading first summarizes a party's claims, then lists errors or grounds using a colon and “(1)”.

patterns.name: Description of technical effects after a colon
patterns.context: First states that a phenomenon has several main effects, then introduces the effects with a colon; no numbered list appears here.

5_427.description: 主要响应引出目标、假设、主张或效应列表的冒号，常伴随冒号后的编号标记；研究计划与法律文书中均有该结构。

patterns.name: 冒号引出项目或说明
patterns.context: 前文提出目标、假设、主张或说明，冒号后接编号条目、字母条目或解释性内容；触发点主要落在冒号及其紧随的列表标记。
patterns.domain: NIH研究计划与专利技术说明

patterns.name: 法律主张后引出编号理由
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉状先概述当事人的主张，随后用冒号和“(1)”列举错误或理由。

patterns.name: 冒号后的技术效应描述
patterns.context: 先说明某现象有若干主要效应，再以冒号引出效应内容；此处未见编号列表。

en.concept: Lead-in to a research objectives list
en.description: Primarily responds to phrases introducing research objectives in NIH application abstracts, such as aims/objectives, and the colon, first number, or parenthetical punctuation that follows; one passage also activates at “asks: Can”, with weaker activation on a few connective words.

patterns.name: Lead-in phrase for listing research objectives
patterns.context: A research plan, project, or application introduces background and then numbered objectives; strong activation is concentrated on the objective lead-in phrase and nearby colon.

patterns.name: Numbering and punctuation in an objectives list
patterns.context: The beginning of a numbered list after an objective lead-in; numbers, periods, or closing parentheses also activate strongly and are usually adjacent to the lead-in phrase.

patterns.name: Project prompt in interrogative form
patterns.context: A project introduction poses a research question with “asks:”; Can follows directly after the colon. This is not the common numbered aims-list format.

patterns.name: Occasional activation at sentence openings or transitions
patterns.context: These words occur where research background transitions to objective statements, but are not shared across all passages and may be secondary activations around the main pattern.

5_427.description: 主要响应 NIH 申请摘要中引出研究目标的 aims/objectives 短语及其后冒号、首个编号或括号标点；另有一段在“asks: Can”处激活，少量衔接词也有激活。

patterns.name: 列出研究目标的引导短语
patterns.trigger: “specific aims” / “aims” / “objectives” 后接 “are to:” 或冒号
patterns.context: 研究计划、项目或申请书先介绍研究背景，再引出编号目标；强激活集中在目标引导短语和冒号附近。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究资助申请书摘要

patterns.name: 目标列表的编号与标点
patterns.context: 研究目标引导语后的编号列表开头；编号、句点或右括号也出现强激活，且通常紧邻引导短语。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究资助申请书摘要

patterns.name: 疑问句式的项目提示
patterns.context: 项目介绍以“asks:”提出研究问题，冒号后直接出现 Can；不是常见的编号 aims 列表形式。

patterns.name: 句首或衔接位置的散见激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在研究背景与目标陈述的衔接处，但并非各段共有，可能是主模式周边的次要激活。

en.concept: Numbered objectives and methods lists in grant applications
en.description: Responds to list structures for objectives, specific aims, or hypothesis-testing steps in NIH applications: an objective lead-in is often followed by a colon, number, or parenthesized number, then an infinitive, nominalized task, or method.

patterns.name: Numbered items introduced by research objectives
patterns.context: In an NIH grant application, introduces research objectives or specific aims, followed by numbered tasks; the items typically begin with an infinitive.

patterns.name: Nominalized items in an objectives list
patterns.context: A research objectives list is presented as numbered items, which may begin with a noun rather than “to + verb”.

patterns.name: List of hypothesis-testing methods
patterns.context: Explains how research hypotheses will be tested and lists methods with parenthesized letter labels.

5_427.concept: 科研申请书中的编号目标与方法列表
5_427.description: 响应 NIH 申请书中目标、具体 aims 或假设检验步骤的列表结构：目标引导语后常出现冒号、数字或括号编号，再接 to 不定式、名词化任务或方法。

patterns.name: 研究目标引出编号条目
patterns.trigger: “aim”/“aims”/“objectives”/“goals”后接“:”或“are”，再接“1”或“(1)”及“to”，如“specific aims of this project are to: 1) determine”
patterns.context: NIH 项目申请语境中，引出研究目标或具体 aims，随后列出编号任务；通常编号后接不定式

patterns.name: 研究目标列表中的名词化条目
patterns.context: 研究目标列表以编号条目呈现，条目可用名词而非“to + 动词”开头

patterns.name: 假设检验方法列表
patterns.context: 说明将如何检验研究假设，并以括号字母编号列出方法

en.description: Primarily responds to a fixed template introducing research objectives and the first item in NIH biomedical applications: aims/objectives, proposal/project/study, are to, a colon, and the numbering 1); also responds to task verbs in lists. The fifth passage contains only an objectives list and an angiogenesis task, with a weaker template match.

patterns.name: NIH research objective statement
patterns.context: An NIH project abstract first states research objectives or aims, then proceeds to numbered objectives; activation is concentrated on the objective lead-in and its following punctuation, number, and infinitive.

patterns.name: Numbered objective format
patterns.context: Serves as the first-item marker in an objectives list, often appearing after aims/objectives; activation occurs even when the wording differs.
patterns.domain: Numbered-list format in formal research proposals

patterns.name: Proposal wording before objectives
patterns.context: Describes proposed research or a project, often immediately adjacent to an aims/objectives statement, but may also appear before the objective sentence.

patterns.name: Objective verbs
patterns.context: Verbs or nominalized tasks that introduce specific research tasks in numbered objectives; wording varies and usually follows “to” or a number.

patterns.name: Punctuation and function words in objective sentences
patterns.context: The syntactic frame between an aims/objectives statement and the first objective; similar templates recur across multiple passages.
patterns.domain: Set phrases in NIH application text

5_427.description: 主要响应 NIH 生物医学申请中引出研究目标及其首项的固定模板：aims/objectives、proposal/project/study、are to、冒号和编号1)；也响应列表中的任务动词。第5段只有目标列表及 angiogenesis 任务，模板较弱。

patterns.name: NIH 研究目标声明
patterns.trigger: “The overall objectives/goals of the proposed research are 1) to”“the specific aims of this study/project are to: 1)”“the aims of this proposal are to: 1)”
patterns.context: NIH 项目摘要中先陈述研究目标或 aims，再进入编号目标；激活集中在目标引导语及其后的标点、编号和不定式。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究计划书

patterns.name: 编号目标格式
patterns.context: 作为目标列表的首项标记，常出现在 aims/objectives 后；即使措辞不同也有激活。
patterns.domain: 正式研究计划书的列表格式

patterns.name: 目标前的计划书措辞
patterns.context: 描述拟议研究或项目，常紧邻 aims/objectives 声明，但也可出现在目标句之前。

patterns.name: 目标动词
patterns.context: 编号目标中用来引出具体研究任务的动词或名词化任务；词项多样，通常跟在“to”或编号后。

patterns.name: 目标句式中的标点与功能词
patterns.context: 位于 aims/objectives 声明与首个目标之间的句法框架；多个段落反复出现相近模板。
patterns.domain: NIH 申请文本的固定句式

en.description: Strongly responds to stock phrases introducing research objectives in NIH grant abstracts (Specific Aims, objectives, goals, aims are to), and the following colon, number, or lettered-list marker; surrounding purpose and planning terms activate more weakly.

patterns.name: Specific Aims/objectives paragraph lead-in
patterns.context: In NIH research plans, projects, or conference grant abstracts, introduces research objectives and often uses a colon to introduce numbered objectives; activation is concentrated on aims, are, the colon, and nearby numbers and parentheses.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter grant application abstracts, formal scientific prose

patterns.name: Introducing research objectives with objectives
patterns.context: A proposal or research plan states objectives, purposes, or questions to be addressed, often followed by are, a colon, or a list structure.

patterns.name: Objective list markers
patterns.context: A list-opening marker follows the objective lead-in; numbers, parentheses, periods, or letter markers themselves activate strongly, while list-item text may activate more weakly.
patterns.domain: Numbered or lettered item format in formal proposals

patterns.name: Local activation on purpose/planning function words
patterns.context: Occurs near research objectives, planned work, or an objectives list; these words are not consistently strongly activating by themselves and appear more like local accompanying features of objective statements.
patterns.domain: Purpose and future-action language in research plan abstracts

5_427.concept: 资助申请目标列表格式
5_427.description: 强烈响应 NIH 资助摘要中引出研究目标的套语（Specific Aims、objectives、goals、aims are to），以及其后的冒号、编号或字母列表标记；周围目的和计划用语也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Specific Aims/目标段落引出语
patterns.trigger: “Specific Aims”“specific aims”“specific aims of this study are to:”及“aims … will be:”
patterns.context: NIH 研究计划、项目或会议资助摘要中，介绍研究目标并常以冒号引出编号目标；激活集中在 aims、are、冒号及其附近编号和括号。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 资助申请摘要，正式科研文体

patterns.name: objectives 引出研究目标
patterns.trigger: “research proposal objectives”“objectives of this proposed research are:”“proposal addresses three fundamental issues”“overall goals of this proposal are”
patterns.context: 提案或研究计划说明目标、目的或待解决问题，常由 are、冒号或列举结构承接。
patterns.domain: NIH 科研资助申请摘要

patterns.name: 目标列表标记
patterns.context: 目标引导语后出现列表起始标记；数字、括号、句点或字母标记本身有强激活，列表项正文也可能有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 正式提案的编号或字母分项格式

patterns.name: 目的/计划类功能词局部激活
patterns.context: 出现在研究目标、拟开展工作或目标列表附近；这些词本身并非处处强激活，较像目标陈述格式中的局部伴随特征。
patterns.domain: 科研计划摘要中的目的与未来行动表述

en.description: All passages are NIH research abstracts; the neuron responds strongly to expressions introducing research objectives, specific aims, or questions, especially structures in which an objective noun is followed by are/to, a colon, and a numbered list, with variable numbering punctuation.

patterns.name: Research objective/purpose lead-in
patterns.context: Sentence forms introducing specific objectives, research purposes, or questions to be addressed in NIH research abstracts; commonly occur after aims/objectives/goals/proposal/study/questions, followed by a colon and numbered items.
patterns.domain: NIH grant application abstracts spanning biomedical, clinical, behavioral, and cognitive research

patterns.name: Numbered format for objectives lists
patterns.context: A colon and number begin a list after the objective lead-in; numbering punctuation varies, including parentheses and periods.
patterns.domain: Structured lists in research application abstracts

patterns.name: Introducing research questions
patterns.context: Introduces specific research questions or objectives by stating that a proposal asks questions.

patterns.name: Variations in objective wording
patterns.context: Nouns denoting research purposes or objectives, often paired with this study/proposal/research or specific; activation is not limited to one fixed word but centers on the position introducing an objectives list.

5_427.description: 所有片段均为 NIH 研究摘要；神经元强烈响应引出研究目标/具体 aims 或问题的表达，尤其是目标名词后接 are/to、冒号及编号列表的结构，编号标点可变。

patterns.name: 科研目标/目的引导语
patterns.trigger: «are»7«:»10«、«aims»4« of this« study»2« are»7« to»7«:»10«、«goals»3« of this« proposal»3« are»7
patterns.context: NIH 研究摘要中引出具体目标、研究目的或待解决问题的句式；常见于 aims/objectives/goals/proposal/study/questions 后，随后接冒号和编号
patterns.domain: NIH 资助申请摘要，涵盖生物医学、临床、行为及认知研究

patterns.name: 目标列表编号格式
patterns.context: 目标引导语之后以冒号和数字编号开始列表；括号、句点等编号标点形式有所不同
patterns.domain: 科研申请摘要的结构化列表

patterns.name: 提出研究问题
patterns.trigger: «proposal»4« asks»6« four»2« questions»4 which« are»2« our»1« specific»1« aims»4
patterns.context: 以 proposal asks questions 的方式引出后续具体研究问题或目标

patterns.name: 目标措辞本身的变体
patterns.context: 作为研究目的、目标的名词，常与 this study/proposal/research 或 specific 搭配；激活不限于单一固定词，而集中在目标列表的引出位置

en.concept: Local lexical features of “regularly” and philosophical terms
en.description: The main pattern is “regularly”: it strongly activates on this word whether it modifies volunteering, scheduling, use, drinking, or behavior. The second passage instead activates near philosophical terms and citation numbers, forming a distinct, rare pattern.

patterns.name: Frequency use of “regularly”
patterns.context: The adverb modifies a verb, participle, or state to indicate something happens periodically, frequently, or repeatedly; nearby words to its left vary considerably across passages.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, news, papers, emails, and forum text

patterns.name: Philosophical terms and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation occurs near philosophical terms concerning uncertainty, ontology, or vague identity, or near citation numbers; this is not the “regularly” pattern.

5_456.concept: regularly 与哲学术语的局部词汇特征
5_456.description: 主要模式是 regularly：无论修饰志愿服务、排班、使用、饮水或行为，均在该词上强激活。第2段则在哲学术语及引文编号附近激活，属于独立的少见模式。

patterns.name: regularly 的频率用法
patterns.context: 该副词修饰动词、分词或状态，表示定期、经常或反复发生；其左侧邻近词在各段差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、新闻、论文、邮件及论坛文本

patterns.name: 哲学术语与专名
patterns.context: 激活落在关于不确定性、存在论、模糊同一性的哲学术语或引文编号附近；并非 regularly 模式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various corpora. More prominent examples include words such as “effective” and “regularly” and common English function words. Other activations occur around philosophical citations, NIH application wording, subword segmentation of titles and proper nouns, and math Q&A; no single stable semantic pattern emerges.

patterns.name: Text fragments containing words for efficacy/effect
patterns.context: In sentences describing goals, treatment plans, daily operations, or customary support; “effective” occurs in NIH applications and medical abstracts, while “regularly” occurs in charity reports and organizational descriptions
patterns.domain: Research applications, medical abstracts, news, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Common words and punctuation in English text
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous English prose or document headers, with no stable semantic collocation

patterns.name: Philosophical terms and parenthetical quotations
patterns.context: Terms are highlighted in quotation marks and accompanied by citation page numbers and author names

patterns.name: NIH application numbers and administrative project wording
patterns.context: Grant applications or project descriptions containing numbers, aims, and management structures

patterns.name: Unusual word forms/capitalization in titles or proper nouns
patterns.context: In titles, proper nouns, or code comments, words are split into subwords by the tokenizer; triggers are not concentrated on a single word sense

patterns.name: Educational math Q&A format
patterns.context: A question asks for an approximate value of a root, followed on a new line by a numerical answer

5_456.concept: 英语词形与文本片段特征
5_456.description: 激活分散在多种语料中，较显眼的是 effective、regularly 等词及常见英文功能词；另覆盖哲学引文、NIH申请措辞、标题与专名的子词切分，以及数学问答，未形成单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 含有效/效果词的文本片段
patterns.context: 在描述目标、治疗方案、日常运作或惯常支持的句子中；effective 出现在 NIH 申请及医学摘要，regularly 出现在慈善报道和组织介绍中
patterns.domain: 科研申请、医学摘要、新闻与百科

patterns.name: 英文文本中的常见词与标点激活
patterns.context: 在连续英文 prose 或文档头部中出现，未见稳定的语义搭配

patterns.name: 哲学术语及引号括注
patterns.trigger: «indef»«init»«eness»；«dis»«j»«unctive» facts；«v»«ague identity»；«ind»«eterm»«in»«acy»；引号、方括号及引文标记
patterns.context: 术语被引号突出，并伴随引用页码、作者姓名

patterns.name: NIH 申请编号与行政项目措辞
patterns.context: 资助申请或项目说明，出现编号、目标与管理架构

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的异常词形/大小写
patterns.context: 标题、专名或代码注释中，词被分词器拆分成子词；触发不集中于单一词义

patterns.name: 教育数学问答格式
patterns.context: 以问句询问根的近似值，随后另起行给出数值答案

en.description: Activations are scattered across internal fragments of English words, proper nouns, and code identifiers from different domains, and also occur near comment delimiters; there is no stable semantic or domain pattern, suggesting sensitivity to specific character sequences and their boundaries.

patterns.name: Letter combinations within English words
patterns.context: Strong activations fall on letter fragments inside English words, often in the middle or at the end; word meanings and domains are inconsistent
patterns.domain: English text including patents, medical literature, and product titles

patterns.name: Fragments within proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on character fragments within proper nouns or project names, with variable fragment boundaries

patterns.name: Code identifiers and path fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur within identifiers or path components in code; they are not restricted to a particular language or syntactic position

patterns.name: Comment or formatting delimiters
patterns.context: Short character fragments activate near code comments, document markup, or long separator lines

5_456.description: 激活散布于不同领域的英文词、专名及代码标识符内部片段，也见于注释分隔符；没有稳定的语义或统一领域，较像对特定字符序列及其边界的敏感。

patterns.name: 英文词中的字母组合
patterns.context: 强激活落在英文单词内部的字母片段上，常见于词的中段或结尾；上下文词义与领域不统一
patterns.domain: 专利、医学文献、产品标题等英文文本

patterns.name: 专名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名或项目名内部的字符片段，片段边界不固定
patterns.domain: 医学项目名、哲学家姓名

patterns.name: 代码标识符与路径片段
patterns.context: 代码中标识符或路径组成部分内部出现激活；并非仅限某种语言或语法位置
patterns.domain: C++ 头文件路径、JavaScript 代码

patterns.name: 注释或格式分隔符
patterns.context: 代码注释、文档标记或长分隔线附近的短字符片段激活

en.description: Apart from one passage containing webpage JavaScript search-box code, the rest are legal materials. Activations often occur near § and statute numbers, and also appear around legal citations, quotation marks, and fixed headings in judgments. Statutory citations are the most stable common thread.

patterns.name: JavaScript code and interface interaction
patterns.context: In a search-box keyboard event handler, around reading the input value and hiding result cards; activations fall on code symbols, keywords, and interface text.

patterns.name: Statute numbers and statutory citations
patterns.context: Legal text containing statute or section numbers prefixed by §, often alongside citations to the U.S. Code, Code of Federal Regulations, state laws, or case law; activations are especially concentrated on § and the following number characters.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and citation markers in legal text
patterns.context: Quotation marks, backticks, and square brackets occur when judgments or legal discussions quote definitions, phrases, passages, or contract rules; triggers may be adjacent to legal citation formatting.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments and citations in legal literature

patterns.name: Fixed headings in legal documents
patterns.context: A fixed heading in uppercase introduces the legal conclusions section of a court judgment.

patterns.name: Sections and case citations in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal arguments cite guideline sections, legal treatises, state codes, or legislative documents; they do not necessarily use the U.S. Code format.
patterns.domain: Judgments, legal guides, and legislative materials

patterns.name: Regulatory context for controlled medications
patterns.context: Discusses methadone take-home medication, regular follow-up visits, and federal regulations; the passage also contains statute numbers.

5_456.concept: 法律文本中的条文引述
5_456.description: 除一段含网页 JavaScript 搜索框代码外，其余均为法律材料；激活常出现在§及法规编号附近，也见法律引文、引号和判决固定标题。法规引述是最稳定的共同线索。

patterns.name: JavaScript 代码与界面操作
patterns.context: 搜索框键盘事件处理函数中，围绕输入值读取和隐藏结果卡片的代码；激活落在代码符号、关键字及界面文本上。

patterns.name: 法律条文编号与法条引述
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现带§的法规或条款编号，常伴随美国法典、联邦法规、州法或判例引述；激活尤其集中在§及其后的编号字符。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引号与引用标记
patterns.context: 判决或法律论述引用定义、短语、引文或合同规则时出现引号、反引号和方括号；其触发可能与法律引述格式相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律判决及法律文献引文

patterns.name: 法律文书固定标题
patterns.context: 法院判决中以大写固定标题引出法律结论部分。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的章节与判例引用
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用指南章节、法律著作、州法典或立法文件；不一定是联邦法典格式。
patterns.domain: 判决、法律指南和立法材料

patterns.name: 医学管制药物法规语境
patterns.context: 讨论美沙酮带回家用药、定期复诊及联邦监管规定；段内同时有法规编号。

en.description: Activations commonly occur in recommendations or obligations formed with “should” and broadly around HTML entities, tags, and escaped text. Other activations include all-caps emphasis, menu input examples, privacy tools, and several isolated technical or occupational words.

patterns.name: Recurring recommendation/obligation use of “should”
patterns.context: “Should” in recommendations or normative judgments, often paired with “you” or “I”; no fixed sentence position is required.
patterns.domain: HackerNews help requests, experience discussions, and general commentary

patterns.name: HTML entities and markup boundaries
patterns.context: HTML-encoded entities, tags, or fragments appear in webpage text, often adjacent to punctuation or formatting boundaries.
patterns.domain: Web corpora, forum text with HTML escaping

patterns.name: All-caps contrastive emphasis
patterns.context: An all-caps phrase emphasizes contrast or dissatisfaction.

patterns.name: Quoted input options
patterns.context: Discusses a command or option entered in a menu, with the example enclosed in quotation marks.

patterns.name: Privacy tools and service names
patterns.context: Lists privacy-protection scenarios and corresponding tools or services.

patterns.name: Scattered technical/occupational vocabulary activations
patterns.context: These words occur in different sentences, with no consistent local semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Web development, labor commentary, part-time work, and entrepreneurship discussions

5_456.description: 激活常见于 should 构成的建议或义务表达，也广泛落在 HTML 实体、标签及转义文本附近；另有全大写强调、菜单输入示例、隐私工具和若干孤立技术或职业词汇。

patterns.name: 反复出现的“should”建议/义务表达
patterns.trigger: “how should I proceed” / “you should be taking notes” / “you should never do” / “you should be patient”
patterns.context: 建议或规范性判断中的 should，常与 you/I 搭配；不要求句子固定位置。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 求助、经验讨论及一般议论

patterns.name: HTML 实体与标记边界
patterns.context: 网页文本中出现 HTML 编码实体、标签或其碎片；往往与标点或格式边界相邻。
patterns.domain: 网页语料、HTML 转义后的论坛文本

patterns.name: 大写转折强调
patterns.context: 用全大写词组突出转折或不满。

patterns.name: 引号括起的输入选项
patterns.context: 讨论菜单中输入的命令或选项，示例以引号括起。

patterns.name: 隐私工具与服务名称
patterns.context: 列举隐私保护场景及对应工具、服务。

patterns.name: 零散的技术/职业词汇激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在各自不同的句子中，未见一致的局部语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 网页开发、劳动议论、兼职与创业讨论

en.concept: Hyphen-delimited text fragments and code/entity boundaries
en.description: Primarily sensitive to title-like, hyphen-delimited slugs in URLs and their word boundaries; scattered activations also occur in template fields/attributes, “hack-a-shaq,” Upstart versions and commands, and the name Memcached.

patterns.name: Hyphen-delimited slugs in URLs
patterns.context: URL paths contain title-like or descriptive word strings separated by hyphens; activations usually concentrate on the hyphen and following words, especially at word boundaries
patterns.domain: Web links, technical and news headline URLs

patterns.name: Fields and values in template syntax
patterns.context: Form field declarations and attributes and values in Ruby/Rails-style templates

patterns.name: The compound “hack-a-shaq”
patterns.context: A hyphenated player nickname or play name in a basketball context

patterns.name: Upstart version strings
patterns.context: An IRC conversation mentions an Upstart version or related version-control commands

patterns.name: Product-name entity in a question
patterns.context: Asks whether a tool similar to a product exists; activation falls within the name Memcached

5_456.concept: 连字符分隔的文本片段及代码/实体边界
5_456.description: 主要对 URL 中连字符分隔的标题式 slug 及其词边界敏感；另在模板字段/属性、hack-a-shaq、Upstart 版本与命令、Memcached 名称中出现零散激活。

patterns.name: 链接 URL 中连字符分隔的 slug
patterns.trigger: URL 路径中如“using-a-pool-of-workers”“why-is-using-a-shell-loop-to”“three-students-built-a-100-device-to-blind”“qbox-releases-qes-elasticsearch-connector-for-magento”“why-sf-restaurants-are”“what-do-real-thugs-think-of-the-wire”等连字符及其后的词
patterns.context: 网址路径中出现以连字符分隔的标题或描述性词串；激活通常集中在连字符及其后的词，尤其是词边界
patterns.domain: 网页链接、技术与新闻标题 URL

patterns.name: 模板语法中的字段与值
patterns.context: Ruby/Rails 风格模板中的表单字段声明及属性和值

patterns.name: hack-a-shaq 复合词
patterns.context: 篮球语境中以连字符拼成的球员昵称/战术名称

patterns.name: Upstart 版本字符串
patterns.context: IRC 对话中提及 Upstart 版本或相关版本控制命令

patterns.name: 问句中的产品名实体
patterns.context: 询问是否存在类似某产品的工具；激活落在 Memcached 名称内部

en.description: Activations are scattered across Tamil Nadu and other segmented proper nouns, English word fragments, and punctuation; they also occur around crop directions, a medical phrase, garbled email text, HIV, and music reviews, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Place name Tamil Nadu
patterns.context: The place name Tamil Nadu occurs in a sentence or category name; activations concentrate on segmented subword fragments.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and rare word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on segmented proper nouns or rare word fragments, including place names, personal names, and fictional characters; there is no unified syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Forum text, historical entries, novel plots

patterns.name: Common English words and suffixes
patterns.context: Scattered occurrences on function words, suffixes, punctuation, or internal word fragments, across sentence types and without stable collocations.

patterns.name: Pixel crop direction expression
patterns.context: Indicates movement from left to right when describing the range of a crop window; the y-coordinate is fixed at 0.

patterns.name: Medical phrase about body weight
patterns.context: Describes a higher proportion of water by weight in a physiological comparison of newborns and premature infants.

patterns.name: Garbled or encoding-corrupted text
patterns.context: Activations fall on segmented email addresses and string fragments that appear to be encoded or formatted.
patterns.domain: Addresses and structured text in Enron emails

patterns.name: HIV and medication adherence
patterns.context: Describes HIV-positive participants and treatment adherence in a randomized controlled trial abstract.

patterns.name: Pop music vocabulary in a review
patterns.context: Discusses whether an album subverts the foundational style of pop music; activations occur on segmented subword fragments.

5_456.description: 激活分散于 Tamil Nadu 及其他拆分专名、英文词片段和标点；另见裁剪方向、医学短语、邮件乱码、HIV 与音乐评论，缺乏统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: Tamil Nadu 地名
patterns.context: 地名 Tamil Nadu 在句中或分类名称中出现；激活集中在被拆分标记的词片段。
patterns.domain: 印度历史、维基百科分类

patterns.name: 专名与罕见词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在拆分的专名或罕见词片段上，涉及地名、人名及虚构人物；没有统一句法条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、历史条目、小说情节

patterns.name: 英文常见词与词尾
patterns.context: 零散出现在语法词、词尾、标点或词内片段上；跨句子类型且无稳定搭配。
patterns.domain: 论坛、评论、医学、技术问答

patterns.name: 像素裁剪方向表达
patterns.context: 在说明裁剪窗口移动范围时，表示从左到右；y 坐标固定为 0。

patterns.name: 医学体重短语
patterns.context: 新生儿与早产儿生理比较中，描述体重中水分比例较高。

patterns.name: 乱码或编码异常文本
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的邮件地址及疑似编码、格式化的字符串片段中。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的地址与结构化文本

patterns.name: HIV 与药物依从性
patterns.context: 随机对照试验摘要中，描述 HIV 阳性参与者及治疗依从性。

patterns.name: 评论中的流行音乐词汇
patterns.context: 讨论专辑是否颠覆流行音乐的基础风格；激活出现在拆分的词片段上。

en.description: Activations often fall on tokenized fragments of URLs, encoded strings, numerical identifiers, and proper nouns, and also occur sporadically around line breaks, directory boundaries, and ordinary words. The case number in the third passage fits the identifier pattern, but overall there is no single stable semantic feature.

patterns.name: URL/domain and web address fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on URLs, domains, paths, or encoded link characters, including email archive links, Reuters links, and website addresses.

patterns.name: Internal substrings in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation corresponds to part of a proper noun rather than a complete word; examples include band locations, football clubs, and signature/name strings.

patterns.name: Numeric and alphanumeric identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur in continuous numbers or mixed codes such as legal case numbers, URL-encoded identifiers, article IDs, or GUIDs.
patterns.domain: Legal text, web links, code configuration

patterns.name: Ship names/ship-related word strings
patterns.context: Occurs in ship entries following a “Ships” heading and descriptions of service locations; activation may also fall on abbreviation boundaries.

patterns.name: Numbering and title boundaries in bibliographies/poetry catalogs
patterns.context: In a catalog of poetic works, activations occur near line breaks, the beginning of titles, and year/work information.

patterns.name: Character fragments in personal email addresses
patterns.context: After “E-mail me at,” activations concentrate on continuous fragments of a personal email username or address.

patterns.name: Isolated generic word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a sentence describing people helping one another at work; the current fragment shows no apparent formatting condition in common with other triggers.

patterns.name: Isolated function word
patterns.context: Occurs in a business news website tagline; activation falls on ordinary prepositions and determiners, with no clear local formatting pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated poetic word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs within the phrase “certain Poems”; the fragment alone is insufficient to identify a distinct semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Isolated paragraph/marker token
patterns.context: Activations occur at line breaks following links and at code/list structure boundaries; they may relate to structural separation, but evidence is limited.

5_456.concept: 结构化字符串中的片段
5_456.description: 激活多落在网址、编码串、数字标识符和专名的分词片段，也零散出现在换行、目录边界及普通词上；第3段案号符合标识符模式，但整体并无单一稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: URL／域名与网址片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 URL、域名、路径或编码后的链接字符上；包括邮件归档链接、Reuters 链接和网站地址。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、邮件归档、新闻

patterns.name: 专名中的内部子串
patterns.context: 激活对应专名的一部分，而非完整词；见于乐队地点、足球俱乐部和签名/姓名字符串。

patterns.name: 数字及混合字母数字标识符
patterns.context: 激活出现在法律案号、URL 编码标识、文章 ID 或 GUID 等连续编号/混合编码中。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、网页链接、代码配置

patterns.name: 船名／舰船相关词串
patterns.context: 出现在“Ships”标题之后的船舶条目及服役地点描述中；激活也可能落在缩写边界。

patterns.name: 书目／诗歌目录中的编号与标题边界
patterns.context: 诗歌作品目录中，换行、标题开头及年份/作品信息附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 个人邮件地址中的字符片段
patterns.context: 在“E-mail me at”之后，激活集中于个人邮箱用户名或地址的连续片段。

patterns.name: 孤立的通用词片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述互相协助工作的句子中，当前片段看不出与其他触发相同的格式条件。

patterns.name: 孤立的语法词
patterns.context: 出现在商业新闻网站宣传语中，激活落在普通介词和限定词上，未见明确局部格式规律。

patterns.name: 孤立的诗歌词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“certain Poems”一词内部，难以仅凭片段确定独立语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 孤立的段落／标记 token
patterns.context: 激活出现在链接后的换行及代码/列表结构边界处；可能与结构分隔有关，但证据有限。

en.description: Primarily responds to the experiential description structure “what it is/was like to…,” often used to ask about or imagine firsthand experience. Weaker or isolated responses also occur in the judgment structure “what it appears to…,” the repeated “the inside of the” structure in a patent, and “corner of my eye.”

patterns.name: Experiential description pattern “what it is like to …”
patterns.context: Around what + it + is/was/’s + like + to/infinitive or experience, asking about or describing what it feels like to experience an activity, situation, or role; sometimes preceded by “wondered,” “imagine,” or similar.
patterns.domain: Web promotions, reviews, event descriptions, and personal narratives

patterns.name: “what it appears to …” in judgments of function or appearance
patterns.context: “What it appears to” is followed by “do” or “be” to express actual function or appearance; it does not contain the typical “it is like” experiential pattern.

patterns.name: Repeated determiners for an interior location
patterns.context: A technical description repeatedly uses “the”/“of” and “inside of the” to refer to the inside of a device; it is not clearly related to the experiential pattern in the other passages.

patterns.name: Possessive in a body-part phrase
patterns.context: A narrative describes seeing someone out of the corner of one’s eye; activations occur around “corner,” “my,” and “eye,” without the dominant “what-it-is-like” structure.

5_456.concept: 英语中的 what-it’s-like 体验句式
5_456.description: 主要响应 what it is/was like to… 这一体验描述结构，常用于询问或想象亲历某事。另对 what it appears to… 的判断结构、专利中的 the inside of the 重复结构及 corner of my eye 有较弱或孤立响应。

patterns.name: “what it is like to …”体验描述句式
patterns.trigger: “what it is like to sell a product”“what it was like to be there”“what it's like to see”“what it’s like to have”“what it's like to be”
patterns.context: 围绕 what + it + is/was/’s + like + to/动词不定式或经历，询问或描述亲历某种活动、处境或角色的感受；有时前接 wondered、imagine 等。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传、评论、活动介绍及个人叙述

patterns.name: 功能或外观判断中的“what it appears to …”
patterns.trigger: “what it appears to do”“what it appears to be”
patterns.context: what it appears to 后接 do 或 be，表达实际功能或表象；不含典型的 it is like 体验句式。

patterns.name: 装置内部位置的重复限定词
patterns.trigger: “the inside of the depressurized chamber”“the inside of the apparatus”
patterns.context: 技术描述中连续出现 the/of，并用 inside of the 指称设备内部；与其他段的体验句式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 身体部位词组中的所有格
patterns.context: 叙事中描述从视线余光处看到某人；激活落在 corner、my、eye 一带，未呈现主导的 what-it-is-like 结构。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the structure introducing an experiential description, “what it’s like to” and variants, across questions, recollections, reviews, and personal narratives. It also activates near technical device terms in one patent passage, which may be a separate pattern.

patterns.name: Experiential question structure “what it’s like to”
patterns.context: This structure introduces a description of the subjective experience of an event, identity, or activity; activation concentrates on “to,” followed by a verb or “be.”
patterns.domain: Web introductions, Q&A, personal narratives, news commentary, etc.

patterns.name: Device-component terms in a technical patent
patterns.context: Patent background text describes processing equipment, openings, and solution flow; this passage does not match the experiential question structure.

5_456.description: 主要对“what it’s like to”及变体中引出体验描述的结构强烈响应，涵盖询问、回忆、评论和个人叙述；另在一段专利设备术语附近激活，可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: “what it’s like to”体验询问结构
patterns.trigger: “what it’s like to”及其变体“what it was like to”“what it is like to”
patterns.context: 该结构引出对某种经历、身份或活动的主观感受描述；激活集中在“to”上，后接动词或“be”。
patterns.domain: 网页介绍、问答、个人叙述、新闻评论等

patterns.name: 技术专利中的设备部件术语
patterns.trigger: “PS plate processor insertion aperture”以及“discharge aperture”
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中描述处理设备、开口和溶液流动；本段不符合体验询问结构。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across “all” and its following constituents, “to” in experiential expressions, the phrase “sit still,” and “in” in a technical context. These local triggers have no reliable shared pattern.

patterns.name: “all” followed by a determiner, pronoun, or noun
patterns.context: In “when all …” temporal/event clauses, or when “all” is followed by constituents such as those/sites/appellees; strong activation falls on “all”.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, web comments, legal texts

patterns.name: Infinitival “to” in experiential expressions with “like”
patterns.context: Often appears in clauses asking or describing “what it feels like”; “to” introduces an experience, state, or encounter. Activation is mainly on “to”.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, game promotional copy, forum comments

patterns.name: The phrase “sit still”
patterns.context: Creative types are described as unsuited to remaining still for long periods; high activation falls on “still”.

patterns.name: Specific local collocation with the preposition “in”
patterns.context: In a technical discussion, recalling having been “in to it” two years earlier; the specific syntactic or semantic trigger is unclear.

5_456.description: 显著激活分散在 all 及其后续成分、体验表达中的 to、短语 sit still 和技术语境的 in to it；这些局部触发并无可靠共同规律。

patterns.name: all 后接限定词、代词或名词
patterns.trigger: “all»10 is over”“all»10 was starting”“all»9 those”“all»9 sites”“all»9 appellees”
patterns.context: 在 “when all …” 时间/事件从句中，或 all 后接 those/sites/appellees 等成分；强激活落在 all
patterns.domain: 论坛口语、网页评论、法律文本

patterns.name: 不定式 to 与 like 的体验表达
patterns.trigger: “to»9 ‘know’”“to»9 be the mayor”“to»9 have their children taken away”；另有 “what it’s like”
patterns.context: 常见于询问或描述“是什么感觉/像什么”的从句，to 引出体验、状态或遭遇；激活主要标在 to
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、游戏宣传文案、论坛评论

patterns.name: sit still 短语
patterns.context: creative types 被说成不适合长时间保持静止；高激活落在 still

patterns.name: 介词 in 的特定局部搭配
patterns.context: 技术讨论中回忆两年前“当时参与其中”；具体句法/语义触发条件不明确

en.description: Activations are scattered across anatomy, sitting still, personal names, vehicle and electrical structures, LaTeX code, jazz discographies, and employment law. A few activations fall on subword fragments or common phrases; there is no stable semantic trigger spanning all passages.

patterns.name: Peritoneal and abdominal anatomy
patterns.context: Mentions an instrument inserted into the abdominal cavity and its contact with the peritoneum; nearby terms include “abdomen” and “abdominal contents”.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical or surgical technology

patterns.name: Scalp and muscle anatomy
patterns.context: Describes using the sharp edge of a scalp knife and separating the muscles beneath the skin.
patterns.domain: Surgical or anatomical description in legal testimony

patterns.name: Restlessness / difficulty sitting still
patterns.context: The phrase “sit still” describes a child or creative person unable to remain seated for long; one passage concerns childhood, another attention and noise.

patterns.name: Unusual word form in a personal name
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on subword fragments in the name “Kevin Kamekona”, amid a legal narrative about government informants.

patterns.name: Vehicle components and flexible structures
patterns.context: Describes a pedal bracket, a flexible portion deforming under pressure, and sliding contact with the side of a vehicle body.

patterns.name: Foot / leg connection structures
patterns.context: Introduces multiple feet on electrical system components and explains how the connection ends of each foot are labeled in a figure.
patterns.domain: Patent background, electrical equipment and figure descriptions

patterns.name: LaTeX typesetting commands and code
patterns.context: Embedded in LaTeX source containing commands such as \\parbox, \\linewidth, and \\today; activation falls on the string “CSE”.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A or typesetting code

patterns.name: Jazz musicians and album titles
patterns.context: Appears in a jazz discography involving members of Betty Carter’s band and song titles.

patterns.name: Control in an employment relationship
patterns.context: A final subword fragment in the name “Bechtel”; the context discusses whether an employer controls how work is done.

5_456.description: 激活分散于解剖、静坐、人名、车辆与电力结构、LaTeX代码、爵士唱片目录及劳动法语境；少数激活落在词内分词或常见短语上，未见贯穿所有段落的稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 腹膜及腹部解剖
patterns.context: 提及腹腔内插入器械及其与腹膜接触；邻近词包括 “abdomen”“abdominal contents”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，医疗或外科技术

patterns.name: 头皮与肌肉解剖
patterns.context: 描述使用头皮刀的锋刃，并分离皮肤下方的肌肉。
patterns.domain: 法律证词中的手术或解剖描述

patterns.name: 坐不住／难以静坐
patterns.context: 短语 “sit still”，描述儿童或创意人士无法长时间安坐；一处涉及童年，另一处涉及注意力与噪声。

patterns.name: 人名中的特殊词形
patterns.context: 激活集中在姓名 “Kevin Kamekona” 的分词片段，周围是政府线人相关的法律叙述。

patterns.name: 车辆部件与柔性结构
patterns.context: 描述踏板支架、柔性部分受压变形并与车身侧面滑动接触。

patterns.name: 支脚／腿部连接结构
patterns.context: 介绍电力系统部件的多个支脚，并说明各支脚连接端在图中的标示。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，电力设备及附图说明

patterns.name: LaTeX排版命令与代码
patterns.context: 嵌在含有 \\parbox、\\linewidth、\\today 等命令的 LaTeX 源码中，激活落在 “CSE” 字符串。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答或排版代码

patterns.name: 爵士音乐人及唱片名
patterns.context: 出现在爵士乐唱片目录中，涉及 Betty Carter 乐队成员及歌曲名。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 音乐家传记与唱片目录

patterns.name: 雇佣关系中的控制权
patterns.context: “Bechtel” 姓名中的末尾分词片段；上下文讨论雇主是否控制工作方式。

en.description: Activations occur across several text types: function words and component descriptions in patent sentences, time formats in arithmetic Q&A, segmented URL/proper-name/Scala-library fragments, specific word fragments in a few comments, and a news place name. No clear semantic pattern spans all passages.

patterns.name: Function words and body/component nouns in English patent text
patterns.context: Patent background or embodiment sentences describe component movement, deformation, contact, and measurement structures; activation falls on multiple function words and nouns.

patterns.name: Time formats in time-arithmetic Q&A
patterns.context: Questions such as “What is … minutes after …?”, “minutes before …?”, or queries about the interval between two times; activation often covers hour/minute digits, colons, and AM/PM.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in URLs and proper names
patterns.context: Names, places, paths, or words in news review headlines and URLs are split into multiple tokens; high activation also falls on fragments such as «10».

patterns.name: ScalaTest dependency configuration
patterns.context: Build configuration includes a ScalaTest description and dependency coordinates; activation concentrates on tokens from the segmented library name.

patterns.name: Sentence-final emphasis on a state of stillness
patterns.context: First-person account of being unable to sit still as a child; the target word occurs in “I couldn’t sit still.”

patterns.name: Adverbial suffix in sports commentary
patterns.context: In a sentence discussing a player’s performance, the adverbial suffix occurs in the quoted word “constantly burned”.

patterns.name: South African mining-region place name
patterns.context: A news account about the Lonmin platinum mine, striking workers, and police opening fire; the place name is split, with activation concentrated on an interior fragment of “Marikana”.

5_456.description: 激活分布在多个不同文本类型：专利句中的功能词及部件描述、时间算术问答的时刻格式、网址/专名与 Scala 库名的切分片段，以及少数评论中的特定词片段和新闻地名；没有贯穿全部段落的明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语专利文本中的功能词与身体/部件名词
patterns.context: 专利背景或实施例句子中，描述部件运动、形变、接触及测量结构；激活落在多个功能词和名词上。

patterns.name: 时间算术问答中的时间格式
patterns.trigger: 时间数字及 «:»、«AM»、«PM»，并伴随换行后的答案
patterns.context: “What is … minutes after …?”、“minutes before …?” 或询问两个时刻间隔；激活常覆盖时分数字、冒号和 AM/PM。

patterns.name: 网址与专名的分词片段
patterns.trigger: «nyt»、«imes»、«jama»、«ica»、«k»、«ids» 等网址或专名的子词片段
patterns.context: 新闻书评标题及 URL 中的人名、地名、路径或词语被拆成多个 token；高激活也落在 «10» 等片段上。

patterns.name: ScalaTest 依赖配置
patterns.context: 代码配置中出现 ScalaTest 描述和依赖坐标；激活集中于库名被切分后的 token。

patterns.name: 句末强调的静止状态
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述童年时无法安坐，目标词位于 “I couldn’t sit still.” 中。

patterns.name: 体育评论中副词后缀
patterns.context: 讨论球员表现的句子中，副词后缀位于引号内的 “constantly burned” 一词中。

patterns.name: 南非矿区地名
patterns.context: 涉及 Lonmin 铂矿、罢工工人及警察开火的新闻叙述中，地名被拆分；激活集中在 “Marikana” 的中间片段。

en.description: Activations cover varied texts: time-arithmetic problems, numeric coordinate strings, URLs and proper names, chat and forum conversations, patent mechanical descriptions, and bibliographic reviews. Apart from local formatting or wording in individual passages, no unified trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Time and minute calculations
patterns.context: Word problems involving clock times, AM/PM, and numbers of minutes; triggers occur across the times, operation words, and parts of some answers.

patterns.name: Numeric and decimal coordinate sequences
patterns.context: Multiple lines of repeated or nearly repeated numeric/decimal sequences interspersed with line breaks and the letter v; resembles coordinate or vector data.

patterns.name: URLs and segmented proper names
patterns.context: Words in news headlines and corresponding URLs are split into multiple subwords; activation covers headline words and URL segments.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web text, news headlines, and URLs

patterns.name: Scattered words in a CLJS discussion
patterns.context: HackerNews conversation about cljs files and the CLJS ecosystem; activation concentrates on a recollection-style phrase and a segmented CLJS term.

patterns.name: Colloquial words in IRC conversation
patterns.context: IRC usernames, chat markers, and colloquial replies; appears in a conversation about honesty and LFC.

patterns.name: Patent mechanical-structure descriptions
patterns.context: Patent sentences describing a pedal bracket, a flexible component under pressure, and vehicle structures; activation is distributed across mechanical nouns, direction words, and structural relation words.

patterns.name: Bibliographic names and literary commentary
patterns.context: A book title, author/artist name, and year are followed by a conditional-sounding comment.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC literary or art review web pages

patterns.name: Historical craft and hypothetical commentary
patterns.context: HackerNews first discusses historical ironworking, then shifts to a hypothetical paid app; triggers are scattered across comment words and nearby quotation marks.

5_456.description: 激活覆盖多种互不相同的文本：时间算术题、数字坐标串、网址专名、聊天与论坛对话、专利机械描述及书目评论；除各段局部格式或词语外，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 时间与分钟运算
patterns.trigger: “7:39 PM”“minutes are there between”“minutes after”“minutes before”及其相邻时间
patterns.context: 钟表时间、AM/PM 和分钟数量构成的文字题；触发分布在题干中的时间、运算词及部分答案附近。

Some activations fall on common words or internal word fragments; no unified semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Quantifiers and universal statements
