patterns.context: 分布于互不相同的上下文，缺少稳定的局部语义条件

en.description: Activations are scattered across different fields, involving technical terminology, numbers/dates, citations, URLs, HTML, and code identifiers. There is no clearly shared trigger pattern stable across passages; many high-activation points look like local strings or segmented fragments specific to their respective fields.

patterns.name: PLL frequency-locking terminology
patterns.context: Describes a PLL circuit failing to achieve frequency acquisition, locking to the wrong frequency, and its characteristics; triggers concentrate near the technical terms frequency acquisition, frequency, and false lock.
patterns.domain: Patent background, circuits and signal processing

patterns.name: Numeric and decimal sequences
patterns.context: Multiple groups of numbers separated by decimal points and arranged consecutively, interspersed with line breaks and v-like field prefixes and coordinate-style numbers.
patterns.domain: GitHub code or structured numerical data

patterns.name: String theory and cosmology terminology
patterns.context: Discusses cosmic strings, string density, and cosmological models; activation falls near fragments of bran(es) and technical terms such as cosmic.

patterns.name: External HTML link
patterns.context: An external URL in an HTML anchor; the domain is split into tokens, with activation concentrated especially on fragments of externalink.com.

patterns.name: Astrophysics citations and abbreviations
patterns.context: Author-year citations and surrounding technical terms in an astrophysics paper; author names, years/suffixes, and segmented word fragments all show activation.

patterns.name: Entomological names and literature citations
patterns.context: Entomological research text containing sample numbers/bracketed citations, the species name A. cyanescens, and a description of a blue-trap experiment.

patterns.name: Assembly identifiers and instructions
patterns.context: Labels, pointer/type identifiers, registers, and mov instructions interspersed in assembly or disassembly code; activation is especially concentrated on plStripEnd.

patterns.name: Dates, times, and URL numbers
patterns.context: Publication details, dates and times, and a New York Times URL in a review or news entry; years, date digits, and URL fragments are marked.

patterns.name: Physics formulas and citation markers
patterns.context: LaTeX formulas in theoretical physics calculations, including perturbation orders, particle-mass symbols, and author-year citations.

patterns.name: Go code and error identifiers
patterns.context: Error variables, camel-case error identifiers, type/method calls, and range loops in Go code.

5_456.description: 激活分散于不同领域，涉及技术术语、数字/日期、引用、URL、HTML及代码标识符；没有跨段稳定共享的明确触发模式，许多高激活点更像各自领域的局部字符串或分词片段。

patterns.name: PLL 频率锁定术语
patterns.trigger: « frequency»5« acquisition»2« and»3 locks onto« an»2« incorrect»1« frequency»3«.»1 … «false»1« lock»2
patterns.context: 描述 PLL 电路无法完成频率捕获、锁定错误频率及其特性；触发集中在技术术语 frequency acquisition、frequency 和 false lock 附近。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，电路与信号处理

patterns.name: 数字与小数序列
patterns.context: 多组数字以小数点分隔并连续排列，夹有换行及类似字段前缀的 v、坐标样式数字。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码或结构化数值数据

patterns.name: 弦论与宇宙学术语
patterns.context: 谈及宇宙弦、弦密度及宇宙学模型；激活落在 bran(es) 的片段和 cosmic 等专业词附近。

patterns.name: HTML 外链地址
patterns.context: HTML 锚点中的外部 URL，域名被分词切开，尤其激活集中在 externalink.com 的域名片段。

patterns.name: 天体物理引用与缩写
patterns.context: 天体物理论文中作者-年份式引文及其周围的专业术语；作者名、年份/后缀和分词后的词片段均有激活。

patterns.name: 昆虫学名称与文献引用
patterns.context: 昆虫学研究文本，包含样本编号/方括号引文、物种名 A. cyanescens 以及蓝色诱捕实验描述。

patterns.name: 汇编标识符与指令
patterns.context: 汇编或反汇编代码中，标签、指针/类型标识符、寄存器和 mov 指令交错出现；激活尤其集中在 plStripEnd。

patterns.name: 日期、时刻与网址数字
patterns.context: 书评或新闻条目中的出版信息、日期时间和纽约时报网址；年份、日期数字及 URL 片段被标记。

patterns.name: 物理公式与引用标记
patterns.context: 理论物理计算中的 LaTeX 公式，包含微扰阶数、粒子质量符号及作者-年份引文。

patterns.name: Go 代码与错误标识符
patterns.context: Go 代码中的错误变量、驼峰式错误标识符、类型/方法调用和 range 循环。

en.concept: Code subwords and technical text fragments
en.description: Activations occur mainly on Go range iteration, fields, and long identifier fragments; there are also scattered triggers involving PLL terminology, the LeftTop enum, physics vocabulary and citation numbers, and email text. No unified semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: Range/loop field iteration in Go
patterns.context: Assignment and iterated object in Go range loops, especially iteration over message fields; ordinary loop variables and subsequent field access also occur.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of specific long identifiers and API names
patterns.context: Subword fragments within code identifiers or method names; activation falls inside longer camel-case names or encoded function names. The trigger may be related to local subwords.

patterns.name: PLL, frequency, and locking terminology
patterns.context: Technical context describing a digital phase-locked loop that cannot acquire a frequency and locks to the wrong one.

patterns.name: “still” in English negation/judgment constructions
patterns.context: The colloquial comment structure “doesn't mean it's not still basically impossible”, with multiple negations and an adverb of degree; the trigger may be local syntax or the word itself.

patterns.name: LeftTop direction enum
patterns.context: Code assigns a direction variable the LeftTop enum value, following a geometric boundary check.

patterns.name: Wire-edge and g-factor terminology
patterns.context: Discusses changes in the g-factor at different wire-subband edges.

patterns.name: Digit strings in reference identifiers
patterns.context: Digits and letter fragments at the ends of citation keys or author-year reference identifiers; appears in two paper passages.

patterns.name: LaTeX email/author identifier text
patterns.context: When typesetting author contact information, activation concentrates on the email address and its segmented text fragments.

patterns.name: Go message-structure field names
patterns.context: Message serialization/reflection code iterates over message.Field; overlaps with the general Go range pattern, but here the activation peak is on field-related identifiers.

patterns.name: Physics scattering and polarizability
patterns.context: Academic discussion of unpolarized Compton scattering and spin polarizability; no clear shared trigger mechanism with the other high-activation words is apparent.

5_456.concept: 代码子词与技术文本片段
5_456.description: 主要在 Go 代码的 range 遍历、字段及长标识符片段上激活；另有 PLL 术语、LeftTop 枚举、物理学词汇与引文数字、邮箱文本等零散触发，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: Go 中的 range/循环字段遍历
patterns.context: Go 代码中 range 循环的赋值与迭代对象，尤以遍历消息字段为明显；也出现普通循环变量及后续字段访问。

patterns.name: 特定长标识符及 API 名称内部片段
patterns.context: 代码标识符或方法名中的词片段，激活落在较长驼峰命名或编码函数名称内部；触发原因可能与局部子词有关。

patterns.name: PLL、频率与锁定术语
patterns.context: 描述数字锁相环无法捕获频率并锁定到错误频率的技术语境。

patterns.name: 英语否定/判断结构中的 still
patterns.context: 口语评论中“doesn't mean it's not still basically impossible”这一多重否定与程度副词结构；可能是局部句法或词项触发。

patterns.name: 方向枚举 LeftTop
patterns.context: 代码将方向变量赋为 LeftTop 枚举值，前面有几何边界判断。

patterns.name: 线边缘与 g 因子术语
patterns.context: 讨论不同 wire-subband 边缘处 g-factor 的变化。

patterns.name: 参考文献标识符中的数字串
patterns.context: 论文引用键或作者—年份型文献标识符末尾的数字、字母片段；两个论文段落中均出现。

patterns.name: LaTeX 邮箱/作者标识文本
patterns.context: 排版作者联系方式时，激活集中于邮箱地址及其拆分出的文本片段。

patterns.name: Go 消息结构字段名
patterns.context: 消息序列化/反射代码中遍历 message.Field；与一般 Go range 模式重合，但此处激活峰值在字段相关标识符。

patterns.name: 物理学散射与极化率
patterns.context: 非极化康普顿散射及自旋极化率的学术讨论；未见与其他高激活词的明确共同触发机制。

en.description: Activations occur in mathematical true/false problems, code and SQL, URLs, English sentences, and technical patent text. They are distributed across numbers, symbols, identifiers, URL fragments, and ordinary words; there is no stable single semantic or morphological trigger.

patterns.name: Mathematical true/false questions and separators
patterns.context: Problems and True/False answer sequences involving mathematical expressions, factors/divisibility, or primality; activation is scattered across numbers, operators, and question text, rather than limited to a particular mathematical symbol.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax fragments
patterns.context: Identifiers, keywords, punctuation, and adjacent fragments in code or SQL; spans multiple languages and tasks.

patterns.name: URLs, paths, and their text
patterns.context: URLs, domains, or paths in code or text; activation covers character fragments of URLs and also occurs in code for retrieving web pages.

patterns.name: Scattered word activations in English natural language
patterns.context: Multiple common and content words are activated in coherent English sentences; the two passages differ in meaning and style and have no obvious shared keywords.
patterns.domain: EuroParl dialogue/parliamentary speech; Pile-CC sports commentary

patterns.name: Technical proper names and patent terminology
patterns.context: Technical explanatory text describing a digital PLL circuit and false-lock behavior.

patterns.name: Other fragmented strong activations
patterns.context: Beyond the themes of individual passages, the strongest activations fall on different proper names or content words; no unified condition can be inferred from these triggers alone.

5_456.description: 激活出现在数学真假题、代码与 SQL、URL、英文句子及专利技术文本中，分布于数字、符号、标识符、网址片段和普通词语；没有稳定的单一语义或词形触发特征。

patterns.name: 数学真假问答与分隔符
patterns.context: 数学表达式、因数/整除/素数判断组成的题目与 True/False 答案序列；激活散布在数字、运算符和问答文本上，并非只落在某个数学符号

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法片段

patterns.name: URL、路径及其组成文本

patterns.context: 连贯英文句子中多个常见词和内容词均有激活；两段语义与文体不同，没有明显共同关键词

patterns.name: 技术专名与专利术语
patterns.context: 描述数字 PLL 电路及错误锁定现象的技术性说明文本

patterns.name: 其他碎片化强激活
patterns.context: 除各段所体现的主题外，最强激活具体落在不同专名或内容词上；缺少能由这些触发词单独归纳的统一条件
patterns.domain: 网页路径/图片 URL；议会人名；体育评论；专利技术文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and arithmetic, segmented technical identifiers, rare words or proper-name fragments, some quantity phrases, and code-formatting markers. They span domains and lack a single stable semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers, arithmetic, and question punctuation
patterns.context: Numbers or symbols embedded in arithmetic, dates/times, identifiers, or questions; activation is not limited to numbers and also involves punctuation and neighboring tokens.
patterns.domain: Math problems, dates/times, and numbered text

patterns.name: Segmented tokens in technical identifiers
patterns.context: Strong activations occur when identifiers in code, field names, macros, or error messages are split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, software error logs, code

patterns.name: Quoted or proper-name fragments in colloquial narrative
patterns.context: Rare quoted words or names split into fragments appear in English narrative; activation falls on local tokens within words.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, people and entertainment content

patterns.name: Local emphasis in quantity or degree expressions
patterns.context: Natural-language sentences contain quantities, degree expressions, or noun phrases; activation concentrates on individual words in the phrase, with no stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Indentation, line breaks, and code formatting
patterns.context: Code or code-like text contains line breaks, indentation, and escape characters; formatting markers alone cannot explain all high activations.

5_456.concept: 混杂的局部 token 模式
5_456.description: 激活分布在数字与算式、被拆分的技术标识符、罕见词或专名片段，以及部分数量短语和代码排版标记；跨领域明显，缺少单一稳定语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字、算式与问句标点
patterns.context: 数字或符号嵌在算术、日期时间、编号或问句中，激活并不只落在数字上，也涉及标点和邻近 token

patterns.context: 代码、字段名、宏或错误信息中，标识符被拆成多个 token 时出现强激活
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、软件错误日志、代码

patterns.name: 口语叙述中的引用或专名片段
patterns.context: 英文叙述中出现带引号的罕见词，或人名被拆分成片段；激活落在词内局部 token

patterns.name: 数量或程度表达中的局部强调
patterns.trigger: “plenty of rubber”“a tool box”“some nights they still”
patterns.context: 自然语言句子中出现数量、程度或名词短语，激活集中在短语中的个别词，未见稳定句法条件

patterns.name: 缩进、换行与代码排版
patterns.context: 代码或类代码文本带有换行、缩进和转义符；仅有排版标记不足以解释全部高激活

en.description: Activations are scattered across high-frequency words, phrases, and internal word fragments in English texts from many domains, with occasional abbreviations, questions, quotation formats, proper names, and code. Triggers across domain-specific vocabulary are sporadic; no unified semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Consecutive words and common phrases
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across consecutive or adjacent words in natural language, often involving function words, phrase-internal words, and ordinary content words; there is no stable single lexical trigger.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, forum discussions, comments, and narratives

patterns.name: English negation and contractions
patterns.context: Complete negative words or parts of apostrophe contractions and neighboring words are activated; activation is not limited to apostrophes or any one contraction form.
patterns.domain: Colloquial English, forum discussions, and narratives

patterns.name: Questions and interrogative contexts
patterns.context: Interrogative structures, modals, or question-related words are activated, but not all question words or question marks are consistently prominent.

patterns.name: Quotation and dialogue formats
patterns.context: Activations appear near forum quotations, replies, or line breaks; many also occur within quoted text, so the pattern cannot be reduced to formatting markers alone.

patterns.name: Proper names, titles, and internal word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations sometimes occur inside proper names or multiword names, often at token boundaries or near names; there is no common name category.
patterns.domain: Entertainment reviews, film bibliographies, software Q&A, and code

patterns.name: Code syntax and punctuation
patterns.context: Scattered activations near assignments, loops, conditions, fields or method calls, and operators in Go code blocks.

patterns.name: Subwords or boundary fragments within words
patterns.context: A part of a segmented word is marked individually, often alongside the complete word or neighboring fragments; examples show no stable semantic category.
patterns.domain: English text, proper names, and colloquial vocabulary

patterns.name: Hockey narrative vocabulary
patterns.context: Multiple activations occur in descriptions of team performance, goalies, and the puck during games, but these words have no clear connection to triggers in other passages.

patterns.name: Robots and tools
patterns.context: Phrase and action words are activated when discussing machine intelligence enabling robots to autonomously find and use tools.

patterns.name: Album and music reviews
patterns.context: Related nouns, adjectives, and neighboring words are activated when evaluating album versions, playback noise, and musical dynamics.

patterns.name: Policy and app discussions
patterns.context: Activations occur in discussions of policy, Apple, and restricting a particular messaging app; they resemble ordinary conversational word distributions and show no specialized semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Kite action vocabulary
patterns.context: A few activations occur in questions and quotations about kite activities, forces, and control actions.

patterns.name: Spirituality and bibliography vocabulary
patterns.context: Activations occur in contexts involving spiritual book recommendations and psychological-center awakening; no clear connection to patterns in other domains.

patterns.name: Recruitment and player contact
patterns.context: Activations occur while discussing whether a coach contacted or offered an opportunity to a player.

patterns.name: Software documentation and imports
patterns.context: Activations occur in questions about obtaining code, imports, and related documentation.

5_456.description: 激活散布于多领域英语文本的高频词、短语和词内片段，偶见缩写、问句、引述格式、专名及代码；各领域词汇触发零散，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 连续词语与常用短语
patterns.context: 激活分布在自然语言中连续或相邻的词语上，常见于功能词、短语内部及普通实词；没有稳定的单一词汇触发条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言、论坛对话、评论及叙述

patterns.name: 英语否定与缩写形式
patterns.context: 完整否定词或带撇号缩写中的一部分及其邻近词有激活；激活并不只落在撇号或某一种缩写上。
patterns.domain: 口语化英语、论坛讨论与叙述

patterns.name: 问句和疑问语境
patterns.trigger: “Was there a ...?”、“I can grab ...?”、“Is there anywhere I can find ...?”
patterns.context: 疑问句中的疑问结构、情态或问句相关词出现激活，但并非所有疑问词或问句标点都稳定突出。

patterns.name: 引述与对话格式
patterns.context: 论坛引用、回复或换行附近可见激活；但也有许多激活位于引述正文，无法归结为格式标记本身。

patterns.name: 专名、作品名及内部词界
patterns.context: 专名或多词名称内部有时出现激活，常在 token 拆分处或名称邻近位置；没有共同的名称类别。
patterns.domain: 娱乐评论、电影书目、软件问答和代码

patterns.name: 代码语法与标点
patterns.context: Go 代码块中，赋值、循环、条件、字段或方法调用及运算符附近有零散激活。

patterns.name: 词内子词或边界碎片
patterns.context: 拆分词的一部分被单独标记，常与完整词或相邻片段共同出现；不同例子之间未见稳定的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 英语文本、专名及口语词汇

patterns.name: 冰球叙述词汇
patterns.context: 描述球队表现、守门员和比赛中的橡胶球时出现多个激活，但这些词与其他段落中的触发缺少明确共同点。

patterns.name: 机器人与工具
patterns.context: 讨论机器智能让机器人自主寻找并取用工具时，短语和动作词附近激活。
patterns.domain: 机器人与人工智能讨论

patterns.name: 唱片与音乐评价
patterns.context: 评价唱片版本、播放噪声和音乐动态时，相关名词、形容词及其邻近词出现激活。

patterns.name: 政策与应用程序讨论
patterns.trigger: “authoritarian”“get rid of”“apps that exclusively call or text”
patterns.context: 讨论政策、Apple 及限制特定通信应用时出现激活；更像普通对话词语的分布，未显示专属语义触发。

patterns.name: 风筝动作词汇
patterns.context: 围绕风筝运动、受力和操纵动作的问句及引文中出现少量激活。

patterns.name: 灵修与书目词汇
patterns.context: 灵修书籍推荐及心理中心觉醒的语境中有激活；与其他领域的模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 招募与球员访问
patterns.context: 讨论教练是否接触或向某球员提供机会时出现激活。

patterns.name: 软件文档与导入
patterns.context: 询问获取代码、导入项和编辑相关文档时出现激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across patent descriptions of polishing and spinning equipment, geometry and plugs, as well as military organization, proper names, and taxonomic subword fragments in encyclopedia and medical texts; also seen in functional introductions in research texts. More apparent local cues include component terms, names, or numbers, but no single semantic pattern covers all examples.

patterns.name: polishing／surface-treatment equipment
patterns.context: Describes processing workpieces or semiconductor surfaces by polishing, grinding, or chemical-mechanical planarization

patterns.name: Operation of spinning equipment
patterns.context: Discusses the speed and inertia of open-end spinning equipment and yarn withdrawal

patterns.name: Numbers／model numbers or organizational numbering in component names
patterns.context: Numbers are attached to component identifiers, military units, or proper names, often in lists or explanatory text

patterns.name: Subword fragments in titles or proper names
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple tokens, with no clear syntactic or semantic context

patterns.name: Subword fragments in pathogen scientific names
patterns.context: Bacterial scientific names are tokenized, especially Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis

patterns.name: Subword fragments in zipper／hook-and-loop brand names
patterns.context: Manufacturer or product brand names are presented as split tokens

patterns.name: Geometric property descriptions
patterns.context: Mathematical descriptions of a convex body passing through a narrow opening, with a sphere achieving the tightest fit

patterns.name: Plug wear and degraded fit
patterns.context: Changes in grip and fit between an electrical plug and socket contacts as the plug wears

patterns.name: Functional introduction of a core component
patterns.context: Introduces three important uses of Core Component D as the subject

patterns.name: Medical organization names
patterns.context: Names of military medical units appear in quotations and biographical titles

patterns.name: Military organization lists
patterns.context: Lists units belonging to armies during the American Civil War and their time spans

5_702.description: 激活分散于专利中的抛光与纺纱设备、几何及插头描述，以及百科、医学文本中的军队编制、专名和学名分词；另见科研文本的功能引言。较明显的局部线索是部件词、名称或编号，但无单一语义模式覆盖全部。

patterns.name: polishing／表面处理设备
patterns.context: 描述通过抛光、研磨或化学机械平坦化加工工件或半导体表面

patterns.name: 织机纺纱设备运行
patterns.context: 讨论开端纺纱设备的速度、惯性及纱线抽出

patterns.name: 部件名称中的数字／型号或组织序号
patterns.context: 数字附着于部件编号、军队编制或专名，常见于清单、说明文字

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆分成多个 token；无明显句法或语义上下文

patterns.name: 病原体学名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 细菌学名被分词，尤其是 Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis

patterns.name: 拉链／粘扣带品牌名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 制造商或产品品牌名被拆分呈现

patterns.name: 几何性质描述
patterns.context: 关于凸体穿过狭窄开口、并以球体达到最紧配合的数学描述

patterns.name: 插头磨损与配合退化
patterns.context: 电插头磨损后与插座触片的抓持能力及配合变化

patterns.name: 核心部件的功能引言
patterns.trigger: «Core»« Component»« D»« serves»« three»« important»« purposes»
patterns.context: 以 Core Component D 为主语，概述其具有三项重要用途

patterns.name: 医学组织名称
patterns.context: 军事医疗单位名称出现在引语和人物职务中

patterns.name: 军事编制清单
patterns.context: 列出美国内战时期军队所属部队及其时间范围

en.concept: Mixed responses to word forms／subword fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across the string “ok” and its tokenization, “three,” dust-related words, and a few sporadic terms; no single semantic theme explains all examples.

patterns.name: The string “ok” and its tokenization
patterns.context: Appears within or near the beginning of words across different forms and contexts; no fixed syntax is required
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, email, biomedical abstracts, song／lyric titles

patterns.name: The numeral “three”
patterns.context: “three” functions as a numeral modifying “important purposes” and the hyphenated compound “three-dimensional”

patterns.name: “dust” and its compounds
patterns.context: Describes dust contamination or a dust-free state

patterns.name: Several patent／technical terms
patterns.context: These terms appear in different phrases and lack a clear shared semantic or syntactic condition

patterns.name: Tokenization activations in technical prose
patterns.context: Adjacent to patent or technical descriptions, but activations are scattered across multiple common words, making a distinct rule difficult to identify

5_702.concept: 词形/子词片段的混合响应
5_702.description: 激活分散于“ok”字串及其切分、“three”、尘埃相关词和少数零散词项；没有单一语义主题能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: “ok”字串及其切分
patterns.trigger: «ok»，以及 [1] 的 «Po»«pp»、[4] 的 «ok»、[5] 的 «M»«ok»；[3] 中 «ok» 位于 “Cytokine” 内
patterns.context: 出现在词内或词首附近，跨越不同词形和语境；不要求固定句法
patterns.domain: 百科、邮件、生物医学摘要、歌曲/歌词标题

patterns.name: “three”数量词
patterns.context: “three”作为数量词，分别修饰 “important purposes” 和连字符复合词 “three-dimensional”

patterns.name: “dust”及其复合形式
patterns.context: 描述尘埃污染或无尘状态

patterns.name: 若干专利/技术词项
patterns.context: 这些词项各自出现于不同短语中，缺少共同的明显语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 学术谈判文本、网页短语

patterns.name: 技术文体中的分词激活
patterns.context: 与专利或技术描述相邻，但激活分散在多个普通词上，难以确认独立规则

en.description: All excerpts strongly activate at may; various verbs or auxiliary verbs can follow, expressing conjecture, possibility, reference, impact, composition, or reader prompts across diverse domains and syntactic complements.

patterns.name: Possibility expressions following modal may
patterns.context: Activates mainly on the modal verb may, especially when it introduces a statement about a subsequent event, property, or possible explanation; it can be followed directly by a verb or by auxiliaries such as have／be.
patterns.domain: News, research abstracts, patents, encyclopedias, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: may followed by be
patterns.context: be follows may directly, indicating a possible state, property, or result; seen in patent structural descriptions, medical statements, and informational descriptions.

patterns.name: may have been
patterns.context: The perfect form have been follows may to conjecture about a past cause or fact.

patterns.name: may play
patterns.context: play follows may to indicate that a factor may have a role.

patterns.name: may reduce
patterns.context: reduce follows may to propose that an intervention may lower risk.

patterns.name: may refer to
patterns.context: may refer to follows a person's name to introduce possible referents; activation also covers the preceding name and line-break formatting.

patterns.name: may pose
patterns.context: pose follows may to indicate that a process may present a challenge.

patterns.name: may contain
patterns.context: contain follows may to describe possible components of a device or carrier.

patterns.name: Low-intensity may recall
patterns.context: recall follows may in a reader-facing prompt suggesting that the reader might remember something; activation is weaker than the strongest triggers in this set.

5_702.description: 所有片段均在 may 处强激活；后续可接多种动词或助动词，表达推测、可能性、指代、影响、组成或读者提示，领域与句法补语多样。

patterns.name: 情态 may 后的可能性表达
patterns.context: 主要激活于情态动词 may，尤其是它引出对后续事件、属性或可能解释的陈述；可直接接动词，也可接 have/be 等助动词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、科研摘要、专利、百科及一般说明文

patterns.name: may 后接 be
patterns.context: may 后直接接 be，表示可能状态、性质或结果；见于专利结构描述、医学陈述及信息描述。

patterns.name: may have been
patterns.context: may 后接完成式 have been，推测过去原因或事实。

patterns.name: may play
patterns.context: may 后接 play，说明某因素可能发挥作用。

patterns.name: may reduce
patterns.context: may 后接 reduce，提出某干预可能降低风险。

patterns.name: may refer to
patterns.context: 人物姓名后接 may refer to，引出名称的可能指代对象；激活也覆盖前面的姓名及换行格式。

patterns.name: may pose
patterns.context: may 后接 pose，指出某过程可能带来挑战。

patterns.name: may contain
patterns.context: may 后接 contain，描述设备或载体可能包含的组成。

patterns.name: 低强度 may recall
patterns.context: may 后接 recall，面向读者提示其可能记得某事；强度低于同批最强触发。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论或面向读者的叙述

en.concept: Normative follow-up actions in formal texts
en.description: The most stable trigger is shall expressing an obligation or command in legal documents, especially court procedures, filing deadlines, jurisdiction, acceptance, and issuance rules; other examples include partnership clauses, line-break formatting, and sporadic historical, popular-science, and abstract texts, which do not all fit a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Requirements or commands following shall
patterns.context: In legal documents, court orders, or rules, shall is followed by an action that a court, party, or clerk must perform; it also appears in the future-tense expression “we shall call” in a general paper.
patterns.domain: Primarily FreeLaw legal documents; also ArXiv abstracts

patterns.name: Formatting and phrasing in court procedural documents
patterns.context: Court orders, appellate procedures, rules, or decisions, often with line breaks, indentation, and formal procedural language; associated with shall triggers, but not every passage contains shall.

patterns.name: Timing, deadlines, and procedural arrangements
patterns.context: Describes filing deadlines, extensions, durations, or the start time of a procedure; often seen in court orders.

patterns.name: Formation clauses for property／partnership relations
patterns.context: Provides that a partnership is formed immediately when multiple people hold shares and is governed by an agreement.

patterns.name: Duration expression following a coronation
patterns.context: A historical account describes a person dying two and a half days after being crowned; no clear connection to the court-order pattern.

patterns.name: Court retains jurisdiction
patterns.context: An order provides that the court retains jurisdiction during a specified matter.

patterns.name: Record requires further development and response ordered
patterns.context: A criminal procedure ruling requires the record to be supplemented and directs the trial court to take further action.

patterns.name: Popular-science account of appetite and weight
patterns.context: Explains satiety signaling mechanisms and their relevance to suppressing appetite, weight, or eating problems.

patterns.name: Clerk accepts filings and court issues orders
patterns.context: Rules or regulations provide for a clerk to accept prisoner cases or for a court to issue an order after a complaint is filed.

5_702.concept: 正式文本中的规范性后续动作
5_702.description: 最稳定触发是法律文书中表示义务或命令的 shall，尤见法院程序、提交期限、管辖权、受理与签发规定；另有合伙条款、换行格式及零散的历史、科普和摘要文本，不能全归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: shall 后接规定或命令内容
patterns.context: 法律、法院命令或规则中，shall 后接法院、当事人或书记员必须执行的动作；也出现于一般论文中的将来表达 “we shall call”。
patterns.domain: 主要为 FreeLaw 法律文书；另见 ArXiv 摘要

patterns.name: 法院程序文书中的格式与措辞
patterns.trigger: «↵»、«     »、«¶» 及其邻近的法院／brief／motion／Court 等词
patterns.context: 法院命令、上诉程序、规则或判决文本，常有换行、缩进和正式程序表述；与 shall 触发相伴，但不要求每段都有 shall。

patterns.name: 时间、期限及程序安排
patterns.context: 叙述提交期限、延长期限、持续期间或程序启动时点；多见法院命令。

patterns.name: 产权／合伙关系的成立条款
patterns.context: 规定多人持有股份时合伙关系随即成立并受协议约束。

patterns.name: 冠礼及其后的时长表达
patterns.context: 历史叙述中描述人物在加冕后两天半去世；与法律命令模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 法院保留管辖权
patterns.trigger: «Court of Common Pleas shall retain jurisdiction»
patterns.context: 命令规定法院在特定事项期间继续保有管辖权。

patterns.name: 记录需进一步完善及下令回应
patterns.trigger: «record should be further developed»；«trial court shall order»
patterns.context: 刑事程序裁定中要求补充记录，并指示审判法院采取后续行动。

patterns.name: 食欲与体重科普叙述
patterns.context: 说明饱腹信号机制及其对抑制食欲、体重或饮食问题的意义。

patterns.name: 书记员受理文件及法院签发命令
patterns.trigger: «Clerk shall accept»；«court shall issue an order»
patterns.context: 规则或法规规定书记员受理囚犯案件，或法院在提交诉状后签发命令。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 地方法规／程序规则

en.description: Activations are scattered across several local English collocations: the superlative closest, the encyclopedia disambiguation phrase may refer to, emphatic uses of ever, and specific phrases in legal, script, and license texts. There is no apparent shared theme or stable syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: English superlative closest followed by a noun
patterns.context: closest modifies a following noun to express the highest degree of relation or similarity; these two activations are concentrated on closest itself.

patterns.name: may refer to in entry-style definitions
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry title is followed by “may refer to,” introducing a disambiguation list of names, terms, or abbreviations.

patterns.name: Emphatic use of ever
patterns.context: ever appears in expressions emphasizing an extreme or continuing state; one instance occurs in a negative／threatening future expression, and another means as always.

patterns.name: The collocation mutually exclusive
patterns.context: mutually modifies exclusive to describe two configuration options that cannot both hold.

patterns.name: may not in file license terms
patterns.context: A license statement uses may not use to impose a restriction on use.

patterns.name: petitioners in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Refers to the three parties in a legal proceeding involving an involuntary petition.

5_702.description: 激活分散在若干英文局部搭配：closest 最高级、百科消歧句式 may refer to、ever 强调用法，以及法律、脚本和许可文本中的特定词组。没有明显共享的主题或稳定句法模式。

patterns.name: 英文最高级 closest 与后续名词
patterns.context: closest 修饰后续名词，表达关系或相似程度的最高级；这两处激活集中在 closest 本身。

patterns.name: 条目式释义中的 may refer to
patterns.context: 百科条目标题后接“may refer to”，引出名称、词项或缩写的消歧列表。

patterns.name: ever 的强调用法
patterns.context: ever 出现在强调极端或持续状态的表达中；一处嵌于否定/威胁式将来表达，一处表示一如既往。
patterns.domain: 法律判决引述；文学叙述

patterns.name: mutually exclusive 搭配
patterns.context: mutually 修饰 exclusive，描述两个配置项不能同时成立。
patterns.domain: GitHub shell 脚本错误提示

patterns.name: 文件许可条款中的 may not
patterns.context: 许可声明以 may not use 规定使用限制。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码版权/许可证头

patterns.name: 法律程序中的 petitioners
patterns.context: involuntary petition 的法律程序叙述中，指提出申请的三方。

en.description: All excerpts discuss constitutional issues in U.S. legal documents, with activation concentrated on the word “constitutional” and its legal context; specific collocations cover rights, issues, challenges, constitutional homesteads, and judicial authority.

patterns.name: Constitution-related terms
patterns.context: Legal discussion includes constitutional issues, rights, challenges, property regimes, or judicial authority; often occurs mid-sentence alongside legal terms
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

5_702.description: 所有片段都在美国法律文书中讨论宪法问题，激活集中在“constitutional”一词及其法律语境；其具体搭配涵盖权利、问题、挑战、宪法性宅地与司法权限。

patterns.name: 宪法相关术语
patterns.trigger: “constitutional”及其后接法律名词，如“constitutional question”“constitutional right”“constitutional challenge”“constitutional homestead”“constitutional power”
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现宪法问题、权利、挑战、财产制度或司法权限；常见于句中，前后带法律术语

en.description: Most examples come from legal documents, with activations on procedural and review language, party claims, and uses of subject／within; other examples include statements or quotations, subject in online comments, and a novel's call to parents, making a single semantic pattern difficult to identify.

patterns.name: Procedural phrasing in legal opinions
patterns.context: Activations fall on procedural language, standards of review, motions, or argumentative relations in legal documents; also includes “subject-intitle requirement” in a legal provision.
patterns.domain: Court decisions, appeals, and legal pleadings

patterns.name: Parties and case statements in legal pleadings
patterns.context: When legal documents describe party identities, burdens of proof, requests, or claims, activation often falls on words expressing obligation or connecting claims.

patterns.name: The word form subject and its contexts
patterns.context: subject and its compounds or fixed expressions occur in legal passages; paragraph 2 also contains “grasp of the subject,” with activation on subject.

patterns.name: within in noun phrases
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed expressions “the within motion” and “within the entire court-martial” in court rulings, referring respectively to the motion in the case and the overall context.

patterns.name: Quotation／citation contexts in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Activation occurs when a text mentions or directly presents a passage, statement, or quotation; examples appear in both legal decisions and narrative texts.

patterns.name: subject in non-legal online comments
patterns.context: A commenter says that another person understands a topic; activation falls on subject and is not clearly related to the adjacent discussion of Islamophobia.

patterns.name: Word forms related to forms of address or possession
patterns.context: In a narrative, a child calls for their mother as the father is about to arrive; activation is concentrated on the address term Mother.

patterns.name: Possible formatting noise in legal documents
patterns.context: Paragraphs 4, 5, and 6 contain page numbers, paragraph markers, page breaks, or layout whitespace; weaker activations also occur at these positions, but there is no consistent semantic trigger.

5_702.concept: 法律文书措辞与局部搭配
5_702.description: 多数样例来自法律文书，激活落在程序与审查措辞、当事人主张及 subject/within 等用语；另见陈述或引语、网络评论中的 subject，以及小说对父母的呼喊，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律意见中的程序性措辞
patterns.trigger: “subject … requirement”“subject to … review”“within motion”“in light of [their] context within the entire court-martial”等
patterns.context: 激活落在法律文书的程序、审查标准、动议或论证关系用语上；也包括法律条文中的“subject-intitle requirement”。
patterns.domain: 法院判决、上诉及法律诉讼文书

patterns.name: 诉讼文书中的当事人及案件陈述
patterns.trigger: “must establish”“on behalf of the Estate”“Appellant seeks”“appellants, must believe”等
patterns.context: 法律文书中描述当事人身份、举证责任、请求或主张时，常激活在表示义务或连接主张的词上。

patterns.name: subject 词形及其语境
patterns.context: 法律段落中出现 subject 及其复合形式或固定搭配；第2段也有“grasp of the subject”，但激活在 subject。
patterns.domain: 法律文本；另有网络评论

patterns.name: 名词短语中的 within
patterns.context: 出现在法院裁定的固定表达“the within motion”以及“within the entire court-martial”中，分别指本案动议和整体语境。

patterns.name: 裁判意见中的引用／引述语境
patterns.context: 文本在提及或直接呈现某段话、陈述或引语时出现激活；法律判决与叙事文本均有例子。

patterns.name: 非法律网络评论中的 subject
patterns.context: 评论者称对方理解某个主题，激活落在 subject；与相邻的 Islamophobia 论述无明显关联。

patterns.name: 人物称谓或所有格相关词形
patterns.context: 叙事中孩子喊母亲、父亲将要到来；激活集中在称呼语 Mother。

patterns.name: 可能的法律文书格式噪声
patterns.context: 第4、5、6段包含页码、段落标记、分页符或排版空白；这些位置也有较弱激活，但缺乏一致语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 扫描／排版后的法律文本

en.description: Activations are concentrated on multiple uses of subject: legal jurisdiction, the entity governed by subject to, and a topic or research object; the word Objectors in conscientious objectors also activates strongly.

patterns.name: The legal term subject-matter jurisdiction
patterns.context: Appears in federal court litigation or decision narratives, often near want of, jurisdiction, suit, court, and related words; paragraph 4 contains the split-token form subject matter.

patterns.name: subject to meaning governed by or applicable to
patterns.context: subject is followed by to, introducing a person or thing governed by a rule, restriction, condition, or scope of applicability; the specific meanings differ across paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, encyclopedia entries, religious and folk-custom descriptions

patterns.name: subject(s) meaning topic or object
patterns.context: subject refers to a topic, research object, or object in philosophical ontology; includes a single-issue rule in a legal context and a title use of object-oriented.

patterns.name: conscientious objectors
patterns.context: Appears in the title of a guidebook for Jewish draft registrants, referring to people who conscientiously refuse military service; Objectors is an independent lexical sense, not an object-oriented use.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia bibliography, religion, and social issues

5_702.description: 激活集中于 subject 的多种用法：法律管辖权、subject to 的受约束对象、议题或研究对象；另对 conscientious objectors 一词中的 Objectors 强烈激活。

patterns.name: subject-matter jurisdiction 法律术语
patterns.context: 出现在联邦法院诉讼或判决叙述中，常与 want of、jurisdiction、suit、court 等词相邻；第4段是 subject matter 的分词断裂形式。

patterns.name: subject to 表示受制于或适用对象
patterns.context: subject 后接 to，引出受某规则、限制、条件或适用范围约束的人或事物；各段具体语义不同。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科条目、宗教民俗说明

patterns.name: subject(s) 表示议题或对象
patterns.context: subject 指议题、研究对象或哲学本体论中的对象；包括法律中的单一议题规则及 object-oriented 的标题用法。

patterns.name: conscientious objectors
patterns.context: 出现在犹太裔征兵登记者的指南书名中，指良心拒服兵役者；Objectors 是独立词义，不是 object-oriented 用法。
patterns.domain: 百科书目、宗教与社会议题

en.concept: Recognition of the word form Object
en.description: Most paragraphs activate on Object／object and its compounds or code identifiers, including code and object-oriented terminology; other sporadic activations include nature／subject in JSON, own in legal texts, and may in a quotation, which do not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: Object-related words
patterns.context: Forms vary in capitalization and code-identifier style; often occur in compounds, variable names, strings, or technical terms.
patterns.domain: Software code, computer-science academic texts, and literary criticism

patterns.name: JSON fields and category words
patterns.context: In JSON-style data, a field value or category name is marked; this differs from the Object word-form pattern.

patterns.name: own in a legal sentence
patterns.context: Appears in the possessive phrase “her own citizens.”

patterns.name: may in a quotation
patterns.context: Appears in a quotation about an individual possessing a weapon, expressing possibility or permission.

5_702.description: 多数段落在 Object/object 及其复合词或代码标识符处激活，涉及代码、面向对象术语等；另有 JSON 中的 nature/subject、法律文本 own、引文 may 等零散激活，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: Object 相关词
patterns.context: 大小写及代码标识符形式不一；常出现在复合词、变量名、字符串或技术术语中。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、计算机学术文本及文学批评

patterns.name: JSON 字段与类别词
patterns.context: JSON 样式数据中，字段值或类别名称被标记；与 Object 词形模式不同。

patterns.name: 法律句中的 own
patterns.context: 出现在“her own citizens”这一所有格短语中。

patterns.name: 引文中的 may
patterns.context: 出现在关于个人持有武器的引文中，表达可能性或许可。

en.description: The most prominent shared trigger is lowercase may, distributed across varied sentence structures and styles; other examples include Cross- in legal titles, a few addresses, sports terms, proper-name tokenization, layout boundaries, and sporadic common-word activations, with no clear semantic connection between these secondary patterns and may.

patterns.name: Positions containing may
patterns.context: Lowercase may appears mid-sentence, followed by a verb or adjective, expressing possibility, permission, or suggestion; occurs in both numbered entries and body text
patterns.domain: Various texts including news, encyclopedias, email, legal texts, and book reviews

patterns.name: Cross- terms in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal case titles or party listings, Cross- occurs within a compound litigation-role name

patterns.name: may near numeric or numbered boundaries
patterns.context: may is adjacent to a year, number, or other entry text, but the context remains an ordinary English sentence; boundaries and formatting vary

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in personal names or titles
patterns.context: Ordinary words in news headlines or body text, sometimes split into subword fragments; no stable semantic or syntactic conditions are apparent

patterns.name: Proper names and layout fragments
patterns.context: Proper-name tokenization and boundary tokens caused by web links, title line breaks, or encyclopedia entry formatting; activations are sporadic

patterns.name: Fifth in an address field
patterns.context: A street address in an email signature, with the ordinal Fifth followed by Avenue

patterns.name: first in first-class
patterns.context: A compound describing a category of cricket match in an encyclopedia biography

patterns.name: Bullet points and separators
patterns.context: Bullet-point wording or horizontal rules in book／quotation text

5_702.description: 最显著的共同触发是小写 may，分布于多种句式与文体；另有法律标题中的 Cross-、少量地址、体育词、专名分词、排版边界及零散普通词激活，未见这些次要模式与 may 有明确语义联系。

patterns.name: may 所在位置
patterns.context: 小写 may 出现在句中，后接动词或形容词，表示可能、许可或建议；在编号条目和正文中均出现
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、邮件、法律、书评等多种文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的交叉上诉词
patterns.context: 法律案件标题或当事人列示中，Cross- 位于复合诉讼身份名称内

patterns.name: 数字或编号边界附近的 may
patterns.context: may 紧邻年份、数字或其他条目文本，但语境仍是普通英文句子；边界和格式各异
patterns.domain: 百科条目、书目/商品介绍

patterns.name: 人名或标题中的零散激活
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题或正文中的普通词，且有时被拆分成词片；未见稳定语义或句法条件

patterns.name: 专名与排版碎片
patterns.context: 网页链接、标题换行或百科条目格式造成的专名分词及边界 token；激活零散

patterns.name: 地址字段中的 Fifth
patterns.context: 邮件签名中的街道地址，序数词 Fifth 后接 Avenue

patterns.name: first-class 中的 first
patterns.context: 百科人物传记中描述板球比赛类别的复合词

patterns.name: 项目符号及分隔线
patterns.context: 书籍/引文文本中的项目符号措辞或水平分隔线

en.description: Activations occur across diverse styles and topics, often on subword fragments within words or adjacent word segments. Local patterns include cricket first-class, criminal judgment wording, catalog entries, addresses, and discussions of firearms; they cannot be reduced to a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Specific word segments within phrases
patterns.context: Activations fall on part of a complete word or phrase, often with activation on the following segment as well; the triggering segments do not form a unified semantic category.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, Gutenberg novel catalogs, Enron emails, legal texts, and webpages

patterns.name: Cricket first-class matches
patterns.context: When describing historical cricket matches or player records, first-class modifies matches, competitions, or games.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sports biographies and cricket history

patterns.name: Legal criminal judgment wording
patterns.context: Describes murder charges, life imprisonment without parole, appellate review, or criminal records in criminal cases.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of state names
patterns.context: Illinois appears split into subword fragments; one occurrence is in a place-name list and another in a link path.
patterns.domain: News link lists and Enron emails

patterns.name: Literary catalog entries
patterns.context: Bibliographic or catalog entries list titles and authors in aligned formatting.

patterns.name: Names, dates, and classical bibliography entries
patterns.context: Brief bibliographic entries give author, date, region, or work information.

patterns.name: Addresses in email signatures
patterns.context: The signature block after the email body contains an organization, street address, and floor.

patterns.name: Firearms and statements about personal discretion
patterns.context: Discusses the right and discretion to own or use firearms.

patterns.name: Doctrinal controversy and papal bulls
patterns.context: Describes controversy over the doctrine of apostolic poverty and how papal documents characterized it.

5_702.description: 激活分布在多种文体与主题中，常落在词语内部片段或相邻词段；可见板球 first-class、刑事判决措辞、目录条目、地址和枪支论述等局部模式，无法归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 短语内部的特定词段
patterns.trigger: “heresy”中的 «here»、«first-class» 中的 «first»、«May» 中的 «may»、以及 «struggle» 中的 «Stru»
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或词组的一部分，且通常紧随其后的词段也有激活；触发部分并不构成统一语义类别。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、古腾堡小说目录、Enron 邮件、法律文本及网页

patterns.name: 板球 first-class 赛事
patterns.context: 描述历史板球比赛或球员履历时，first-class 修饰比赛、赛事或场次。
patterns.domain: 维基百科体育传记与板球史

patterns.name: 法律刑事判决措辞
patterns.context: 刑事案件中说明谋杀罪名、无假释终身监禁、上诉审查或前科。

patterns.name: 州名的分词片段
patterns.context: Illinois 被拆成词段出现；一处在地名列表，一处在链接路径中。
patterns.domain: 新闻链接列表与 Enron 邮件

patterns.name: 文学作品目录条目
patterns.context: 书目或目录以作品名、作者名和对齐排版列出条目。

patterns.name: 人名、年代与古典书目条目
patterns.context: 简短参考书目条目给出作者、年代、地域或作品信息。

patterns.name: 邮件签名中的地址
patterns.context: 邮件正文结束后的签名栏包含机构、街道地址和楼层。

patterns.name: 枪支与个人裁量表述
patterns.context: 论述个人持有或使用枪支的权利及裁量。

patterns.name: 教义争议与教皇诏书
patterns.context: 描述基督贫穷教义争议及教皇文件对其定性。

en.concept: Expressions of frequency and quantity of components
en.description: Primarily responds to component expressions like two parts/portions and frequency or multiplicative words such as once and twice. There are also sporadic triggers like before and here; some activations may jointly reflect counting semantics or local sentence structure.

patterns.name: “two parts/portions” structure
patterns.context: When introducing the components of a method, system, or software, the quantity word two is followed by parts/portions, often introducing an explanation of the components.

patterns.name: twice meaning two times or double
patterns.context: Describes something happening two times or a quantity being double another; activation falls on twice.

patterns.name: once meaning one time or formerly
patterns.context: Indicates a single occurrence or is used in a temporal expression meaning “formerly”; appears in narratives or legal arguments.

patterns.name: before meaning earlier or prior to
patterns.context: Indicates that an event occurred before another event, involving event order.

patterns.name: here pointing to the current object or location
patterns.context: Introduces the content being provided in a quoted email (“here it is”) or identifies the speaker’s role (“dev here”).

patterns.name: thought once how
patterns.context: A past thought recalled in literary poetry; beyond once, there is no clear shared triggering structure.

patterns.name: once but twice emphasizing repeated failure to act
patterns.context: A fixed contrastive phrase in a legal argument emphasizing that a party failed to act on two occasions.

patterns.name: Double counting in a paragraph
patterns.context: A personal narrative states that two roles each occurred twice; activation is on twice.

patterns.name: Twice as long multiplicative comparison
patterns.context: Compares the length of two bibliographies, expressing that the former is twice as long as the latter.

5_702.description: 主要响应 two parts/portions 的组成表达，以及 once、twice 等次数或倍数词；另有 before、here 等零散触发，部分激活可能由计数语义或局部句式共同造成。

patterns.name: “two parts/portions”结构
patterns.context: 在介绍方法、系统或软件组成时，数量词 two 后接 parts/portions，常引出组成说明。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、医学摘要

patterns.name: twice 表示两次或两倍
patterns.context: 描述某事发生两次，或某数量为另一数量的两倍；激活落在 twice 上。

patterns.name: once 表示一次或曾经
patterns.context: 表示一次发生，或用于“曾经”的时间表达；出现在叙述或法律论证中。

patterns.name: before 表示先前或此前
patterns.context: 表示某事件发生在另一事件之前，涉及事件顺序。

patterns.name: here 指示当前对象或所在处
patterns.context: 在邮件引述中引出当前提供的内容（“here it is”），或自我介绍所在身份（“dev here”）。

patterns.name: thought once how
patterns.context: 文学诗歌中回忆过去的一段思绪；除 once 外没有明显共享触发结构。

patterns.name: once but twice 强调重复错失
patterns.context: 法律论证中用固定对举短语强调某方两次未采取行动。

patterns.name: 段落中的双重计数
patterns.context: 个人经历叙述中并列说明两种身份各出现两次；激活在 twice。

patterns.name: Twice as long 的倍数比较
patterns.context: 比较两类书目长度，表达前者为后者两倍。

en.description: Activations show diverse local lexical and structural patterns: expressions with things/thing, legal judgment terminology, think(s), parts, code assignment symbols, and first degree murder. There is no clear triggering pattern shared across all segments.

patterns.name: things followed by a clause or complement
patterns.context: Occurs in English expressions such as “one of the things …,” “6 things that …,” and “one thing in particular”; nearby complements or modifiers often include that, about, and to know.

patterns.name: Legal adjudication and appeal terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a judicial citation in a statutory list and in a judge’s opinion at the end of a judgment.

patterns.name: Use of think(s) in quotations
patterns.context: Appears in a quotation or paraphrase to express someone’s view; the former has “One of the” nearby, while the latter is in the first person.

patterns.name: Method divided into several parts
patterns.context: Describes the components of a research method, followed immediately by an introduction to the first part.

patterns.name: Assignment equals sign in code
patterns.context: Appears in a JavaScript assignment expression, with a function call on the right-hand side.

patterns.name: first degree in a criminal charge
patterns.context: Occurs with “degree murder” to describe the charge against a defendant.

5_702.description: 激活呈现多种局部词汇与结构：things/thing 的表达、法律判决术语、think(s)、parts、代码赋值符号及 first degree murder；没有明显覆盖所有段的统一触发模式。

patterns.name: things 后接从句或补语
patterns.context: 出现在英语表达 “one of the things …”“6 things that …”“one thing in particular” 等中；附近常有 that、about、to know 等补语或修饰语。

patterns.name: 法律裁判与上诉用语
patterns.context: 分别出现在法条枚举的司法引证和判决末尾的法官意见中。

patterns.name: 引文中 think(s) 的用法
patterns.context: 出现在引文或转述中，表达某人的看法；前者附近有 “One of the”，后者是第一人称表达。

patterns.name: 方法分成若干部分
patterns.context: 描述研究方法的组成，并紧接着介绍第一部分。

patterns.name: 代码中的赋值等号
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript 赋值表达式中，右侧是函数调用。

patterns.name: 刑事罪名中的 first degree
patterns.context: 与 “degree murder” 连用，描述被告所受指控。

en.concept: Responses to local vocabulary and sentence structures
en.description: Activations are most concentrated on “in part” and part/parts, used for argumentative grounds or method components. There are also sporadic responses to local words or sentence structures such as exception, except that, subjecting, objected, wish, and things, across legal, academic, patent, and forum texts.

patterns.name: “part” and argumentative dependence
patterns.context: Appears in sentences explaining the basis of an argument or components of a method; “part(s)” itself and nearby words show marked activation.
patterns.domain: Legal arguments, philosophy papers, scientific method descriptions

patterns.name: “exception” and its sentence boundary
patterns.context: When reporting results, exception introduces an exception and is immediately followed by a period; the period is also marked as active.

patterns.name: “except that” qualifying a method
patterns.context: Describes an experimental design or method as matching an existing method, but with a qualifying difference.

patterns.name: Patent claims wording with “subjecting”
patterns.context: Appears in patent chemistry text, describing a compound being placed under some treatment or reaction.

patterns.name: Objection during questioning
patterns.context: In courtroom question-and-answer proceedings, the state's attorney objects to a question; the court then overrules the objection.

patterns.name: “wish” expressing a desire
patterns.context: In a social website discussion, a speaker expresses a wish for Facebook chat functionality.

patterns.name: “things” introducing a writing topic
patterns.context: In a quoted forum excerpt, “One of the things about writing” begins a discussion of the characteristics of writing.

5_702.description: 激活最集中于 “in part” 及 part/parts，用于论证依据或方法组成；另对 exception、except that、subjecting、objected、wish 和 things 等局部词语或句式有零散响应，跨越法律、学术、专利与论坛文本。

patterns.name: “part”与论证依赖关系
patterns.trigger: “in”后接“part”，如 “relies in part on”“relying in part on”“relied in part on”；另有 “parts”
patterns.context: 出现在说明论证依据或方法组成部分的句子中；“part(s)”本身及邻近词有显著激活。
patterns.domain: 法律论证、哲学论文、科学方法描述

patterns.name: “exception”及其句界
patterns.context: 报告结果时，以 exception 引出例外，并紧接句号；句号也被标记为激活。

patterns.name: “except that”方法限定
patterns.context: 描述实验构造或方法与既有方法相同、但存在限定差异。

patterns.name: “subjecting”专利权利要求用语
patterns.context: 出现在专利化学文本中，描述将化合物置于某种处理或反应之下。

patterns.name: 质询中的反对
patterns.context: 法庭庭审问答中，州方律师对问题提出异议；随后法院驳回异议。

patterns.name: “wish”表达愿望
patterns.context: 社交网站讨论中，发言者表达希望获得 Facebook 聊天功能。

patterns.name: “things”引出写作话题
patterns.context: 论坛引用摘录中，以 “One of the things about writing” 开始谈写作特点。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: many examples center on thing followed by a comment or explanation; others include legal requests with seeking, clarification questions with mean, and a channel receive symbol and identifier try in code. They span domains, with no unified semantics apparent.

patterns.name: “thing” followed by a predicate
patterns.context: The noun “thing” serves as the topic, subject, or object in a discourse or sentence, followed by an explanation, evaluation, or elaboration; some examples use “Good thing” to introduce a comment.
patterns.domain: News, forums, Q&A, and everyday narratives

patterns.name: Legal relief introduced by “seeking”
patterns.context: Appears in court documents describing summary judgment motions, with “seeking” introducing the relief requested from the court.

patterns.name: “mean” introducing a clarification or definition question
patterns.context: Asks for confirmation or an explanation of preceding content; one example discusses international trade barriers, while another asks whether war includes ancient wars.

patterns.name: Receive operation in code
patterns.context: A channel receive expression in a Go concurrency example; activation falls on the receive symbol.

patterns.name: “try” in an identifier
patterns.context: Appears in the example code function or identifier name `defun org-try-merging-last-clock`, not as ordinary English.

5_702.description: 激活模式分散：多例集中在 thing 及其后续评论或说明，另有 seeking 法律请求、mean 澄清提问，以及代码中的通道接收符号和标识符 try。它们跨领域，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: “thing”及紧随其后的谓语
patterns.trigger: “thing”后接“happens”（[1]）、“we didn't have to…”（[3]）、“is how…”（[4]）、“that those graphs…”（[5]）、“about design…”（[10]）；另有反复出现的短语“Good thing”（[3]、[5]）
patterns.context: 名词“thing”作为话语或句子中的话题、主语或宾语，后面接说明、评价或补充内容；部分例子是“Good thing”引出的评论。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛、问答及日常叙述

patterns.name: “seeking”所引出的法律诉求
patterns.context: 出现在法院文件对 summary judgment motions 的描述中，“seeking”引出请求法院给予的救济。

patterns.name: “mean”引出澄清或释义问题
patterns.context: 对前文内容提出确认或解释性追问；一例谈国际贸易壁垒，另一例询问战争是否包括古代战争。

patterns.name: 代码中的接收操作
patterns.context: Go 并发接收器示例中的通道接收表达式；激活落在接收符号上。

patterns.name: 标识符中的“try”
patterns.context: 出现在示例代码的函数或标识符名称 `defun org-try-merging-last-clock` 内，并非普通英语用法。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、Emacs Lisp 代码

en.description: Activations occur across diverse local patterns: thing and predicates for events or surprises, except introducing exceptions, litigation procedure expressions, quantity phrases, code function assignments, and a French word-internal fragment. These patterns span domains, with no single unified trigger condition apparent.

patterns.name: “thing(s) happens/surprises” expression
patterns.context: thing is followed by a predicate indicating that something happens or causes surprise; both examples occur in quotations or colloquial comments.

patterns.name: except exception/condition clauses
patterns.context: except introduces a methodological exception, applicability condition, or alternative operation, followed by a that-clause, prepositional phrase, or gerund.

patterns.name: Procedural terms in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes court cases, motions, and requests for relief; activations concentrate on procedural expressions such as alternative and seeking.

patterns.name: Quantity or proportion descriptions
patterns.context: Locally involves quantities, proportions, or one/thing phrases; in 1 it occurs in mortality statistics, while in 6 it appears within a quotation.

patterns.name: Function and assignment structures in code
patterns.context: At the beginning of a JavaScript function body, with braces, newline indentation, a variable declaration, and an assignment.

patterns.name: Accented-letter fragments within French words
patterns.context: Activation markers fall on subword fragments of French words, involving accented letters and word-final morphology; no clear shared syntactic condition is apparent.

5_702.description: 激活分布于多种局部模式：thing 与事件/意外谓语、except 引出例外、诉讼程序表达、数量短语、代码函数赋值及法语词内片段。模式跨领域，未见单一统一触发条件。

patterns.name: “thing(s) happens/surprises”表达
patterns.context: thing 后接表示发生或带来意外的谓语；均处于引述或口语化评论中。

patterns.name: except 例外/条件从句
patterns.context: except 引出方法上的例外、适用条件或替代操作，后续接 that 从句、介词短语或动名词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法、学术论文

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的程序性词语
patterns.context: 描述法院案件、动议及救济请求；激活集中于 alternative、seeking 等程序性表达。

patterns.name: 数量或比例描述
patterns.context: 局部涉及数量、比例或 one/thing 短语；1 中为死亡统计，6 中嵌在引语内。

patterns.name: 代码中的函数与赋值结构
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数体开头，包含花括号、换行缩进、变量声明和赋值。

patterns.name: 法语词内部的重音字母片段
patterns.context: 激活标记落在法语单词的子词片段中，涉及重音字母及词尾构词；未见明确的共同句法条件。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to “one hand” in the fixed phrase “on the one hand,” used to introduce one side of an argument and establish a contrast; it also responds to the French equivalent “d’une part.” The pattern appears across disciplines and styles.

patterns.name: “on the one hand” contrastive structure
patterns.context: The phrase introduces one side or point, paired with another side, the other hand, or a contrast later in the text; sometimes the latter does not appear in the excerpt.
patterns.domain: Formal argumentation in academic papers, legal texts, and news discussions

patterns.name: French “d’une part”
patterns.context: Introduces one side of an argument, usually anticipating a contrast with another side or a subsequent result.

patterns.name: “on the one hand” for conceptual contrasts
patterns.context: Uses the phrase to organize a comparison between two sets of concepts; this example shares the fixed phrase with the other segments, but “and” follows it directly.

5_702.description: 主要对固定搭配“on the one hand”中的“one hand”强烈响应，用于引出论述的一方并建立对照；也响应法语对应表达“d’une part”。覆盖不同学科与文体。

patterns.name: “on the one hand” 对照结构
patterns.trigger: «one»« hand»，常见形式为“on the one hand”；[1]–[9]多在“hand”处最强
patterns.context: 该短语引出一方或一项，与后文另一方、另一方面或对照项并列；有时后文尚未出现在片段中
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律文本、新闻讨论等正式论述

patterns.name: 法语“d’une part”
patterns.context: 用于提出论述的一方，通常预示与另一面或后续结果形成对照

patterns.name: “on the one hand”用于概念对举
patterns.context: 以该短语组织两组概念的比较；本例与其他段落同样出现该固定搭配，但搭配后直接接“and”

en.concept: Introducing an item in a list
en.description: Many patterns share one/One introducing and elaborating on one item among several: legal lists, statutory deadlines, sports colloquialisms, experimental conditions, and case reports; triggering contexts and styles vary.

patterns.name: Introducing an exception or individual item after a list in legal arguments
patterns.context: A legal text first states several motions, errors, reasons, judgment outcomes, or document contents, then uses one to introduce and elaborate on an item; it is often followed by of which, exception, or part.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw judgments, legal arguments, and legal documents

patterns.name: Parenthetical repetition of a deadline number in statutes
patterns.context: A statute first states a deadline of one year, then repeats the number of years in parentheses; the surrounding provisions concern contracts, residential exemptions, and written form.

patterns.name: Positive-event expression in sports quotations
patterns.context: In an interview quotation about an NFL rookie and what he anticipates, one good thing happens begins an example or reassuring expression.

patterns.name: Experimental groups and individual conditions
patterns.context: Research methods identify one of two groups or experimental parts and explain its treatment or experimental condition.

patterns.name: An individual case among a number of cases
patterns.context: A report on human cases of parasitic disease identifies one among several cases and describes the patient.

5_702.description: 多处模式共享 one/One 引出多个对象中的一项并展开说明：法律列举、法条期限、体育口语、实验条件和病例报告；触发语境及文体各异。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的列举后引出例外/个别项
patterns.context: 法律文本先陈述多个动议、错误、理由、判决结果或文件内容，再以 one 引出其中一项及其具体说明；后续常接 of which、exception 或 part。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决、法律论证及法律文件

patterns.name: 法条中期限数字的括号重复
patterns.context: 法条先写期限 one year，随后用括号数字重复年数；周围是关于契约、住宅豁免及书面形式的规范。

patterns.name: 体育引语中的积极事件表达
patterns.context: NFL 新秀及其期待的采访引语中，以 one good thing happens 开始举例或宽慰式表达。

patterns.name: 实验分组与单项条件
patterns.context: 研究方法中从两个组或两个实验部分中指出其中一个，并交代其处理方式或实验条件。

patterns.name: 病例数量中的单个病例
patterns.context: 报告寄生虫病的人类病例时，从多个病例中指出其中一例并描述患者。

en.description: Most segments activate on “on the one hand” and nearby words in argumentative texts, including memory research, patents, biomedicine, astrophysics, pollution, and philosophy. There are also isolated activations in code structures and legal deed wording.

patterns.name: “on the one hand” sentence structure
patterns.context: Occurs in the paired contrast or exposition structure “on the one hand …”; sometimes the preceding on is unmarked, while punctuation or following words after hand may also be marked.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patents, legal texts, philosophy, and social science argumentation

patterns.name: Code or structured data snippet
patterns.context: In nested objects or JSON-like code/data structures, activations concentrate on field names, brackets, and indentation; the phrase “on the one hand” is absent.

patterns.name: Deed narrative in legal documents
patterns.context: In an account of a date, sheriff's certificate, and deed transfer, activation falls on quoted legal-document wording and phrase boundaries; the segment does not contain “on the one hand”.

5_702.description: 多数片段在论述性文本中激活于“on the one hand”及其邻近词，涵盖记忆研究、专利、生物医学、天体物理、污染与哲学等；另有代码结构和法律契据措辞两类孤立激活。

patterns.name: “on the one hand”句式
patterns.context: 处于成对对照或分述论证的“on the one hand …”结构中；有时前面的 on 未标记，有时也有 hand 后的标点或后续词被标记。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、法律文本、哲学与社会科学论述

patterns.name: 代码或结构化数据片段
patterns.trigger: «place»、«nested»、«{»、«chunks»等，周围有引号、冒号、下划线及缩进换行
patterns.context: 嵌套对象或类似 JSON 的代码/数据结构中，激活集中在字段名、括号和缩进处；未见“on the one hand”短语。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的契据叙述
patterns.context: 日期、警长证书及契据转让的叙述中，激活落在引述法律文书措辞和短语边界；该片段未出现“on the one hand”。

en.concept: Local structural markers and fixed phrases
en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: “on the one hand” in academic argumentation, “in part” and motion terminology in legal texts, newlines, indentation, and syntax markers in code, and sample numbers in medical results. Local formatting and common phrases may also contribute.

patterns.name: on the one hand sentence structure
patterns.context: Occurs in an “on the one hand” contrastive or argumentative structure; activation concentrates on hand, and several instances also include the following comma.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, memory research; argumentative narratives in legal documents

patterns.name: in part in legal documents
patterns.context: In accounts of deed contents or citations of judgment provisions, the phrase is followed by a specific statement.

patterns.name: Structural newlines and indentation in code
patterns.context: Code/JSON-like text contains newlines, indentation, and nested structures; activations fall on tokens related to newlines and indentation.

patterns.name: Procedural phrases in legal cases
patterns.context: Procedural accounts of court cases, especially summaries of summary judgment motions and the relief they request.

patterns.name: Statistical figures in ophthalmology research results
patterns.context: The results section reports sample statistics by group, including patients, eyes, and sex.

patterns.name: Unexplained code snippet markers
patterns.context: A code output contains fragments resembling grid/boundary descriptions; the relationship between these markers and the main pattern cannot be determined from the excerpt.

patterns.name: Unexplained JSON field content
patterns.context: Field names and array contents appear within a JSON/configuration structure; activations mainly fall on newlines and indentation, while the field-level pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Unexplained program syntax fragment
patterns.context: Activations occur near C-style code control flow and parentheses/braces, but do not fully match the newline-indentation pattern.

5_702.concept: 局部结构标记与固定短语
5_702.description: 激活模式分散：学术论述中的“on the one hand”、法律文本中的“in part”及动议术语、代码里的换行缩进和语法标记、医学结果的样本数字。也可能受局部格式与常见短语影响。

patterns.name: on the one hand 句式
patterns.context: 出现在“on the one hand”对照或论述结构中；激活集中于 hand，多个实例还包含后续逗号
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、记忆研究；法律文书中的论证叙述

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 in part
patterns.context: 法律文件叙述契据内容或引用判决条款时，短语后接具体陈述

patterns.name: 代码中的结构性换行与缩进
patterns.context: 代码/类 JSON 文本中出现换行、缩进和嵌套结构；激活落在换行与缩进相关 token 上

patterns.name: 法律案件程序短语
patterns.context: 法院案件的程序性叙述，尤其概述简易判决动议及其请求

patterns.name: 眼科研究结果中的统计数字
patterns.context: 结果部分按组报告患者、眼数与性别等样本统计
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要/研究结果

patterns.name: 未解释的代码片段标记
patterns.context: 代码输出中出现类似网格/边界描述的片段；无法从片段确定这些标记与主模式的关系

patterns.name: 未解释的 JSON 字段内容
patterns.context: JSON/配置结构内的字段名和数组内容，激活主要落在换行及缩进，而字段本身的模式不清楚

patterns.name: 未解释的程序语法片段
patterns.context: C 风格代码控制流与括号/大括号附近出现激活，但不完全等同于换行缩进模式

en.concept: Subwords after spaces and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on L subwords with a leading space and a few fixed subwords; it also covers formatting features such as code configuration, JSON, legal citations, years, names, and line breaks, with semantic domains scattered.

patterns.name: L characters in special formatting
patterns.context: The letter L appears as a standalone fragment or a subword with a leading space in structured text, names, citations, or medical terms; the following content varies.

patterns.name: Language model configuration marker
patterns.context: In GitHub code, the marker sequence occurs in a configuration-key-like structure, followed by DataKinds or FlexibleContexts

patterns.name: Substring within obtained
patterns.context: Appears in the hyphenated compound “-obtained”, preceded by “fraudulently-” or “as-”; the surrounding word meanings have no apparent shared theme with this substring

patterns.name: L. monocytogenes pathogen name
patterns.context: In a medical abstract, as part of the name of an infectious pathogen

patterns.name: L in legal citations
patterns.context: In statutory or legal citation formats, L. follows a volume-page citation

patterns.name: s in year numbers
patterns.context: The suffix s after a year number is marked in expressions such as “1190s in England”

patterns.name: Record structure in JSON data
patterns.context: Example data consists of objects, key-value pairs, and repeated names, including names and street addresses

patterns.name: L subwords in names
patterns.context: Names are tokenized into multiple subwords; activation falls on the initial surname fragment and subsequent subwords

patterns.name: End-of-line and whitespace line-break markers
patterns.context: Activation appears at line breaks after code snippets, entries, or names, often alongside consecutive blank lines

5_711.concept: 空格后子词与格式边界
5_711.description: 激活最一致地落在带前导空格的 L 子词及少数固定子词上；另涵盖代码配置、JSON、法律引注、年代、人名和换行等格式特征，语义领域分散。

patterns.name: 特殊格式中的 L 字符
patterns.context: 字母 L 作为独立片段或带前导空格的子词出现在结构化文本、姓名、引文或医学术语中；各处后续内容不同

patterns.name: 语言模型配置标记
patterns.context: GitHub 代码中，标记序列处于类似配置键的结构里，后接 DataKinds 或 FlexibleContexts

patterns.name: obtained 内部子串
patterns.context: 出现在连字符复合词“-obtained”中，前接“fraudulently-”或“as-”；周围词义与该子串无明显共同主题
patterns.domain: 法律文本、材料科学摘要

patterns.name: L. monocytogenes 病原体名称
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，作为感染病原体名称的一部分

patterns.name: 法律引注中的 L
patterns.context: 法条或法律引注格式中，L. 位于卷页引用之后

patterns.name: 年代数字中的 s
patterns.context: “1190s in England”一类年代表达中，年代数字后缀 s 被标记

patterns.name: JSON 数据中的记录结构
patterns.context: 示例数据以对象、键值对和重复姓名构成，包含姓名及街道地址

patterns.name: 姓名中的字母 L 子词
patterns.context: 人名被分词为多个子词；激活落在姓氏开头片段及后续子词

patterns.name: 行尾及空白换行标记
patterns.context: 激活出现于代码片段、条目或人名之后的换行位置，常伴随连续空行
patterns.domain: 代码、百科条目、数据文本

en.description: Activation most consistently appears on uppercase L subword fragments after a space; what follows may belong to code keys, names, medical terms, email names, or legal abbreviations. Other instances include code metadata, year expressions, and miscellaneous line breaks.

patterns.name: L-prefix subword fragments
patterns.context: The letter L begins a following word or abbreviation, often adjacent to other segmented subword fragments; it sometimes occurs in proper names, institution names, or citations.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; including code, medicine, biographical entries, email, and legal citations

patterns.name: Language marker in code
patterns.context: Appears in YAML-like key-value metadata, followed by fields such as Data Kinds or Flexible Contexts.

patterns.name: Numbers and s in years
patterns.context: An s follows a sequence of digits to form the English year expression “1190s”, followed by a place and an event-entry format.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in line-broken name entries
patterns.context: Names are split into multiple subword tokens, appearing in entry titles, repeated names, or at the start of entries.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Multiple medical words are segmented into in-word fragments; the same passage also contains « L»isteria.

patterns.name: L.R.R.M. abbreviation in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears after page numbers and volume information in case citations.

patterns.name: L-initial portion of a name in email
patterns.context: Part of a possessive name, occurring in a request and attachment description.

patterns.name: Unmergeable line breaks and entry fragments
patterns.context: Multiple line breaks are adjacent to truncated fragments; no stable shared trigger can be determined from the fragments.

5_711.concept: 大写 L 起始片段
5_711.description: 激活最稳定地出现在空格后的大写 L 子词片段，后续可属于代码键、姓名、医学词、邮件人名或法律缩写；另有代码元数据、年代表达及换行杂项。

patterns.name: L 前缀子词片段
patterns.context: 字母 L 作为后续词或缩写的起始部分，常与其他被切分的子词片段相邻；有时处在专名、机构名或引文中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；代码、医学、人物条目、邮件和法律引文等

patterns.name: 代码中的 Language 标记
patterns.context: 出现在类似 YAML 的键值元数据中，后接 Data Kinds 或 Flexible Contexts 等字段。

patterns.name: 年份中的数字与 s
patterns.context: 数字序列后接 s，组成英语年代表达“1190s”，随后是地点和事件条目格式。
patterns.domain: 维基百科年代事件条目

patterns.name: 分行姓名条目中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 人名被拆成多个子词 token，出现在条目标题、重复姓名或条目开头。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 多个医学词被分词为词内片段；同一段也包含 « L»isteria。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 L.R.R.M. 缩写
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文的页码与卷册信息之后。

patterns.name: 邮件中人名的 L 起始部分
patterns.context: 作为所有格人名的一部分，位于请求及附件说明中。

patterns.name: 无法归并的换行及条目碎片
patterns.trigger: «BL»«3»«M»、« Floor»« L»«amp»，以及 «Share» 与随后标点
patterns.context: 多次换行和截断片段相邻；难以从片段确定稳定的共同触发条件。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to occurrences of uppercase L: most prominently in FILED markers in legal documents, and also in configuration keys, legal abbreviations, and the initial letters of pathogen and personal names; triggering contexts span multiple text types.

patterns.name: FILED markers in legal documents
patterns.context: In legal-document layout, usually an all-caps filing marker at the top or margin of a page, with the court name “United States” nearby

patterns.name: L.R.R.M. in legal citations
patterns.context: A legal citation or rule abbreviation following the number “129”

patterns.name: L in configuration keys
patterns.context: In a Markdown-style configuration snippet, the first letter of the word “LANGUAGE”; nearby are option names such as “DataKinds” or “FlexibleContexts”

patterns.name: L in the name Listeria
patterns.context: In a medical abstract, the first letter of the pathogen name “Listeria monocytogenes”, appearing in a statement about infection

patterns.name: L in a personal name
patterns.context: The initial of the surname in the French name “François Lecointre”, in encyclopedia-style biographical text

patterns.name: L in a surname
patterns.context: The initial of the surname in the email name “TK Lohman's”, in a sentence about an attachment or request

5_711.description: 主要对大写字母 L 的出现敏感：法律文书的 FILED 标记中最突出，也出现在配置键、法律缩写以及病原体和人名的词首；触发背景横跨多种文本。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 FILED 标记
patterns.trigger: «F» I« L» E D（含分隔空格、换行及周围留白）
patterns.context: 法律文书版面中，通常作为页首或页边的全大写归档标记，附近可见法院名称“United States”

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 L.R.R.M.

patterns.name: Name suffix fragments

en.description: Activation repeatedly falls on the word-initial fragments “War” and “Ul”, but War also occurs in the surname Warren; other instances are scattered across English apostrophe contractions and an in-word fragment of lynching, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: War word beginning or stem
patterns.context: War-related categories, military service, military games, or accounts of military history; often at the beginning of noun phrases or headings.

patterns.name: War in the name Warren
patterns.context: “Warren” is tokenized as beginning with “War”, referring to the surname of a football-club player and unrelated to war.

patterns.name: Ul at the start of a proper name
patterns.context: The “Ul” at the beginning of a personal name is marked as a fragment; it appears in an Austrian name in a Mars report and a name in French news.

patterns.name: Apostrophes in English contractions
patterns.context: The apostrophe belongs to an English possessive or contraction, usually immediately followed by letters; scattered across dialogue and narration.

patterns.name: lyn stem in a song title
patterns.context: Occurs in the theme “lynching” sung in “Strange Fruit”, as an internal subword fragment.

5_711.description: 激活标记反复落在词首片段「War」和「Ul」，但War也覆盖姓氏Warren；其余命中分散于英语撇号缩略形式及lynching的词内片段，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: War词首或词干
