en.description: Activations occur in heterogeneous contexts, including political elections and legislators, legal documents, proper-name tokenization, code identifiers, programming operators, statistical numbers, and mathematical abstracts; no single stable word sense or domain covers all examples.

patterns.name: Parliamentary elections and legislators
patterns.context: Describes electoral systems, elected legislators, and their constituencies or parties
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on political figures and elections

patterns.name: Court document formatting
patterns.context: Case captions and formatted titles of appellate court documents

patterns.name: Tokenization or word boundaries in proper names
patterns.context: Proper names split into multiple tokens, including intra-word boundaries; fragments also occur in ordinary English contexts

patterns.name: Code identifiers and camel case
patterns.context: Code contains identifiers, method names, and calls composed of multiple words or displayed in split form

patterns.name: Bitwise enumerations and comparison operators
patterns.context: Lists integer flag values and explains how comparison operators are parsed

patterns.name: Numbers, time, and statistics
patterns.context: Dates, years, or experimental statistics embedded in prose

patterns.name: Specific mathematical notation topic
patterns.context: An abstract describes the decomposition of finite groups and their representations

patterns.name: Entry titles and entity disambiguation
patterns.context: A disambiguation entry titled with a name lists institutions sharing that name and identifies the entities

patterns.name: Fragmentary text and layout artifacts
patterns.context: Context is truncated or mixed with formatting, lists, or transcription noise; no common semantic trigger can be confirmed

5_1000.description: 激活分布于政治选举与议员、法律文书、专名分词、代码标识符、编程运算、统计数字和数学摘要等异质语境；没有单一稳定的词义或领域能覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: 议会选举与议员
patterns.context: 描述选举制度、当选议员及其选区或政党
patterns.domain: 百科全书政治人物与选举条目

patterns.name: 法院文书格式
patterns.trigger: “Appellee”“v.」「Defendant, Appellant”“APPEAL FROM THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT”
patterns.context: 法院案件标题及上诉法院文书的格式化标题

patterns.name: 专名中的分词或词界
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个 token，包含词内边界；片段同时有普通英文语境

patterns.name: 代码标识符与驼峰命名
patterns.context: 代码中出现由多个词构成或拆分显示的标识符、方法名及调用

patterns.name: 位运算枚举与比较运算符
patterns.context: 列举整数标志值，并解释比较操作符的解析

patterns.name: 数字与时间、统计量
patterns.context: 日期、年份或实验统计结果嵌在叙述中

patterns.name: 特定数学表示主题
patterns.context: 摘要描述有限群及其表示的分解

patterns.name: 词条标题及实体消歧
patterns.context: 以名称为题的消歧词条，列举同名机构并定位实体

patterns.name: 残缺文本与版式碎片
patterns.trigger: “ko suggested Sunday …”及段首/段尾的截断片段
patterns.context: 上下文被截断或混有格式、列表、转录噪声；没有可确认的共同语义触发条件

en.concept: Heterogeneous detection of word and phrase boundaries
en.description: Activations are scattered across heterogeneous texts, notably English function words and phrase boundaries, and also cover spatial terms, numbers, and proper-name tokenization. Other local word sequences occur in mathematical terminology and historical, entertainment, game, and urban narratives, with no unified topic or stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Grammatical function words and phrase boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs at noun phrases, coordinated structures, prepositional phrases, or sentence transitions; often adjacent to a following noun or place name, but with no fixed collocation
patterns.domain: General and academic English in mixed texts

patterns.name: North and directional nouns
patterns.context: Used as a regional name or directional modifier, usually adjacent to a place name, landform, or city description

patterns.name: Greek letter iota and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Embedded in formulas or operator expressions, adjacent to functions, variables, and mathematical symbols
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, partial differential equations or operator theory

patterns.name: Structures expressing binary choices or contrasts
patterns.context: Compares the values of two Xs or X's and lists different allocations of oxygen/sulfur
patterns.domain: Chemical or materials variable definitions in patent background text

patterns.name: Proper-name and terminology fragments in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Describes group representations, finite groups/modules, and related mathematical objects in abstracts or main text

patterns.name: Random matrix ensembles and scaling-limit terminology
patterns.context: Discusses locally uniform convergence, kernels, and limits of different ensembles

patterns.name: Mathematical theorem names and distance terminology
patterns.context: An abstract states a result about a type of hyperbolicity and the Kobayashi distance
patterns.domain: Complex geometry or mathematical paper abstracts

patterns.name: Numbers, currency, and statistical values
patterns.context: Values are associated with pound amounts, regions, or per-capita statistics
patterns.domain: Regional economic data in news or commentary

patterns.name: Affix boundaries in proper names
patterns.context: Occurs in tokenized fragments of personal names, company names, or loanwords

patterns.name: Historical figures and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Describes a person's surrender, actions, or death, with proper names appearing in tokenized form

patterns.name: Game characters and work-title fragments
patterns.context: Discusses game plots, characters, and evil spirits, with proper names split into subwords

patterns.name: TV programs and company-name fragments
patterns.context: A television station and production company collaborate to adapt an Argentine TV series

patterns.name: Urban redevelopment and flattening terrain
patterns.context: Describes leveling hills and modifying terrain for urban development

5_1000.concept: 词与短语边界的异质检测
5_1000.description: 激活散布于异质文本，显著涉及英语功能词与短语边界，也覆盖方位词、数字和专名分词；另有多种数学论文术语及历史、娱乐、游戏、城市叙述中的局部词串，缺少统一的主题或稳定词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 语法功能词与短语边界
patterns.context: 出现在名词短语、并列结构、介词短语或句子衔接处；常与后续名词或地名相邻，但没有固定搭配
patterns.domain: 混合文本中的一般英语及学术英语

patterns.name: North及方位名词
patterns.context: 作为地区名称或方向修饰语，通常邻接地名、地貌或城市描述
patterns.domain: 英国地区统计、历史地理叙述

patterns.name: 希腊字母 iota 与数学符号
patterns.context: 嵌入公式或算子表达式中，邻接函数、变量及数学符号
patterns.domain: 数学论文，偏微分方程或算子理论

patterns.name: 表示二元选择或对照的结构
patterns.context: 比较两个 X 或 X's 的取值，并列举氧/硫的不同分配
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的化学或材料变量定义

patterns.name: 数学论文中的专名与术语片段
patterns.context: 在论文摘要或正文中描述群表示、有限群/模及相关数学对象

patterns.name: 随机矩阵系综与缩放极限术语
patterns.context: 讨论局部一致收敛、核及不同系综的极限
patterns.domain: 数学物理或概率论论文

patterns.name: 数学定理名称及距离术语
patterns.context: 摘要中陈述关于某种双曲性及 Kobayashi 距离的结果
patterns.domain: 复几何或数学论文摘要

patterns.name: 数字、货币与统计数值
patterns.context: 数值与英镑金额、地区或人均统计相连
patterns.domain: 新闻或评论中的区域经济数据

patterns.name: 专名中的词缀边界
patterns.context: 出现在人名、公司名或外来词的分词片段中

patterns.name: 历史人物与专名片段
patterns.context: 叙述人物投降、行动或死亡，专名以分词形式出现

patterns.name: 游戏人物与作品名片段
patterns.context: 讨论游戏剧情、角色及邪灵，专名被拆分成子词

patterns.name: 电视节目与公司名片段
patterns.context: 电视台与制作公司合作改编阿根廷电视剧

patterns.name: 城市改造与地形改平
patterns.context: 描述为城市建设削平山丘、进行地形改造

en.description: Activations occur in directional place names, code identifiers, mathematical formulas and terminology, dimensional descriptions in papers, and medical classification sentences; common semantic cues are unstable, and some highlighted spans are split word fragments or common words.

patterns.name: Direction, relative location, and orientation descriptions
patterns.context: Directions and relative positions of places or terrain, often in geographical descriptions; also appears in state and place names in legal documents

patterns.name: Word fragments in compound identifiers
patterns.context: Code or variable names split into multiple tokens; activation falls on identifier components

patterns.name: Variables and operators in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Symbols, variable names, and operator terms occur in derivations or programming explanations

patterns.name: Properties in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Academic discussion introducing metric measure spaces, operators, and their properties

patterns.name: Word forms related to dimensions
patterns.context: Discusses incorporating the time dimension into an algorithm or dimensionality reduction; word forms may be split across tokens

patterns.name: Categories and their distinctions
patterns.context: Divides a result into different categories and describes each separately

patterns.name: Local triggers not classifiable under the above patterns
patterns.context: There is insufficient evidence around the activation to support a more specific common semantic pattern

5_1000.description: 激活分布于方位地名、代码标识符、数学公式与术语、论文中的维度表述，以及医学分类句；共同语义线索不稳定，且部分高亮落在拆分词片段或普通词上。

patterns.name: 方向、相对位置与方位描述
patterns.trigger: « south»、« north»、« of»；« southeastern»、« north» of
patterns.context: 地点或地形的方向、相对位置，常出现在地理描述中；另见司法文书中的州名地名

patterns.name: 复合标识符中的词片段
patterns.context: 代码或变量名被拆分成多个 token；激活落在标识符组成部分上

patterns.name: 数学公式中的变量与运算符
patterns.context: 符号、变量名及运算词出现在公式推导或编程解释中

patterns.name: 数学论文中的性质术语
patterns.context: 介绍度量测度空间、算子及其性质的学术论述

patterns.name: 维度与维数相关词形
patterns.context: 讨论把时间维度纳入算法，或维度约简；词形可能跨 token 拆分

patterns.name: 分类类别及其区分
patterns.context: 将某种结果划分为不同类别，并分别描述

patterns.name: 无法归入上述模式的局部触发
patterns.context: 激活周围没有足够证据支持更具体的共同语义模式

en.concept: Academic set phrase “to the best of our knowledge”
en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the fixed phrase “to the best of our knowledge” in academic texts, often introducing claims about prior work, novelty, or being the first study; other examples include medical statistics, technical Q&A, historical geography, and code fragments, with no apparent shared trigger feature.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “to the best of our knowledge”
patterns.context: The phrase introduces a paper or research statement, usually followed by a judgment about prior work, novelty, or being the first study; activation concentrates on multiple words in the phrase, especially best, of, and knowledge.

patterns.name: Causal explanation sentence structure
patterns.context: Explains why a parsing result or behavior occurs, followed by a specific mechanism and example; not the fixed phrase above.

patterns.name: Quantity, rate, and person-year statistics
patterns.context: Describes mortality rates and age-group statistics during a study period; the academic fixed phrase does not occur.

patterns.name: Urban terrain modification and place names
patterns.context: Recounts the historical leveling of hills in Seattle, including directions, years, and place names; no clear relation to the academic phrase pattern.

patterns.name: Operator values and node reduction in code
patterns.context: Code comments and branch conditions describe the reduction of expression-tree nodes; the academic phrase does not occur.

5_1000.concept: 学术固定短语“to the best of our knowledge”
5_1000.description: 主要对学术文本中的固定短语“to the best of our knowledge”强烈响应，常引出既有研究、新颖性或首次研究声明；另有医学统计、技术问答、历史地理和代码片段，未见共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 固定短语“to the best of our knowledge”
patterns.trigger: “To the best of our knowledge”及大小写变体 “to the best of our knowledge”
patterns.context: 该短语作为论文或研究陈述的引导语，通常后接关于既有工作、新颖性或首次研究的判断；激活集中在短语中的多个词，尤其 best、of 和 knowledge。

patterns.name: 因果解释句式
patterns.context: 解释某种解析或行为为何发生，后接具体机制和例子；并非上述固定短语。

patterns.name: 数量、率与人年统计表达
patterns.context: 描述研究期间的死亡率及年龄分组统计；没有出现学术固定短语。

patterns.name: 城市地形改造与地名
patterns.context: 叙述西雅图历史上的削平山丘工程，包含方位、年份和地名；与学术短语模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 代码中的运算符值与节点缩减
patterns.trigger: “children[0].value == '*'”、“value == '+'”、“reduce to None”、“reduce to a single occ…”
patterns.context: 代码注释和分支条件描述表达式树节点的缩减；没有出现学术短语。

en.concept: Conventional expressions and markers in academic text
en.description: Primarily activates on the academic formula “To the best of our knowledge”; other weaker lexical and formatting patterns include proper names and place names, bold mathematical headings, roster years, ordering with “the order of,” and abstract-format markers.

patterns.name: Formulaic expression “To the best of our knowledge”
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning or within a sentence to qualify novelty, priority, or the researchers' knowledge; may be followed by a comma, period, or continuation of the research conclusion.

patterns.name: Place names and their components
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across word fragments or complete place names, including spellings split across tokens; context introduces a location, route, or institutional location.

patterns.name: Bold academic term headings
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on terms in bold headings and the heading format; the following text continues with a definition of the term.

patterns.name: Years in lists or tables
patterns.context: Years occur in an annual list under a roster heading, surrounded by line breaks and list formatting.

patterns.name: “Order” in quantitative results
patterns.context: The phrase introduces a ranking by decreasing emission volume; activation falls on “order.”

patterns.name: Quantum-system paper abstract formatting
patterns.context: Occurs in the separator and field labels at the beginning of an abstract; activation also covers subsequent general academic abstract text, with no more specific lexical trigger.

5_1000.concept: 学术文本中的惯用表达与标记
5_1000.description: 主要对“To the best of our knowledge”学术套语激活；另见专名与地名、粗体数学标题、名册年份、“the order of”排序，以及摘要格式标记，呈现多种较弱的词汇和版式模式。

patterns.name: “To the best of our knowledge”公式表达
patterns.context: 出现在句首或句中，用来限定新颖性、优先性或研究者认知；有时后接逗号、句点或续接研究结论。

patterns.name: 地名及地名组成部分
patterns.context: 激活分散在地名或专名的词片段、完整地名中，包含跨 token 拼写；语境在介绍地点、路线或机构所在地。

patterns.name: 粗体学术术语标题
patterns.context: 激活集中在粗体标题中的术语及标题格式，后文以定义该术语的正文衔接。

patterns.name: 列表或表格中的年份
patterns.context: 年份位于名册标题下的逐年列表中，周围有换行及列表式排版。

patterns.name: 量化结果中的“order”
patterns.context: 短语引出发射量递减的排序；激活落在“order”上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/化学研究摘要

patterns.name: 量子系统论文摘要格式
patterns.context: 出现在摘要开头的分隔线和字段标签；激活也覆盖后续一般学术摘要文本，缺乏更特定的词汇触发。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据及摘要

en.description: Activations are scattered across punctuation and document boundaries, numbers and alphanumeric identifiers, split technical words or proper names, and a few paper-structure and explanatory phrases; they span code, encyclopedias, and biomedical texts, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Structural markers and boundary symbols
patterns.context: Activations occur near line breaks, separators, and punctuation in code diffs, lists, or document structures; paragraphs also contain ordinary prose or code, with no single fixed symbol combination.
patterns.domain: Code, technical documents, and paper section formatting

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric strings
patterns.context: Numbers occur in different contexts such as patch line numbers, enumeration values, measurements, years, or formula parameters; numbers themselves and adjacent punctuation are also activated.
patterns.domain: Code, encyclopedias, Q&A, and academic texts

patterns.name: Technical proper names and alphanumeric identifiers
patterns.context: Technical identifiers such as genes, proteins, viral genes, and code symbols combine letters and numbers or segmented abbreviations; this is not restricted to one domain.
patterns.domain: Code, molecular biology, and medical research

patterns.name: Tokenization and transliteration fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Personal or place names are split into multiple subword tokens; activation falls on local parts of proper names rather than sentence meaning.

patterns.name: Technical terms and terminology subwords
patterns.context: Technical terms or file names are split into subwords, with activation distributed across local fragments; implementation explanations or method descriptions often surround them.
patterns.domain: Software engineering and machine learning papers

patterns.name: Comparison operations and logical explanations
patterns.context: When explaining how enumeration values or operators are parsed, comparison-operation names and their components are highlighted.

patterns.name: Geographic area and unit expressions
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry gives a region's area, a value, and a parenthetical conversion between imperial and metric units.

patterns.name: Paper organization and statements of purpose
patterns.context: Near paper section headings, research-purpose sentences, and methods or related-work sections.

patterns.name: General function words and phrases
patterns.context: Common words in sentence-opening or explanatory structures receive sporadic activation across genres, without forming a stable independent semantic pattern.

5_1000.concept: 异质的结构与子词特征
5_1000.description: 激活分散于标点与文档边界、数字和字母数字标识符、被拆分的技术词或专名，以及少量论文结构和解释性短语；跨代码、百科与生物医学文本，缺少统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 结构化标记与边界符号
patterns.context: 代码差异、列表或文档结构中，换行、分隔符及标点附近出现激活；段内同时有普通叙述或代码，未见单一固定符号组合。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术文档与论文小节格式

patterns.name: 数字与编号串
patterns.context: 数字出现在补丁行号、枚举值、测量数据、年份或公式参数等不同语境；数字本身与邻近标点也有激活。
patterns.domain: 代码、百科、问答及学术文本

patterns.name: 技术专名与字母数字标识符
patterns.context: 基因、蛋白、病毒基因、代码符号等技术标识符中，字母与数字或分段缩写组合出现；并非只限某个领域。
patterns.domain: 代码、分子生物学与医学研究

patterns.name: 专名中的分词与转写片段
patterns.context: 人名或地名被切成多个子词 token；激活落在专名局部而非整句语义上。

patterns.name: 技术词与术语子词
patterns.context: 技术术语或文件名被拆成子词，激活分布在术语的局部片段；周围常有实现说明或方法描述。
patterns.domain: 软件工程与机器学习论文

patterns.name: 比较运算与逻辑解释
patterns.context: 解释枚举值或运算符如何解析时，比较操作名称及其组成词被突出。

patterns.name: 地理面积及单位表达
patterns.context: 百科条目给出地区面积、数值和英制/公制单位的括号换算。

patterns.name: 论文组织与目的表述
patterns.context: 论文小节标题、研究目的句以及方法或相关工作段落附近。

patterns.name: 通用功能词与短语
patterns.context: 常见句首或解释性结构中的词有零散激活，跨体裁出现，未形成稳定独立语义模式。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code boundary symbols, tokenized proper names and identifiers, encyclopedia categories and personal names, astronomical formula notation, and biological abbreviations; they span domains and have unstable trigger forms, so no single pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Marker boundaries or structural symbols
patterns.context: In code or text with structural markers, activation occurs near boundary symbols such as line breaks or closing parentheses; the specific symbols differ across examples

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on subword fragments of tokenized proper names or identifiers; there is no stable shared word form

patterns.name: Category and regional terms
patterns.context: Around place, transport-category, or country names in encyclopedia category entries

patterns.name: Astronomical parameter notation
patterns.context: Near cosmological parameters and numerical formulas, including Greek-letter variables and LaTeX notation

patterns.name: Biological abbreviations and mutation names
patterns.context: Biomedical abstracts involving vacuole fission, proteins, or mutants; gene names and abbreviations are tokenized

patterns.name: Time words and time-of-day conditions
patterns.context: Code uses Hindi time-of-day words to check the current hour

patterns.name: Fragments in English titles
patterns.context: Compound titles such as Prince-Archbishop appear in historical narratives, with activation concentrated on tokenized word fragments

patterns.name: Numerical units and cosmological notation
patterns.context: Observational units, parameter symbols, and exponential notation in astrophysics texts

patterns.name: Sports figures and club names
patterns.context: In personal profiles, nationalities and team names are split into multiple subword fragments

5_1000.description: 激活分散在代码边界符号、切分后的专名与标识符、百科类别和人物名称、天文公式记号及生物学缩写等处；跨领域、触发形式不稳定，无法由单一模式解释。

patterns.name: 标记边界或结构符号
patterns.context: 代码或带结构标记的文本中，激活落在换行、闭括号等边界符号附近；不同样例具体符号并不一致
patterns.domain: Github 代码及结构化文本

patterns.name: 专名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名或标识符被切分后的子词片段；没有稳定的共同词形

patterns.name: 类别与地域名词
patterns.context: 百科分类条目中，围绕地点、交通类别或国家名称

patterns.name: 天文参数记号
patterns.context: 宇宙学参数及数值公式附近，包含希腊字母变量和 LaTeX 标记

patterns.name: 生物学缩写与突变名
patterns.context: 涉及液泡分裂、蛋白或突变体的生物医学摘要；基因名与缩写被分词

patterns.name: 时间词与时段条件
patterns.context: 代码用印地语时段词判断当前小时

patterns.name: 英文职衔中的片段
patterns.context: 历史叙述中出现选帝侯大主教等复合职衔，激活集中于切分词片段

patterns.name: 数值单位与宇宙学记号
patterns.context: 天文物理文本中的观测单位、参数符号及指数记法

patterns.name: 体育人物与俱乐部名称
patterns.context: 人物简介中，国籍与球队名称被切分为多个子词片段

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of proper names, code identifiers, scientific symbols, and license markers, with no obvious shared semantic topic. At most, they share sensitivity to specialized names or formatted strings.

patterns.name: Countries, regions, and place names in proper names
patterns.context: Place or administrative-region names occur in prose, case captions, or category entries; activation often falls on words that make up the place name.
patterns.domain: Historical narratives, legal entries, railway categories

patterns.name: Code identifiers and structured syntax
patterns.context: Programming text contains identifiers, member names, enumeration values, file names, or syntax markers; activation is scattered across code symbols and their components.
patterns.domain: Code, code comments, software documentation, and change descriptions

patterns.name: Scientific parameters and mathematical notation
patterns.context: An astrophysics paper lists cosmological parameters, with activation near symbols, subscripts, and numerical expressions.

patterns.name: GPL license marker
patterns.context: A license name and link follow a file-header copyright notice.

5_1000.concept: 专门标记与命名字符串
5_1000.description: 激活分布在多类专名、代码标识符、科学符号和许可证标记上；没有明显共享的语义主题。共同点至多是对专门命名或格式化字符串较敏感。

patterns.name: 专名中的国家、地区与地名
patterns.trigger: “Elector-Archbishops of Mainz, Cologne”“Western Australia”“St. Louis County, Missouri”“United States”
patterns.context: 地名或行政区域名出现在正文、判例标题或分类条目中；激活常落在组成地名的词上。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、法律条目、铁路分类

patterns.name: 代码标识符与结构化语法
patterns.context: 编程文本中出现标识符、成员名、枚举值、文件名或语法标记；激活分散在代码符号及其组成部分上。
patterns.domain: 代码、代码注释、软件文档与变更说明

patterns.name: 科学参数与数学记号
patterns.context: 天体物理论文句子中列举宇宙学参数，激活紧邻符号、下标及数值表达式。

patterns.name: GPL 许可证标记
patterns.context: 文件头版权声明后出现许可证名称及链接。
patterns.domain: 开源软件版权/许可证文本

en.concept: Multiple local word-form and formatting features
en.description: Activations are scattered across local word forms and formatting: the fixed phrase with information, audio/streaming contexts, code indentation and modified, as well as isolated examples such as legal numbering, long time, and medical terminology; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: information collocations
patterns.context: Appears in phrases such as “For information about…” or “For your information.”; often preceded by For and followed by about or sentence-final punctuation.

patterns.name: audio and streaming
patterns.context: Discusses audio formats, audio input, or streaming services; related passages also contain words such as streaming, format, and Line In.

patterns.name: Legal provision number format
patterns.context: A fragment composed of numbers, letters, and punctuation resembling a clause or statute number, followed by a newline and uppercase NOT.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase long time
patterns.context: Occurs in “For a long time,” followed by a time adverbial and a medical-history narrative.

patterns.name: Indented code and modified identifier
patterns.context: Indented spaces and the modified identifier appear in code or source-file comments; the two occurrences have different syntax.

patterns.name: Pathology terminology fragment
patterns.context: A word is split into multiple subword fragments that form a medical term similar to refractory periodontitis; followed by a description related to abnormal white blood cell phagocytosis and smoking.

5_1121.concept: 多种局部词形与格式特征
5_1121.description: 激活分散于多种局部词形与格式：information 固定搭配、音频/流媒体语境、代码缩进与 modified，以及法律编号、long time 和医学术语等孤例；未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: information 搭配
patterns.context: 出现在“For information about…”或“For your information.”一类短语中；前面常有 For，后接 about 或句末标点。

patterns.name: audio 与流媒体
patterns.context: 谈及音频格式、音频输入或流媒体服务；相关段落中也出现 streaming、format、Line In 等词。

patterns.name: 法律条文数字格式
patterns.context: 数字、字母和标点组成类似条款或法条编号的片段，后接换行及大写 NOT。

patterns.name: long time 固定搭配
patterns.context: 位于“For a long time”中，后接时间状语及医学史叙述。

patterns.name: 缩进代码与 modified 标识符
patterns.context: 代码或源文件注释中出现缩进空格及 modified 标识符；两处所在语法不同。

patterns.name: 病理学术语片段
patterns.context: 词被切分成多个子词，组成类似 refractory periodontitis 的医学术语；后接与异常白细胞吞噬作用和吸烟相关的描述。

en.concept: Multiple local word-string and subword patterns
en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: they include the phrase “For information,” audio-related words, split proper names, and local strings in legal citations, medical narratives, and license disclaimers; there is no single stable triggering feature.

patterns.name: “information” phrase
patterns.context: “For” introduces an informational explanation; information may be preceded by about/your and followed by a period or other text

patterns.name: Audio formats and processing
patterns.context: Discusses audio formats, streaming loudness processing, or codecs and controllers

patterns.name: Proper names / within-word segmentation
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple subword fragments; includes names or product names such as Nelson Stepanyan and YETI Colster

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: Numbers and abbreviations form a U.S. case citation, followed by a newline and “NOT”

patterns.name: Medical history narrative
patterns.context: Begins with a time adverbial and describes how medical history is recorded

patterns.name: License disclaimer
patterns.context: Warranty disclaimer in a software license; activation is concentrated on the contrastive word but and uppercase emphasis

5_1121.concept: 多种局部词串与子词模式
5_1121.description: 激活模式分散：包含“For information”词组、音频相关词、被拆分的专名，以及法律引文、医学叙述和许可证免责声明中的局部词串；没有单一稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: “information”词组
patterns.trigger: «For» … «information»，包括 “For information about” 和 “For your information”
patterns.context: “For”引出信息说明，information 前可有 about/your，后可接句点或其他内容

patterns.name: 音频格式与处理
patterns.trigger: «audio»，以及与其相邻的 “Opus”“format”“Loudness Penalty”“audio codec”“audio controller”
patterns.context: 讨论音频格式、流媒体响度处理或编解码器及控制器

patterns.name: 专名/词内分段激活
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个子词片段；含 Nelson Stepanyan、YETI Colster 等人名或产品名

patterns.name: 法条引文格式
patterns.context: 数字与缩写构成美国判例引文，后接换行及 “NOT”

patterns.name: 病史叙述
patterns.trigger: «For» «a» «long» «time»，后接 “medical history was written by physicians”
patterns.context: 以一段时间状语开头，叙述医学史记录方式

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明
patterns.trigger: “NormalmapGenerator is distributed in the hope that it will be useful”及«but»«WITHOUT» … «WARRANTY»
patterns.context: 软件许可证中的无担保免责声明；激活集中于转折词 but 及大写强调语

en.description: Primarily responds to the common words audio and information and their technical and media collocations; additional sporadic activations include a game name, advertising fragments, complementary, and the surname Shatner, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragment in a game term
patterns.context: Tokens combine to form the game name “YETI COLSTER” (possibly “Yeti Colster”); activation falls on the latter part of the name, which appears repeatedly

patterns.name: audio
patterns.context: Audio appears in English technical or general text, in varied collocations including audio codec, controller, content, player, car system, and recording
patterns.domain: Patents, web pages, email, papers, and general text

patterns.name: information
patterns.context: Information appears in explanations, recommendations, or technical descriptions; includes information retrieval/consumption, ACA renewal information, and stored information

patterns.name: Possible product name/brand string
patterns.context: Weak activation occurs near a product name, free-promotion wording, and an image placeholder in a player-upgrade advertisement

patterns.name: Context of the technical term Flash memory
patterns.context: Describes volatile storage technology and the complementary functions of Flash memory; the activation marker appears on complementary

patterns.name: Person-name fragment
patterns.context: William Shatner’s name is split into tokens; activation appears within the name, followed by discussion of his television show and Captain Kirk

5_1121.concept: 常见英语词汇片段
5_1121.description: 主要对 audio 与 information 两个常见词及其技术、媒体搭配起反应；另有游戏名、广告碎片、complementary 和 Shatner 姓名等零散激活，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 游戏术语中的片段
patterns.context: 跨 token 拼成游戏名“YETI COLSTER”（可能是“Yeti Colster”），激活落在名称后段；重复出现该名称
patterns.domain: 网页文本/游戏相关，语境不明

patterns.name: audio
patterns.context: 英文技术或一般文本中出现 audio，涵盖音频 codec、控制器、内容、播放器、车载系统、录音等不同搭配
patterns.domain: 专利、网页、邮件、论文及一般文本

patterns.name: information
patterns.context: 在说明、建议或技术描述中出现 information；包括信息获取/消费、ACA 续期信息及存储信息

patterns.name: 疑似产品名/品牌字符串
patterns.context: 播放器升级广告中，产品名、免费促销字样及图片占位符附近出现较弱激活
patterns.domain: 邮件中的网页广告/HTML 转储

patterns.name: 技术名词 Flash memory 的上下文
patterns.context: 描述易失性存储技术及 Flash memory 的互补功能；激活标记出现在 complementary

patterns.name: 人物姓名片段
patterns.context: William Shatner 的名字被分词拆开；激活出现在姓名中间，随后谈及其电视节目和 Captain Kirk

en.concept: Mixed local word-form and code patterns
en.description: Activations are scattered across color-related code properties, the letter string buck, test-code identifiers, and newlines and indentation in code fragments; an additional passage on ceramic piezoelectric materials remains unexplained, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Color properties and color identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in color-related properties, fields, or class names in code; includes CSS as well as Java class names and drawing parameters.

patterns.name: Substring buck
patterns.context: Requires only the letter substring buck; in different passages it occurs within a citation, a name, and an ordinary English word.
patterns.domain: Academic citations, patent background, fiction or TV reviews

patterns.name: Error identifier in test code
patterns.context: A Go test function calls an assertion tool to check err; highlighting is concentrated on the Error identifier.

patterns.name: modified in a test name
patterns.context: Appears in the Go test function name UnmodifiedLock, as part of an identifier.

patterns.name: Newlines and indentation in code or style fragments
patterns.context: Appears when code, class definitions, or CSS rules are arranged line by line; not necessarily related to color themes.

5_1121.concept: 混合的局部词形与代码模式
5_1121.description: 激活分散在颜色相关代码属性、buck 字母子串、测试代码标识符及代码片段换行缩进；另有陶瓷压电材料段无法解释，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 颜色属性与颜色标识符
patterns.context: 出现在代码中的颜色相关属性、字段或类名；既包括 CSS，也包括 Java 类名和绘图参数。

patterns.name: 子串 buck
patterns.context: 只需出现字母子串 buck；在不同段中分别位于文献引用、人名和普通英文单词内部。
patterns.domain: 学术引用、专利背景、小说或电视评论

patterns.name: 测试代码中的 Error 标识符
patterns.context: Go 测试函数中调用断言工具检查 err；高亮集中在 Error 标识符。

patterns.name: 测试名中的 modified
patterns.context: 出现在 Go 测试函数名 UnmodifiedLock 中，作为标识符的一部分。

patterns.name: 代码或样式片段中的换行与缩进
patterns.context: 代码、类定义或 CSS 规则按行排列时出现；与颜色主题并不必然相关。

en.description: Activations fall on internal or initial fragments of various words, such as Goal, login, Software, Sul, Inspector, gazetted, Retrieved, disobedience, and articulating; contexts span web pages, source code, encyclopedias, and legal text.

patterns.name: Go and goal in fixed phrases
patterns.context: The sentence discusses solving a problem or carrying out a goal; the trigger is concentrated on the tokenized fragment of Goal

patterns.name: Forum registration prompt
patterns.context: A website welcome page prompts visitors to log in or register to use features

patterns.name: Free Software Foundation attribution
patterns.context: A source code comment provides contact information related to the software author or license

patterns.name: Sul within proper names
patterns.context: Sul appears within proper names; examples are the Brazilian competition Sul-Minas and the Indonesian island Sulawesi

patterns.name: Ins in a code identifier
patterns.context: Initial fragment in the camel-case JavaScript identifier WebInspector

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in gazetted
patterns.context: In an account of a historical figure receiving an honor, gazetted means published or officially announced

patterns.name: Ret in a citation record
patterns.context: Marks a Retrieved date in a reference entry

patterns.name: disob in a legal word
patterns.context: A court ruling discusses whether a court order was deliberately violated

patterns.name: artic in a legal term
patterns.context: A ruling cites precedent and states the school district’s legal obligations

5_1121.concept: 词内片段与专名子串
5_1121.description: 激活落在多种词的内部片段或词首，如 Goal、login、Software、Sul、Inspector、gazetted、Retrieved、disobedience、articulating；语境横跨网页、源码、百科和法律文本。

patterns.name: 固定短语中的 Go 与目标
patterns.context: 句子讨论如何解决问题或执行目标；触发集中于 Goal 的分词片段

patterns.name: 论坛注册提示
patterns.trigger: «login»10，及相邻的 “You are experiencing a small sample… Please login or register”
patterns.context: 网站欢迎页提示访客登录或注册以使用功能

patterns.name: 自由软件基金会署名
patterns.context: 源代码注释中提供软件作者或许可相关联系信息

patterns.name: 专名中的 Sul
patterns.context: 地名专名内部出现 Sul；分别是巴西赛事名 Sul-Minas 和印度尼西亚岛名 Sulawesi

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 Ins
patterns.context: 驼峰式 JavaScript 标识符 WebInspector 中的词首片段

patterns.name: gazetted 的词中片段
patterns.context: 历史人物授勋叙述中，gazetted 用作公布或刊宪之意

patterns.name: 引用记录中的 Ret
patterns.context: 参考文献条目中标记 Retrieved 日期

patterns.name: 法律词中的 disob
patterns.context: 法院判决语境中讨论是否故意违反法院命令

patterns.name: 法律术语中的 artic
patterns.context: 判决引用先例并表述学区的法律义务

en.description: Activations are concentrated on several discrete substrings: Tri, software license terms, and initial or internal fragments such as phys, Exp, Del, tem, acknowled, and expired. They belong to different contexts and, apart from license text, lack unified semantics.

patterns.name: GNU/LGPL license text
patterns.context: Software copyright or license notice, especially LGPL terms and version notes

patterns.name: Tri at the start of a word
patterns.context: The Tri substring in an uppercase word; one occurrence is in a book title and another in an event name

patterns.name: Android physical-device identifier
patterns.context: An identifier in Android graphics/device-related C code

patterns.name: Expense reimbursement matter
patterns.context: Lists administrative tasks to be handled in an email

patterns.name: Delphi programming tool
patterns.context: Describes the tool used to implement an experimental program

patterns.name: tempered substring
patterns.context: Describes initial excitement later subsiding somewhat

patterns.name: acknowledgement at the start of a word
patterns.context: Software redistribution terms require acknowledgment in product documentation

patterns.name: expired in exception documentation
patterns.context: Lists methods related to login or query timeouts and describes an exception state

5_1121.concept: 离散词段触发
5_1121.description: 激活集中于若干离散子串：Tri、软件许可条款，以及 phys、Exp、Del、tem、acknowled、expired 等词首或词段。它们分属不同语境，除许可文本外缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: GNU/LGPL 许可文本
patterns.trigger: “This library is free software”, “GNU Lesser General Public License”, “Software Foundation”
patterns.context: 软件版权或许可声明，尤其是 LGPL 条款及其版本说明

patterns.name: Tri 词首
patterns.context: 大写词内部的 Tri 子串；一处位于书名，一处位于活动名称

patterns.name: Android 物理设备标识符
patterns.context: Android 图形/设备相关 C 代码中的标识符

patterns.name: Expense 报销事项
patterns.context: 邮件中列举待处理的行政事项

patterns.name: Delphi 编程工具
patterns.context: 描述实验程序的实现工具

patterns.name: tempered 子串
patterns.context: 描述最初的兴奋后来有所减退

patterns.name: acknowledgement 词首
patterns.context: 软件再分发条款要求在产品文档中致谢

patterns.name: expired 异常文档
patterns.context: 列举登录或查询超时相关方法，并描述异常状态

en.description: The most prominent repeated cue is “open,” but it occurs across different meanings and contexts. Other high activations fall on unrelated fragments involving diffraction, excessive breadth, a title word, Basel, foreclosure, and supervisory plans, making them difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Uses related to open
patterns.context: Occurs in different collocations such as open week, open box, eyes open, and email open; meanings involve open hours, an empty box in a diagram, staying alert, and an email being open, respectively.
patterns.domain: IRC, research figure captions, Q&A, email

patterns.name: Diffraction word fragment
patterns.context: An initial fragment of “diffract,” describing the diffraction behavior of a crystal.

patterns.name: Too broad
patterns.context: Appears in “too broad,” describing a question marked as having too broad a scope.

patterns.name: Initial fragment of Approaching
patterns.context: An initial fragment of “Approaching,” appearing in an event title.

patterns.name: Basel
patterns.context: Combines with the following “el” to form “Basel,” referring to the Basel 2 banking capital regulatory framework.

patterns.name: Foreclosure word fragment
patterns.context: An initial fragment of “foreclosing,” describing a court foreclosing on a lien.

patterns.name: supervisory word fragment
patterns.context: An initial fragment of “supervisory,” appearing in a description of a supervisory plan.

5_1121.concept: none
5_1121.description: 激活最明显的重复线索是“open”，但它分布于多种不同语义和语境。其余高激活分别落在衍射、过宽、标题词、Basel、止赎及监督计划等互不相同的词片段上，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: open 相关用法
patterns.context: 出现在 open week、open box、eyes open、email open 等不同搭配中；语义分别涉及开放时段、图示空框、保持警觉和邮件处于打开状态。

patterns.name: 衍射词片段
patterns.context: 作为“diffract”的词首片段，描述晶体的衍射表现。

patterns.name: 过于宽泛
patterns.context: 出现在“too broad”中，描述问题被标记为范围过宽。

patterns.name: Approaching 词首片段
patterns.context: 作为“Approaching”的词首片段，出现在活动标题中。

patterns.name: Basel
patterns.context: 与后续“el”组成“Basel”，指银行资本监管框架 Basel 2。

patterns.name: 止赎词片段
patterns.context: 作为“foreclosing”的词首片段，描述法院对留置权执行止赎。

patterns.name: supervisory 词片段
patterns.context: 作为“supervisory”的词首片段，出现在监督计划的描述中。

en.description: Activations are distributed across while, hard, and various code identifiers and word fragments; the trigger forms, meanings, and contexts differ across passages, with no stable pattern that explains all examples.

patterns.name: Special fragment “while”
patterns.context: The word while itself is marked; [1] is followed by boot it, [3] by water fasting, and [4] by they were listening. The three instances differ in syntax and meaning.

patterns.name: Expressions related to hard
patterns.context: Contains the string hard, but it is part of an identifier, an adjective meaning difficult, or part of a compound word; meanings and syntax vary.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and boundary fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on code identifiers, camel-case name fragments, or code boundaries; [1] also contains an encrypted database comment, [5] is C# member code, [6] is an Objective-C interface, and [10] is a code comment.

patterns.name: Adjacent word fragments and token boundaries
patterns.context: Markers are scattered across words or within-word fragments, with no consistent semantics or stable local syntax; [2] is a forum narrative, [3] a title-like question, [4] a paper, and [8] a review.

patterns.name: Word-final and local noun fragments
patterns.context: [9] is marked within videophone; [10] occurs in a code comment about the global EventSource object. Their connection to the other passages is unclear.

5_1121.concept: none
5_1121.description: 激活分布在 while、hard 及多种代码标识符和词语片段上；不同段的触发形式、语义与语境不一致，未见能统一解释全部例子的稳定模式。

patterns.name: 特殊片段“while”
patterns.context: 词 while 本身被标记；[1] 后接 boot it，[3] 后接 water fasting，[4] 后接 they were listening。三处句法与语义不同。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、问句、学术论文

patterns.name: 硬（hard）相关表达
patterns.trigger: «hard»9（[6] 中 HardLight）；«hard»9（[7] 中 hard to fit）；«hard»9（[9] 中 hard-of-hearing）
patterns.context: 包含 hard 字符串，但分别是标识符的一部分、表示困难的形容词、复合词的一部分；语义和句法不一。
patterns.domain: 代码、机器学习问答、医疗/无障碍文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与边界片段
patterns.context: 激活落在代码标识符、驼峰命名片段或代码边界附近；[1] 另含加密数据库注释，[5] 为 C# 成员代码，[6] 为 Objective-C 接口，[10] 为代码注释。

patterns.name: 相邻词片段与分词边界
patterns.context: 标记散布于词语或词内片段，未见一致语义或稳定局部句法；[2] 是论坛叙事，[3] 是标题式问句，[4] 是论文，[8] 是评论文字。

patterns.name: 词尾及局部名词片段
patterns.context: [9] 在 videophone 词内被切分标记；[10] 位于 global EventSource object 的代码注释中。与其他段的联系不明确。
patterns.domain: 医疗/无障碍文本、代码注释

en.description: Activations are scattered across several text types: comparisons, extrema, and ordering in Chinese algorithm comments; English expressions of depth, length, and duration; locations near or approaches to the body; and self promotional. Local trigger positions are somewhat similar across passages, but their meanings are not unified.

patterns.name: Comparisons, extrema, and ordering words in Chinese code comments
patterns.context: Appears in Chinese algorithm comments describing maximum/minimum or priority; activation is concentrated on 「最」 and the following comparison or ordering expression.
patterns.domain: GitHub algorithm code and Chinese comments

patterns.name: English expressions of depth, length, and duration
patterns.context: Expresses depth, length, duration, or an ongoing process; activation falls on degree words or time/process expressions, though the specific forms and meanings are not entirely consistent.
patterns.domain: Poetry, system error definitions, lyrics, technical explanations

patterns.name: Spatial descriptions near the body or body parts
patterns.context: Body parts or people serve as spatial reference points to describe proximity; nearby spatial or degree words may also trigger activation.

patterns.name: Self-promotional expression
patterns.context: Discusses users repeatedly submitting personal blog content to promote themselves; activation is concentrated on the word self and adjacent words.

5_1121.concept: none
5_1121.description: 激活分散在多类文本：中文算法注释中的最值与排序；英文深度、长度、持续表达；身体附近的位置或接近；以及 self promotional。各段触发位置局部相似，但语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 中文代码注释中的比较、极值与次序词
patterns.trigger: 「每个位置左右最大值中较小值」；「最大堆，取出优先级最高的那个元素」
patterns.context: 出现在中文算法注释中，描述最大/最小或优先级；激活集中于「最」及其后的比较、排序表达。
patterns.domain: Github 算法代码及中文注释

patterns.name: 英文深度、长度与持续程度表达
patterns.trigger: “dig deep trenches”；“Argument list too long”；“three months”；“while boot it”
patterns.context: 表达深、长、久或过程持续；激活落在程度词或时间/过程表达上，但具体词形与语义并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 诗歌、系统错误定义、歌词、技术说明

patterns.name: 靠近身体或身体部位的空间描述
patterns.trigger: “low on her neck”；“holding him closer and closer”
patterns.context: 身体部位或人物作为空间参照，描述位置接近、贴近；也可能只是邻近的空间/程度词触发。
patterns.domain: 小说叙述、个人回忆散文

patterns.name: 自我促销表达
patterns.context: 讨论用户反复提交个人博客内容以自我宣传；激活集中于 self 一词及相邻词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code declarations, baseball, cybersecurity, poetry, machine learning, software development, and EEG research. Depth/intensity (deep, deeper) and temporal or accompanying expressions (while, as well) stand out locally, but there is no stable trigger pattern covering all passages.

patterns.name: C++ function pointer and struct declaration
patterns.context: A struct contains a function pointer field with a parameter that is a pointer to the struct itself; the preceding text describes an OpenCL prototype error

patterns.name: Baseball terminology and deep hits
patterns.context: In a baseball context, discusses batting, reaching base, home runs, and deep fly balls

patterns.name: HashSet, equality, and HashMap
patterns.context: Explains how a set uses an object’s equals method and a hash map to determine equality

patterns.name: JavaScript callback naming and function syntax
patterns.context: Notes that a callback and a query result are named with the same variable, then shows callback function code

patterns.name: Cybersecurity credentials and online services
patterns.context: Discusses passwords, digital credentials, and their potential sale on the dark web

patterns.name: Aging imagery in poetry
patterns.context: The lines use winter, brows, and deep furrows to portray aging and the decline of appearance

patterns.name: In-depth consideration of software use cases
patterns.context: Describes a student software development challenge that requires in-depth consideration of use cases and potential users

patterns.name: Machine-learning generalization performance
patterns.context: Discusses support vector machine fitting, regularization tuning, and generalization performance

patterns.name: Rapid iteration and sketching
patterns.context: Introduces a drawing tool with features such as hot reload and animation, and mentions rapid sketch iteration

patterns.name: Synchronized EEG and audio decoding
patterns.context: Research on decoding audio features from brain signals recorded while listening, emphasizing synchronized listening

5_1121.concept: none
5_1121.description: 激活分散于代码声明、棒球、网络安全、诗歌、机器学习、软件开发及脑电研究等语境。局部突出深度/深入（deep、deeper）、时间或伴随表达（while、as well），但没有覆盖全部段落的稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: C++ 函数指针与结构体声明
patterns.context: 结构体中含有函数指针字段，参数包含指向结构体自身的指针；前文是 OpenCL 原型错误

patterns.name: 棒球术语与深远击球
patterns.context: 棒球语境中谈击球、上垒、全垒打及飞球深远

patterns.name: HashSet、相等性与 HashMap
patterns.context: 解释集合如何利用对象的 equals 方法及哈希映射判断相等性

patterns.name: JavaScript 回调命名与函数语法
patterns.context: 指出回调与查询结果被命名为同一变量，随后展示函数回调代码

patterns.name: 网络安全凭据与在线服务
patterns.context: 讨论密码、数字凭据及其可能在暗网上被售卖

patterns.name: 诗歌中的衰老意象
patterns.context: 诗句以冬季、眉额和深沟描写年岁增长与容颜衰老

patterns.name: 深入思考软件用例
patterns.trigger: software development «lif»1ecycle ... think «deeper»9 about use cases
patterns.context: 描述学生软件开发挑战，要求深入考虑用例及潜在用户
patterns.domain: 教育/软件开发活动介绍

patterns.name: 机器学习泛化表现
patterns.context: 讨论支持向量机拟合、正则化调参及泛化效果

patterns.name: 快速迭代与草图绘制
patterns.context: 介绍支持热重载、动画等功能的绘图工具，并提及快速迭代草图
patterns.domain: 技术讨论/软件工具介绍

patterns.name: EEG 与音频同步解码
patterns.context: 研究从听音时记录的脑电信号解码音频特征，强调同步听音过程
patterns.domain: 神经科学/音频信号处理论文

en.concept: Structured terminology and boundaries in technical contexts
en.description: Activations occur mainly at types, function signatures, parameters, and syntax boundaries in source code, as well as in technical text. Sporadic patterns also include the baseball sense of base, while for ongoing actions, security discussions, and algebraic geometry terminology.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and type declaration boundaries
patterns.context: Appears in source code, function signatures, type declarations, member access, and at code-comment boundaries; activation is not limited to a particular language or identifier.
patterns.domain: Code snippets in GitHub source code and technical discussions

patterns.name: Typed function parameters and Boolean conditions
patterns.context: Explicit types and structured syntax appear in function parameters, return types, or conditional expressions; especially visible in the Boolean parameter declaration in segment 5.
patterns.domain: Source code in Go and other programming languages

patterns.name: The word base in a baseball context
patterns.context: Baseball narratives about a batter reaching base, returning to a state, or whether a fly ball will clear the home run wall; activation is concentrated in non-code natural-language snippets.

patterns.name: Security discussions involving past and boundary
patterns.context: Technical discussions of out-of-bounds reads, module boundaries, and security risks, rather than ordinary code declarations.

patterns.name: Ongoing actions introduced by while
patterns.context: Describes how users can use a tool while rapidly iterating or sketching; the trigger word appears in natural-language description.
patterns.domain: Software feature descriptions or product discussions

patterns.name: Instance and call-effect identifiers in code
patterns.context: After a class or object definition, a call-effect function appears with arguments such as addresses and instructions.
patterns.domain: Reverse engineering or program analysis code

patterns.name: OpenCL prototype errors and function-pointer structs
patterns.context: A C-style struct and function-pointer declaration follow an error message, illustrating OpenCL's limitation on variadic prototypes.
patterns.domain: Compiler diagnostics and C/OpenCL source code

patterns.name: Open immersion and scheme gluing in mathematics
patterns.context: Mathematical definitions or output descriptions of an open immersion from U into a scheme, and gluing X and Y along an open set.

5_1121.concept: 技术语境中的结构化术语与边界
5_1121.description: 激活多见于源码中的类型、函数签名、参数与语法边界，也见于技术文本；另有棒球语境的 base、进行中动作的 while、安全论述及代数几何术语等零散模式。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与类型声明边界
patterns.context: 出现在源码、函数签名、类型声明、成员访问及代码与注释的交界处；激活不局限于某一种语言，也不局限于某个特定标识符。
patterns.domain: Github 源码与技术讨论中的代码片段

patterns.name: 类型化函数参数与布尔条件
patterns.trigger: «is»、«Owner»、«Group»、«bool»、«Mode»，以及 «(»、«{»、«->» 等签名或结构边界
patterns.context: 函数参数、返回类型或条件表达式呈现显式类型和结构化语法时；尤其可见于第 5 段的布尔参数声明。

patterns.name: base 一词的棒球语境
patterns.context: 关于打者上垒、回归状态或飞球是否会飞出全垒打墙的棒球叙述；激活集中在非代码自然语言片段。

patterns.name: past 与 boundary 相关的安全论述
patterns.trigger: «sp» 后接 «reads»，再接 « past»；邻近 «module boundaries»
patterns.context: 讨论越界读取、模块边界与安全风险的技术论述，而非普通代码声明。

patterns.name: while 引导的进行中动作
patterns.context: 说明用户在快速迭代、绘制草图时可使用某工具；触发词处在自然语言描述中。
patterns.domain: 软件功能介绍或产品讨论

patterns.name: 代码中的实例与调用效果标识
patterns.context: 类或对象定义后，出现调用效果函数及地址、指令等参数。
patterns.domain: 逆向工程或程序分析代码

patterns.name: OpenCL 原型错误及函数指针结构体
patterns.context: 错误信息后紧跟 C 风格结构体与函数指针声明，展示 OpenCL 对可变参数原型的限制。
patterns.domain: 编译器诊断与 C/OpenCL 源码

patterns.name: 数学中的开浸入与概形粘合
patterns.context: 描述从 U 到概形的开浸入，以及沿开集粘合 X、Y 的数学定义或输出说明。

en.description: In most segments, well is strongly activated in the additive construction “as well as,” including medical and music-related text. Two other segments activate in a Rust code snippet and a Go function signature, showing different code-token patterns.

patterns.name: well in “as well as”
patterns.context: In the phrase “as well as,” which adds parallel information, well is the main trigger; it may be followed or preceded by a noun, noun phrase, or clause-like constituent.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts, clinical trial descriptions, patient information, medical reviews, and music biographies; segments 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10

patterns.name: Markers in Rust code
patterns.context: In a HackerNews discussion of Rust code, activations occur around code identifiers, method signatures, and punctuation; there is no “as well as” construction here.
patterns.domain: Rust safety discussion and code example in a programmer forum; segment 3

patterns.name: Go identifiers and type signatures
patterns.context: In a Go function declaration, activation covers the identifier CookieSigner, method name Sign, parameter types, and signature punctuation; no “as well as” construction appears.

5_1121.concept: “as well as”中的 well
5_1121.description: 多数段在并列补充结构“as well as”中强烈激活 well，涵盖医学及音乐文字；另有两段分别在 Rust 代码片段和 Go 函数签名中激活，呈现不同的代码 token 模式。

patterns.name: “as well as”中的 well
patterns.context: 在并列补充信息的短语“as well as”中，well 是主要触发点；前后可接名词、名词短语或从句式成分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、临床试验描述、患者资料、医学综述，以及音乐背景介绍；段 1、2、4、5、6、7、9、10

patterns.name: Rust 代码中的标记
patterns.context: 在 HackerNews 的 Rust 代码讨论中，激活分布于代码标识符、方法签名及标点附近；此处没有“as well as”结构。
patterns.domain: 程序员论坛中的 Rust 安全讨论与代码示例；段 3

patterns.name: Go 标识符与类型签名
patterns.context: 在 Go 函数声明中，激活覆盖标识符 CookieSigner、方法名 Sign、参数类型及签名标点；未见“as well as”结构。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code and natural language: the Go type string, source-code identifiers, two English phrases, and an HTTP error message. The marked-token positions and meanings vary substantially, making it difficult to identify a single stable feature.

patterns.name: string in code identifiers
patterns.context: In Go function parameters or return-value declarations, string appears as a type name; [3] also contains the Java identifier RecordStringConverterLoader, but not a standalone string type.

patterns.name: HTTP error text in code
patterns.context: In an HTTP protocol response error message, not has the strongest activation.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and terminal error output

patterns.name: The English phrase not try too hard
patterns.context: In an informal suggestion, hard ends the phrase try too hard; the preceding text discusses whether to make a project link public.

patterns.name: Ongoing activity introduced by English while
patterns.context: while appears in a clause describing rapid iteration and a drawing workflow; quickly iterating also appears nearby in the segment.

patterns.name: Parameter or variable names in code
patterns.context: Function parameters or variable identifiers are marked in code from different languages; there is no clear shared semantic category.
patterns.domain: Java, Go, C++, Java, and other code

patterns.name: Code tokens not grouped into a stable pattern
patterns.context: Types, methods, members, and operators occur in varied code positions; the samples do not establish a common trigger condition.

5_1121.concept: none
5_1121.description: 激活分散在代码与自然语言中：Go 的 string 类型、源码标识符，以及两处英语短语和一处 HTTP 错误文本。标记 token 的位置与语义差异较大，难以归为单一稳定特征。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 string
patterns.context: Go 函数参数或返回值的类型声明中，string 作为类型名出现；[3] 也有 Java 标识符 RecordStringConverterLoader，但并非独立的 string 类型。

patterns.name: 代码中的 HTTP 错误文本
patterns.context: HTTP 协议响应错误信息中，not 处激活最强。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及终端错误输出

patterns.name: 英语短语 not try too hard
patterns.context: 口语化建议中，hard 是短语 try too hard 的结尾，前文讨论是否公开链接项目。

patterns.name: 英语 while 引导的进行中活动
patterns.context: while 位于描述快速迭代、绘图流程的从句中；本段附近还出现 quickly iterating。

patterns.name: 代码中的参数名或变量名
patterns.context: 不同语言代码中，函数形参或变量标识符被标记；没有明显统一的语义类别。

patterns.name: 未归入稳定模式的代码 token
patterns.context: 代码中的类型、方法、成员或操作符位置各异，无法由样本确认共同触发条件。

en.concept: Expressions of speed and force (with code noise)
en.description: Activations occur most consistently on expressions of speed or force such as fast and hard, and also on words related to button operations. They additionally cover code/API text, error tracebacks, and mixed Chinese-English technical text; the latter categories lack a unifying semantic cue.

patterns.name: Expressions of speed/force
patterns.context: The trigger word describes speed, force, or degree; it sometimes occurs in comparative or sufficiency constructions.
patterns.domain: Narrative, game instructions, news quotations, and commentary

patterns.name: Buttons, clicks, and interface controls
patterns.context: Buttons, keys, clicks, and their responses appear in interface code or usage instructions.

patterns.name: Specific code/API identifiers
patterns.context: API, protocol, encoding names, and identifier fragments in code or technical Q&A; no consistent local semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Tracebacks and file information
patterns.context: The traceback heading and file and line-number entries in Python error output.

patterns.name: Mixed Chinese-English text and Chinese character fragments
patterns.context: Chinese content is split into several tokens, appearing in code comments or URL-encoding Q&A examples.

patterns.name: Page-turning action
patterns.context: In reading-related narratives, “turn the pages” describes page-turning and emphasizes speed.

5_1121.concept: 速度与力度表达（兼有代码噪声）
5_1121.description: 激活最稳定地落在 fast、hard 等速度或力度表达，也见于按钮操作相关词；另覆盖代码/API、错误回溯和中英文混合技术文本，后几类缺少统一语义线索。

patterns.name: 快速/用力程度表达
patterns.trigger: «fast»；«hard»，尤其是“as fast as possible”“as fast as they have”“as hard as I could”“push hard enough”
patterns.context: 触发词用于描述速度、力度或程度；有时处于比较或足够条件结构中
patterns.domain: 叙述、游戏说明、新闻引语、评论

patterns.name: 按钮、点击与界面控件
patterns.context: 界面代码或操作说明中出现按钮、按键、点击及其响应

patterns.name: 特定代码/API 标识符
patterns.context: 代码或技术问答中的 API、协议、编码名和标识符片段；未见统一的局部语义条件
patterns.domain: Github 与 StackExchange 技术文本

patterns.name: 追踪回溯与文件信息
patterns.context: Python 错误输出中的 traceback 标题及文件、行号条目
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答/错误日志

patterns.name: 中英文混合及中文字符片段
patterns.context: 中文内容被拆成若干 token，出现在代码注释或 URL 编码问答示例中

patterns.name: 翻页动作
patterns.context: 阅读叙述中以“turn the pages”表达翻页，并强调速度

en.concept: Opening braces and locally informative words
en.description: Strong responses occur in several local patterns: opening braces in code and nearby function signatures, as well as identifiers such as rest, Selector, and discretization. Text also contains scattered expressions such as fast enough, batted, far as you can, not allowed, and push hard enough, with little stable semantic connection among them.

patterns.name: Opening braces and the start of code blocks
patterns.context: An opening brace in code for a function, method, or implementation block, often after the signature; [1] also has a following newline and indentation.

patterns.name: rest / Rest in code identifiers
patterns.context: The C++ method name RestartDemux is split into a subword containing rest; it also occurs near a method definition and opening brace.

patterns.name: Pages and expressions of speed
patterns.context: Narrative context describing a reader reading very fast and eager to turn pages.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC, book reviews or narrative prose

patterns.name: Cricket terminology
patterns.context: Describes a team winning the toss and batting first; activation falls on the stem of batted.

patterns.name: Event type names and parameters
patterns.context: The parameter list of a touch-event handler ends, followed by the function body.

patterns.name: Wording about out-of-bounds reads
patterns.context: Discusses how a lack of safety can cause out-of-bounds reads across modules; Rust-style implementation code also appears nearby.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, software security discussion and code

patterns.name: Searching backward and as far as possible
patterns.context: An email requests searching as far back or as far out as possible in a database for relevant records.

patterns.name: Selector in an API identifier
patterns.context: The function name contains FieldSelector, followed by a parameter list; strong activation also occurs at the opening brace in the function body.

patterns.name: HTTP error response wording
patterns.context: curl reports receiving a disallowed HTTP/0.9 response; strong activation falls on not.

patterns.name: Pushing hard and bending
patterns.context: Using a straw as an example, describes how pushing hard enough will make it bend; activation is concentrated on hard.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, analogy explaining a physical phenomenon

patterns.name: Discretization parameter
patterns.context: The discretization parameter at the end of a C++ function signature and its closing parenthesis, followed by the start of the function body.

5_1121.concept: 左花括号与局部高信息词
5_1121.description: 强响应落在多类局部模式：代码块左花括号及邻近函数签名，也包括 rest、Selector、discretization 等标识符；文本中则散见 fast enough、batted、far as you can、not allowed、push hard enough 等表达，彼此缺少稳定语义联系。

patterns.name: 代码中的开括号与块体起始
patterns.context: 代码中函数、方法或实现块的左花括号，常出现在签名之后；[1] 还紧接换行和缩进

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 rest / Rest
patterns.context: C++ 方法名 RestartDemux 被拆成带有 rest 的子词；同时处于方法定义与左花括号附近

patterns.name: 页面与速度表达
patterns.context: 描述读者读得很快、急于翻页的叙述语境

patterns.name: 板球比赛术语
patterns.context: 描述球队赢得掷币并先击球；激活落在 batted 的词干部分

patterns.name: 事件类型名与参数
patterns.context: 触摸事件处理函数的参数列表结束，随后进入函数体

patterns.name: 越界读取相关措辞

patterns.name: 往回查找并尽可能远

patterns.name: API 标识符中的 Selector

patterns.name: HTTP 错误响应措辞

patterns.name: 离散化参数

en.concept: Code blocks and member declaration boundaries
en.description: Primarily responds to the opening brace `{` that begins a code block after a declaration or function signature, especially at the start of a function body. It also activates on `{`, property names, and get/set accessors in C# property declarations. A generic type name is activated in one other instance.

patterns.name: C# properties and property accessors
patterns.context: Near property names and accessors in C# class member declarations; activation often falls on the opening brace, and also occurs on property-name and accessor tokens.

patterns.name: Opening brace in a function or method definition
patterns.context: At the start of a code block or function body, immediately after the signature; sometimes the function name, return type, or parentheses also activate.
patterns.domain: Source code in multiple programming languages (C, C++, Python, PowerShell)

patterns.name: Type boundaries in generic declarations
patterns.context: In C# generic property declarations, activation also occurs near type names inside and outside angle brackets; this co-occurs with the property-accessor pattern.

5_1121.concept: 代码块与成员声明边界
5_1121.description: 主要对代码中声明或函数签名之后开启代码块的左花括号 `{` 起反应，尤见函数体开头；也激活 C# 属性声明中的 `{`、属性名及 get/set 访问器。另在一处泛型类型名附近激活。

patterns.name: C# 属性与属性访问器
patterns.trigger: `{` 后跟 `get; set;`、`get { ... }` 或属性名，如 `LabelRule`、`operatingSystem`、`ImageName`、`Arguments`
patterns.context: C# 类成员声明中，属性名及属性访问器附近；激活常落在左花括号，也出现在属性名和访问器 token 上

patterns.name: 函数或方法定义的左花括号
patterns.trigger: 函数/方法签名后换行的 `{`，如 `spx_resource_stats_wall_time(void)`、`Get-TargetResource`、`restartDemux()`、`main()`，以及 `epyxfastload_roml_read(...)`
patterns.context: 代码块或函数体的开头，签名之后紧接左花括号；有时函数名、返回类型或括号也激活

patterns.name: 泛型声明中的类型边界
patterns.context: C# 泛型属性声明中，尖括号内外的类型名附近也有激活；与属性访问器模式同时出现

en.description: Primarily responds to opening braces and accessor structures in class-member property declarations or getters; it also responds to struct return types and local variables in Go test functions, and to opening braces that begin function bodies after C/C++ function signatures. The shared cue is declaration boundaries and braces in code.

patterns.name: C# property declarations and accessors
patterns.context: Property declarations or getter implementations in C# class members; activation is concentrated on the opening brace and near getter.

patterns.name: Struct slices in Go test helper functions
patterns.context: A function in Go test code that converts API resources into struct resources.

patterns.name: Start of C/C++ function definitions
patterns.context: The function signature ends and the function body begins; activation is concentrated on the opening brace.
patterns.domain: C/C++ source code; segment 9 is image-processing code with Portuguese comments, and segment 10 is an Android monitor API

5_1121.concept: 代码声明与花括号边界
5_1121.description: 主要响应类成员属性声明或 getter 中的左花括号及访问器结构；也响应 Go 测试函数的结构体返回类型与局部变量，以及 C/C++ 函数签名后开启函数体的左花括号。共同线索是代码中的声明边界和花括号。

patterns.name: C# 属性声明及访问器
patterns.trigger: `{ get; set; }`、`{ get { ... } }`、`{ get; private set ... }`；附近常有 `public`、属性名和类型
patterns.context: C# 类成员中属性声明或 getter 实现；激活集中于左花括号及 getter 附近
patterns.domain: Github/StackExchange 中的 C# 代码

patterns.name: Go 测试辅助函数中的结构体切片
patterns.context: Go 测试代码中把 API 资源转换为结构体资源的函数
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Go 测试代码

patterns.name: C/C++ 函数定义开头
patterns.context: 函数签名结束并开始函数体；激活集中在左花括号
patterns.domain: C/C++ 源码；段9为葡萄牙语注释的图像处理代码，段10为 Android 监视器 API

en.description: Primarily responds to C# public property declarations and their accessor blocks, especially the opening brace of the property body after the type name; property types and names vary. A few related code snippets also involve a toString method, a constructor base initializer, and XML-serialization properties.

patterns.name: C# member declarations
patterns.context: Declares public properties in C# classes, with varied property names and types; activation often covers public, the type name, and part of the property name.

patterns.name: Property accessors and braces
patterns.context: An accessor block follows the property declaration; activation is especially strong on the opening brace and nearby get/set.

patterns.name: String conversion method
patterns.context: A public method named toString is followed by the return type String and a method body; this is not a property declaration.

patterns.name: Constructor initializer
patterns.context: A constructor calls a base-class constructor, surrounded by parameters and assignment code; activation is distributed across parameters, punctuation, and initializer fragments.

patterns.name: XML-serialization-generated property
patterns.context: A bool property composed of an attribute and a specified field name in code related to generation or serialization.

patterns.name: Property documentation comments
patterns.context: An XML documentation comment appears before a property declaration; the comment itself seems to be neighboring context, with no stable evidence of an independent trigger.

5_1121.concept: C# 属性声明与访问器
5_1121.description: 主要响应 C# public 属性声明及其访问器块，尤其类型名之后的属性体左花括号；属性类型与名称多样。另见 toString 方法、构造函数基类初始化器及 XML 序列化属性等少数相关代码片段。

patterns.name: C# 成员声明
patterns.trigger: public；public 后接 String、bool、List<...>、Stream、接口或自定义类型等类型名
patterns.context: C# 类中声明 public 属性，属性名及类型多样；激活常覆盖 public、类型名和属性名的一部分。

patterns.name: 属性访问器与花括号
patterns.context: 属性声明后出现访问器块；尤以左花括号及其后的 get/set 附近激活强。

patterns.name: 字符串转换方法
patterns.context: public 方法名为 toString，后接返回类型 String 和方法体；并非属性声明。

patterns.name: 构造函数初始化器
patterns.context: 构造函数调用基类构造函数，周围包含参数与赋值代码；激活分布在参数、标点和初始化器片段。

patterns.name: XML 序列化生成属性
patterns.context: 生成或序列化相关代码中，以属性标注和指定字段名组成的 bool 属性。

patterns.name: 属性文档注释
patterns.context: 属性声明前出现 XML 文档注释；该注释本身似乎只是邻近上下文，未见稳定独立触发证据。

en.description: Primarily activates on function or method definitions and their opening-brace structure in code, across C#, C/C++, Java, and Objective-C; it also responds to properties/accessors, local type declarations, annotations, comments, and a few natural-language subword fragments.

patterns.name: C# method declaration and method-body start
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the method signature and the following newline and opening brace; common in public methods, especially when the signature ends with an empty parameter list.

patterns.name: C/C++ main function entry point
patterns.context: A main function definition in a C/C++ example; activation falls on the return type, function name, empty parameter list, and start of the function body.

patterns.name: Other C/C++ function entry points
patterns.context: An ordinary C function definition, not main; the function body begins immediately after the signature.

patterns.name: Objective-C method/function definition
patterns.context: A static function definition in Objective-C source; the function name uses camel case, and the function body starts with an opening brace.

patterns.name: Property declarations or accessors
patterns.context: Near property definitions and their accessors; some examples split the property name into multiple tokens, but activation still falls on the declaration and accessor structure.

patterns.name: Type declarations inside method bodies
patterns.context: Local type or variable declarations within a function body; these do not immediately follow a public method signature but remain in a code context.

patterns.name: updateHTML in a mixed HTML/text context
patterns.context: C# method code follows HTML content; the activated ordinary words do not form an obvious function-declaration pattern.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, mixed HTML and C#

patterns.name: Subword fragments in Portuguese text
patterns.context: In Portuguese explanatory text and a credit-card property example, activation falls on natural-language words or their subword fragments rather than solely on code syntax.

patterns.name: English explanatory subword fragments in C# code
patterns.context: English words in method comments or explanatory text also activate and cannot be fully grouped under the method-signature feature.

patterns.name: C# routing/attribute annotations
patterns.context: HTTP routing and attribute annotations before a method declaration; activation is weak and distributed.

patterns.name: Java annotations and generic method signatures
patterns.context: Java generic return type and method declaration after path and produces annotations; activation falls on type-name fragments and method structure.

patterns.name: Zero-value assignment and loop fragment
patterns.context: A local C++ code fragment after a thread loop; there is no clear evidence that it shares the function-entry pattern.

patterns.name: Objective-C dictionary type fragment
patterns.context: Near the return type and function name in a static function signature; similar to method definitions in other languages, but with language-specific structure.

5_1121.concept: 代码函数定义起始
5_1121.description: 主要对代码中的函数或方法定义及其左花括号起始结构激活，覆盖 C#、C/C++、Java 和 Objective-C；也响应属性/访问器、局部类型声明、注解、注释及少量自然语言词片。

patterns.name: C# 方法声明与方法体起始
patterns.trigger: «public»、返回类型如 «List»/«string»、方法名、«()»，随后是 «↵» 和 «{»
patterns.context: 激活集中在方法签名及紧随其后的换行、左花括号；常见于 public 方法，尤其签名以空参数列表结束。

patterns.name: C/C++ main 函数入口
patterns.context: C/C++ 示例中的 main 函数定义，激活落在返回类型、函数名、空参数列表及函数体开头。

patterns.name: 其他 C/C++ 函数入口
patterns.context: 普通的 C 函数定义，不是 main；函数签名后立即进入函数体。

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法/函数定义
patterns.context: Objective-C 源码中静态函数定义，函数名采用驼峰式命名，函数体以左花括号开始。

patterns.name: 属性声明或访问器
patterns.context: 属性定义及其访问器附近；部分示例把属性名拆为多个 token，激活仍落在声明和访问器结构上。

patterns.name: 方法体中出现的类型声明
patterns.context: 函数体内部的局部类型或变量声明；此处并非紧随公共方法签名，但仍处于代码上下文。

patterns.name: HTML/文本混合上下文中的 updateHTML
patterns.trigger: «Some»、« more»、« over»，并邻近未标记的 HTML 与 «update»«HTML» 方法名
patterns.context: HTML 内容之后切换到 C# 方法代码；激活的普通词不构成明显的函数声明模式。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，HTML 与 C# 混合

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语文字中的词片
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语说明文字及信用卡属性示例中，激活落在自然语言词语或其子词片，而非仅落在代码语法上。

patterns.name: C# 代码中的英文说明词片
patterns.context: 方法注释或说明性文本中的英文词语也出现激活，无法完全归入方法签名特征。

patterns.name: C# 路由/属性标注
patterns.context: 方法声明之前的 HTTP 路由和属性标注处，激活较弱且分散。

patterns.name: Java 注解及泛型方法签名
patterns.context: 路径与 produces 注解之后的 Java 泛型返回类型和方法声明；激活落在类型名片段及方法结构上。

patterns.name: 零值赋值和循环片段
patterns.context: C++ 线程循环后的局部代码片段；未见明确证据表明它与函数入口模式相同。

patterns.name: Objective-C 字典类型片段
patterns.context: 静态函数签名中的返回类型和函数名附近；与其他语言方法定义相似，但语言特有结构不同。

en.concept: Code member declarations and block starts
en.description: Primarily responds to member-definition structures in object-oriented code, especially public members, method signatures, and their opening braces; it also covers properties/get-set accessors. Weaker or localized activations occur in generic types, routing annotations, comments, identifiers, and Perl subroutines.

patterns.name: C# public member definitions
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated near member declarations in classes or interfaces, often adjacent to the opening brace of a property, method, or accessor; triggers are not limited to one member type.

patterns.name: Method declarations and method-body starts
patterns.context: Activation occurs when a method name, parameter list, or return type is followed by an opening brace for the method body; sometimes activation is concentrated on the brace and following newline indentation.

patterns.name: Property and accessor definitions
patterns.context: Activation occurs when a property body follows the property name or type, or when get/set accessors appear; includes auto-properties and properties with explicit accessors.

patterns.name: Type names and generic return types
patterns.context: Types, generic return types, and their member names appear in method or member declarations; activation is distributed across type names, identifiers, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Web/API routes and HTTP annotations
patterns.context: HTTP method comments, route attributes, or API paths appear before a method declaration; the same segment is followed by a public method returning a list.

patterns.name: HTML strings and update-related identifiers
patterns.context: The identifier updateHTML, HTML content fragments, and string-processing code appear together; this segment also contains a C# public method declaration.
patterns.domain: C# and HTML examples in StackExchange

patterns.name: Credit-card validation property and Portuguese text
patterns.context: A string property is declared and its property body begins after a Portuguese CreditCard validation error message.
patterns.domain: C# data annotation example on StackExchange

patterns.name: Audio-file method and comments
patterns.context: A comment describes returning a list of audio files associated with a broadcast account, followed by a public List<String> method signature and method body.

patterns.name: Query-result method declaration
patterns.context: A public generic query method is declared after path and produces annotations, followed by an exception declaration and the start of the method body.

patterns.name: Stream property and local initialization
patterns.context: A description of converting data to a memory stream is followed by a string stream variable declaration and a public Stream property.

patterns.name: Perl subroutine and module imports
patterns.context: A subroutine definition appears after Perl module imports, strict/warnings directives, and package-level variables; this is a similar block-start signal in non-C# code.

patterns.name: String-formatting method
patterns.context: A toString method is defined after loop logic and its body begins, followed by a string variable declaration and the start of a string literal.

patterns.name: Return description in documentation comment and count property
patterns.context: A documentation comment describes the current duplicate count, followed by a count property declaration and entry into a getter.
patterns.domain: C# code and XML documentation comments on GitHub

patterns.name: Constructor and parameter property
patterns.context: A constructor calls base(command) and assigns a parameter, then defines a SelectArguments property and getter.
patterns.domain: C# data-source component code on GitHub

5_1121.concept: 代码成员声明与块起始
5_1121.description: 主要对面向对象代码中的成员定义结构起反应，尤其是 public 成员、方法签名及其开括号，也覆盖属性/get-set 访问器；泛型类型、路由注解、注释、标识符和 Perl 子程序中也有较弱或局部激活。

patterns.name: C# 公共成员定义
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在类或接口的成员声明附近，常紧邻属性、方法或访问器的起始大括号；触发并不局限于一种成员类型。
patterns.domain: C# 及相近的面向对象代码

patterns.name: 方法声明与方法体起始
patterns.context: 可见的方法名、参数列表或返回类型后接方法体开括号时激活；有时激活集中在开括号及换行缩进处。

patterns.name: 属性及访问器定义
patterns.context: 属性名或类型后进入属性体，或出现 get/set 访问器时激活；包括自动属性和带显式访问器的属性。

patterns.name: 类型名与泛型返回类型
patterns.context: 类型、泛型返回类型及其成员名出现在方法或成员声明中；激活分散在类型名、标识符和标点上。

patterns.name: Web/API 路由与 HTTP 标注
patterns.context: 方法声明前出现 HTTP 方法注释、路由属性或 API 路径；同一段随后是公共列表返回方法。

patterns.name: HTML 字符串与更新相关标识符
patterns.context: 标识符 updateHTML、HTML 内容片段及字符串处理代码相邻出现；此段同时含 C# 公共方法声明。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 C# 与 HTML 示例

patterns.name: 信用卡校验属性与葡萄牙语文本
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语 CreditCard 校验错误消息之后声明字符串属性并开启属性体。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 C# 数据注解示例

patterns.name: 音频文件方法及注释
patterns.context: 注释说明返回广播账号关联音频文件列表，随后出现公共 List<String> 方法签名和方法体。

patterns.name: 查询结果方法声明
patterns.context: 路径与 produces 注解之后声明公共泛型查询方法，并以异常声明及方法体开始收尾。

patterns.name: Stream 属性与局部初始化
patterns.context: 先说明将数据转换为 memory stream，随后声明字符串流变量及公共 Stream 属性。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 C# 数据处理代码

patterns.name: Perl 子程序及模块导入
patterns.context: Perl 模块导入、strict/warnings 指令和包级变量之后出现子程序定义；是非 C# 代码中的相似块起始信号。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Perl 代码

patterns.name: 字符串格式化方法
patterns.context: 循环逻辑后定义 toString 方法并开启方法体，随后创建字符串变量并开始字符串字面量。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 Java/C# 风格代码

patterns.name: 文档注释中的返回描述与计数属性
patterns.context: 文档注释描述现有重复次数，之后声明计数属性并进入 getter。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C# 代码及 XML 文档注释

patterns.name: 构造函数与参数属性
patterns.context: 构造函数调用 base(command) 并赋值参数，随后定义 SelectArguments 属性及 getter。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C# 数据源组件代码

en.description: Activations are scattered across several terms: ads, Loop, clarification, case-precedent classification terms, and wolf and Sweet in names or titles; no unified context is apparent beyond local terms.

patterns.name: 广告相关词
patterns.context: 讨论广告插入、广告商业模式或读者刊登的小广告时激活。

en.description: Activations span several text types: formatting markers and whitespace, Loop/identifiers in code, split personal names, legal decision templates, and the proper name Loop. patterns.name: Annotated corpus/file delimiter

patterns.name: Loop in code examples

patterns.name: Peter name segmentation
patterns.context: The names Peter Stoop and Peter Piaggio are split into multiple subword tokens, near an entry title or snippet boundary

patterns.name: Monospaced spaces and seller terminology

patterns.name: Og substring in a name
patterns.context: In the name Craig Ogier, Og occurs at the start of the surname; the sentence discusses family members and cancer

patterns.name: XML components and Maven identifiers
patterns.context: An XML configuration contains component/library tags and Maven dependency coordinates

patterns.name: Decision title template
