patterns.context: 解释法律文本时，以文本是否清楚作为是否继续分析的条件。

patterns.name: 传送布局与边缘部位
patterns.context: 描述袋体与喷嘴在同一输送线上的位置及其边缘部分。

patterns.name: 卡片交易类型
patterns.context: 询问记录卡交易、非现场交易及盗刷的分类或识别。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论：支付与交易安全

patterns.name: 概率/搜索中的 bound 论证
patterns.context: 通过规约或缩短过程来界定单次深度优先搜索的逃逸概率。

patterns.name: 数学图论定理陈述
patterns.context: 定理环境中给出平面线段图族的有界性质及更精确表述。

en.description: Activations cover transport routes and planning, mathematical objects and properties, whether a legal dispute remains live, and expressions of design methods and purposes in patents. No specific lexical or syntactic trigger unifies the domains.

patterns.name: Railways and transport routes
patterns.context: Descriptions of railways, roads, routes, or transport services; some excerpts concern route locations or planning.

patterns.name: Properties or values of mathematical objects
patterns.context: Mathematical discussion introduces mappings, spaces, vectors, or their properties; no single mathematical term serves as a unified trigger.

patterns.name: Whether a legal dispute remains live
patterns.context: Discusses federal court jurisdiction and whether a dispute remains live during proceedings.

patterns.name: Purpose or method phrasing in patent text
patterns.context: Describes how mechanical components are designed and their intended effects.

5_1172.description: 激活覆盖交通线路与规划、数学对象及性质、司法争议存续，以及专利中的设计方式和目的表达；跨领域未见统一的具体词汇或句法触发。

patterns.name: 铁路及交通线路
patterns.context: 铁路、道路、路线或交通服务的描述；部分段落涉及线路位置或线路规划。

patterns.name: 数学对象的性质或取值
patterns.context: 数学论述中介绍映射、空间、向量或其性质；没有统一的单一数学术语触发。

patterns.name: 司法争议是否仍然存在
patterns.trigger: “appeal is moot”“actual controversy must be … extant”
patterns.context: 讨论联邦法院管辖权，以及审理期间争议是否仍然存在。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的目的或方式表达
patterns.trigger: “in such a way as to increase”
patterns.context: 描述机械部件的设计方式及其预期效果。

en.description: Activations occur in mathematical definitions and terminology, format or category labels, place-name fragments, and encyclopedia section/location descriptions. They also appear in ordinary assertion words and comparative expressions; no single stable trigger pattern spans domains.

patterns.name: Naming a term in a definition
patterns.context: Formally defining or explaining what an object is called, especially a term following a copular construction

patterns.name: Technical terms or concepts in mathematical prose
patterns.context: Definitions, property statements, or proofs in mathematical discussion, with terms embedded in technical sentences

patterns.name: Format, category, or attribute labels
patterns.context: Classifying a data transmission method or object by its format, category, or attribute

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in proper and place names
patterns.context: A word-form fragment appears in a place name, district name, or location name, rather than as an independent concept in a sentence

patterns.name: Section, navigation, and reference labels
patterns.context: Section headings or navigation content near the end of an encyclopedia entry

patterns.name: Location- or road-related expressions
patterns.context: Describing where a place is located, roads, or routes for visiting

patterns.name: General explanatory assertions and result expressions
patterns.context: Stating conditions, conclusions, or causal relationships; these words occur in ordinary prose across different fields
patterns.domain: Mathematical arguments, patent descriptions, encyclopedias, and forum text

patterns.name: Comparatives and expressions of degree
patterns.context: Describing comparisons or changes in cost, degree, or scale

5_1172.description: 激活分布在数学定义与术语、格式或类别标签、地名片段及百科栏目/位置描述，也见普通断言词和比较表达；跨领域缺少单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 定义句中的术语命名
patterns.trigger: “is called” / “is said to be” 后接术语，如 «called»、«is»、«said to be»、«regular»、«canonical»
patterns.context: 正式定义或说明某对象被称作什么，尤其是系词结构后给出术语

patterns.name: 数学正文中的专业术语或概念成分
patterns.context: 数学论述中的定义、性质陈述或证明，术语嵌在技术性句子中

patterns.name: 格式、类别或属性标签
patterns.context: 把数据传输方式或对象归入某种格式、类别或属性
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、数学定义

patterns.name: 专名及地名中的词形片段
patterns.context: 词形片段出现在地名、区名或地点名称中，并非句子中的独立概念

patterns.name: 标题、导航与参考资料标签
patterns.context: 百科条目尾部的栏目标题或导航内容

patterns.name: 位置或道路相关表达
patterns.context: 描述地点所在位置、道路或到访路线
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目、旅游信息

patterns.name: 通用说明性断言与结果表达
patterns.context: 说明条件、结论或因果关系；这些词在不同领域的普通叙述中出现
patterns.domain: 数学论证、专利说明、百科与论坛文本

patterns.name: 比较级及程度表达
patterns.context: 描述成本、程度或规模的比较及变化

en.description: Activations center on several local expressions: information available online, network outage status reports, spread-spectrum terminology, television tuning, sports rankings, real-world care, and “top” in lists. The patterns span domains, with no unified trigger feature.

patterns.name: Information available online
patterns.context: Describing materials, lists, or information that can be viewed online; “online” occurs at the end of a phrase or where a URL is introduced

patterns.name: Network status reports and outages
patterns.context: In a network service status list, INTER NET is followed by a colon and a report that there is no scheduled downtime; the same email passage recurs in different samples

patterns.name: Spectrum and signal terminology
patterns.context: Technical context discussing the transmission, concealment, or detection of data streams using spread-spectrum formats

patterns.name: TV tuning and OTA broadcasts
patterns.context: Explaining that a TV can be tuned to receive OTA digital or analog programming, following descriptions of cable TV and video equipment

patterns.name: Sports rankings and season predictions
patterns.context: Discussing a team’s performance during a player’s absence and predicting its league ranking

patterns.name: Real-world care implementation
patterns.context: Describing the integration of evidence-based treatment into real-world care settings at child mental health agencies

patterns.name: Rankings in lists
patterns.context: Asking which kind of gift should rank first on a list; may relate to the use of “top” in sports rankings, but the context differs

5_1172.description: 激活集中于若干局部表达：online信息可查、网络停机状态报告、扩频术语、电视调谐、体育排名、现实世界护理，以及榜单中的top；模式跨领域，未见统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 在线信息可查看
patterns.context: 描述资料、名单或信息可在网上查看，online 位于短语末尾或网址引出位置

patterns.name: 网络状态报告与停机
patterns.context: 网络服务状态清单中，INTER NET 后接冒号，报告没有计划停机；相同邮件段落在不同样本中重复

patterns.name: 频谱与信号术语
patterns.trigger: «spread»« spectrum»7；后文再次出现«spread»« spectrum»10« format»6
patterns.context: 讨论以扩频格式传输、隐藏或检测数据流的技术背景

patterns.name: 电视调谐及OTA广播
patterns.context: 说明电视可调谐接收OTA数字或模拟节目，处于有线电视与录像设备介绍之后

patterns.name: 体育排名与赛季预测
patterns.context: 讨论球队在球员缺阵期间的表现，并预测其联赛排名

patterns.name: 现实世界护理实施
patterns.context: 描述将循证治疗整合进儿童心理健康机构的现实护理环境

patterns.name: 榜单排名表达
patterns.context: 询问某类礼物应在榜单中居于首位；与体育排名中的 top 用法可能相关，但语境不同
patterns.domain: 消费科技/社交媒体文章

en.description: Activations are concentrated on “accessible” and contexts involving online lookup, especially “easily accessible.” Other sporadic patterns include online purchasing and duration phrases, sentence-final “not” in comments, HN formatting fragments, and “top jobs.” Styles range across academic, web, legal, and commentary text, so they cannot be fully attributed to a single trigger.

patterns.name: easily accessible
patterns.context: Describing information, resources, or services as easy for a group to reach, obtain, or consult; [4] is followed by “to this population,” [7] by “online,” and [10] by “at the [Bureau of Prisons”
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research methods, legal documents

patterns.name: Information available online
patterns.context: Describing policies, supplementary materials, or entries as available online; [5] is also immediately followed by a website address

patterns.name: Verbal uncertainty and negation
patterns.context: A commenter expresses uncertainty with “I’m not sure if … or not”; activation is concentrated on the sentence-final “not.”

patterns.name: Time span or duration
patterns.context: Time units or frameworks are highlighted in numeric or duration phrases: the online purchase period for insurance and a project delivery time frame

patterns.name: Rankings or top positions
patterns.context: “Top” modifies jobs in a discussion of connections, university graduation, and employment opportunities

patterns.name: Formatting and filtering parameters in links/citations
patterns.context: Web text such as HN page parameters, comment separators, and quoted news headlines; no clear unified local semantic trigger

patterns.name: Generic promotional web phrase
patterns.context: An insurance advertisement describes arranging temporary vehicle insurance as quick, convenient, and purchasable online

patterns.name: Delivery timelines in risk lists
patterns.context: Describes project risks or business assumptions alongside factors such as production, equipment, and personnel

patterns.name: unexplained: Discussion of research subjects/accessibility
patterns.context: A medical abstract lists treatment options for infected people and compares accessibility; it contains “accessible” but not “online,” so its correspondence with other patterns is uncertain

patterns.name: unexplained: Accessibility of social media content
patterns.context: A news headline summary states that Holocaust-denial content is available on multiple platforms; it contains “accessible” but not “easily accessible,” and the context is cross-platform distribution

patterns.name: unexplained: Data policy and website address
patterns.context: An explanation of a research questionnaire and data access policy is followed by a website; it matches the online pattern, but whether it has the same trigger mechanism is unclear

patterns.name: unexplained: Online encyclopedia entry
patterns.context: States that a list of award winners can be found online, with no clear specific semantic condition

patterns.name: unexplained: Exposure of private information
patterns.context: A legal document states that sensitive information is easily accessible due to a lack of review; this aligns with accessibility phrases, but highlights privacy exposure

patterns.name: unexplained: Connections and networking
patterns.context: Discusses parental connections, university, and employment opportunities; only “top jobs” is locally highlighted, with no stable accessibility or time pattern

5_1172.description: 激活最集中于“accessible”及线上可查语境，尤其是“easily accessible”；另有在线购买与期限短语、评论中的句末 not、HN 排版片段及“top jobs”等零散模式。文体横跨学术、网页、法律与评论，不能完全归为单一触发。

patterns.name: easily accessible（易于访问）
patterns.context: 形容信息、资源或服务容易被某群体接触、获取或查阅；[4]后接“to this population”，[7]后接“online”，[10]后接“at the [Bureau of Prisons”
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、研究方法、法律文书

patterns.name: online 信息可查
patterns.context: 描述政策、补充材料或条目可在网上查阅；[5]还紧接网站地址

patterns.name: 言语不确定与否定
patterns.trigger: «sure»4« if»2« this»2« is»3« free»7« or»3« not»10«.»2
patterns.context: 评论者以“I’m not sure if … or not”表达不确定；激活集中在句末“not.”

patterns.name: 时间跨度或期限
patterns.context: 数字或期限短语中突出时间单位/框架：保险在线购买期限、项目交付时间框架
patterns.domain: 商业网页、企业风险描述

patterns.name: 排行或顶尖职位
patterns.context: “top”修饰职位，处于关于人脉、大学毕业与就业机会的讨论中

patterns.name: 链接/引用文本的排版与筛选参数
patterns.context: HN 页面参数、评论分隔符及引用新闻标题等网页文本；没有明显统一的局部语义触发条件

patterns.name: 普通网页宣传短语
patterns.context: 保险广告中描述临时车辆保险办理迅速、方便、可在线购买

patterns.name: 风险清单中的履约时间
patterns.context: 与生产、设备、人力等因素并列，说明项目风险或经营假设

patterns.name: unexplained: 研究对象/可及性讨论
patterns.context: 医学摘要列举感染者的治疗方案并比较可及性；虽含“accessible”，但缺少“online”，与其他模式的对应关系不确定

patterns.name: unexplained: 社交媒体内容可及
patterns.trigger: «readily»4« accessible»10« across»2 Twitter, YouTube and Reddit
patterns.context: 新闻标题转述中说明否认大屠杀的内容可在多个平台获取；有“accessible”但不是“easily accessible”且语境为跨平台传播

patterns.name: unexplained: 数据政策与网站地址
patterns.context: 研究问卷和数据访问政策的说明，随后给出网站；在线模式吻合，但是否为同一触发机制不明确

patterns.name: unexplained: 在线百科条目
patterns.context: 说明获奖者名单可在线找到，未见明显特定语义条件

patterns.name: unexplained: 隐私信息暴露
patterns.context: 法律文书称敏感信息因缺乏审查而可被轻易获取；与可及性短语相合，但突出的是隐私泄露

patterns.name: unexplained: 连接与人脉
patterns.context: 讨论父母关系、大学与就业机会；只有“top jobs”局部高亮，未见稳定的可及性或时间模式

en.concept: Mixed feature of formal notation and sentence-final “not”
en.description: Activations occur across two relatively clear cues: high-dimensional spaces, superscript exponents, sets, and technical terms in mathematical papers; and sentence-final negation in colloquial “if … or not” expressions. Other sporadic patterns include corporate delivery deadlines, web parameters, and comments about device failures, which cannot be unified by a single word meaning.

patterns.name: Sentence-final alternative-question construction
patterns.context: In colloquial speech or online comments, expressing uncertainty and ending with “or not”; activation is concentrated on “not.”

patterns.name: Dimension superscripts in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In mathematical papers, symbolic expressions for sets, spaces, or vectors; superscript numbers or variables show strong activation
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Time deadlines in contract language
patterns.context: Mentioning delivery by an agreed deadline while listing project execution, supplier performance, or similar risks or capabilities

patterns.name: Preposition “of” at a fragmentary sentence start
patterns.context: A fragment of corporate text extracted from a clause, beginning with a prepositional phrase and missing preceding syntactic content

patterns.name: Specialized terminology in mathematical research
patterns.context: Terms adjacent to formal notation in definitions, propositions, or technical descriptions in mathematical papers; activations are distributed across terms and symbols
patterns.domain: Mathematics, theoretical computer science, and control papers

patterns.name: Encoding formats in web parameters
patterns.context: URL/query parameter fragments before comment text, involving encoding and filter fields

patterns.name: Broken-screen descriptions in technical product reviews
patterns.context: A user reports that a review device’s screen broke shortly after use and asks whether the problem is common

patterns.name: Abstract formal symbol strings
patterns.context: Dense mathematical notation for variables, indices, vectors, and parameters in papers; the specific semantics are difficult to determine from the fragment alone

5_1172.concept: 形式化符号与句末 not 的混合特征
5_1172.description: 激活分布于两类较明确线索：数学论文中的高维空间、上标指数、集合与技术术语；以及口语“if … or not”的句末否定。另有企业履约期限、网页参数和设备故障评论等零散模式，无法由单一词义统一解释。

patterns.name: 句末选择疑问结构
patterns.trigger: “if this is free or not”“if this is widespread or not”
patterns.context: 口语或网络评论中，表达不确定并以“or not”收尾；激活集中在“not”。

patterns.name: 数学表达中的维数上标
patterns.context: 数学论文中，集合、空间或向量的符号化表达；上标数字/变量部分出现强激活。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 合同措辞中的时间期限
patterns.context: 列举项目执行、供应商履约等风险或能力指标时，提及按约定期限交付。

patterns.name: 碎片化句首的介词“of”
patterns.trigger: 段首“of and continuity of metals”
patterns.context: 从句中截取的企业文本片段，开头为介词短语，缺少前置句法内容。

patterns.name: 研究数学中的专门术语
patterns.context: 数学论文的定义、命题或技术说明中，术语与形式化记号相邻；激活分散在术语及符号内部。
patterns.domain: 数学、理论计算机科学与控制论文

patterns.name: 网页参数中的编码格式
patterns.context: 评论正文之前的 URL/查询参数片段，涉及编码和筛选字段。

patterns.name: 技术产品评论中的坏屏描述
patterns.trigger: “Galaxy Fold review unit”“screen … completely broken”“two days in”
patterns.context: 用户报告评测设备短时间内屏幕损坏，并追问问题是否普遍。

patterns.name: 抽象形式化符号串
patterns.context: 论文中变量、索引、向量及参数的密集数学记号；具体语义仅凭片段难以确定。

en.description: The activation patterns are diverse: uncertainty questions of the “or not” type, online availability of network content or services, and a few special cases involving contract delivery times, blog interfaces, and EU obligations in Estonian. No single trigger pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Sentence- or phrase-final “not”
patterns.context: Often occurs at the end of questions or uncertainty expressions, such as “free or not,” “widespread or not,” and “reasonable or not”; the “not” at the end of passage 2 activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Website or network availability and accessibility
patterns.context: Web content, data, or services are described as available, accessible, or online; activation often falls on words related to the internet or platforms.
patterns.domain: Web copy, legal text, online publishing

patterns.name: Time frame and fulfillment
patterns.context: Describes a contracting party providing services or goods within an agreed time; activation is concentrated on the time-frame phrase.
patterns.domain: Corporate project and risk disclosure text

patterns.name: Blog comment-section formatting
patterns.context: A blog page contains layout elements such as related posts, sharing, comment counts, and a comment form; “guarantee” also activates in this passage.

patterns.name: Estonian legal expression
patterns.context: An Estonian sentence discusses fulfillment of obligations at the EU level; activation is distributed within morphologically rich words.

5_1172.description: 激活模式较杂：包括“or not”式不确定问句、网络内容或服务在线可用，以及合同履约时间、博客界面和爱沙尼亚语欧盟义务等少数特例。没有单一触发模式覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 句末或短语末的 not
patterns.context: 常出现在疑问或不确定表达的末尾，如 “free or not”“widespread or not”“reasonable or not”；第2段末尾的 not 激活最强。

patterns.name: 网页或网络可用性、可访问性
patterns.context: 网页内容、数据或服务被描述为可用、可访问或在线；激活常落在 internet 或平台相关词上。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、法律文本、网络出版

patterns.name: 时间框架及履约
patterns.context: 描述合同方按约定时间提供服务或商品，激活集中在时间框架一词组。
patterns.domain: 企业项目及风险披露文本

patterns.name: 博客评论区格式
patterns.context: 博客页面包含相关帖子、分享、评论数和评论表单等版式元素；本段还激活 guarantee。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语法律表达
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子谈及欧盟层面的义务履行；激活分布在形态丰富的词内部。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in web copy prompting users to click links or controls, and in contexts describing rankings of products, teams, warehouses, and other items. There are also isolated activations within Estonian words and in a question about automatic file transfer.

patterns.name: Link or button prompts
patterns.context: Prompts readers to click a page link, icon, or control; may be followed by purposes such as reporting abuse, getting more information, or unsubscribing

patterns.name: Rankings and placement expressions
patterns.context: Describes the position, ranking, or popularity of a team, app, warehouse, or league; often includes top, rank(ed), or a number
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, technology discussions, sports, and product descriptions

patterns.name: Fragment within an Estonian word
patterns.context: In an Estonian sentence, strong activation falls within lubaduste (promises); word-form segmentation is visible, but there are too few examples to determine a more specific condition

patterns.name: Description of daily automatic transfer
patterns.context: Asks how to use a cron job to automatically transfer files to a server; activation falls within transfered

5_1172.description: 激活主要出现在网页引导点击链接或控件的文案，以及描述产品、球队、仓库等排名的语境；另有爱沙尼亚语词内激活和自动传文件问答中的孤例。

patterns.name: 链接或按钮的操作提示
patterns.context: 引导读者点击页面链接、图标或控件；有时后接报告滥用、获取更多信息或退订等用途。
patterns.domain: 网页界面文案、电子邮件营销

patterns.name: 排名及名次表达
patterns.context: 描述球队、应用、仓库或联赛的名次、排名或热门位置，常出现 top、rank(ed)、数字。
patterns.domain: 百科、科技讨论、体育与产品介绍

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子中，强激活落在 lubaduste（承诺）的词内部；可见词形切分，但没有足够例子确定更具体条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、爱沙尼亚语

patterns.name: 每日自动传输的描述
patterns.context: 询问用 cron job 将文件自动传到服务器；激活落在 transfered 的词内。

en.concept: Web prompts to continue searching or viewing
en.description: The main responses are to web or forum expressions prompting readers to keep looking, such as “Find/Read more” and “out there,” often at the end of a passage, as well as descriptions of publicly available data. There are also sporadic activations in Estonian fragments; the rest of passages 8 and 10 cannot reliably be assigned to the main pattern.

patterns.name: “More / see here” links to web content
patterns.context: Phrases in web body text or recommendations that prompt readers to continue viewing, learn more, or visit a link; triggers often fall on more, here, there, and nearby words
patterns.domain: Web promotion, blogs, news, and content recommendations

patterns.name: Publicly available data and resources
patterns.context: Mentions publicly available data or resources, or collection and analysis based on these materials; may relate to internet or research data

patterns.name: End-position links or references to locations/objects
patterns.context: Says that something or information can be found online, or asks whether a relevant tool exists; often appears at the end of a sentence or near a link prompt

patterns.name: “There” in sentence-final questions
patterns.context: Uses an existential construction to ask whether a type of tool or resource exists; activation is concentrated on there and nearby words in the question

patterns.name: Estonian word endings/word-form fragments
patterns.context: A continuous Estonian word fragment is segmented into multiple tokens; activation appears within a word in the sentence, rather than in English web-prompt contexts

5_1172.concept: 网页中的继续查找／查看导引
5_1172.description: 主要响应网页或论坛中引导读者继续查看的“Find/Read more”“out there”等表达，常见于段落末尾；也响应公开可用数据的描述。爱沙尼亚语片段另有零星激活；第8段及第10段其余部分无法可靠归入主模式。

patterns.name: 网页内容的“更多／查看这里”链接
patterns.context: 在网页正文或推荐文字末尾，出现引导读者继续查看、了解更多或访问链接的短语；触发常落在 more、here、there 及其前后词上。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传、博客、新闻与内容推荐

patterns.name: 公开可用的数据与资源
patterns.context: 提及可公开获取的数据、资源，或基于这些材料进行搜集、分析；可能与互联网数据或研究数据相关。

patterns.name: 末尾的地点／对象链接或指向
patterns.context: 表达某物或资料可在网络上找到，或询问是否存在相关工具；常出现在句末或链接导引处。

patterns.name: 末尾问句中的“there”
patterns.context: 以存在句询问是否有某类工具或资源，激活集中在疑问句中的 there 及邻近词。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词尾／词形片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语连续词片段被切分为多个 token；激活出现在句中词形，而非英语网页导引语境。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本，爱沙尼亚语

en.concept: Common web fragments and SQL JOIN
en.description: Activations occur in word fragments and common web phrasing, especially traffic-driving expressions such as “out there,” “more,” and “internet.” Several StackExchange passages center on SQL INNER JOIN, ON, and id fields. Other contexts include comments, product recommendations, local news, and promotional copy, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Compound-word fragments at English word boundaries
patterns.context: Often appears at the end of a word, phrase, or sentence, and also within technical terms; activation position is unstable and includes different parts of speech
patterns.domain: Web text, comments, tutorials, and code-mixed text

patterns.name: SQL INNER JOIN and related fields
patterns.context: An SQL query combines tables using INNER JOIN and links them via id fields; these are mostly code examples, but also include explanations of JOIN
patterns.domain: StackExchange database Q&A and SQL code

patterns.name: Web traffic-driving and promotional copy aimed at readers
patterns.context: Web copy prompts readers to see more, visit links, submit information, or follow internet traffic; no specific topic is required
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web copy, promotions, and directory descriptions

patterns.name: Evaluation contexts for digital products and fictional works
patterns.context: Compares or evaluates optional works or products, using phrases such as “there are better…” or product-recommendation language

patterns.name: Specific join query in an SQL example
patterns.context: Joins two tables using their id fields; activation here is especially concentrated near the field identifiers

patterns.name: Count queries in database descriptions
patterns.context: Joins description and question tables, counts by description, and filters questions; triggers include fields and SQL clauses

patterns.name: Local news coverage of back-to-school events
patterns.context: Local news reports on a back-to-school event and fundraising, with a further-reading link at the end

patterns.name: Buying advice for shaving products
patterns.context: Offers recommendations and product reviews for scissors, safety razors, and trimmers

patterns.name: Video editing and service promotion
patterns.context: Describes a service’s security and features and directs users to visit via a URL

patterns.name: SQL JOIN tutorial prompt
patterns.context: Provides a JOIN example with product and agent tables and recommends reviewing JOIN syntax

patterns.name: Joining and filtering medical tables
patterns.context: Joins patient and medication records, counts patients, and filters by medication category

patterns.name: Online directories and traffic promotion
patterns.context: Invites users to submit information to improve directory relevance and website traffic

5_1172.concept: 网页常见词片段与SQL JOIN
5_1172.description: 激活分布于词内片段和常见网页措辞，尤见于“out there”“more”“internet”等导流表达；若干 StackExchange 段则集中在 SQL INNER JOIN、ON 与 id 字段。另有评论、产品建议、地方新闻及推广文案等语境，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语词边界处的复合词片段
patterns.trigger: 词内拆分后被标记的后缀或片段，如 «net»«worth»、«inner»«JOIN»、«identi»«cal»；另有 «internet»、«there»、«more» 等完整词
patterns.context: 常出现在词语、短语或句子末尾，也会出现在技术词内部；激活位置并不稳定，且包括不同词类
patterns.domain: 网页文本、评论、教程及代码混合文本

patterns.name: SQL 的 INNER JOIN 及其关联字段
patterns.trigger: «INNER JOIN»、«ON»、«id»，以及「products … agent … id」等表名和连接字段
patterns.context: SQL 查询中以 INNER JOIN 合并表，并用 id 字段建立连接；多为示例代码，也包括围绕 JOIN 的解释
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数据库问答与 SQL 代码

patterns.name: 面向读者的网页导流与推广措辞
patterns.context: 网页文案引导读者查看更多、访问链接、提交信息或关注互联网流量；不要求特定主题
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页文案、宣传及目录介绍

patterns.name: 数字产品与虚构作品的评价语境
patterns.context: 比较或评价可选作品、产品，出现“there are better…”或产品推荐式措辞
patterns.domain: 游戏评论、消费建议网页

patterns.name: SQL 示例中的特定连接查询
patterns.trigger: «id» 及其前后的「SELECT * FROM … INNER JOIN … ON …」
patterns.context: 以表的 id 字段连接两张表；此处激活尤其集中在字段标识符附近

patterns.name: 数据库描述计数查询
patterns.context: 连接描述与问题表，并按 description 计数、筛选问题；触发点包括字段和 SQL 子句

patterns.name: 地域性返校活动报道
patterns.trigger: «more» «here»，其前文提到 Homecoming Court、募款和慈善
patterns.context: 地方新闻报道返校活动及募捐，末尾提供进一步阅读入口

patterns.name: 剃须用品的选购建议
patterns.context: 围绕剪刀、安全剃刀和修剪器提供选择建议及产品评测
patterns.domain: 消费指南或产品评测网页

patterns.name: 视频编辑与服务推广
patterns.context: 介绍服务的安全性与功能，并用网址引导访问

patterns.name: SQL JOIN 教学提示
patterns.context: 给出产品与代理人表的 JOIN 示例，并建议复习 JOIN 语法

patterns.name: 医疗表的连接与筛选
patterns.context: 连接患者和用药记录，统计患者并按药物类别筛选
patterns.domain: StackExchange 医疗数据库 SQL 示例

patterns.name: 网络目录与流量宣传
patterns.context: 邀请用户提交资料以提高目录相关性和网站流量
patterns.domain: 机构或地区目录网页宣传

en.description: Activations are distributed across emphasis on locations or scope in web copy, calls to read or learn more, interface location instructions, the code field id, and “remotely” in negation. No single word form or topic explains all passages.

patterns.name: Web-copy emphasis at “there”
patterns.context: In web descriptions or promotional copy, points to a place, scope, or availability; often emphasizes location or scope at the end of a sentence or phrase

patterns.name: “More” call-to-action link copy
patterns.context: Call-to-action/link text at the end of web content or promotional text, encouraging readers to continue reading or learn more
patterns.domain: Web marketing, news, or product content

patterns.name: Location word in comment-box instructions
patterns.context: Explains that users can click in the upper-right corner of the comment box to report inappropriate content

patterns.name: SQL identifier and field access
patterns.context: In a PHP database query, an SQL JOIN condition compares id fields from two tables; activation is concentrated on the field name id

patterns.name: “Remotely” emphasizing a negative judgment
patterns.context: Appears with “I don't think this is even,” reinforcing the rejection of the claim that quantum computers could replace ordinary computers

5_1172.concept: 网页文本中的强调性片段
5_1172.description: 激活分散在网页文案的地点或范围强调、阅读/了解更多的链接号召、界面位置说明，以及代码字段 id 和否定句中的 remotely；没有一个词形或主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: “there”位置的网页文案强调
patterns.context: 网页描述或宣传文案中，指向某处、范围或可获得性；常在句末或短语末尾强调地点、范围

patterns.name: “More”号召式链接文案
patterns.context: 网页内容或宣传文字结尾处的行动号召／链接文字，促使读者继续阅读或了解
patterns.domain: 网页营销、新闻或产品内容

patterns.name: 评论框界面中的位置词
patterns.context: 说明在评论框界面中点击右上角以举报违规内容
patterns.domain: 网站使用说明、社区规范

patterns.name: SQL 标识符及字段访问
patterns.context: PHP 数据库查询中，SQL JOIN 条件比较两张表的 id 字段；触发集中在字段名 id

patterns.name: “remotely”强调否定判断
patterns.context: 与 “I don't think this is even” 连用，强化对量子计算替代普通电脑这一说法的否定

en.description: Activations concentrate on emphatic words in phrases or at sentence ends in web copy or instructions, such as more, out there, and right here. There are also local patterns involving remotely (a negative feasibility judgment) and found on the (finding information); no unified semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Sentence-final focus words in information-search or recommendation text
patterns.context: A word at the end of a sentence or phrase activates in web copy or instructions that summarize, recommend, or prompt further reading; its position varies across passages
patterns.domain: Commercial websites, product or content recommendations, explanatory text

patterns.name: Sentence-final word in a feasibility or possibility judgment
patterns.context: In a negative judgment, an intensifying adverb appears at a line break at the end of the sentence, followed by the adjective being judged

patterns.name: Expression of missing performance information
patterns.context: States that no performance dates can be found for a region; the phrase is followed by a website or page name

5_1172.concept: 网页文案中的强调性短语
5_1172.description: 激活集中在网页文案或说明中短语、句末的强调性词语，如 more、out there、right here；另有 remotely（否定可行性判断）及 found on the（查找信息）等局部模式，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 信息检索或推荐语句的句末重点词
patterns.context: 网页文案或说明文字在总结、推荐或引导继续阅读时，句末/短语末尾的词激活；不同段中位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 商业网页、产品或内容推荐、说明文

patterns.name: 可行性与可能性判断的句末词
patterns.context: 否定判断中，程度副词位于句末换行处，后接被判断的形容词。

patterns.name: 演出信息缺失表达
patterns.context: 说明某区域没有可查到的演出日期，短语后接网站或页面名称。
patterns.domain: 音乐演出相关网页文本

en.concept: Multiple local lexical and formatting cues
en.description: Activations are scattered: code exception handling and returns, email-style openings, question marks, and Q&A formats are most prominent. Also present are medical terms, mathematical terminology, football statistics, and a haiku title, with no stable semantic feature spanning the examples.

patterns.name: Answer-style code returns and exception handling
patterns.context: Handling payloads, module loading, or exceptions in code blocks; segment 1 also has a `=>` function body and indentation structure

patterns.name: Conversational opening
patterns.context: Opening a message or introducing a plan in email or informal communication; activations cluster at the beginning of sentences

patterns.name: Question-mark punctuation
patterns.context: At the end of questions; segment 4 is followed immediately by a newline, while segments 6 and 9 use a question-and-answer format
patterns.domain: Q&A, math problems, and web headlines

patterns.name: Headline-style rhetorical question
patterns.context: A short question followed by a newline and continuation text; activation peaks on the question mark

patterns.name: Biomedical noun phrase
patterns.context: A core noun in a description of a small-cell lung carcinoma membrane antigen

patterns.name: Number-theory true-or-false questions
patterns.context: Natural-language questions about primes, composites, or divisibility, followed by True/False; numbers are split into multiple tokens

patterns.name: Sports-statistics narration
patterns.context: Adjacent to numbers in statistical lists of American football players’ seasonal performance

patterns.name: Haiku error-message headline
patterns.context: A Hacker News link headline phrased as a question, followed by a URL

5_1308.concept: 多种局部词法与格式线索
5_1308.description: 激活线索分散：代码异常处理与返回、邮件式开场、问号及问答格式最明显；另见医学名词、数学术语、橄榄球统计和俳句标题，缺乏贯穿各段的稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: 回答式代码返回与异常处理
patterns.context: 代码块中处理 payload、模块加载或异常；第 1 段还有 `=>` 函数体和缩进结构

patterns.name: 会话式开场语
patterns.context: 邮件或非正式交流中开启发言、提出计划；激活集中在句首

patterns.name: 问句标点
patterns.context: 问句结尾处；第 4 段紧接换行，第 6、9 段是逐项问答格式
patterns.domain: 问答、数学题及网页标题

patterns.name: 标题式反问
patterns.context: 短问句后换行，接续内容；激活最高在问号

patterns.name: 生物医学名词短语
patterns.context: 作为肺小细胞癌膜抗原描述中的核心名词

patterns.name: 数论判断题
patterns.context: 以自然语言询问素数、合数或整除关系，并给出 True/False；数字被切分为多个 token

patterns.name: 体育统计叙述
patterns.context: 美式橄榄球运动员赛季表现的统计列表中，紧邻数字

patterns.name: 俳句错误消息标题
patterns.context: 以问句形式出现的 Hacker News 链接标题，后接 URL

en.description: Activations occur across various text boundaries and local fragments: email-initial Ok, question marks/newlines, sentence-initial Here, and medical terminology, mathematical symbols, names, headline subword fragments, and code comments. Apart from several opening markers, there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Ok
patterns.context: An email or conversation response beginning with Ok, followed by a greeting or a plan.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial questions and question-mark line breaks
patterns.context: A question or headline-style phrase ends with a question mark; in one segment, the newline after the question mark is also marked.

patterns.name: Newlines and subsequent text boundaries
patterns.context: The beginning of text paragraphs, headings, or code comments; the newline itself is repeatedly activated, but the following content varies considerably.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Here
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Here, followed by a place and explanatory content.

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: An internal word fragment in the term membrane antigen and the subsequent medical description.

patterns.name: Mathematical negatives and operators
patterns.context: Minus and plus signs in expressions, between numbers or fractions.

patterns.name: Character fragments in names
patterns.context: Names in book production credits are tokenized into multiple fragments; activation falls on characters within names.

patterns.name: Proper-name or domain fragments in headlines
patterns.context: Proper names, domains, or internal fragments of common words in web headlines or questions; activation positions do not form a consistent meaning.

patterns.name: Code comment openings and version numbers
patterns.context: The opening of a block comment in a CSS/JavaScript library, including the project name and version number.

5_1308.description: 激活分布在多种文本边界与局部片段：邮件句首 Ok、问号/换行、句首 Here，以及医学术语、数学符号、人名、标题词片段和代码注释。除若干开头标记外，缺少统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 句首 Ok
patterns.context: 邮件或对话中以 Ok 开始回应，后续可接称呼或计划说明。

patterns.name: 句首疑问与问号换行
patterns.context: 问句或标题式短语以问号结束；问号后的换行在一段中也被标记。

patterns.name: 换行及其后的文本边界
patterns.context: 文本段落、标题或代码注释的开头；换行本身反复激活，但其后内容差异较大。

patterns.name: 句首 Here
patterns.context: 句子以 Here 起始，后接地点及说明性内容。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 术语 membrane antigen 中的词内片段及其后续医学描述。

patterns.name: 数学负数与运算符
patterns.context: 算式中的负号和加号，夹在数字或分数之间。

patterns.name: 姓名中的字符片段
patterns.context: 书籍制作署名中的人名被分词成多个片段；激活落在姓名内部字符上。

patterns.name: 标题中的专名或域名片段
patterns.context: 网页标题或问题文本中的专名、域名或普通词内部片段；触发位置不构成一致词义。

patterns.name: 代码注释开头及版本号
patterns.context: CSS/JavaScript 库的块注释开头，包含项目名和版本号。

en.description: Activations cluster around the line-initial discourse marker “Ok” and around newlines, indentation, comment asterisks, and headline-style text in source code or documents. They also span distinct content such as copyright notices, licenses, configuration fields, and legal headings.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “Ok”
patterns.context: “Ok” appears at the beginning of a message as a discourse marker opening a response or introducing what follows; activation falls mainly on Ok, while subsequent words are not a stable trigger.

patterns.name: Code comment opening format
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of block comments in source files, often introducing file descriptions, copyright, or license text.

patterns.name: Spaces and asterisk formatting in code comments
patterns.context: Line-initial indentation and asterisks form a repeated formatting template within comments or license blocks; associated with high activation in several examples.

patterns.name: Copyright notice
patterns.context: Identifies a copyright year and an individual or organization in a code comment, often near the beginning of the comment.

patterns.name: License title and body formatting
patterns.context: License text appears with uppercase titles, newlines, and indentation.

patterns.name: Configuration items or property lists
patterns.context: Newlines and indented key-value items or field mappings; colons or equals signs are followed by values such as numbers or identifiers.
patterns.domain: Github configuration, code, or data definitions

patterns.name: Court document heading
patterns.context: A formal heading rendered as an uppercase institutional name and newline, preceded by substantial indentation.

5_1308.description: 激活集中在行首语篇标记“Ok”，以及源码或文档中的换行、缩进、注释星号和标题式文本；另覆盖版权、许可证、配置字段及法律抬头等不同内容。

patterns.name: 句首“Ok”
patterns.trigger: «Ok»，后接口语称呼或计划说明，如 “Ok guys I've taken a stab at” 和 “Ok, here's the plan”
patterns.context: “Ok”位于消息开头，作为开启回应或引出后续内容的语篇标记；激活主要落在 Ok，本身的后续词并非稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、非正式商务交流

patterns.name: 代码注释起始格式
patterns.trigger: «/*!» 或 «/**»，随后是换行及注释行标记 « *»
patterns.context: 出现在源码文件的块注释开头，常引出文件说明、版权或许可证文本。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的空格与星号排版
patterns.trigger: 注释行中的缩进空格 «    »、« *»，以及 «↵»
patterns.context: 注释或许可证块内，行首缩进和星号构成重复的排版模板；在若干示例中与高激活相关。

patterns.name: 版权声明
patterns.trigger: «Copyright»，以及年份和版权所有者文本；另有 «(C)»、«(c)»
patterns.context: 代码注释中标明版权年份与个人或组织，常位于注释开头附近。

patterns.name: 许可证标题与正文格式
patterns.trigger: «GNU GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE»、«Version»及其周围缩进
patterns.context: 许可证文本以大写标题、换行和缩进排版出现。

patterns.name: 配置项或属性清单
patterns.context: 换行、缩进的键值项或字段映射；冒号或等号后接数值、标识符等值。
patterns.domain: Github 配置、代码或数据定义

patterns.name: 法院文件抬头
patterns.trigger: «UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT»、«FOR THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA»
patterns.context: 以大写机构名称和换行呈现的正式抬头，前有大量空格缩进。

en.description: Activations are distributed across web markup, mathematical symbols, email openings, technical forum terms, and various code fragments. Locally they often fall on plus signs, newline indentation, code markers, and adjacent tokens; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: English entries and HTML/markup boundaries
patterns.context: In web or structured text, title/field markers, quotation marks, plus signs, empty tags, arrows, and adjacent newlines; “Entries Tag ged” appears before and is followed by Google

patterns.name: l and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variable l, numbers, and multiplication, division, addition, or subtraction symbols densely interleave, often with newlines or incomplete expressions

patterns.name: Conversational email opening
patterns.context: An email begins with Ok, introducing an address to a group, an action already taken, or a plan

patterns.name: Plus signs and numeric/pointer arguments in code
patterns.context: Plus signs connect numbers or expressions in formatting calculations and code calls involving container sizes or indices

patterns.name: Code block endings and newline indentation
patterns.context: In multiline code, return statements, closing braces, and indentation on the next line recur

patterns.name: moneyFormatFloor call
patterns.context: JavaScript-style code applies moneyFormatFloor to tempValue, either directly or after adding 0.1

patterns.name: Technical terms in a web help post
patterns.context: A help seeker looks for people with real project experience to discuss React and Node.js applications

patterns.name: C/C++-style assertion and out-of-bounds text
patterns.context: An assertion macro checks a list pointer and the result of modules.size() plus a constant, with an out-of-bounds error string

patterns.name: Russian text and Python newline string
patterns.context: Russian text is followed by Python Q&A code; a function concatenates string s with a newline and returns it

patterns.name: Build-script-generated comment and filename
patterns.context: A shell script header notes that it is machine-generated and must not be edited, and records an identifier related to the build command

5_1308.description: 激活分布在网页标记、数学符号、邮件开场、论坛技术词和多种代码片段中；局部常落在加号、换行缩进、代码标记及相邻 token 上，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文条目与 HTML/标记边界
patterns.context: 网页或结构化文本中，标题/字段标记、引号、加号、空标签、箭头和换行相邻；前面出现“Entries Tag ged”，后接 Google
patterns.domain: 网页抓取文本或格式化条目

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 l 与运算符
patterns.context: 变量 l、数字和乘除加减等符号密集交错，常夹有换行或不完整表达式

patterns.name: 邮件中的口语开场
patterns.trigger: «Ok»；«Ok»后接 «guys» 或逗号，再接邮件计划内容
patterns.context: 邮件开头以 Ok 引出对群体的发言、已采取的行动或计划

patterns.name: 代码中的加号及数值/指针参数
patterns.context: 加号连接数值或表达式，出现于格式化计算、容器大小/索引等代码调用中

patterns.name: 代码块结束与换行缩进
patterns.context: 多行代码中，return 语句、右花括号和下一行缩进反复出现

patterns.name: moneyFormatFloor 调用
patterns.context: JavaScript 风格代码中，对 tempValue 执行 moneyFormatFloor，并出现直接传入及加 0.1 后传入的形式

patterns.name: 网页求助帖中的技术名词
patterns.context: 求助者寻找有真实项目经验的人，讨论 React、Node.js 应用

patterns.name: C/C++ 风格断言及越界文本
patterns.context: 断言宏调用列表指针与 modules.size() 加常数的结果，并附越界错误字符串

patterns.name: 俄文片段与 Python 换行字符串
patterns.context: 俄文文字后出现 Python 问答代码，函数把字符串 s 与换行符拼接并返回

patterns.name: 构建脚本生成注释与文件名
patterns.context: shell 脚本文件头注明机器生成、不可编辑，并记录构建命令相关标识

en.description: Activations appear in sequence-term problems and mathematical expressions containing negatives and minus signs, as well as in Greek word forms, money-formatting code, modulo loops, and numeric-sorting instructions. No single clear trigger pattern covers these heterogeneous texts.

patterns.name: Finding a sequence’s general term
patterns.context: A math problem asks for the kth, rth, uth, or pth term, or the general term, from several sequence values; the sequence may follow a quadratic or simple increasing pattern

patterns.name: Minus signs and negative numbers in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign appears in formulas, arithmetic expressions, or surrounding sequence-problem text; it may indicate a negative number or subtraction

patterns.name: Greek word forms
patterns.context: Characters or subword fragments in continuous Greek text; activation clusters on Greek-letter sequences rather than mathematical or code contexts

patterns.name: JavaScript money-formatting code
patterns.context: A function branch calls a money-formatting method, handling the original value and the value increased by 0.01 separately

patterns.name: JavaScript loops and modulo
patterns.context: A loop iterates over i and uses modulo to test divisibility before appending a string; a comment says the original number will always be included

patterns.name: Numeric sorting instruction
patterns.context: An instruction asks for several given numbers to be sorted in descending order, followed by more numbers or calculations

5_1308.concept: 异质文本中的局部片段
5_1308.description: 激活分布于数列通项题及含负数、减号的数学表达式，也出现在希腊语词形、金额格式化代码、取模循环和数值排序指令中；未见能覆盖这些异质文本的单一明确触发模式。

patterns.name: 数列通项求解题
patterns.trigger: “What is the …'th term of”以及随后给出的逗号分隔数列；常伴有以变量表示的多项式答案
patterns.context: 数学题目要求从若干数列项推断第 k、r、u 或 p 项，或求通项；数列可能呈现二次规律或简单递增规律

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的减号与负数
patterns.context: 减号出现在公式、算术表达式或数列题的前后文中，既可能表示负数，也可能表示减法

patterns.name: 希腊语词形
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文本中的词语字符或子词片段；触发集中在希腊字母序列，而非数学或代码语境

patterns.name: JavaScript 金额格式化代码
patterns.context: 函数分支中调用金额格式化方法，分别处理原值与加上 0.01 的值

patterns.name: JavaScript 循环与取模
patterns.context: 循环遍历 i，并通过取模判断整除后追加字符串；注释说明总会包含原数

patterns.name: 数值排序指令
patterns.context: 要求将给定的若干数值按降序排列，后文继续给出数值或计算内容

en.description: Activations occur across many text types, often on tokenized symbols, identifiers, or uppercase word fragments. They appear in mathematical formulas, code, JSON, database names, and colloquial text, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Symbol and punctuation activations under special tokenization
patterns.context: Activations often fall on non-ordinary subwords, punctuation, or uppercase/specially formatted fragments; the examples share no common local semantic condition.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematics and formal symbols
patterns.context: Appears near mathematical formulas, variable subscripts, relation symbols, or LaTeX commands.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math, physics, and theory papers

patterns.name: Camel-case identifiers and type fragments in code
patterns.context: Occurs in C++ declarations, member names, type names, or method calls; activation may fall on subwords within identifiers.

patterns.name: JSON key-values and database constraint identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in quoted JSON field names, random strings, or all-uppercase, underscore-separated configuration or constraint names.
patterns.domain: Structured data, configuration, and database test code

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in uppercase English colloquial text
patterns.context: Activation occurs in uppercase, subword-tokenized conversational advertising/dialogue, rather than formula or code structure.
patterns.domain: Colloquial or advertising content in FreeLaw text

patterns.name: Graph theory terminology in abstracts
patterns.context: An abstract introduces random walks or pursuit problems on graphs; visible activation currently falls mainly on split word fragments.
patterns.domain: ArXiv abstracts, graph theory or probability

5_1308.description: 激活分布于多种文本中，常落在被拆分的符号、标识符或大写词片段；数学公式、代码、JSON、数据库名及口语文本均出现，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 特殊分词下的符号与标点激活
patterns.trigger: 多处触发集中在被拆分或混合编码的符号串，如 [1] «T»、«$»、«_»；[3] «otimes»、«oplus»；[5] JSON 字符串与随机键；[7] AUTO_INCREMENT；[8] 全大写口语；[9] std::ostream
patterns.context: 激活常落在非普通词汇的子词、标点或大写/特殊格式片段上；各段缺乏共同的局部语义条件。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学及形式化符号
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式、变量下标、关系符号或 LaTeX 命令附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论论文

patterns.name: 代码中的驼峰/标识符与类型片段
patterns.context: 位于 C++ 声明、成员名、类型名或方法调用中；激活点可能是标识符内部子词。

patterns.name: JSON 键值和数据库约束标识符
patterns.context: 出现在引号括起的 JSON 字段名、随机字符串或全大写下划线分隔的配置/约束名中。
patterns.domain: 结构化数据、配置与数据库测试代码

patterns.name: 英语大写口语文本的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在大写、按子词切分的对话式广告/对白，而非公式或代码结构。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 文本中的口语或广告式内容

patterns.name: 摘要中的图论术语
patterns.context: 摘要介绍图上随机游走/追捕问题；目前可见激活主要落在被拆分的词片段。

en.description: Activations appear in three heterogeneous text types: operators, coefficients, and question wording in automatically generated algebra problems; identifiers and member/property syntax in code; and LaTeX formula commands and symbols in papers. No single stable cross-domain trigger substring is apparent.

patterns.name: Signed-coefficient expressions in math problems
patterns.context: After an algebraic expression or function definition, the text asks for a polynomial function value or a sum of products; activations are scattered across operators, numbers, variables, and problem wording
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, automatically generated algebra problems

patterns.name: Identifiers and member access in code
patterns.context: Identifiers, member access, method calls, and type/property configuration statements in Go or C# code; no clearly consistent single code-syntax trigger

patterns.name: Formula markers and symbols in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Around commands, Greek letters, and mathematical relation symbols in LaTeX formulas, integrals, or representation-theoretic expressions

5_1308.concept: 数学符号与结构化表达式
5_1308.description: 激活见于三类异质文本：自动代数题中的运算符、系数与提问语句，代码中的标识符和成员/属性语法，以及论文 LaTeX 公式命令与符号。未见跨领域稳定的单一触发子串。

patterns.name: 数学题中的带符号系数表达式
patterns.trigger: «-»、«+»及相邻的数字、变量或乘法项；常与«What is»、«Determine»、«Calculate»及«*»相邻
patterns.context: 代数式或函数定义后，询问多项式函数值或若干乘积之和；激活散布在运算符、数字、变量和题目措辞上
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，自动生成的代数题

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与成员访问
patterns.context: Go 或 C# 代码中，标识符、成员访问、方法调用及类型/属性配置语句；没有显然一致的单一代码语法触发点

patterns.name: 数学论文中的公式标记与符号
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式、积分或表示论式表达式中，命令、希腊字母和数学关系符号周围

en.description: Activations are scattered across code/SQL syntax boundaries, mathematical formula structure and symbols, English with-phrases, Japanese descriptions of exceptions, and tokenized names in encyclopedic text. Some triggers may be local word forms or marker boundaries, but no unified semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: Code and syntax-structure boundaries
patterns.context: Keywords, identifiers, and adjacent spaces, punctuation, and structural boundaries in code or queries; includes C++, PHP, and SQL.

patterns.name: Separators and structural symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Near formula punctuation, set/norm symbols, parentheses, or LaTeX structure in math-paper formulas and proofs; activation is not limited to one operation.

patterns.name: English relational word with
patterns.context: Connects entities with their attributes, members, or holders in English noun phrases; appears in biographies of people with surnames and in legal factual accounts.

patterns.name: Japanese exception wording and explanation of causes
patterns.context: A Japanese sentence discusses an exception and its specific cause; nearby text also describes service-status updates.

patterns.name: Paciotti in a name
patterns.context: The surname Paciotti is marked as a split fragment at the word ending; appears in lists of people and biographical introductions.

patterns.name: von Ahrensberg in a name
patterns.context: The compound surname recurs in biographies and cast lists, with activation near tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia biographies and film/TV articles

patterns.name: Numeric-threshold phrase
patterns.context: A legal account describes people holding less than a specified number of shares; this activation is weak and isolated.

5_1308.description: 激活分散于代码/SQL语法边界、数学公式结构与符号、英文with关系短语，以及日文异常表述和百科人名分词；部分触发可能是局部词形或标记边界，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 代码与语法结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或查询语句中的关键字、标识符及其相邻空格、标点和结构边界；涉及 C++、PHP、SQL。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的分隔与结构符号
patterns.context: 数学论文公式及证明中，公式标点、集合/范数符号、括号或 LaTeX 结构附近；激活不局限于某一种运算。

patterns.name: 英文关系词 with
patterns.context: 英文名词短语中连接实体与其属性、成员或持有人；出现于姓氏人物介绍和法律事实叙述。

patterns.name: 日文异常词语及原因说明
patterns.context: 日文句子谈到异常发生及其具体原因，附近还出现服务状态更新等说明。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Paciotti
patterns.context: 姓氏 Paciotti 在词尾被拆分标记；出现在人物名单及人物介绍中。

patterns.name: 人名中的 von Ahrensberg
patterns.context: 复合姓氏在人物介绍和演员名单中重复出现，分词边界附近激活。
patterns.domain: 英文百科人物与影视条目

patterns.name: 数字阈值短语
patterns.context: 法律事实中描述持股数量低于特定门槛的人群；该激活较弱且孤立。

en.description: Primarily responds to public base classes introduced by a colon in C++ class declarations and to C++ constructor initializer lists; also appears in Dart super initialization. C++ template code and an internal fragment in a Wikipedia passage may be secondary or incidental patterns.

patterns.name: Colon in C++ inheritance declarations
patterns.context: A colon after a class name in a C++ `class` declaration introduces one or more base classes; activation is concentrated on the colon and nearby `public`.

patterns.name: C++ constructor member initializer lists
patterns.context: An initializer list after a C++ constructor declaration and before the function body; the colon is followed by members or base classes and parenthesized arguments.

patterns.name: Dart constructor super initialization
patterns.context: A Dart constructor calls the parent constructor after its parameter list using a colon, passing named arguments.

patterns.name: Template declarations and template metaprogramming
patterns.context: C++ template definitions or template parameter lists; snippets include type deduction/metaprogramming code and multiline template parameters.

patterns.name: Letter fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within English/French names or words, rather than an evidently independent syntactic structure.

5_1308.concept: 冒号引出的继承或初始化结构
5_1308.description: 主要响应 C++ 类声明中冒号引出的 public 基类，以及 C++ 构造函数初始化列表；也见于 Dart 的 super 初始化。另有 C++ 模板代码和一段维基百科词内片段，可能是次要或偶然模式。

patterns.name: C++ 继承声明中的冒号
patterns.trigger: `:9« public`，后接基类名；如 `: public WindowEx`、`: public FilterPolicy`、`: public RefCounted`
patterns.context: C++ `class` 声明的类名之后，以冒号引出一个或多个基类；激活集中落在冒号及 `public` 附近。

patterns.name: C++ 构造函数成员初始化列表
patterns.context: C++ 构造函数声明后、函数体开始前的初始化列表；冒号后接成员或基类及括号参数。

patterns.name: Dart 构造函数的 super 初始化
patterns.context: Dart 构造函数参数列表后，以冒号调用父类构造函数，并传入命名参数。

patterns.name: 模板声明与模板元编程
patterns.context: C++ 模板定义或模板参数列表；片段包含类型推导/元编程代码及跨行模板参数。

patterns.name: 英语词内的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语/法语人名或词语内部的子词片段，而非显然独立的语法结构。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code-structure punctuation and identifier fragments, parliamentary transcript attributions and multilingual word fragments, and apostrophes and headline hyphens in English copy. No single word meaning or stable context spans all examples.

patterns.name: Control-flow or code-block boundaries
patterns.context: In source code, especially structural boundaries of functions, conditionals, or module wrappers; activations fall on punctuation, whitespace, and adjacent code tokens, without being limited to one language

patterns.name: Word fragments and case boundaries within identifiers
patterns.context: Activation may fall on camel-case identifiers, name fragments, or word endings; there is no consistent meaning or fixed position

patterns.name: European Parliament speaker-attribution format
patterns.context: In EuroParl transcripts, speaker names often appear in attribution positions after a newline, followed by a language marker or a new speech

patterns.name: Apostrophes in English promotional slogans
patterns.context: Contraction apostrophes in short English retail slogans; activation falls mainly on the apostrophe character

patterns.name: Hyphens in headlines
patterns.context: Connects compound modifiers in English headlines

patterns.name: Accented or Greek-letter fragments within non-English words
patterns.context: Markers fall on internal characters or subwords in non-English words; these examples vary in language and meaning and show no stable grammatical or semantic condition
patterns.domain: Swedish, Danish, and Greek political text

5_1308.description: 激活分散在代码结构标点与标识符片段、议会逐字稿的署名和多语种词片段，以及英文文案的撇号、标题连字符；没有贯穿全部样本的单一词义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: 控制流或代码块边界
patterns.context: 在源代码中，尤其是函数、条件语句或模块包装器的结构边界；激活落在标点、空白及相邻代码 token 上，不局限于某一种语言

patterns.name: 标识符内部的词片与大小写边界
patterns.trigger: `LogItemThread::LogItemThread()`、`Toussas`、`Hannan`、`Ricardo` 等标识符或专名中被标记的片段
patterns.context: 激活可落在驼峰式标识符、名字片段或词尾；没有一致的词义或固定位置
patterns.domain: 代码标识符及人名文本

patterns.name: 欧洲议会发言人署名格式
patterns.trigger: `Daniel Hannan`（[6]、[9]）；另见 `Georgios Toussas`（[5]）及其后的 `↵(EN)` 或发言正文
patterns.context: EuroParl 逐字稿中，发言人名字常出现在换行后的署名位置，并接语言标记或新发言
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种转录文本

patterns.name: 英文宣传语中的撇号
patterns.context: 英文零售宣传短句中的缩写撇号；激活主要落在撇号字符

patterns.name: 标题中的连字符
patterns.context: 英文标题里连接复合修饰语

patterns.name: 非英语词内部的重音或希腊字母片段
patterns.trigger: 瑞典语 `säker`、`vårt`、`närvarande`；丹麦语 `tilgængelig`；希腊语 `Ουγγαρία`、`επιτροπή` 中被标记的子词片段
patterns.context: 标记落在非英语词的内部字符或子词上；这些例子语言与语义各异，未显示稳定的语法或语义条件
patterns.domain: 瑞典语、丹麦语、希腊语政治文本

en.concept: Boundaries and formatting in structured text
en.description: Activations fall mainly on indentation whitespace, compound identifiers, and syntax boundaries in code, commonly around class and function structures. Other localized patterns include aligned headers in court documents, parliamentary transcript formatting, log separators, indentation checksums, and SVG attribute code.

patterns.name: Indentation and whitespace in C++/C# code
patterns.context: Indentation, blank lines, and alignment positions in code structures are marked; they commonly occur near braces, declarations, or member functions

patterns.name: Compound names in types or identifiers
patterns.context: Programming-language identifiers composed of multiple subword fragments, commonly appearing in class, member, or variable declarations

patterns.name: Code punctuation and syntax boundaries
patterns.context: Boundaries in code syntax structures; some activations fall on punctuation itself or on surrounding spaces

patterns.name: Near initialization and constructors
patterns.context: Class constructor declarations or definitions, and the beginning of initializer lists or constructor bodies

patterns.name: Court document headers, case numbers, and layout whitespace
patterns.context: Headers or post-page-break case metadata in court opinions, with conspicuous centered-alignment whitespace

patterns.name: Estonian parliamentary speech and speaker labels
patterns.context: Speeches, chair interruption notes, and speaker name/country labels in parliamentary transcripts

patterns.name: Formatting tags in documentation comments
patterns.context: Closing tags in C# XML documentation comments, appearing before class declarations

patterns.name: Separators in strings and log output
patterns.context: Log output statements containing quoted lines of equals signs, followed by loop processing

patterns.name: Indentation-length validation
patterns.context: Assertions or validation logic comparing the actual and expected lengths of indentation text

patterns.name: SVG length attribute access
patterns.context: Function implementation that reads length attribute information from an SVG element

5_1308.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与排版
5_1308.description: 激活主要落在代码中的缩进空白、复合标识符及语法边界，常见于类与函数结构；另覆盖法院文书的对齐页眉、议会记录排版，以及日志分隔线、缩进校验和 SVG 属性代码等局部模式。

patterns.name: C++/C# 代码中的缩进与空白
patterns.trigger: 多处缩进空格，如「    」(2、5、8)、「                        」(4、7)，以及换行后的代码块
patterns.context: 代码结构中的缩进、空行和对齐位置被标记；常与花括号、声明或成员函数附近出现
patterns.domain: 源代码（主要是 GitHub，也含 StackExchange）

patterns.name: 类型或标识符中的复合命名
patterns.trigger: 「LogItemThread」「UpdateWindow」「actualOffsetIndentText」「laPlaceFilter」「LengthAttributesInfo」等名称中的大小写边界及连续标识符
patterns.context: 编程语言标识符由多个词片段构成，常出现在类、成员或变量声明中

patterns.name: 代码标点与语法边界
patterns.trigger: 「::」「()」「{」「}」「:」及「.»等标点，尤其是紧邻函数声明、构造函数或成员访问处
patterns.context: 代码语法结构边界；部分激活落在标点本身或其前后的空格上

patterns.name: 初始化与构造函数附近
patterns.context: 类构造函数声明或定义，以及初始化列表/构造函数体开头

patterns.name: 法院文书页眉、案号与排版空白
patterns.trigger: 「Case:」「Document:」「Fourth Court of Appeals」「MEMORANDUM OPINION」「No.」及其周围长空格
patterns.context: 法院意见书的页眉或分页后的案件元数据，文本带有明显居中对齐空白

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语议会发言与说话人标记
patterns.context: 议会记录中的发言、主席打断说明及发言人姓名/国别标记
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录（爱沙尼亚语片段）

patterns.name: 文档注释中的格式标签
patterns.context: C# XML 文档注释的结束标签，出现在类声明之前

patterns.name: 字符串中的分隔线与日志输出
patterns.context: 日志输出语句包含引号内的等号分隔线，后接循环处理

patterns.name: 缩进长度校验
patterns.context: 比较实际与期望缩进文本长度的断言或校验逻辑

patterns.name: SVG 长度属性访问
patterns.context: 读取 SVG 元素长度属性信息的函数实现

en.description: Activations occur mainly in court document title areas, especially the names of federal courts of appeals and their centered layout. Other activations occur near input-control terms in a single Japanese Gmail question and near punctuation, keywords, and identifier boundaries in various C++ source files; no shared semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: U.S. federal court of appeals titles
patterns.context: Appearing on the first page or in a header, often alongside document numbers, dates, line breaks, and centered-layout spaces; also includes some court titles with clerk, filing date, and other heading information.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw court document headings and layout

patterns.name: Fourth Circuit memorandum opinion titles
patterns.context: Court document title area; court name, location, document type, and case number are arranged on centered lines.

patterns.name: Input-control terms in Gmail and Japanese text
patterns.context: A Japanese question discusses Gmail TextInput behavior; activations occur near Japanese particles/subword fragments and the word Gmail.

patterns.name: C++ container and iterator code
patterns.context: C++ code clears and resizes a container, then traverses it with an iterator; activations cluster near brackets, assignment, and iterator syntax.

patterns.name: C++ function and loop syntax
patterns.context: A function takes a reference to a vector of strings and traverses it with a for loop; activations occur near the function signature and loop-control syntax.

patterns.name: WebCore C++ constructors and member initialization
patterns.context: A C++ constructor definition in the WebCore namespace, with a class-qualified name, parameters, and a member initializer list.

5_1308.description: 主要激活于法院文件标题区，尤其是联邦上诉法院名称及其居中排版；另在单条日语 Gmail 问答和多种 C++ 源码的标点、关键字、标识符边界附近激活，未见共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 美国联邦上诉法院标题
patterns.trigger: «UNITED» STATES COURT« OF» «APPEALS»、«FOR» «THE» FIFTH CIRCUIT、«IN THE»
patterns.context: 出现在文件首页或页眉中，常与文档编号、日期、换行及居中排版空格共同出现；也包括部分法院标题与书记员、提交日期等标题信息。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法院文件标题与版式

patterns.name: 第四上诉法院备忘录意见标题
patterns.context: 法院文件标题区；法院名称、地点、文书类型和案号以分行居中形式排列。

patterns.name: Gmail 与日语文本中的输入控件词
patterns.context: 日语问答在讨论 Gmail 的 TextInput 行为；激活落在日语助词/词内片段和 Gmail 字样附近。

patterns.name: C++ 容器与迭代器代码
patterns.context: C++ 代码中清空并调整容器大小后，以迭代器遍历容器；激活集中在括号、赋值和迭代器语法附近。

patterns.name: C++ 函数与循环语法
patterns.context: 函数接收字符串向量引用并通过 for 循环遍历；激活落在函数签名及循环控制语法附近。

patterns.name: WebCore C++ 构造函数与成员初始化
patterns.context: WebCore 命名空间中的 C++ 构造函数定义，带有类限定名、参数和成员初始化列表。
patterns.domain: Github WebKit 风格 C++ 源码

en.concept: Code declarations and block structure (with legal headers)
en.description: Primarily responds to structural markers near class/function declarations in code: public, parentheses after method names, opening braces, newline indentation, and the start of method bodies. Covers getters, regular methods, class declarations, and loop headers. There is also an isolated response to a legal opinion header.

patterns.name: Java/C++ method declarations and method-body beginnings
patterns.context: Code within a class or function body; activations often fall on parentheses after method names, opening braces, newline indentation, and extend to the beginning of the method body. Some examples include getters/return statements, while others contain loops, so the pattern is not limited to getters.
patterns.domain: Java and C++ code on Github

patterns.name: Class declarations and access modifiers
patterns.context: Near class definitions or class members, especially access modifiers and declaration structures; overlaps with the method-declaration pattern but is not identical.
patterns.domain: C++ and Java code on Github

patterns.name: Legal opinion headers
patterns.context: Centered headers in court rulings or memorandum opinions; no code structure is apparent.

5_1308.concept: 代码声明与块结构（兼有法律页眉）
5_1308.description: 主要响应代码中类/函数声明附近的结构标记：public、方法名后的括号、左花括号、换行缩进及方法体开头；覆盖 getter、普通方法、类声明和循环头。另对法律意见书法院页眉有孤立响应。

patterns.name: Java/C++ 方法声明与方法体开头
patterns.trigger: `public`、方法名、`()`，随后 `{`、换行缩进及 `return`，例如 `public ... getX509DataType() {`、`getHandler()`、`getName()`；也有 `for (...)` 循环头
patterns.context: 代码处于类或函数体中；激活常落在方法名后的括号、左花括号、换行缩进等结构 token 上，并延续到方法体起始处。部分例子包含 getter/返回语句，另有循环结构，不能只归结为 getter。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 Java、C++ 代码

patterns.name: 类声明及访问修饰符
patterns.trigger: `class SSLConfigServicePref : public ...`、`public:`；另见 `public class PinyinComparator implements ...`
patterns.context: 类定义或类体成员区附近，尤其是访问修饰符与声明结构；与方法声明模式有重叠，但不完全相同。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C++、Java 代码

patterns.name: 法律意见书页眉
patterns.trigger: `Fourth Court of Appeals`、`San Antonio, Texas`、`MEMORANDUM OPINION`、`No. 04-20-00060`
patterns.context: 法院判决或备忘录意见书的居中排版页眉；未见代码结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to declaration and structural markers in object-oriented code: classes/access modifiers, braces beginning function bodies after method or constructor signatures, and inheritance and base-constructor syntax. Sporadic activations also occur around comment endings, assignment and null fallback, Python file context managers, C++ namespaces, and compound identifiers. The configuration snippet in the first segment does not fit a stable pattern.

patterns.name: Opening brace after a function or method declaration
patterns.context: In C#, Java, C++, PHP, and other code, a function, constructor, or class method declaration ends and the function body begins; parentheses and a return type or inheritance information have often appeared beforehand

patterns.name: Class declarations and access modifiers
patterns.context: At the beginning of a class definition or near class member declarations, especially where modifiers, class names, and inheritance/constructor syntax occur together

patterns.name: Delimited parameter or configuration assignment
patterns.context: Configuration initialization, object property assignment, or parameter-selection expressions; occurs only in specific code snippets
patterns.domain: Assignment and configuration expressions in source code

patterns.name: C# base-constructor call
patterns.context: A C# constructor declaration calls a base-class constructor after a colon, then enters the function body

patterns.name: Documentation comments and return descriptions
patterns.context: End of a documentation comment before a code declaration, including return-value or type-link descriptions

patterns.name: Python file context manager
patterns.context: Python code opens a CSV file and binds the file handle to a variable, then runs indented write-related code

patterns.name: C# null fallback expression
patterns.context: When service resolution may return null, a property on an existing device object is used as a fallback value

patterns.name: C++ namespaces and constructor definitions
patterns.context: A class constructor with a member initializer list is defined inside nested C++ namespaces

patterns.name: Class inheritance declarations
patterns.context: A C++ class declaration specifies public inheritance from a base class, followed by a public member section

patterns.name: Case boundaries in strings, type names, and member names
patterns.context: Code identifiers consist of multiple case-separated segments; this appears across several segments and is not a unique stable trigger

5_1308.description: 主要响应面向对象代码中的声明与结构标记：类/访问修饰符、方法或构造函数签名后进入函数体的花括号，以及继承和基类构造语法；另对注释收尾、赋值与空值回退、Python文件上下文管理器、C++命名空间及复合标识符有零散激活。第1段配置片段难以归入稳定模式。

patterns.name: 函数或方法声明后的左花括号
patterns.trigger: 方法名与参数列表后的「{」，如「SelectingEventArgs (DbCommand command, DataSourceSelectArguments argument)」后的「{」
patterns.context: C#、Java、C++、PHP 等代码中，函数、构造函数或类的方法声明结束，紧接着进入函数体；通常括号和返回类型或继承信息已出现

patterns.name: 类声明与访问修饰符
patterns.trigger: 「class」「public」「private」「explicit」以及类名、继承关系和访问符号「:」「extends」
patterns.context: 类定义开头或类成员声明附近，尤其是修饰符、类名和继承/构造语法相邻

patterns.name: 带分隔符的参数或配置赋值
patterns.trigger: 「=」「:」「??」及附近的变量、属性名，例如「self.client = client」「partition: region?.partition ?? partition」
patterns.context: 配置初始化、对象属性赋值或参数选择表达式；仅在特定代码片段中出现
patterns.domain: 源代码中的赋值与配置表达式

patterns.name: C# 基类构造调用
patterns.context: C# 构造函数声明后通过冒号调用基类构造函数，再进入函数体

patterns.name: 文档注释与返回说明
patterns.context: 代码声明之前的文档注释收尾，包含返回值或类型链接说明

patterns.name: Python 文件上下文管理器
patterns.context: Python 中打开 CSV 文件并将文件句柄绑定到变量，之后缩进执行写入相关代码

patterns.name: C# 空值回退表达式
patterns.context: 依赖服务解析结果可能为空时，使用已有设备对象上的属性作为回退值

patterns.name: C++ 命名空间与构造函数定义
patterns.context: C++ 中嵌套命名空间内定义带成员初始化列表的类构造函数

patterns.name: 类继承声明
patterns.context: C++ 类声明通过 public 继承指定基类，后接 public 成员区

patterns.name: 字符串、类型名及成员名中的大小写边界
patterns.context: 代码标识符由多个大小写分段组成；多段中同时出现，未显示为唯一稳定触发条件

en.description: Primarily responds to closing parentheses at the end of function, method, and constructor parameter lists, especially when immediately followed by the opening brace of a function body. Also responds to opening braces for classes, conditional blocks, and other code blocks, along with nearby newline indentation, across multiple programming languages.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis in function/method signatures
patterns.context: At the end of the parameter list in a function, method, or constructor declaration, often followed by a return type or method body, or immediately by the opening brace of the method body; occurs across multiple languages

patterns.name: Opening brace of a method body
patterns.context: At the start of a function or constructor definition; also appears near the beginning of class definitions or code blocks

patterns.name: Opening brace of a class/code block
patterns.context: After a class, namespace, or conditional-block declaration/control structure; not necessarily a function body

patterns.name: Code line endings and indented newlines
patterns.context: A new line begins after a declaration, comment, or statement; adjacent to structural boundaries near braces

5_1308.description: 主要响应函数、方法和构造函数参数列表结束的右括号，尤其紧接函数体左花括号；也响应类、条件块等代码块左花括号及其附近的换行缩进，跨多种编程语言。

patterns.name: 函数/方法签名的右括号
patterns.trigger: `)`，各段中在签名参数列表末尾出现，并作为最高激活 token
patterns.context: 函数、方法或构造函数声明的参数列表结束处，常接返回类型/方法体，或紧接方法体左花括号；跨多种语言

patterns.name: 方法体左花括号
patterns.trigger: `{`，常与前一模式的 `)` 连续出现，如 `) {`；第6段为换行后单独出现
patterns.context: 函数或构造函数定义开始处；也见于类定义或代码块开头附近

patterns.name: 类/代码块左花括号
patterns.context: 类、命名空间或条件块的声明/控制结构之后；不一定是函数体

patterns.name: 代码行结束与缩进换行
patterns.context: 声明、注释或语句结束后开始新行；与花括号附近的结构边界相邻

en.description: Primarily responds to block boundaries, indentation, and braces in code, often alongside conditions or class/member declarations; also appears in HTML script templates. Activations also occur at subsection-heading boundaries in two encyclopedia passages, which are difficult to explain through the code pattern.

patterns.name: Block beginnings and opening braces in code
patterns.context: Activations often fall near code-block boundaries, especially after declarations, conditions, or function headers; markers may also cover surrounding whitespace and adjacent tokens.

patterns.name: Control-flow conditional structures
patterns.context: Occurs in code control-flow statements, commonly around parenthesized conditions and the code blocks that follow.

patterns.name: JavaScript documentation script template
patterns.context: Script snippets near the head/body of HTML documents; segments 5 and 8 have highly similar contexts.

patterns.name: Object-oriented declarations and member code
patterns.context: Class, constructor, or member declarations and their code-block boundaries; activations are not limited to one language.
patterns.domain: C++, Java, C#, and other code

patterns.name: Subsection boundaries in Wikipedia articles
patterns.context: Natural-language articles transition from a paragraph to a subsection heading; the provided context has no corresponding code structure.

5_1308.description: 主要响应代码中的块边界、缩进及花括号，常伴随条件或类/成员声明；也出现在 HTML 脚本模板。另在两段百科文本的小节标题边界激活，难以由代码模式解释。

patterns.name: 代码中的块起始与左花括号
patterns.trigger: 行首或缩进后的「{」，以及代码块开始处的换行
patterns.context: 激活常落在代码块边界附近，尤其是声明、条件或函数头之后；标记也可能覆盖周边空白和相邻 token。

patterns.name: 控制流条件结构
patterns.trigger: 「if」；条件后接「{」，或以检查表达式构成条件
patterns.context: 处于代码控制流语句中，常见括号条件及其后的代码块。

patterns.name: JavaScript 文档脚本模板
patterns.context: HTML 文档 head/body 附近的脚本片段；第 5、8 段是高度相似的上下文。
patterns.domain: 生成的 HTML/JavaScript 文档代码

patterns.name: 面向对象声明与成员代码
patterns.context: 类、构造器或成员声明及其代码块边界；激活不局限于某一种语言。

patterns.name: 维基百科条目中的小节边界
patterns.trigger: 「Conservation」「Heritage listings」前后的换行或小节标题
patterns.context: 自然语言条目在段落转向小节标题处；所给上下文没有对应代码结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to the opening brace after the parameter list closes in Java declarations, especially at the beginning of methods or constructors; also responds more weakly to public, field, and class declarations. Android onCreate is a common subcase, but not the only pattern.

patterns.name: Opening brace of a Java method or constructor
patterns.context: An opening brace immediately follows the closing parameter list of a method or constructor declaration; this is the strongest trigger position in most examples.
patterns.domain: Java source code, including Android, ordinary classes, and test/library code

patterns.name: public declarations and constructor signatures
patterns.context: The public keyword at the start of a class member or constructor declaration, followed by a type name, method name, or constructor name; usually weaker than the opening brace after the parameter list.

patterns.name: Android lifecycle method onCreate
patterns.context: The onCreate method declaration in Activity- or View-related classes, with a Bundle savedInstanceState parameter; nearby @Override, super.onCreate, and similar elements are also common.
patterns.domain: Android Java code and related StackExchange Q&A

patterns.name: Class declarations and inheritance
patterns.context: public class or extends at class definitions, especially near the beginning of Java file examples; activations at these positions are weaker.

patterns.name: Member-variable declarations
patterns.context: Field declarations in a class body, commonly including a type, modifier, and variable name; also includes field initialization and comments.

5_1308.description: 主要响应 Java 声明中参数列表闭合后的左花括号，尤其是方法或构造器起始处；也对 public/字段/类声明有较弱响应。Android onCreate 是常见子类场景，但并非唯一模式。

patterns.name: Java 方法或构造器的左花括号
patterns.context: 方法或构造器声明的参数列表闭合后，紧接着出现左花括号；这是多数样本中最强的触发位置。
patterns.domain: Java 源码，覆盖 Android、普通类及测试/库代码

patterns.name: public 声明与构造器签名
patterns.context: 类成员或构造器声明开头的 public 关键字，以及紧随其后的类型名、方法名或构造器名；强度通常低于参数列表后的左花括号。

patterns.name: Android 生命周期方法 onCreate
patterns.context: Activity 或 View 相关类中，onCreate 方法声明及其 Bundle savedInstanceState 参数；相邻的 @Override、super.onCreate 等也常见。
patterns.domain: Android Java 代码及相关 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 类声明与继承
patterns.context: 类定义处出现 public class 或 extends，尤其是在 Java 文件示例开头；这些位置的激活较弱。

patterns.name: 成员变量声明
patterns.context: 类体中的字段声明，常见类型、修饰符及变量名；也包括字段初始化和注释。

en.description: Most activations fall on boundaries around class members or method declarations in code: newline indentation, access modifiers, annotations, parentheses, method names, and opening braces. A few occur at accessor and constructor boundaries in generated code. One activation occurs at the “Conservation” subsection heading in an orchid article and cannot be unified with the code pattern.

patterns.name: Statement boundaries in Java/Android method bodies
patterns.context: Code near class members, annotations, or method declarations, where a newline followed by indentation begins a member or method body; activations often fall at varying positions such as newlines, spaces, access modifiers, method names, or opening braces.

patterns.name: C# member declarations and constructor boundaries
patterns.context: Near class members or constructor declarations, especially access modifiers, constructor parameters/initializers, method bodies, or newlines between members.

patterns.name: Accessor declarations in generated code
patterns.context: Property accessor declarations in generated XML/protocol types; the activation occurs at the opening brace after the accessor method name.

patterns.name: Cryptography-class constructor boundary
patterns.context: A no-argument constructor with an empty method body follows a field declaration.

patterns.name: Paragraph transition in a Wikipedia article
patterns.context: A standalone heading introduces conservation-status content after a paragraph describing species distribution.

5_1308.description: 多数激活落在代码中类成员或方法声明的边界：换行缩进、访问修饰符、注解、括号、方法名及左花括号；少数落在生成代码访问器和构造函数边界。另有一例激活于兰花条目的“Conservation”小标题，无法与代码模式统一解释。

patterns.name: Java/Android 方法体中的语句边界
patterns.trigger: «↵»、缩进空白及紧随其后的 «public»、«protected»、«private»、«@Override»、方法名或 «{»
patterns.context: 代码处于类成员、注解或方法声明附近，换行后出现缩进并开始一个成员或方法体；激活常落在换行、空格、访问修饰符、方法名或左花括号等不同位置。

patterns.name: C# 成员声明与构造函数边界
patterns.context: 类成员或构造函数声明附近，尤其是访问修饰符、构造函数参数/初始化器、方法体或成员之间的换行。

patterns.name: 生成代码中的访问器声明
patterns.context: XML/协议类型生成代码的属性访问器声明，激活出现在访问器方法名后的左花括号。

patterns.name: 密码学类构造函数边界
patterns.context: 字段声明后出现无参构造函数及其空方法体。

patterns.name: Wikipedia 条目中的段落转折
patterns.context: 物种分布描述段落之后，以单独小标题引出保护状况内容。

en.description: Activations occur at code block boundaries and declarations across multiple languages, especially public, opening braces after method signatures, and return; Android onCreate is also included. Activations in two encyclopedia passages fall near subsection headings and cannot be unified with the code pattern.

patterns.name: return in method return values
patterns.context: Occurs in a method body, followed by a field or property value and ending in a semicolon; segment 1 also has @return in a documentation comment.
patterns.domain: Java, PHP code, and API documentation comments

patterns.name: public modifier and method/class definitions
patterns.context: Visibility modifiers in code declarations, commonly appearing in class, constructor, or method declarations.

en.description: Primarily responds to method/constructor declarations, access modifiers, and brace boundaries in code, especially where a signature ends and the method body begins. en.concept: Proper names and terms in titles
en.description: Activation appears on terms in a range of titles or phrases: medical terms and Expression of structures, German health terms, sports event names, historical figures, and football statistics titles; no single theme explains all instances.

patterns.name: Medical terms or phrases beginning with Co-
patterns.context: At the beginning of a title or abstract, Co- combines with the following word to form a term; appears across biomedical topics, including a title on mononuclear spin trapping

patterns.name: Subword fragments within German words
patterns.context: Activation covers the German compound “Psychische Gesundheit,” split into multiple subword tokens

patterns.name: Named entities in sports event titles
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the event name and its title, followed by a year or continuation of the title

patterns.name: Person name Judas of Galilee
patterns.context: The full name and prepositional phrase are marked, followed by a repeated beginning of the name

patterns.name: Football statistics titles
patterns.context: In list titles, activation covers countries, football teams, and phrases related to hat-tricks

patterns.name: Expression of structure in paper titles
patterns.context: Titles begin with Expression of, introducing the molecule or peptide being expressed

5_1359.description: 激活出现在多种标题或短语中的词项：医学术语与Expression of结构、德语健康词、体育赛事名、历史人物名和足球统计标题；没有统一主题能解释全部实例。

patterns.name: Co- 开头的医学术语或短语
patterns.context: 标题或摘要开头，Co- 与后续词构成术语；出现于不同生物医学主题，也包括单核自旋俘获标题

patterns.name: 德语词内部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖一个拆分成多个子词 token 的德语复合词“Psychische Gesundheit”

patterns.name: 体育赛事标题中的实体名称
patterns.context: 激活集中在赛事名及其所在标题，后接年份或标题续文

patterns.name: 足球统计标题
patterns.context: 列表标题中，激活覆盖国家、足球队及帽子戏法相关短语
