patterns.trigger: “Expression of CD105”“Expression of developmentally regulated plasma membrane polypeptide”
patterns.context: 标题以 Expression of 引出被表达的分子或多肽

en.description: Most examples activate on Diagn- forms in medical titles or copy; other high activations occur on tokens within proper names, titles, or names, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Word-initial/medial diagnostic stem
patterns.context: In English medical abstracts or clinical/coding-related titles, diagnostic words are tokenized into tokens beginning with Diagn; subsequent forms and topics vary.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Appears in entity names or title-like text, with activation on tokens within the name; no consistent semantic or syntactic condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, web content, and plot summaries

5_1359.description: 多数片段在医学标题或文案中的 Diagn- 词形上激活；其余高激活落在各类专名、标题或名称内部的 token 上，尚无统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 词首/词中诊断词干
patterns.context: 英文医学摘要或临床/编码相关标题中，诊断词被分词为以 Diagn 开头的 token；后续词形和主题各异。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、医疗编码文案

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在实体名称或标题性文本中，激活落在名称内部的 token；未见一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、网页内容与剧情简介

en.description: Activation concentrates mainly on sentence-initial Design; there are also sporadic responses to trophy names, family branches, comparative wording, athletes’ senior years, and polite requests in email.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Design
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a paragraph or title, followed by a gerund, past participle, or of phrase.
patterns.domain: Expository text, encyclopedia article titles, academic paper titles

patterns.name: Trophy in a specific name
patterns.context: Appears in the event name “World Team Trophy.”

patterns.name: Family branch descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the main branches of a family and their connections to estates or mansions.
patterns.domain: British aristocracy and local history encyclopedias

patterns.name: Quantity comparison expressions
patterns.context: Project abstracts express a need for more evidence and improved evidence quality.

patterns.name: Athlete career stage
patterns.context: Describes an athlete entering their senior year after college experience and serving as captain.

patterns.name: Polite request
patterns.context: An email asks the recipient to perform a deletion after confirmation.

5_1359.description: 激活主要集中在句首 Design；另对奖杯名称、家族分支、比较性措辞、运动员 senior 阶段及邮件中的礼貌请求有零散响应。

patterns.name: 句首 Design
patterns.context: 出现在段落或标题开头，后接动名词、过去分词或 of 短语。

patterns.name: 特定名称中的 Trophy
patterns.context: 出现在“World Team Trophy”赛事名称中。

patterns.name: 家族分支表述
patterns.context: 描述家族的主要分支及其地产、宅邸关联。
patterns.domain: 英国贵族与地方史百科

patterns.name: 数量比较表达
patterns.context: 项目摘要中表达增加证据数量及改善证据质量的需求。

patterns.name: 运动员生涯阶段
patterns.context: 描述运动员大学经历后进入 senior 年级并担任队长。

patterns.name: 礼貌请求
patterns.context: 邮件中请求对方在确认后执行删除操作。

en.description: Strong activation occurs mainly on tokens beginning with capitalized Inter, across multiple domains and with diverse following stems; activation also occurs on a segmented form of Frankfurt and the Right identifier in game interface code.

patterns.name: Inter-initial fragments
patterns.context: Words begin with capitalized Inter, with activation concentrated on the initial token; following stems vary.

patterns.name: Segmented proper name Frankfurt
patterns.context: Frankfurt is split into two tokens and appears in repeated names or possessive phrases.

patterns.name: Game control properties
patterns.context: In game interface code, Right appears near control identifiers, properties, or labels and is repeated within the same passage.

5_1359.description: 主要对词首大写 Inter 的 token 产生强激活，覆盖多领域且后接词干多样；另对 Frankfurt 拆分形式及游戏界面代码中的 Right 标识符有激活。

patterns.name: Inter 词首片段
patterns.context: 单词以大写 Inter 起始，激活集中于词首 token；后续词干各异。

patterns.name: Frankfurt 专名拆分
patterns.context: Frankfurt 被拆分成两个 token，出现在重复的名称或所有格短语中。

patterns.name: 游戏控件属性
patterns.context: 游戏界面代码中 Right 出现在控件标识符、属性或标签附近，且同段重复。

en.description: Activation spans legislative word forms, the polite emphasis very much, favour expressions of support or choice, and greatly modifying appreciated or affect; triggers are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Legislative institution word forms
patterns.context: The stem legisl- appears in words referring to legislative institutions or lawmaking; in both examples it continues into a suffix.
patterns.domain: UK parliamentary news; human rights policy reporting

patterns.name: Polite expression very much
patterns.context: In thanks or polite replies, very much is followed by thanks, greetings, or a reason for gratitude.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches; business email; forum comments

patterns.name: favour and surrounding wording
patterns.context: Expresses support, preference, or choice; sometimes adjacent to vote or of, and sometimes followed by a policy object in in favour of.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates; historical architecture accounts; patent system commentary

patterns.name: Polite formula greatly appreciated
patterns.context: In email, greatly appreciated expresses thanks after a request for assistance.

patterns.name: greatly affect
patterns.context: greatly modifies affect, describing a topic's major impact on authority.

5_1359.description: 激活分布于议会/立法词形、礼貌强调语 very much、favour 支持或取舍表达，以及 greatly 修饰 appreciated 或 affect；触发点并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 立法机构词形
patterns.context: 词干 legisl- 出现在表示议会机构或制定法律的词中；两例中都延续为后缀。
patterns.domain: 英国议会新闻；人权政策报道

patterns.name: very much 礼貌表达
patterns.context: 在致谢或礼貌回应中，very much 后接感谢、致意或感谢原因。
patterns.domain: 议会发言；商务邮件；论坛评论

patterns.name: favour 及其周边措辞
patterns.context: 表达支持、偏向或取舍；有时紧邻 vote、of，有时在 in favour of 后接政策对象。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论；历史建筑记述；专利制度评论

patterns.name: greatly appreciated 礼貌套语
patterns.context: 邮件中在请求协助后，以 greatly appreciated 表达感谢。

patterns.name: greatly affect
patterns.context: greatly 修饰 affect，描述某话题对权威的重大影响。

en.description: Activation is scattered across to/ate, function words in legal clauses, HTML navigation anchors, and numbers and unusual fragments in forum posts; it spans domains and genres, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Strong activation adjacent to the preposition to
patterns.context: Across several samples, activation appears near English to or Romanian ate subword fragments; some strong activations fall on following words. The trigger does not correspond to a single word sense or syntactic function.
patterns.domain: Historical narrative, forums, parliamentary text, research funding, energy email, medical research; multiple genres

patterns.name: Function words and structures in legal text
patterns.context: In US constitutional clauses, activation concentrates near recurring function words and parallel structures in legal phrasing.

patterns.name: HTML navigation markers and anchor fields
patterns.context: In HTML navigation or API documentation table fragments, activation falls on underscores, anchor markers, and field names such as summary, detail, and method.

patterns.name: Numbers and unusual fragments in forum text
patterns.context: In forum text, activation appears on anomalous strings or number fragments near separators and line breaks; the two passages show no obvious consistent semantic trigger.

5_1359.description: 激活分散于 to/ate、法律条文功能词、HTML 导航锚点，以及论坛中的数字和特殊片段；跨领域、跨文体，未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 紧邻介词 to 的强激活
patterns.trigger: «to»3 «further»10（1）；«To»3 «get»10（2）；«to»4«ate»9（3）；«to»2« cover»5« the»2« expenses»5« of»1« approximately»10（4）；«in»9« terms»（5、6）
patterns.context: 多个样本中，激活出现在英语 to 或罗马尼亚语 ate 等子词片段附近；部分强激活落在其后续词上。触发并非只对应单一词义或句法功能。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、论坛、议会文本、科研资助、能源邮件、医学研究；多种文体

patterns.name: 法律文本中的功能词与结构
patterns.context: 美国宪法条文中，激活集中在重复的法律句式功能词及并列结构附近。

patterns.name: HTML 导航标记与锚点字段
patterns.context: HTML 导航或 API 文档表格片段中，激活落在下划线、锚点标记及 summary、detail、method 等字段名上。

patterns.name: 论坛文本中的数字与特殊片段
patterns.context: 论坛文本中，激活出现在分隔线、换行附近的异常字符串或数字片段；两段没有明显一致的语义触发条件。

en.concept: “On the basis of” phrase and sporadic fragments
en.description: The main pattern is the fixed phrase “On the basis of” in academic text; other activations are scattered across intra-word fragments, punctuation, numbers, and several common words in multiple genres, making them difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “On the basis of”
patterns.context: The prepositional phrase “On the basis of” occurs in sentences, typically introducing conclusions drawn from evidence or findings; capitalization and following words may vary.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments within strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on punctuation, intra-word fragments, or numbers, with inconsistent local contexts; no semantic condition shared with the main phrase is evident.
patterns.domain: Web page titles, Italian parliamentary text, legal text, XML/code, etc., paragraphs 1, 3, 6, 7, 8, 10

patterns.name: Other sporadic words and phrases
patterns.context: Activates in their respective sentences, but there is no clear consistent contextual condition shared with one another or with “On the basis of.”

5_1359.concept: “On the basis of”短语及零散片段
5_1359.description: 主要模式是学术文本中的固定短语“On the basis of”；其余激活分散在词内片段、标点、数字及若干普通词语上，跨多种文体，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 固定短语“On the basis of”
patterns.context: 句中出现介词短语“On the basis of”，通常用于引出根据某些证据或发现得出的结论；大小写及其后续词语可变。
patterns.domain: 学术论文（医学、物理等），覆盖段落2、4、5

patterns.name: 字符串内部的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在标点、词内切分片段或数字上，局部上下文并不一致；未见与主短语相同的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、意大利语议会文本、法律文本、XML/代码等，覆盖段落1、3、6、7、8、10

patterns.name: 其他零散词语与短语
patterns.context: 在各自句子中激活，但彼此之间及与“On the basis of”均缺乏清楚一致的上下文条件。

en.description: Activation mainly occurs on “Out of,” often introducing a quantity, proportion, or previously mentioned set; it also responds to Italian word-form fragments in all’inizio and iniziativa, and sporadically activates near Russian meta keywords and forum separators.

patterns.name: “out of” phrase
patterns.context: Used as a prepositional phrase to introduce a set, total, or previously mentioned referent, followed by a number, noun, or pronoun; it can occur across sentences in this group.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research, forums, and social issues text

patterns.name: Italian word-form fragment “all’inizio”
patterns.context: Appears in subword fragments of the Italian word “all’inizio” (at the beginning of), in an in-sentence temporal expression.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment “iniziativa”
patterns.context: Appears in subword fragments of the Italian word “iniziativa” (initiative), near mentions of transportation or improvement.

patterns.name: Isolated multilingual/character fragments
patterns.context: Occur respectively near line breaks/separators in forum text and in subword fragments of Russian words among HTML meta keywords; no clear semantic condition shared with the other patterns is evident.

5_1359.description: 激活主要落在“Out of”中，常用于引出数量、比例或先前集合；另对意大利语 all’inizio 与 iniziativa 的词形片段有反应，并零星激活于俄语 meta 关键词及论坛分隔符附近。

patterns.name: “out of”短语
patterns.context: 作为介词短语引出集合、总量或先前提及对象，后接数字、名词或代词；本组中可跨句出现。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研、论坛及社会议题文本

patterns.name: “all’inizio”意大利语词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语词“all’inizio”（在……开始时）的分词片段中，处于句中时间表达。

patterns.name: “iniziativa”词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语词“iniziativa”（倡议、举措）的分词片段中，附近提及交通或改善。

patterns.name: 孤立的多词/字词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在论坛文本的换行/分隔符附近，以及 HTML meta 关键词中俄语词汇的子词片段；未见与其他模式相同的明确语义条件。

en.description: The most stable feature is recognition of the English “out of” construction, especially “out of + quantity/determiner,” used to count or identify a subset from a whole; there is also one instance of “of the + category” introducing a scope, along with sporadic local activations.

patterns.name: “out of” introducing a quantity or subset of a whole
patterns.context: A number, pronoun, or definite article follows “out of,” indicating that something is taken from, counted within, or described as part of a total; activation often falls on “of,” and sometimes also on nearby “the / this / these / every.”
patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository text, statistical narrative, and dialogue; covers nearly all corpus types

patterns.name: “of the” introducing a specific whole or category
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or clause, “of the + noun” defines the scope under discussion, followed by its composition or proportion; “Out of the forested land” also appears later in the same passage.

patterns.name: Local common collocations or lexical triggers
patterns.context: A few markers are scattered through sentences and do not form a stable pattern repeated across passages that can be independently confirmed; they may reflect incidental collocations or other local features.

5_1359.concept: 英语 out of 结构
5_1359.description: 最稳定的特征是识别英语“out of”结构，尤其“out of + 数量/限定词”，用于从总体中统计或指出子集；另有一次“of the + 类别”引出范围，以及零散局部激活。

patterns.name: “out of”引出数量或总体中的子集
patterns.context: 在“out of”之后接数字、代词或定冠词，表示从某个总量中取出、统计或描述其中一部分；激活常落在“of”，有时邻近的“the / this / these / every”也激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明文、统计叙述及对话；覆盖几乎全部语料类型

patterns.name: “of the”引出特定总体或类别
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头用“of the + 名词”限定讨论范围，随后给出该类别内部的构成或比例；此处同段稍后也出现“Out of the forested land”。
patterns.domain: 百科地理、土地利用比例说明

patterns.name: 局部的常见搭配或词汇触发
patterns.context: 少数标记分散在句中，未形成跨段重复、可独立确认的稳定模式；可能是偶发搭配或其他局部特征。

en.concept: Prepositional structures expressing source, scope, or exclusion
en.description: Primarily activates out/of in English “out of” structures and their following complements, covering proportions, selection from a whole, and source or scope. Also activates fragments of the French “en dehors de” and the Italian parliamentary honorific “Onorevole”.

patterns.name: “out of” structures
patterns.context: In English, expresses proportions (“out of 100”, “out of 5316”), selection from a whole or composition (“out of which”, “out of these compounds”), and scope or source (“out of state”); no specific domain is required.
patterns.domain: English news, legal, forum, medical, and academic texts

patterns.name: French “en dehors de”
patterns.context: Word fragments in the French phrase “en dehors de” (outside of / apart from).

patterns.name: Italian honorific word fragment
patterns.context: The Italian honorific for a member of parliament in European Parliament speeches, occurring after “Presidente” and before a name.

5_1359.concept: 表示来源、范围或排除的介词结构
5_1359.description: 主要对英语“out of”结构中的 out/of 及后续补语激活，涵盖数量比例、整体中的选取及范围来源。另对法语“en dehors de”及意大利语议会敬称“Onorevole”的片段激活。

patterns.name: “out of”结构
patterns.trigger: “out« of»”及其后续成分，如“out« of»10”“out« of»« which»”“out« of»« these»”
patterns.context: 英语中表示数量比例（“out of 100”“out of 5316”）、从整体中选取或说明组成（“out of which”“out of these compounds”），以及范围或来源（“out of state”）；不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 英语新闻、法律、论坛、医学论文、学术文本

patterns.name: 法语“en dehors de”
patterns.context: 法语短语“en dehors de”（在……之外／除……之外）中的词语片段。

patterns.name: 意大利语敬称词片段
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言中对议员的意大利语敬称，出现在“Presidente”之后及人名之前。

en.concept: out of phrases and sporadic intraword fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the English phrase “out of”, appearing with quantities, sets, sources, and fixed expressions; the following element varies. There is also one intraword fragment in Italian “Inoltre”, difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: out of followed by a quantity, set, or selected item
patterns.context: Primarily the phrase “out of” followed by a noun or pronoun, indicating something from a range, set, or source; the fixed expression “out of the way” also occurs. Activation does not require a specific following part of speech or meaning.
patterns.domain: English corpora including encyclopedia entries, game reviews, stories, social issue articles, and entertainment reviews

patterns.name: Italian intraword fragment
patterns.context: The fragment occurs inside the Italian word “Inoltre” (furthermore), surrounded by Italian policy text; it differs from the English “out of” pattern.
patterns.domain: Italian text from the European Parliament

5_1359.concept: out of 短语及偶发词内片段
5_1359.description: 主要响应英文短语“out of”，从数量范围、集合、来源到固定搭配均有出现，后接成分不固定；另有一次意大利语“Inoltre”词内片段，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: out of 后接数量、集合或选择对象
patterns.trigger: [1] “out« of»10”中 “of” 最强；[2] “out« of»10 contract players”；[3] “Out« of»9« this»4 meeting”；[4] “Out« of»9« the»6 260« episodes”；[5] “out« of»9 Gradius Rebirth”；[6] “out« of»9« the»5 darkness”；[7] “out« of»9« a»4« total»2« of»3 640”；[8] “Out« of»9« them»2”；[10] “out« of»9« the»6« way»4”
patterns.context: 主要是短语 “out of” 后接名词或代词，表示从某个范围、集合、来源中；也见固定表达 “out of the way”。触发强度不要求后接特定词类或语义。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、游戏评论、故事文本、社会议题文章、娱乐评论等英文语料

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 片段位于意大利语 “Inoltre”（此外）一词内部，周围是意大利语政策说明文本；与英文 “out of” 模式不同。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语文本

en.description: Primarily activates on English out, especially out of followed by nouns for source, cause, scope, or space, and including out of the blue; also has sporadic activations on a virus keyword, a Bulgarian word fragment, and a French place-name fragment.

patterns.name: English phrase out of
patterns.context: “out of” indicates something originating from a source or caused by a circumstance, followed by a noun phrase.

patterns.name: English phrase out of the blue
patterns.context: Fixed idiom meaning that something happens suddenly or unexpectedly.

patterns.name: English phrase out of the project
patterns.context: Indicates leaving or being excluded from a project; here it describes an actor withdrawing from casting.

patterns.name: English phrase out of fear
patterns.context: Indicates that an action was taken because of fear, followed by a noun for an emotion or motive.

patterns.name: English phrase out of the episodes
patterns.context: Indicates some items among a given total, followed by a quantity or set.

patterns.name: English phrase out of the darkness
patterns.context: Indicates emerging from darkness; a literal spatial image used in narrative.

patterns.name: Other uses of English out
patterns.context: The verb phrase find out (discover) and out of meaning outside a range; these differ from the main out of phrase pattern.

patterns.name: Virus keyword metadata
patterns.context: The keyword list contains virus and its variants; the activation fragment also includes a Russian virus word form.

patterns.name: Bulgarian intraword fragment
patterns.context: The activation falls on a subword fragment of a segmented Bulgarian word; this example does not establish a link to English out/out of.

patterns.name: French place-name intraword fragment
patterns.context: The activation occurs on a subword fragment of a Paris street name, with no evident English out phrase context.

5_1359.description: 主要激活于英语 out，尤其 out of 后接来源、原因、范围或空间名词，也包括 out of the blue；另有病毒关键词、保加利亚语词片段及法语地名片段等零散激活。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of
patterns.context: “out of”表示从某来源产生、由某情况导致，后接名词短语。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of the blue
patterns.context: 固定习语，表示突然、出乎意料地发生。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of the project
patterns.context: 表示离开或被排除出某个项目；此处描述演员退出选角。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of fear
patterns.context: 表示因恐惧而采取某行动，后接情绪或动机名词。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of the episodes
patterns.context: 表示在给定总数中、就其中某些项目而言，后接数量或集合。

patterns.name: 英语短语 out of the darkness
patterns.context: 表示从黑暗中出现；字面空间意象用于叙事。

patterns.name: 英语 out 的其他用法
patterns.context: 分别是动词短语 find out（查明）和 out of 表示不在某范围内；与主要的 out of 短语模式不同。

patterns.name: 病毒关键词元数据
patterns.context: 关键词列表中包含 virus 及其变体；激活片段还含有俄语病毒词形。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的保加利亚语词片段中，无法从该例确认它与英语 out/out of 有关。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 法语地名词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在巴黎街道名称的子词片段中，没有明显的英语 out 短语语境。

en.concept: out of phrases and cross-lingual local word forms
en.description: Most English examples activate in out of quantity or set constructions; cause, contract, and committee uses also occur. The remaining examples are Bulgarian policy word forms and Spanish date subword tokens, which do not fit a single clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: English collocation out of
patterns.context: The phrase out of is followed by a quantity, set, institution, or personal pronoun, often meaning “among”; activation concentrates on out of and the following word.

patterns.name: Other English uses of out of
patterns.context: out of forms expressions of cause, contract status, and committee procedure; the same phrase is present, but semantic and syntactic relations vary.

patterns.name: Bulgarian competitiveness-related word forms
patterns.context: Bulgarian parliamentary sentences about competitiveness and the specific object being emphasized; activation is distributed within subword-tokenized words.

patterns.name: Bulgarian parliamentary and agreement word forms
patterns.context: Sentences about the compatibility of an agreement with WTO rules and parliamentary questions; activation falls within words at the subword-token level, not on English out of.

patterns.name: Bulgarian conditional and jurisdictional word forms
patterns.context: A conditional sentence about a permanent representative office or an authorized consul and related matters; activation falls within Bulgarian words.

patterns.name: Spanish date structure
patterns.context: Wording for the effective date of the Lisbon Treaty; activation covers the date preposition and several subword tokens in the month.

5_1359.concept: out of 短语及跨语种局部词形
5_1359.description: 多数英语样例在 out of 数量或集合结构中激活，也见原因、合同和委员会用法；其余为保加利亚语政策词形及西班牙语日期子词元，不能归入同一明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语搭配 out of
patterns.context: 短语 out of 后接数量、集合、机构或人称代词，常表示“在……之中”；激活集中在 out of 及紧随其后的词。

patterns.name: 英语其他 out of 用法
patterns.trigger: “out« of»10 fear”“out« of» contract players”“reported out« of» the Senate Judiciary Committee”
patterns.context: out of 分别构成原因表达、合同状态表达及委员会程序表达；仍包含同一词组，但语义和句法关系各异。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语竞争力相关词形
patterns.context: 保加利亚语议会语句中竞争力及其具体强调对象的词语，激活分布在被子词元切分的词内部。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语议会与协议词形
patterns.context: 关于协议与世贸规则相容性、议会问题的句子；激活落在词内子词元，并非英语 out of。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语条件与管辖词形
patterns.context: 条件句中谈及常驻代表机构或有权领事及相关事务；激活落在保加利亚语词内部。

patterns.name: 西班牙语日期结构
patterns.context: 里斯本条约生效日期的表述，激活覆盖日期介词及月份的若干子词元。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，西班牙语议会发言记录

en.concept: Mixed responses to local patterns of “out of” and Bulgarian subword fragments
en.description: Most passages activate on English “out of”, often introducing a set, quantity, or circumstance, though the following structures and meanings vary. Two Bulgarian parliamentary texts activate on sporadic subword fragments such as “върху”; their relation to the English pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “out of”
patterns.context: “out of” occurs at the beginning or in the middle of a sentence, followed by a quantity, demonstrative, or determiner; the numbers 10 and 9 may themselves form part of the continuous phrase.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, reviews, forums, blogs, and research texts

patterns.name: Part of a proportion or set
patterns.context: Identifies members, sources, outcomes, or occurrences from a set, total, or circumstance; the semantic functions are not entirely the same.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, online articles, forums, and research texts

patterns.name: Word-form activations in Bulgarian fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Bulgarian text, activation falls on subword fragments of several words; “върху” appears twice, while the other activated fragments are sporadic.

5_1359.concept: 对短语“out of”的局部模式及保加利亚语子词片段的混合响应
5_1359.description: 多数段落激活英文“out of”，常引出集合、数量或情境，但后续结构和语义各异；两段保加利亚语议会文本则激活“върху”等分散子词片段，和英文模式关系不明。

patterns.name: 固定短语“out of”
patterns.context: 句首或句中出现“out of”，后接数量、指示词或限定词；数字 10、9 本身也可能是连续短语的一部分。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括百科、评论、论坛、博客及科研文本

patterns.name: 比例或集合中的部分
patterns.trigger: “Out of”后接“this meeting”“the 260 episodes”“them”“the darkness”“the blue”“all the cookies”“these compounds”等
patterns.context: 从某个集合、总量或情境中指出其成员、来源、结果或发生情况；语义功能并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、网络文章、论坛及科研文本

patterns.name: 保加利亚语片段中的词形激活
patterns.context: 保加利亚语连续文本中，激活落在若干词的子词片段上；可见“върху”出现两次，但其他激活片段分散。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

en.description: Activation concentrates on the phrase “out of”, covering selection or examples from a whole as well as emerging from somewhere, work titles, and fixed or context-specific uses such as “unexpectedly” and “because of fear”.

patterns.name: “out of” structures
patterns.context: The trigger mainly occurs in the phrase “out of”, followed by different determiners or pronouns, often indicating selection or counting a subset of a whole; paragraph 8 has the idiom “out of the blue”, paragraph 9 has “out of the darkness”, and paragraph 10 has “out of fear”.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, academic texts, reviews, and narratives

patterns.name: Subset selection or examples from a whole
patterns.context: “out of” is followed by the, these, them, or all, referring to selecting part of a previously mentioned set or category or introducing examples; it sometimes precedes a quantity or explanation.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, experimental papers, research project descriptions, social commentary, and food blogs

patterns.name: Entity nouns following “out of the”
patterns.context: “out of” is followed by this or the plus a noun; the examples respectively express something arising from a meeting, part of an album title, and emerging from darkness, with different meanings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, music discographies, and narrative texts

patterns.name: Fixed idioms and causal phrases
patterns.context: “out of the blue” means unexpectedly; “out of fear” means doing something because of fear. Neither is a literal use of selecting a subset from a set.
patterns.domain: Online discussions, biographies, or entertainment encyclopedias

5_1359.description: 激活集中在短语“out of”，涵盖从整体中选取或举例，也包括由某处出现、作品名称及“出乎意料”“因害怕”等固定或语境化用法。

patterns.name: “out of”结构
patterns.context: 触发词主要出现在短语“out of”中，后接不同限定词或代词，常表示从整体中选取、统计其一部分；第 8 段是习语“out of the blue”，第 9 段是“out of the darkness”，第 10 段则为“out of fear”。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术、评论、叙事等多种文体

patterns.name: 整体中取子集或举例
patterns.trigger: “Out« of»9« the»4 260 episodes”、“Out« of»9« the»4 20 subjects”、“Out« of»9« these»3 compounds”、“Out« of»9« them»2”、“Out« of»9« all»7 the cookies”
patterns.context: “out of”后接 the、these、them 或 all，指从前述集合或类别中选出部分、引出实例；有时后接数量或说明。
patterns.domain: 百科、实验论文、科研项目介绍、社会评论、饮食博客

patterns.name: “out of the”后接实体名词
patterns.trigger: “Out« of»10« this»2 meeting”、“Out« of»9« the»4 Wind»1”、“out« of»9« the»4 darkness”
patterns.context: “out of”后接 this 或 the 加名词；分别表达由某次会议产生、专辑名的一部分，以及从黑暗中出现，含义并不相同。
patterns.domain: 百科、音乐作品列表、叙事文本

patterns.name: 固定习语与原因短语
patterns.context: “out of the blue”表示出乎意料；“out of fear”表示因害怕而做某事，均非从集合中取子集的字面用法。
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、人物传记或娱乐百科

en.description: All segments contain “out of”, but the following elements and meanings vary: scope, source, cause, fixed idioms, titles, or emerging from darkness. Segment 1 also contains an ordinary “of” relation phrase; the other weakly marked words have no common theme.

patterns.name: “out of” structures
patterns.context: The core trigger is the prepositional phrase “out of”, followed by different types of noun phrases, pronouns, or fixed expressions; it can indicate source, scope, motive, or a change of state, with no single meaning required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, encyclopedias, forums, papers, titles, and online articles

patterns.name: “of” relation phrases
patterns.context: In segment 1, besides “out of”, “of” also occurs in a year expression and a kinship relation; whether this extends the same mechanism is uncertain.

patterns.name: Sporadic co-activated words
patterns.context: These are separately marked weaker activations in the segments and are distributed sporadically; the evidence does not support a unified, independent trigger pattern.

5_1359.description: 所有段都含“out of”，但后续成分及意义多变：范围、来源、原因、固定习语、标题或“由黑暗中出现”。第1段另有普通“of”关系短语；其余弱标记词缺乏共同主题。

patterns.name: “out of”结构
patterns.context: 核心触发是介词短语“out of”，后接不同类型的名词短语、代词或固定表达；可表示来源、范围、动机、状态转换等，不要求单一语义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、百科、论坛、论文、标题及网络文章

patterns.name: “of”关系短语
patterns.context: 在第1段中，除“out of”外，“of”还出现在年份表达和亲属身份关系中；是否是同一机制的延伸不确定。

patterns.name: 零散共激活词
patterns.context: 这些是各段中另行标记的较弱激活，分布零散；材料不足以支持统一的独立触发模式。

en.concept: out of and related local phrases
en.description: Primarily responds to “out of” structures: extracting from a set, counting, or introducing a result; also occurs in fixed phrases such as “out of control” and “out of the blue”. One example is marked in the causal phrase “death from a heart attack”.

patterns.name: “Out of” introducing part of a whole or a subsequent result
patterns.context: “out of” is followed by a quantity, demonstrative, or pronoun, forming a phrase that selects or counts from a set or introduces a result; “the”, “all”, or other words sometimes occur between the quantity and “of”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research, legal texts, forums, and general explanatory texts

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “out of control”
patterns.context: Describes behavior or a situation becoming uncontrollable; “of 10” is marked in between here, but the original phrase is “out of control”

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “out of the blue”
patterns.context: “out of the blue” means something happens suddenly or unexpectedly; the marked positions span inserted content within the phrase
patterns.domain: Online forum discussion of a business acquisition

patterns.name: Directional use “out of a heart attack”
patterns.context: The cause-of-death expression is “death from a heart attack”; the marked position actually falls within the causal phrase and is not a typical “out of” structure

5_1359.description: 主要响应“out of”结构：从某集合中取出、统计或引出结果；也见于“out of control”“out of the blue”等固定短语。另有一例标记落在“death from a heart attack”的原因短语中。

patterns.name: “Out of”引出总体中的部分或后续结果
patterns.trigger: «Out»…« of»…，包括 “Out of the 260 episodes”“Out of this meeting”“Out of these compounds”“Out of the 20 subjects”“Out of them”“Out of the entire front page”
patterns.context: “out of”后接数量、指示词或代词，构成从某个集合中选取、统计或引出结果的短语；有时数量与“of”之间插入“the”“all”等词
patterns.domain: 百科、科研、法律、论坛及一般说明性文本

patterns.name: 固定短语“out of control”
patterns.context: 描述行为或局势失控；此处中间有“of 10”标记，但原文短语为“out of control”
patterns.domain: 法律/儿童福利案件叙述

patterns.name: 固定短语“out of the blue”
patterns.context: “out of the blue”表示突然、出乎意料地发生；此处被激活位置跨过短语中的插入内容
patterns.domain: 网络论坛对商业收购的讨论

patterns.name: 方位用法“out of a heart attack”
patterns.trigger: “death from «a» heart attack”中的标记 token «a»，以及邻近的“death”“from”
patterns.context: 死亡原因表达“death from a heart attack”；标记位置实际落在原因短语内部，并非典型的“out of”结构

en.description: Primarily responds to “out of the” and “out of” structures, covering quantities, sets, sources, emission, and loss of control; sporadic nearby activations on general of, under, to, down/in, etc. cannot all be assigned to the same phrase pattern.

patterns.name: “out of the” phrases
patterns.context: A fixed prepositional phrase, often followed by a quantity, set, or source noun; can mean “among” or “from”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news commentary, cooking articles, legal texts, and literary narratives

patterns.name: Other “out of” collocations
patterns.context: The phrase out of occurs contiguously, but is not followed by the; the examples respectively indicate source/output or a state of loss of control.

patterns.name: Nearby collocation “down in flames”
patterns.context: Describes an aircraft being shot down and crashing in flames; activation falls on down and in, not out of.

patterns.name: “eru… explode out of the ground”
patterns.context: “out of the ground” indicates emerging from the ground; the same segment also contains the segmented “eruptions”, whose status as an independent trigger is uncertain.

patterns.name: “under GRUDGE” and following phrases
patterns.context: Describes project affiliation and planned publications; in addition to out of, under and to are also marked.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on the preposition of
patterns.context: Activates in common prepositional structures with of, but the segment does not contain the full “out of the” sequence; this may reflect broad collocation or accidental co-occurrence.

5_1359.description: 主要响应“out of the”及“out of”结构，覆盖数量、集合、来源、喷出和失控等用法；另见一般 of、under、to、down/in 等零散邻近激活，无法完全归为同一短语模式。

patterns.name: “out of the”短语
patterns.context: 固定介词短语，常接数量、集合或来源名词；可表示“在……之中／从……中”。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻评论、烹饪文章、法律及文学叙述

patterns.name: “out of”其他搭配
patterns.trigger: «out» «of»，后接具体名词或短语，如“out of GRUDGE”“out of control”
patterns.context: 短语中 out of 连续出现，但后续成分不是 the；分别表示来源/产出或失控状态。

patterns.name: “down in flames”邻近搭配
patterns.context: 描述飞机被击落后燃烧坠落；激活落在 down 与 in，而非 out of。

patterns.name: “eru… explode out of the ground”
patterns.context: “out of the ground”表示从地面喷出；另有同段被拆分标记的“eruptions”，不能确定其是否独立触发。

patterns.name: “under GRUDGE”及后续短语
patterns.context: 描述项目隶属关系与计划出版内容；除 out of 外，under、to 也被标记。

patterns.name: 介词 of 的零散激活
patterns.trigger: «of»，如“invitation «of» Marguerite Doane”“daughter «of» hymn writer William Doane”“one «of» which”
patterns.context: 在常见 of 介词结构中激活，但所在片段并未出现完整“out of the”序列；可能反映宽泛搭配或偶然共现。

en.concept: out of phrases and their semantic uses
en.description: Primarily responds to out of phrases, especially those introducing quantities, wholes, or sources; also occurs in fixed expressions indicating motive, loss of control, or sudden occurrence. A few nearby word activations lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: “out of” quantity, proportion, or part of a whole
patterns.context: The phrase out of introduces a source, whole, or denominator, followed by a quantity, an entity in the whole, or a pronoun; it can also be used to express a proportion.
patterns.domain: Ordinary narration or argument in encyclopedias, news, forums, blogs, and legal texts

patterns.name: “out of” indicating cause or motive
patterns.context: out of is followed by an abstract noun, indicating the respect or motive behind an action.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “out of control”
patterns.context: out of and control form a fixed expression describing behavior becoming uncontrollable.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “out of the blue”
patterns.context: out of the blue means that something happens suddenly or unexpectedly.

patterns.name: Other activations in nearby structures
patterns.context: These activations do not form the same local phrase pattern as out of and may involve other contextual features or accidental co-occurrence.

5_1359.concept: out of 短语及其语义用法
5_1359.description: 主要响应 out of 短语，尤其是引出数量、整体或来源；也出现在表示动机、失控、突然发生的固定表达中。少数邻近词激活缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: “out of”数量、比例或整体中的一部分
patterns.trigger: «Out»/«out»« of»9/10 后接数量、指示词或代词，如 “«Out»2« of»10« this»3 meeting”、“«Out»1« of»10« the»6 260 episodes”、“«out»2« of»9« them»2”、“99 «out»« of»9 100”
patterns.context: 短语 out of 引出来源、整体或分母，后接数量、整体中的实体，或代词；也可用于比例表达。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、论坛、博客与法律文本中的普通叙述或论证

patterns.name: “out of”表示原因或动机
patterns.trigger: “postponed «out»1« of»9 respect for the victims”、“«out»1« of»9 deference”
patterns.context: out of 后接抽象名词，说明行为所出于的尊重或动机。

patterns.name: “out of control”固定搭配
patterns.context: out of 与 control 构成固定表达，描述行为失控。
patterns.domain: 法律／社会服务案件叙述

patterns.name: “out of the blue”固定搭配
patterns.context: out of the blue 表示事情突然、出乎意料地发生。

patterns.name: 其他出现在邻近结构中的激活
patterns.context: 这些激活未构成与 out of 相同的局部短语模式，可能涉及其他上下文特征或偶然共现。

en.description: Primarily activates on word-initial Ser subwords across various medical terms, proper names, and identifiers, with no common semantics apparent; additional sporadic activations occur on can, imaging, Martin-Rieux, and Hip.

patterns.name: Ser-initial fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on tokenized items beginning with Ser; continuations form different words or names such as Serine, Serodiagnosis, Serum, Serotonin, Ser608, and Serigne, which do not all share a meaning.
patterns.domain: Biomedical terminology, proper names, and Wikipedia text

patterns.name: Ser at a word boundary
patterns.context: Serine is part of a protein kinase category name, with Ser at the beginning of the word.

patterns.name: Other activations in non-Ser words
patterns.context: Activations occur separately on the function word can, the medical term imaging, the proper name Martin-Rieux, and Hip split across a line break; these do not clearly match the Ser-initial pattern.

5_1468.description: 主要在词首 Ser 子词激活，覆盖多种医学词、专名及编号，未见统一语义；另有 can、imaging、Martin-Rieux、Hip 等零散激活。

patterns.name: Ser-词首片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Ser 开头的切分 token；后续拼成 Serine、Serodiagnosis、Serum、Serotonin、Ser608、Serigne 等不同词或名称，并非都共享词义
patterns.domain: 生物医学术语、专名及 Wikipedia 文本

patterns.name: 成词边界中的 Ser
patterns.context: Serine 是蛋白激酶类别名称的一部分，Ser 位于词首

patterns.name: 非 Ser 词中的其他激活
patterns.context: 激活分别出现在功能词 can、医学术语 imaging、专名 Martin-Rieux，以及换行后被拆分的 Hip；不与 Ser 词首模式明显吻合

en.description: The main pattern is activation on the word-initial subword token “Ser,” spanning various medical terms, variant sequences, and personal names; two isolated patterns also occur on “can” in a patent sentence and “imaging” in a medical title.

patterns.name: Ser-initial subword tokens
patterns.context: Activations concentrate at the beginnings of words or fragments starting with Ser; the continuations vary widely, including complete medical terms, personal names, and digit sequences.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles, abstracts, and database text, as well as Wikipedia biographical entries

patterns.name: Modal verb can
patterns.context: Appears after the sentence subject “Digital assistants,” expressing ability; provide and other words in the same sentence are also marked, but can has the peak activation.

patterns.name: imaging
patterns.context: Appears in the title “The role of imaging in early hip OA” as a noun naming the research topic.

5_1468.description: 主要模式是词首子词元“Ser”激活，涵盖多种医学术语、变体序列和人名；另有专利句中的“can”及医学标题中的“imaging”两个孤立模式。

patterns.name: Ser-词首子词元
patterns.trigger: 词首 «Ser»10，后续分别接 «ine»（Serine）、«odiagnosis»（Serodiagnosis）、«um»（Serum）、«608»（编号/变体序列）、«oton»（Serotonergic/Serotonin）、«igne»（人名）、«hi»（人名）
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Ser 开头的词或词片段起始处；后续词形差异很大，既有完整医学词汇，也有人名及数字序列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题、摘要与数据库文本，以及维基百科人名条目

patterns.name: 情态动词 can
patterns.context: 出现在句子主语“Digital assistants”之后，表示能力；同一句中还标记 provide 等词，但峰值为 can。

patterns.name: imaging
patterns.context: 出现在“The role of imaging in early hip OA”标题中，作为研究主题名词。

en.description: The strongest activations repeatedly fall on “courts” in legal texts; other strong activations are scattered across mathematical solutions, Aristotle, micellar solutions, and operator theory, and cannot be fully explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “courts” in courts and legal proceedings
patterns.context: Legal texts mention courts, often near adjudication, legal rules, review, or litigation procedures; also appears in informal texts discussing court rulings.
patterns.domain: Case law, legal proceedings, and legal commentary

patterns.name: “yield/solutions” denoting results in mathematical or scientific texts
patterns.context: Computational or theoretical derivations discuss a system producing correct solutions; “solutions” also describes experimental subjects in a scientific paper, but is not marked as a strong activation.

patterns.name: “Aristotle” in philosophical texts
patterns.context: Activates when discussing Aristotle and his work Metaphysics.

patterns.name: “solutions” in solution chemistry
patterns.context: Describes solutions containing surfactant micelles and compares their relaxation times.

patterns.name: “solutions” in operator theory
patterns.context: A theoretical paper discusses operator properties and their solutions; “solutions” refers to solutions of equations or operator problems.

5_1468.description: 最强触发反复落在法律文本的“courts”；其余强触发分散于数学解、亚里士多德、胶束溶液和算子理论，无法由单一语义模式完整解释。

patterns.name: 法院及法定程序中的“courts”
patterns.context: 法律文本中提及法院，常与裁判、法律规则、审查或诉讼程序相邻；也见于讨论法院裁决的非正式文本。
patterns.domain: 判例、法律程序及法律评论

patterns.name: 数学或科学文本中表示结果的“yield/solutions”
patterns.context: 计算或理论推导中谈到系统产生正确解；另有科学论文中“solutions”描述实验对象，但未标记为强触发。

patterns.name: 哲学文本中的“Aristotle”
patterns.context: 讨论亚里士多德及其著作《形而上学》时触发。

patterns.name: 溶液中的“solutions”
patterns.context: 描述表面活性剂胶束所在的溶液，并比较其弛豫时间。

patterns.name: 算子理论中的“solutions”
patterns.context: 理论论文讨论算子性质及其解；“solutions”指方程或算子问题的解。

en.concept: Various proper names and structured text fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed: particularly responsive to Aristotle in philosophical texts; also responds to HTML/XML markup, mathematical and physical formulas, Wikipedia links, legal case titles, and wording about criminal evidence collection.

patterns.name: Aristotle
patterns.context: Aristotle appears by name in philosophical discussion, sometimes alongside Hume or Pascal.

patterns.name: HTML/XML markup
patterns.context: Doctype and HTML/XHTML markup, including namespace and DTD declarations.

patterns.name: Mathematical operators and formula structure
patterns.context: Summation, partial-derivative operators, and real coefficients appear in mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Physics formulas
patterns.context: Formulas containing integrals, cross sections, and dark-matter-related symbols.

patterns.name: Wikipedia links
patterns.context: Wikipedia links pasted in Markdown format in HackerNews posts, linking to submarine or psychology entries.

patterns.name: New York case titles
patterns.context: Case titles list the state, defendant, and litigants, using a court-record format.

patterns.name: Criminal precedents and evidence collection
patterns.context: Cites precedents and discusses collecting breath samples.

5_1468.concept: 多种专名与结构化文本片段
5_1468.description: 激活模式分散：哲学文本中特别响应 Aristotle；另对 HTML/XML 标记、数学与物理公式、维基百科链接，以及法律案件标题和刑事证据措辞有反应。

patterns.name: Aristotle
patterns.context: Aristotle appears by name in philosophical discussion, sometimes alongside Hume or Pascal.

patterns.name: HTML/XML 标记
patterns.context: Doctype and HTML/XHTML markup, including namespace and DTD declarations.

patterns.name: 数学算子与公式结构
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现求和、偏导算子及实数系数。

patterns.name: 物理学公式
patterns.context: 包含积分、截面及暗物质相关符号的公式。

patterns.name: 维基百科链接
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子中以 Markdown 格式贴出的维基百科链接，链接到潜艇或心理学条目。

patterns.name: 纽约州案件标题
patterns.context: 案件标题列出州、被告及诉讼双方，含法庭记录格式。

patterns.name: 刑事判例与证据采集
patterns.context: 援引判例，讨论采集呼吸样本。

en.concept: Proper names and structured terminology in technical texts
en.description: Activations occur across various technical texts: HTML/CSS class names and styles, I/O system terminology, scientists in research contexts, drug court statistics, cell experiment titles, Seyfert galaxies, email recipient names, and C++ template implementation symbols.

patterns.name: Markers or attribute values in HTML/CSS code
patterns.context: In HTML/CSS snippets, neuron-response class names, attribute values, and adjacent punctuation; background image paths and style declarations are especially salient.

patterns.name: I/O and system switching in technical text
patterns.context: Describes an application process waiting for I/O, another process handling a request, and the operating system switching context.

patterns.name: Scientist identity terms in academic passages
patterns.context: In research projects or academic discussions, scientists refers to researchers; contexts include career stages, researcher groups, or training objectives.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, materials science discussions

patterns.name: Juvenile drug court statistics
patterns.context: Discusses the history, number, and development of juvenile drug courts.

patterns.name: Experimental methods section headings and cell experiment terminology
patterns.context: Cell culture or transfection methods passages, including experiment subheadings, separator lines, and biomedical terminology.

patterns.name: Galaxy names in astrophysics
patterns.context: Activates on the galaxy class name Seyfert when discussing AGN, the iron Kα line, and galaxy observations.

patterns.name: Recipient names in email headers
patterns.context: Enron email headers with date, time, sender, or recipient fields; strong activations fall on recipient names.

patterns.name: Tuple implementation symbols generated by the C++ compiler
patterns.context: Implementation symbols in C++ template instantiations or compiler error output, alongside lambda expressions, hexadecimal values, and template parameters.

5_1468.concept: 技术文本中的专名与结构化术语
5_1468.description: 激活分布于多种技术文本：HTML/CSS 类名与样式、I/O 系统术语、科研语境中的 scientists、药物法院统计、细胞实验标题、Seyfert 星系、邮件收件人姓名及 C++ 模板实现符号。

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 代码中的标记或属性值
patterns.context: HTML/CSS 片段中，神经元响应类名、属性值及相邻标点；背景图片路径和样式声明尤为明显。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 I/O 与系统切换
patterns.context: 描述应用进程等待 I/O、另一进程处理请求及操作系统切换上下文。

patterns.name: 学术段落中的科学家身份词
patterns.context: 科研项目或学术讨论中，scientists 指研究人员；包括职业阶段、研究者群体或培养目标等语境。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、材料科学讨论

patterns.name: 青少年药物法院统计
patterns.context: 讨论青少年药物法院的历史、数量和发展。

patterns.name: 实验方法章节标题及细胞实验术语
patterns.context: 细胞培养或转染方法段落，包含实验小标题、分隔线和生物医学术语。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 天体物理中的星系名称
patterns.context: 讨论 AGN、铁 Kα 线及星系观测时，触发星系类别名称 Seyfert。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的收件人姓名
patterns.context: 带日期、时间、发件人或收件人字段的 Enron 邮件头；强激活落在收件人姓名上。

patterns.name: C++ 编译器生成的元组实现符号
patterns.context: C++ 模板实例化或编译器错误输出中的实现符号，伴随 lambda、十六进制值及模板参数。

en.concept: Text line boundaries and formatting structure
en.description: Activations commonly occur at line endings and formatting boundaries such as line breaks and indentation; the corpus spans legal decisions, CSS/JavaScript, configuration code, and license declarations. Content words vary, while formatting boundaries are the shared clue.

patterns.name: Newline characters and adjacent whitespace
patterns.context: The newline itself or indentation after a line break in code and legal documents; recurs across multiple passages and is often the strongest activation token.
patterns.domain: Formatting and text layout across domains

patterns.name: Formatting fragments in legal decisions
patterns.context: Formatted positions such as case titles, background paragraphs, citations, and paragraph numbering in decisions.

patterns.name: CSS declarations and selectors
patterns.context: Declaration endings or selector lines in stylesheets, where punctuation and line breaks form formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Output comments after JavaScript line breaks
patterns.context: Near the end of code statements, output results, or the start of comments, with activations concentrated around line breaks.

patterns.name: Configuration array entries and keys
patterns.context: Array mapping entries in configuration or program code, separated by line breaks.

patterns.name: Software licenses and copyright notices
patterns.context: Source file headers or license clauses, especially at declaration line endings, line breaks, and continued clauses.

5_1468.concept: 文本行边界与格式结构
5_1468.description: 激活广泛出现在行末和换行、缩进等排版边界；语料横跨法律判决、CSS/JavaScript、配置代码及许可证声明。各类内容词并不统一，格式边界是共同线索。

patterns.name: 换行符及其相邻空白
patterns.context: 换行符本身或换行后代码、法律文书中的缩进位置；在多段中反复出现，常是最强激活 token
patterns.domain: 跨领域的排版与文本格式

patterns.name: 法律判决书的格式片段
patterns.context: 判决书的案件标题、背景段、引注和段落编号等格式化位置

patterns.name: CSS声明与选择器
patterns.context: 样式表中声明结束或选择器行，标点与换行构成格式边界

patterns.name: JavaScript换行后的输出注释
patterns.context: 代码语句结束、输出结果或注释开始附近，激活集中在换行前后

patterns.name: 配置数组条目与键名
patterns.context: 配置或程序代码中，数组映射条目以换行分隔

patterns.name: 软件许可证与版权声明
patterns.context: 源代码文件头或许可证条款，特别是声明行结束、换行及条款续行处

en.description: Activations are scattered: way and expressions of routes, intervals, or relations appear in multiple passages; other activations cover fraction code, button attributes, mathematical/physical symbols, graph theory definitions, holster descriptions, and album entries, with no common trigger pattern apparent.

patterns.name: way
patterns.context: In phrases such as “the way between… / all the way to… / on the way to…,” or with to, between, and similar words following way; the highlighted token is sometimes way itself and sometimes a nearby function word.

patterns.name: Fraction or ratio
patterns.context: fraction indicates a proportional position between two points; in code macros it appears as part of an identifier, with from and to also occurring in the same passage.

patterns.name: Button selectors and size attributes
patterns.context: JavaScript queries a button and reads its clientHeight; activation falls on button and adjacent code tokens.

patterns.name: Mathematical subscripts and coordinate expressions
patterns.context: Multivariable/coordinate index expressions in formulas, with markers distributed across mathematical symbols and numbers.

patterns.name: Field and state symbols in physics formulas
patterns.context: Vector position, time, potential terms, and wavefunction symbols in aligned formulas; activations are distributed across LaTeX commands and punctuation.

patterns.name: Graph-theoretic description of edge betweenness
patterns.context: Defines an edge’s contribution to shortest paths between pairs of vertices, focusing on graph theory terminology and relational expressions.

patterns.name: Holster position and orientation
patterns.context: Describes a shoulder holster and pistol placement, followed by a list of three orientations.

patterns.name: People, albums, and song titles
patterns.context: Names, labels/media, and work titles in discography entries; activations are scattered with no clear shared trigger word.

patterns.name: Routes and data for transport infrastructure
patterns.context: A cable car passes steel towers on its way to a terminus, alongside route details and basic data such as distance and vertical drop.

5_1468.description: 激活较分散：多段出现way及路线、区间或关系表达；另覆盖分数代码、按钮属性、数学/物理符号、图论定义、枪套描述和唱片条目，未见统一触发模式。

patterns.name: way
patterns.context: 在短语“the way between… / all the way to… / on the way to…”中，或way后接to、between等；被强调的token有时是way本身，有时是邻近的功能词
patterns.domain: 网页问答、百科、学术文本

patterns.name: 分数或比例
patterns.context: fraction表示两点间的比例位置；代码宏中作为标识符的一部分，且同段还出现from、to

patterns.name: 按钮选择器与尺寸属性
patterns.context: JavaScript中查询按钮并读取其clientHeight，激活落在button及相邻代码token上

patterns.name: 数学下标与坐标表达式
patterns.trigger: x_{1}, y_{1}及其相邻的下标、逗号和括号
patterns.context: 公式中的多变量/坐标索引表达式，标记分散在数学符号及数字上

patterns.name: 物理公式中的场与态符号
patterns.context: 对齐公式中的矢量位置、时间、势项和波函数符号，激活分布于LaTeX命令及标点

patterns.name: 图论边介数叙述
patterns.context: 定义边在顶点对之间最短路径上的贡献，关注图论术语及关系表达

patterns.name: 枪套位置与方位
patterns.context: 描述肩部枪套及手枪放置方式，随后列举三种方位

patterns.name: 人名、唱片与歌曲标题
patterns.context: 唱片目录条目中的人名、厂牌/介质与作品名；激活分散且无明显共同触发词

patterns.name: 交通设施路线与数据
patterns.context: 缆车经过钢塔前往终点，伴随路线及距离、垂直落差等基本数据

en.description: Activations are distributed across local regions of heterogeneous specialist texts: paper affiliation addresses, chemical oxidation states, and narratives about opera history and camp emails; various mathematical and physics formulas also appear. Some share proper names, punctuation, LaTeX markup, or local word forms, but no specific semantic pattern accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Institutional addresses and author affiliations
patterns.context: Paper author affiliations or institutional addresses; often accompanied by LaTeX superscript numbers, commas, and line breaks.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata; some academic text

patterns.name: Chemical elements and coordination chemistry notation
patterns.context: Element symbols, oxidation states, and NMR coordination shifts occur together.

patterns.name: Dates and hurried revisions in opera narratives
patterns.context: Recounts an opera premiere date and the hurried revisions made because a replacement singer was absent.

patterns.name: Camp pickup and transport arrangements
patterns.context: Describes morning childcare, camp staff, and bus pickup; includes possessive or first-person expressions addressed to the recipient.

patterns.name: Mathematical physics integral formulas
patterns.context: Formula derivation following the Schwinger–Dyson equation, including integral limits and LaTeX math notation.

patterns.name: Matrix/tensor formula notation
patterns.context: Pairs of subscripted and superscripted symbols appear in aligned formula lines.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical or theoretical physics formulas

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions with coordinate parameters
patterns.context: Parameterized formulas consisting of variables, indices, and ± signs.

patterns.name: Time direction and path-ordering operator in gauge field theory
patterns.context: A LaTeX formula introduces the path-ordering operator and an exponential integral containing field variables.

5_1468.description: 激活分布于异质的专业文本局部：论文署名地址、化学氧化态，以及歌剧史和营地邮件叙述；另有多种数学物理公式。部分共同伴随专名、标点、LaTeX 标记或局部词形，但未见能覆盖所有段落的具体语义模式。

patterns.name: 机构地址与作者单位
patterns.trigger: «School», «University», «Academy», «Laboratory», «Institute», 以及城市、邮编和国家名称
patterns.context: 论文作者署名或单位地址；常伴随 LaTeX 上标编号、逗号和换行
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据；个别段落为学术文本

patterns.name: 化学元素与配位化学记号
patterns.context: 元素符号、氧化态及核磁共振配位位移并列出现

patterns.name: 歌剧叙述中的时间与匆忙修改
patterns.context: 叙述歌剧首演日期及因替补歌手缺席而匆忙修订的经过

patterns.name: 营地接送与交通安排
patterns.context: 描述早晨托管儿童、营地工作人员及巴士接送；有面向收件人的所有格或第一人称表达

patterns.name: 数学物理积分公式
patterns.context: Schwinger–Dyson 方程后的公式推导，包含积分上下限和 LaTeX 数学记号

patterns.name: 矩阵／张量公式记号
patterns.context: 成对的带下标上标符号出现在对齐的公式行中
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或理论物理公式

patterns.name: 带坐标参数的数学表达式
patterns.context: 变量、索引及 ± 号组成的参数化公式

patterns.name: 规范场论中的时间方向与路径序算符
patterns.context: LaTeX 公式引出路径序算符及含场变量的指数积分

en.description: High activations occur primarily in complex LaTeX formulas in ArXiv papers, and also in representation theory, physics, machine learning, and fractional calculus prose; author lists and multiparticle-state title fragments also occur. There is no evidence that all formulas share a particular symbol or topic.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical relations and operators
patterns.context: Activations occur in paper excerpts containing complex formulas; the notation varies, with no common specific operator or symbol apparent.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and machine learning papers

patterns.name: Representation theory and group representations
patterns.context: Discusses irreducible admissible or automorphic representations of the general linear group.

patterns.name: Field theory formulas in physics
patterns.context: Formulas contain time directions, integrals, and field variables, possibly expressing operators or evolution in a physical model.

patterns.name: Machine learning function formulation
patterns.context: Mentions machine learning applications in the context of real-valued function families and parameters.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers related to machine learning

patterns.name: Preliminaries in fractional calculus
patterns.context: A paper’s preliminaries introduce conformal fractional calculus and specify a function domain.

patterns.name: Multiparticle physics and author information
patterns.context: An author list follows the phrase; activations may also be affected by paper metadata or name formatting.

patterns.name: HTML names and author lists
patterns.context: Personal names in small-caps HTML styling, formatted as an author list.

5_1468.description: 高激活主要出现在 ArXiv 论文的复杂 LaTeX 数学公式中，也见于表示论、物理、机器学习和分数阶微积分正文；另有作者名单及多粒子态标题片段。没有证据表明所有公式共享特定符号或主题。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学关系与算子
patterns.trigger: 公式中的 `=`, `\int`, `\exp`, `\mathcal`, `\operatorname` 等数学记号
patterns.context: 激活出现在含复杂公式的论文片段中；记号本身类型各异，未见统一的具体算子或符号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及机器学习论文

patterns.name: 表示论与群表示
patterns.context: 讨论一般线性群上的不可约可容许或自守表示。

patterns.name: 物理场论公式
patterns.context: 公式含时间方向、积分及场变量，疑似物理模型中的算符或演化表达式。

patterns.name: 机器学习函数表述
patterns.context: 以实值函数族及参数为背景，提及机器学习应用。
patterns.domain: 机器学习相关数学论文

patterns.name: 分数阶微积分预备知识
patterns.context: 论文预备章节介绍共形分数阶微积分，并给出函数定义域。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，分数阶微积分

patterns.name: 多粒子物理与作者信息
patterns.context: 短语后紧接作者名单；激活也可能受论文元数据或姓名排版影响。
patterns.domain: 物理论文及作者元数据

patterns.name: HTML 姓名与作者列表
patterns.context: HTML 小型大写样式中的人名，呈作者列表形式。

en.concept: Mathematical formula markers in scientific text
en.description: The most prominent activations are parentheses, commands, integrals, and formula symbols in LaTeX mathematical text; scattered activations also include formula constraints, academic transitions, statistical indices, machine learning terminology, theoretical physics equations, and German institutional addresses, with no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Formula delimiters in mathematical environments
patterns.context: Parentheses, equals signs, backslash commands, and integral/fraction structures occur together in mathematical formulas or LaTeX fragments; many activated tokens are formula punctuation or parts of commands.
patterns.domain: Mathematical and scientific/technical literature, formula text

patterns.name: Integrals and limits of integration in formulas
patterns.context: Integral signs and their limits, variables, or integrands form formula fragments; some passages also contain infinite upper limits or differentials.
patterns.domain: Mathematical analysis, physics, and other quantitative sciences

patterns.name: Bold mathematical symbols and operators
patterns.context: LaTeX commands denote boldface, font, or vector symbols, often alongside formula variables and differential operators.

patterns.name: Conditions and variable constraints after mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Formula endings or nearby text list function spaces, variable ranges, parameter inequalities, and other constraints; these symbols do not all belong to one content pattern.

patterns.name: Introductory and transitional phrases in academic passages
patterns.context: Section headings or English academic expressions introducing preceding conclusions or research findings appear in prose; these differ from the surrounding formula text.

patterns.name: Statistical notation definitions and sample indices
patterns.context: Defines expression values indexed by sample i and gene j, and specifies index ranges; activations include both symbols and explanatory text.

patterns.name: Machine learning application phrasing
patterns.context: Mentions machine learning applications after a general mathematical definition or objective function; the words are prose, not formula commands.

patterns.name: Chemical and university names in institutional addresses
patterns.context: Split German institution and university names, as well as city names, appear in an address line, preceded by “address:” and a list marker.

patterns.name: Self-consistency equations and mass symbols
patterns.context: Text mentions the Schwinger-Dyson equation as a self-consistency condition, followed by a formula containing mass squared, an integral, and a cutoff parameter.

patterns.name: Residual activations with no shared theme
patterns.context: Specific symbols, word fragments, or formatting tokens in different passages activate strongly, but their semantic triggers are inconsistent and do not support a more specific shared interpretation from the excerpts alone.

5_1468.concept: 科学文本中的数学公式标记
5_1468.description: 最突出的是 LaTeX 数学文本中的括号、命令、积分和公式符号；另有公式约束、学术承接语、统计索引、机器学习用语、理论物理方程及德语机构地址等零散激活，未形成单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学环境中的公式定界符
patterns.context: 数学公式或 LaTeX 片段中，括号、等号、反斜杠命令及积分/分式结构相邻出现；许多激活 token 是公式标点或命令的一部分。
patterns.domain: 数学与科学技术文献、公式文本

patterns.name: 公式中的积分及积分上下限
patterns.context: 积分号与上下限、变量或被积函数构成公式片段；部分段落还出现无穷上限或积分微元。
patterns.domain: 数学分析、物理及其他定量科学

patterns.name: 粗体数学符号与算子
patterns.context: LaTeX 中以命令表示粗体、字体或向量等符号，常与公式变量、微分算子并列。

patterns.name: 数学公式后的条件与变量约束
patterns.context: 公式末尾或公式附近列出函数所属空间、变量范围、参数不等式等约束；并非所有此类符号都同属一种内容模式。

patterns.name: 学术段落的引导与承接语
patterns.context: 正文中出现章节标题或引出前述结论、研究结果的英语学术表达；与周围公式文本不同。

patterns.name: 统计符号定义与样本索引
patterns.context: 定义按样本 i 和基因 j 索引的表达值，并说明索引范围；触发同时包含符号与说明文字。
patterns.domain: 生物统计、基因表达分析论文

patterns.name: 机器学习应用表述
patterns.context: 一般数学定义或目标函数之后提及机器学习应用；词语本身是正文，不是公式命令。

patterns.name: 机构地址中的化学与大学名称
patterns.context: 论文地址栏中出现拆分的德语机构名、大学名及城市名，前有“address:”和列表符号。

patterns.name: 自洽方程与质量符号
patterns.context: 文字提及 Schwinger-Dyson 方程作为自洽条件，随后给出含质量平方、积分及截止参数的公式。

patterns.name: 无法归入共同主题的残余激活
patterns.context: 不同段落中的特定符号、单词片段或排版 token 虽然激活较强，但语义触发条件并不一致，无法仅凭片段建立更具体的共同解释。
patterns.domain: 跨领域论文及排版文本

en.concept: Special symbols in mathematics and source code
en.description: Activations are concentrated in LaTeX formulas in mathematical and scientific texts, especially integrals, subscripts and superscripts, and typesetting commands; also seen in JavaScript regexes and code identifiers, Markdown headings, English function words, and statistical variable notation.

patterns.name: LaTeX integral symbols
patterns.context: Integrals appear in mathematical expressions, often with limits, differentials, or integrands; no specific mathematical topic is required
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, Q&A, and formula source code

patterns.name: LaTeX subscript, superscript, and exponent symbols
patterns.context: Mathematical notation uses subscripts and superscripts for powers, indices, or variables; often alongside formulas and integrals

patterns.name: LaTeX commands and mathematical typesetting structures
patterns.context: LaTeX formulas or paper source code; near typesetting commands for parentheses, fractions, arrows, and similar elements

patterns.name: Delimited regular-expression source code
patterns.context: JavaScript regular expressions enclosed in slashes, often containing anchors, quantifiers, groups, or alternatives

patterns.name: Common function words in English syntax
patterns.context: Words in English prose that connect clauses, introduce results, or qualify conditions; activations are scattered across different sentences

patterns.name: Mathematical variables and parameter notation
patterns.context: Latin or Greek letters denote variables, indices, or parameters in formulas; some are adjacent to subscripts or superscripts

patterns.name: Markdown heading markers
patterns.context: Bold text in Markdown headings and the equals-sign heading underline below them

patterns.name: Code identifiers and comment text
patterns.context: Property names, function syntax, and comments in JavaScript code; co-occurs with regular expressions

patterns.name: Asterisk and tilde notation in statistical expressions
patterns.context: In notation for gene expression estimates, asterisks and tildes mark mathematical variables

5_1468.concept: 数学与源码中特殊符号
5_1468.description: 激活主要分布于数学及科学文本的 LaTeX 公式，尤其积分、上下标和排版命令；另见 JavaScript 正则与代码标识符、Markdown 标题、英文功能词及统计变量标记。

patterns.name: LaTeX 积分符号
patterns.context: 数学表达式中出现积分，常伴随上下限、微分或被积函数；不要求特定数学主题
patterns.domain: 数学论文、问答及公式源码

patterns.name: LaTeX 上下标与幂次符号
patterns.context: 数学记号中用上下标表示幂、指标或变量；常与公式及积分同时出现

patterns.name: LaTeX 命令及数学排版结构
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式或论文源码；括号、分式、箭头等排版命令附近

patterns.name: 带分隔符的正则表达式源码
patterns.context: 斜杠包围的 JavaScript 正则表达式，常含锚点、量词、分组或备选项

patterns.name: 英文句法中的常见功能词
patterns.trigger: «Before»、« presenting»、« our»、« get»、« when»、« holds»、« such that»
patterns.context: 英文叙述中连接从句、引出结果或限定条件的词语；激活分散在不同句子

patterns.name: 数学变量及参数记号
patterns.context: 公式中用拉丁或希腊字母表示变量、索引、参数，部分紧邻上下标

patterns.name: Markdown 标题标记
patterns.context: Markdown 标题的加粗文本及其下方等号式标题线

patterns.name: 代码标识符与注释文本
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中的属性名、函数语法及注释；与正则表达式并存

patterns.name: 统计表达式的星号和波浪号标记
patterns.context: 基因表达估计的符号说明中，星号与波浪号标示数学变量

en.description: Activations occur mainly in symbol-dense sequences: boundaries and escape characters in code regexes, LaTeX mathematical commands, and formulas; also seen in name typesetting, address line breaks, and Shell pipeline substitutions.

patterns.name: Regular expressions and boundary syntax
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on regex syntax characters, pattern beginnings, or branch boundaries; commonly found in JavaScript regex literals or regexes built by concatenation.
patterns.domain: Github code, including syntax highlighting, date handling, Markdown parsing, and operator matching

patterns.name: LaTeX symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in inline or displayed mathematical formulas, often with subscripts, superscripts, braces, and integral expressions.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers and StackExchange mathematics Q&A

patterns.name: Word and glyph boundaries in names
patterns.context: Author names are typeset with HTML small-caps styling, superscript numbers, and punctuation; activations are scattered across name spellings and boundaries.

patterns.name: Line breaks and punctuation in address fields
patterns.context: Multiline institutional mailing addresses follow field labels; line breaks and separators format the address.
patterns.domain: Institutional address information in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Command-line pipelines and regex substitution
patterns.context: A Shell script pipes display information to sed and uses a substitution pattern with anchors and groups to filter text.

patterns.name: Exponential structure in integral formulas
patterns.context: Exponential and power functions form part of an integral expression; although adjacent to the LaTeX mathematical-symbol pattern, the salient local feature is the combination of exponential terms.

patterns.name: Norms and integrals in displayed formulas
patterns.context: Formulas discussing random-variable norms or probability-distribution properties, including infinity norms and generalized integrals.

5_1468.concept: 结构化文本的符号边界
5_1468.description: 主要激活于结构密集的符号序列：代码正则表达式的边界与转义符、LaTeX 数学命令及公式；另在姓名排版、地址换行和 Shell 管道替换中出现。

patterns.name: 正则表达式及其边界语法
patterns.context: 激活集中在正则语法字符、模式开头或分支边界；常位于 JavaScript 的正则字面量或拼接生成的正则表达式中。
patterns.domain: Github 代码，语法高亮、日期处理、Markdown 解析、运算符匹配等

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 LaTeX 符号
patterns.context: 出现在行内或独立展示的数学公式中，常伴随上下标、花括号和积分表达式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文及 StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 姓名中的分词或字形边界
patterns.trigger: 姓名内部或相邻的 HTML/标记边界，如 `Nohara`、`Tou`、`Yoshikazu`，以及 ``、`$^{1}`
patterns.context: 作者姓名以 HTML 小型大写字样式、上标编号和标点排版，激活分散在姓名拼写及其边界处。

patterns.name: 地址字段换行与标点
patterns.context: 字段标签后接多行机构邮寄地址，换行与分隔符用于排版地址。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文中的机构地址信息

patterns.name: 命令行管道与正则替换
patterns.context: Shell 脚本将显示器信息通过管道传给 sed，并用带锚点和分组的替换模式筛选文本。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 中的 Bash 脚本示例

patterns.name: 积分公式的指数结构
patterns.trigger: `e^{...}`、`x^{...}` 及其间的分式、微分符号
patterns.context: 指数函数和幂函数构成积分表达式的一部分；该段虽与 LaTeX 数学符号模式相邻，但突出的局部是指数项组合。

patterns.name: 展示数学公式中的范数与积分
patterns.context: 讨论随机变量范数或概率分布性质的公式，包含无穷范数和广义积分。

en.description: Activations are distributed across structured passages in technical and academic text: author and institutional addresses, name formatting, code and command lines, and mathematical, biostatistical, and physics notation; no single clear word meaning or domain explains all examples.

patterns.name: Paper author addresses and institutional formatting
patterns.context: Near the end of a paper or in the author information section, institutional addresses are listed line by line, often with backslashes, commas, postal codes, email addresses, or author names; triggers are scattered throughout the formatted passage.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and author addresses

patterns.name: Author names and formatting markers
patterns.context: Names in author lists are split or wrapped in small-caps HTML tags, with nearby superscripts, commas, or line breaks.

patterns.name: Syntax and regex fragments in code
patterns.context: Punctuation, keywords, regex fragments, and code-line structure co-occur in JavaScript function and object definitions.

patterns.name: Mathematics paper titles and formula introductions
patterns.context: The paper body develops through section headings, mathematical terminology, and formula definitions; activations fall on headings, ordinary academic phrasing, and formula symbols.

patterns.name: Biostatistical notation and variable definitions
patterns.context: The Methods section defines variables with subscripts and superscripts for gene expression or sample summaries, and specifies index ranges.

patterns.name: Shell commands and pipeline text
patterns.context: Terminal commands are combined through pipelines and include regex substitution, filtering, and selecting the first line; connection-status matching expressions also appear locally.

patterns.name: Symbols in physics terminology
patterns.context: The body of a physics paper discusses nuclear spin relaxation rates and dynamical spin structure factors, with symbols adjacent to technical terms.

5_1468.concept: 技术文本中的结构化标记
5_1468.description: 激活分布于技术学术文本的结构化片段：作者与机构地址、姓名排版、代码和命令行，以及数学、生物统计和物理符号；没有单一明显词义或领域能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 论文作者地址及机构栏排版
patterns.trigger: «address:»、«\»、«Department»、«University»，以及机构、人名、邮编前的空格和换行
patterns.context: 论文末尾或作者信息区，机构地址按行排列，常伴随反斜线、逗号、邮编、邮箱或作者姓名；触发点分散在整段格式中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据与作者地址

patterns.name: 作者姓名及排版标记
patterns.trigger: «Sh»iva« Pr»as«ad»、«Kas»iv«is»wanathan，以及 «<span style="font-variant:small-caps">» 等姓名或格式片段
patterns.context: 作者列表中姓名被拆分或套用 small-caps HTML 标记，附近有上标、逗号或换行。

patterns.name: 代码中的语法/正则片段
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数和对象定义中，标点、关键字、正则表达式片段及代码行结构共同出现。

patterns.name: 数学论文标题与公式引导
patterns.context: 论文正文以章节标题、数学术语和公式定义展开；激活落在标题、普通学术措辞及公式符号上。

patterns.name: 生物统计符号与变量定义
patterns.context: 方法部分用带上下标的变量定义基因表达或样本汇总值，并说明索引范围。

patterns.name: Shell 命令与管道文本
patterns.context: 终端命令通过管道组合，包含正则替换、过滤和取首行等操作；局部也有连接状态匹配表达式。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术讨论/命令行文本

patterns.name: 物理术语中的符号
patterns.context: 物理论文正文讨论核自旋弛豫率和动力学自旋结构因子，符号与专业术语相邻。

en.description: Activations occur in paper formulas, author and institutional metadata, and regex and string-processing code; the shared feature appears to be sensitivity to dense structural markers, punctuation, and formatting fragments, rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formulas
patterns.context: Symbol definitions or equation environments in mathematical formulas or papers; activations fall on formula markers, commands, or tokens adjacent to mathematical symbols.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical papers

patterns.name: Paper author and institutional metadata
patterns.context: Formatting of authors, affiliations, and addresses in paper metadata, often with LaTeX superscripts, line breaks, postal codes, and country names.

patterns.name: Regexes and code punctuation
patterns.context: Regular expressions or similar pattern strings in code; triggers concentrate on escape characters, character classes, quantifiers, and their combinations.

patterns.name: String method calls in code
patterns.context: String-processing chains in JavaScript-style code, followed by property checks and regex matching.

5_1468.description: 激活分布在论文公式、作者与机构元数据，以及代码中的正则表达式和字符串处理处；共同特点更像对密集结构标记、标点和格式化片段敏感，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式
patterns.context: 数学公式或论文中的符号定义、方程环境；激活落在公式标记、命令或紧邻数学符号的 token 上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论论文

patterns.name: 论文作者与机构元数据
patterns.context: 论文元数据中作者、单位、地址的排版，常见 LaTeX 上标、换行、邮编和国家名。

patterns.name: 正则表达式及代码标点
patterns.context: 代码中的正则表达式或类似模式串；触发集中在转义符、字符类、量词及其组合上。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串方法调用
patterns.context: JavaScript 风格代码中，字符串处理链及其后的属性检查和正则匹配。

en.description: Activations concentrate on structured formatting and syntax fragments in papers and code: LaTeX author lists and mathematical notation, JavaScript regular expressions, and institutional addresses; one paper sentence also activates on “prove”.

patterns.name: LaTeX author information and name formatting
patterns.context: Near paper author lists, affiliation/footnote markers, and line breaks; some fragments also contain name spellings and punctuation
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and LaTeX typesetting

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: At mathematical formulas or the boundary between formulas and body text; segment 2 also contains an author list, so formulas alone cannot explain it

patterns.name: Regexes and punctuation in code
patterns.context: Regex literals in JavaScript source code, commonly with anchors, character classes, escapes, and capture groups; sometimes adjacent to function or object syntax

patterns.name: Institutional addresses and place names
patterns.context: Author affiliation or mailing address lists on the first page of a paper

patterns.name: Proof-related phrasing
patterns.context: Statements of theoretical results in a paper abstract or body; occurs only once, so its relation to other patterns is uncertain

5_1468.description: 激活集中于论文与代码中的结构化排版/语法片段：LaTeX 作者列表及数学标记、JavaScript 正则表达式，以及机构地址；另在一处论文语句的“prove”上激活。

patterns.name: LaTeX 作者信息及姓名格式
patterns.context: 论文作者列表、作者单位/脚注标记及换行附近；有的片段还包含姓名拼写与标点
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据与 LaTeX 排版

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式片段
patterns.context: 数学公式或公式与正文的边界处；段2另含作者列表，不能仅以公式解释

patterns.name: 代码中的正则表达式与标点
patterns.context: JavaScript 源码中正则字面量，常见锚点、字符类、转义和捕获组；部分邻接函数或对象语法

patterns.name: 机构地址与地名
patterns.trigger: `The University of Chicago`、`Chicago, IL 60637, USA`、`Department of Astronomy & Astrophysics`
patterns.context: 论文首页作者单位或通讯地址列表

patterns.name: 证明措辞
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文中陈述理论结果；仅有单次出现，不能确定与其他模式有关

en.description: Responses are scattered: decimal-place phrasing stands out in rounding problems; other examples include a female pronoun in patient or legal contexts, privacy language addressing readers, paper formulas, author bylines, and experimental measurement expressions.

patterns.name: “decimal places” in rounding questions
patterns.context: Asks for a decimal to be rounded to a specified number of decimal places, often adjacent to a number and question mark; numbers, signs, and place counts vary.

patterns.name: “her” in legal text
patterns.context: The pronoun refers to a female party or patient; appears in a description of visitation rights.

patterns.name: “her” in patient consent statements
patterns.context: States that the patient consented to the use of her images and clinical information; her refers to a female patient.

patterns.name: “your” in privacy notices
patterns.context: A company privacy notice addresses the reader directly, in the phrase “takes your privacy seriously”.

patterns.name: Symbols and formulas in mathematics papers
patterns.context: Around definitions of coding functions and mathematical formulas such as finite-field products.

patterns.name: Author names and institutional affiliations
patterns.context: After a paper abstract or body, transitions to author metadata listing authors, departments, universities, and addresses.

patterns.name: Measurement expressions in cell-experiment methods
patterns.context: Describes colon cancer cell seeding density and the number of experimental plate wells, including scientific notation.

5_1468.description: 响应分散：数学舍入题中突出小数位数措辞；另见患者或法律语境的女性代词、面向读者的隐私称呼、论文公式、作者署名和实验计量表达。

patterns.name: 四舍五入题目中的 decimal places
patterns.context: 要求将小数舍入到指定小数位数，常紧邻数值与问号；数字、正负号和位数会变化。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 her
patterns.context: 代词指女性当事人或患者；出现在探视权描述中。

patterns.name: 患者同意声明中的 her
patterns.context: 说明患者同意使用其图像和临床信息，her 指女性患者。

patterns.name: 隐私宣传中的 your
patterns.context: 公司隐私声明中直接称呼读者，出现在“takes your privacy seriously”一语。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的广告/免责声明

patterns.name: 数学论文中的符号与公式
patterns.context: 编码函数定义及有限域乘积等数学公式周边。

patterns.name: 作者姓名与机构署名
patterns.trigger: 姓名片段及其后的“\”或机构名称
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文结束后进入 author 元数据，列出作者、院系、大学及地址。

patterns.name: 细胞实验方法中的计量表达
patterns.context: 描述结肠癌细胞接种密度及实验板孔数，包含科学计数法。

en.description: Responds to local markers in various structured and formatted texts: paper author metadata, Objective-C identifiers, rounding instructions, medical terminology, legal boilerplate, and crystallographic refinement tables; these patterns differ markedly in vocabulary and domain.

patterns.name: Paper metadata and author lists
patterns.context: When a paper excerpt transitions to author, title, or affiliation information; activations concentrate on markers, name fragments, and separators

patterns.name: Objective-C containers and variable identifiers
patterns.context: When Foundation class names, type names, and related syntax appear in code

patterns.name: Decimal-rounding problems and answer format
patterns.context: A math exercise asks to round a decimal to a specified precision, with the answer on a separate line

patterns.name: Magnetic resonance relaxation rates and measurement methods
patterns.context: Describes measurement, calculation, and fitting relationships for magnetic resonance relaxation rates

patterns.name: Court boilerplate declining oral argument
patterns.context: The court states that oral argument is unnecessary and decides the case on the record

patterns.name: Crystallographic refinement tables
patterns.context: Table rules, reflection counts, and atomic-site information occur together in a crystal-structure refinement data table

5_1468.description: 响应多种结构化、格式化文本中的局部标记：论文作者元数据、Objective-C标识符、舍入题指令、医学术语、法律套语及晶体学精修表格；这些模式的词汇与领域差异明显。

patterns.name: 论文元数据与作者列表
patterns.context: 论文正文片段转入作者、标题或机构信息时；激活集中在标记符、姓名片段和分隔符

patterns.name: Objective-C 容器与变量标识符
patterns.context: 代码中出现 Objective-C 的 Foundation 类名、类型名及相关语法时

patterns.name: 小数舍入题及答案格式
patterns.context: 数学练习要求把小数舍入到指定精度，答案以数字另起一行

patterns.name: 磁共振弛豫率与测量方法
patterns.context: 描述磁共振弛豫率的测量、计算及拟合关系

patterns.name: 法院拒绝口头辩论的裁判套语
patterns.context: 法院说明无需口头辩论，并依据案卷材料作出决定

patterns.name: 晶体学精修表格
patterns.context: 晶体结构精修数据表中，表格线、反射数及原子位点信息相邻出现

en.concept: Boilerplate formats in legal procedure and scientific notation
en.description: Responds mainly to standard language used by courts of appeals to dispense with oral argument and close variants; also responds to procedural language denying rehearing en banc, and to Å, reciprocal units, and radiation data in crystallographic parameter tables, especially the strong activation on “^−1”.

patterns.name: Court of appeals boilerplate dispensing with oral argument
patterns.context: A federal court of appeals finds that the written materials adequately present the facts and legal arguments, so oral argument would not aid the decision; activations concentrate on words such as “not”, “would”, “aid”, “argument”, and “before” in the boilerplate, and on adjacent formatting
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, court opinions and procedural orders

patterns.name: Rehearing request denied
patterns.context: The court states that no one requested an en banc vote on a rehearing petition; appears in a procedural order, with high activation on “having requested”

patterns.name: Lattice and radiation data in crystallographic parameter tables
patterns.context: A crystallography paper or structure data table lists unit-cell parameters, radiation source, wavelength/units, and temperature; activations concentrate on the reciprocal-unit symbol “^−1”
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, crystallographic data in scientific papers

patterns.name: Oral-argument language in other appellate contexts
patterns.context: Similar to court boilerplate dispensing with oral argument, but phrased as “decision process would not be significantly aided by oral argument”; the preceding text mentions briefs, the record, and an appeal

5_1468.concept: 法律程序与科学符号中的固定格式
5_1468.description: 主要响应上诉法院免除口头辩论的固定措辞及其近义变体；另响应拒绝全院再审的程序语句，以及晶体学参数表中的Å、倒数单位和辐射数据，尤其对“^−1”强烈激活。

patterns.name: 上诉法院免除口头辩论的套语
patterns.trigger: “We dispense with oral argument because the facts and legal contentions are adequately presented … and argument would not aid the decisional process.”；也包括变体“decision[al] process would not be significantly aided by oral argument”
patterns.context: 联邦上诉法院认为书面材料已充分呈现事实与法律论点，因此口头辩论无助于裁决；激活集中在该套语中的“not”“would”“aid”“argument”“before”等词及其相邻格式
patterns.domain: FreeLaw，法院意见及程序性裁定

patterns.name: 再审请求被拒绝
