patterns.context: Occurs in “even if” or a conditional construction, introducing a condition, exception, or concession.

patterns.name: Paragraph/clause numbering symbols in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears around citations, plan clauses, or pleading paragraph numbers in legal texts.

patterns.name: Numeric and decimal/alphanumeric formats
patterns.context: Markers are distributed over numbers and symbols in values, dimensions, or mixed alphanumeric technical notation.

patterns.name: Paragraph and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: At paragraph or line breaks; some activations are immediately before the first sentence of a new line.

patterns.name: Textual errata and correction wording
patterns.context: An author says that a previously reported number or text should be corrected to a certain value.

patterns.name: Inter-sentence temporal progression in judicial narratives
patterns.context: After narrating events such as an arrest, a temporal adverb advances the sequence of events.

patterns.name: Destructive verbs describing disaster consequences
patterns.context: A parallel description of roads, pipelines, or buildings damaged by disasters such as earthquakes.

patterns.name: Descriptions of changes in medical results
patterns.context: Describes the direction of changes in glucose challenge and diabetes-related measures as the condition progresses.

5_2017.description: 激活分散于多类文本：while/if 等从句连接词、法律编号标记、数字与换行边界，以及各领域中勘误、时间推进、损害和指标变化等局部词语；未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: while 从句中的 while
patterns.context: 连接两个同时发生或对照的动作、状态；常出现在长句中段，后接主语或另一分句。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、天文学论文

patterns.name: 条件或让步从句中的 if
patterns.context: 位于“even if”或条件结构中，引出条件、例外或让步。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的段落/条款编号符号
patterns.context: 出现在法律文本的引文、计划条款或诉状段落编号周围。

patterns.name: 数字与小数/字母编号格式
patterns.context: 数值、尺寸或字母数字混排的技术记法中，标记分布在数字和符号上。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、天文学论文

patterns.name: 段落及换行边界
patterns.context: 文本段落或换行处；部分激活紧邻换行后的句首。

patterns.name: 文字勘误与更正表述
patterns.context: 作者说明此前报告的数字或文字应更正为某值。

patterns.name: 司法叙事中的句间时间推进
patterns.context: 叙述逮捕等事件后，以时间副词推进事件顺序。

patterns.name: 灾害后果的破坏性动词
patterns.context: 地震等灾害导致道路、管线或建筑受损的并列描述。

patterns.name: 医学结果的变化描述
patterns.context: 描述葡萄糖挑战及糖尿病相关指标随病情变化的方向。

en.description: Activations are distributed across unrelated content: dimension expressions, code tokens, variable assignments, statutory citations, document and paper numbering, validation logic, and figure titles. The commonality is weak; activations often fall near numbers, punctuation, or formatting markers, but there is no consistent word meaning or single context.

patterns.name: six and nearby dimension words
patterns.context: Describes distance, dimensions, or ranges; paragraph 1 also contains the specific spatial relation “six inches of”.

patterns.name: Code tokens adjacent to numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Program code, test assertions, and structured key-value content; the triggering tokens differ across passages.

patterns.name: found identifier and its assignment
patterns.context: The same variable-name prefix found combines with different property names, followed by an assignment or usage note.

patterns.name: Numbering in statutory citations
patterns.context: Numbering of statutes, clauses, or subsections, and associated parentheses or square brackets; trigger locations vary across examples.

patterns.name: Document-style numbering and citation formats
patterns.context: Pleading paragraph numbers or academic references/figure numbers, often accompanied by parentheses, punctuation, and line breaks.

patterns.name: ASP.NET validation condition description
patterns.context: Explains validators on the same control and the behavior of property values when validation fails.

patterns.name: Paper figure numbers and section titles
patterns.context: Image filenames, figure numbers, figure-caption links, and section titles in a medical paper; markers often occur at Markdown/HTML-style formatting boundaries.

5_2017.description: 激活分布于多种互不相同的内容：尺寸表达、代码 token、变量赋值、法规引文、文书与论文编号、验证逻辑及图号标题。共同点较弱，常落在数字、标点或格式化标记附近，但没有一致的词义或单一语境。

patterns.name: six及附近尺寸词
patterns.trigger: «within»« six»« inches»« of»，以及词序相近的 «to»、«within»
patterns.context: 描述距离、尺寸或范围；第1段中还出现“six inches of”的具体空间关系。

patterns.name: 数字与标点相邻的代码 token
patterns.trigger: «371»、«);»、«}"»、«b»、«c»、«d» 等；触发位置常在数字、引号、括号或代码标点旁
patterns.context: 程序代码、测试断言及结构化键值内容；不同段中的触发 token 不完全相同。

patterns.name: found 标识符及其赋值
patterns.trigger: «found»Value、«found»Address、«found»Row，以及 «set as value»、«set as address string»、«set as row»
patterns.context: 同一变量名前缀 found 与不同属性名组合，随后赋值或附注用途。

patterns.name: 法规引文中的编号
patterns.context: 法条、条款或子段编号及其括号、方括号格式；各例触发位置较分散。

patterns.name: 文书式编号与引用格式
patterns.context: 诉状段落号或学术文献/图注编号，常伴随括号、标点和换行。

patterns.name: ASP.NET 验证条件描述
patterns.context: 说明同一控件上的验证器及验证失败时属性值的行为。

patterns.name: 论文图号与章节标题
patterns.context: 医学论文中图像文件名、图号、图注链接及章节标题，标记常处于 Markdown/HTML 式排版边界。

en.description: The most stable cue is structural boundaries such as parentheses, commas, periods, line breaks, and code indentation, especially in legal citation numbering. There are also local activations on code words, mathematical notation, patent markers, and a few word fragments, but no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Punctuation, parentheses, and line-break boundaries
patterns.context: Near sentence endings, parentheses, citation numbers, or line breaks in code and dialogue; activations often fall on the punctuation itself and its immediate boundary.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, code, encyclopedia entries, and fiction across domains

patterns.name: Parenthetical numbering in legal citations
patterns.context: Nested parentheses, letters, and numeric labels in statutory or case citations, often adjacent to punctuation at the end of a citation sentence.

patterns.name: Separators and indentation structure in code
patterns.context: Indentation, whitespace placeholders, parentheses, and block boundaries in code lines; not a stable response to a specific programming language or identifier.

patterns.name: Specific code and command text
patterns.context: Near control flow, test assertions, or command-output strings; appears only in individual code passages and may overlap with the code-structure boundary pattern.

patterns.name: Mathematical notebook notation
patterns.context: In dense sequences of Mathematica-style expressions, escaped line breaks, array indexing, and variable updates.
patterns.domain: StackExchange mathematics or scientific computing content

patterns.name: Quotes and dialogue punctuation in narratives
patterns.context: In fictional dialogue and narrative paragraphs, line breaks and punctuation around sentence-final quotation marks activate alongside a few word fragments.

patterns.name: Structural numbering and punctuation in patents
patterns.context: In patent descriptions of electrodes, regions, and components, repeated component names occur next to parenthetical figure references.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on proper names or in-word fragments
patterns.context: No consistent semantic or lexical condition spans passages; these word fragments occur respectively in historical narratives, code, or fiction.

5_2017.description: 最稳定的线索是括号、逗号、句点、换行及代码缩进等结构边界，法律引文编号中尤明显。另有代码词、数学记号、专利标记和少数词片段的局部激活，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 标点、括号与换行边界
patterns.context: 句末、括号及引用编号附近，或代码、对话中的换行处；激活常落在标点本身及其紧邻边界。
patterns.domain: 多领域的法律文本、代码、百科与小说

patterns.name: 法律引文中的括号编号
patterns.context: 法规条文或判例引文中的嵌套括号、字母和数字编号，常接在引文句末标点前后。

patterns.name: 代码中的分隔符和缩进结构
patterns.context: 代码行的缩进、空白占位、括号及块边界；并非稳定响应某个具体编程语言或标识符。

patterns.name: 特定代码与命令文本
patterns.context: 控制流、测试断言或命令输出字符串附近；仅在个别代码段出现，可能与代码结构边界模式重叠。
patterns.domain: Go 测试代码、PowerShell 脚本

patterns.name: 数学笔记本记号
patterns.context: Mathematica 风格表达式及转义换行、数组索引和变量更新的密集序列中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数学或科学计算内容

patterns.name: 叙事中的引语与对白标点
patterns.context: 小说对白及叙述段落中，换行、句末引号周边标点与少数词片段同时激活。

patterns.name: 专利中的结构编号与标点
patterns.context: 专利对电极、区域及部件的描述中，重复部件名与括号式附图标记相邻。

patterns.name: 专名或词内片段的零散激活
patterns.context: 没有跨段一致的语义或词法条件；这些词片段分别出现在历史叙述、代码或小说中。

en.description: Primarily responds to errors in code, logs, and test assertions, especially Go test Fatal/Fatalf calls and expected errors; also shows isolated responses to literal newline escapes, translation metadata, JSON configuration, HBV paper figures, and legal testimony.

patterns.name: Error assertions in Go tests
patterns.context: In Go test code, checks function results, errors, or collection counts; constructs Fatal/Fatalf messages when an assertion fails.

patterns.name: Code logs and error messages
patterns.context: Code calls logging or error-formatting functions to record missing resources or failed requests; not necessarily a test assertion.

patterns.name: Newline escape with backslash and n
patterns.context: Text presents a backslash and the letter n as an escape sequence or literal content; the context does not resemble an ordinary test assertion.

patterns.name: Translation file metadata
patterns.context: Translation and revision metadata fields in the header of a PO file.

patterns.name: HBV numerical results in medical research
patterns.context: The paper reports the proportion of hepatitis B virus-related cases and cites a table.

patterns.name: JSON metric configuration fields
patterns.context: A JSON-style configuration object describes an enabled maximum-value metric and its field label.

patterns.name: Actions and quotations in legal testimony
patterns.context: Describes an office altercation witnessed by a witness and cites testimony with quotation marks and trial transcript page numbers.

5_2017.concept: 代码错误与格式化文本
5_2017.description: 主要响应代码中错误、日志及测试断言，尤其 Go 测试的 Fatal/Fatalf 与预期错误；另对字面换行转义、翻译元数据、JSON 配置、HBV 论文数值和法律证词各有孤立响应。

patterns.name: Go 测试中的错误断言
patterns.trigger: “does not exist”, “expected does not exist error”, “Expected non-err”, “expected 2 secrets, got %v”及“t.Fatal”“t.Fatalf”
patterns.context: Go 测试代码中，检查函数结果、错误或集合数量；断言失败时构造 Fatal/Fatalf 消息。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Go 测试代码

patterns.name: 代码日志与错误消息
patterns.trigger: “could not find”“failed to get vulnerabilities at %q:”以及“found the following file”
patterns.context: 代码调用日志或错误格式化函数，记录未找到资源或请求失败；不一定是测试断言。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Python/Go 代码

patterns.name: 反斜杠与 n 的换行转义
patterns.trigger: “\n”，尤其连续出现的“\n”及其邻近数值、变量
patterns.context: 文本中把反斜杠和字母 n 作为转义序列或字面内容呈现；上下文不像普通测试断言。

patterns.name: 译文文件元数据
patterns.context: PO 文件头部的翻译与修订元数据字段。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的 HBV 数值结果
patterns.context: 论文正文报告乙肝病毒相关病例比例，并引用表格。

patterns.name: JSON 指标配置字段
patterns.context: JSON 样式的配置对象，描述一个启用的最大值指标及其字段标签。
patterns.domain: Github 上的结构化配置文本

patterns.name: 法律证词中的动作与引语
patterns.context: 叙述证人所见的办公室冲突动作，并以引号和庭审记录页码引用证词。

en.description: Activations occur on short subword fragments, punctuation boundaries, and code structures across varied corpora; a few visible local patterns include degrade(s) in technical writing, ingestion narratives, and body-part phrases, but there is no consistent cross-passage semantics.

patterns.name: Unmarked short words and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur on very short word fragments or punctuation/whitespace boundaries, without a stable semantic trigger; [1]’s “resolved or chronic” and [10]’s “which degrades” contain similar fragments.
patterns.domain: Natural and technical texts across domains

patterns.name: degrade(s) in technical text
patterns.context: The within-word fragment “de” and following “grades” are marked separately; in [3] it refers to declining circuit performance, and in [10] to declining measurement accuracy.

patterns.name: Load balancing/ingestion-related narrative
patterns.context: Discusses crystal toxins being ingested and killing insect larvae; “upon” is the strongest marked token in the passage, but nearby ingestion, kills, insect, and larvae also activate.

patterns.name: Head and neck body-part phrases
patterns.context: Appears in a narrative about readers getting goosebumps; activations cluster around prepositions, articles, and body-part phrases.

patterns.name: Code and structured-text fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on word fragments, identifiers, HTML tags, escape characters, and locations near newlines or parentheses in code; the examples have no clear shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, scripts, HTML, Protobuf serialized text

patterns.name: Legal entity/litigation text fragments
patterns.context: In legal statements by credit card issuers and defendants, activations are scattered across company names, legal entity terms, and quotation/parenthesis structures.

patterns.name: Fragments in medical statistics reports
patterns.context: In sentences reporting HBV-positive proportions and case statistics, activations are scattered across conjunctions, numbers, percent signs, and articles, without a single stable medical-term trigger.

5_2017.description: 激活分布于多种语料的短词片段、标点边界和代码结构；少数可见局部模式包括技术文中的 degrade(s)、摄入叙述及身体部位短语，但跨段缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 未标记短词与标点边界
patterns.trigger: « or»、« de»、«grades»，以及标点、空格和引号附近的零散 token
patterns.context: 激活出现在很短的词片段或标点/空白边界上，未形成稳定的语义触发；[1] 的 “resolved or chronic” 和 [10] 的 “which degrades” 也有类似片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言与技术文本

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 degrade(s)
patterns.context: 词内片段 “de” 与后续 “grades” 被分别标记；在 [3] 指电路性能变差，在 [10] 指测量精度变差。

patterns.name: 负载均衡/摄入相关叙述
patterns.context: 谈及晶体毒素被摄入后杀死昆虫幼虫；“upon” 是该段最强标记，但邻近的 ingestion、kills、insect、larvae 也有激活。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、生物杀虫剂说明

patterns.name: 头颈部身体部位短语
patterns.trigger: « on»6« the»5« back»3« of»9« the»4« neck»
patterns.context: 出现在描述读者起鸡皮疙瘩的感受性叙述中，激活集中于介词、冠词和身体部位短语。
patterns.domain: 文学评论/个人阅读感受

patterns.name: 代码及结构化文本碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在代码中的词片段、标识符、HTML 标签、转义字符及换行/括号附近；各例没有明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、脚本、HTML、Protobuf 序列化文本

patterns.name: 法律实体/诉讼文本碎片
patterns.context: 信用卡发行方及被告的法律陈述中，激活分散在公司名、法律实体词和引述/括号结构上。

patterns.name: 医学统计报告碎片
patterns.context: HBV 阳性比例及病例统计句中，激活分散在连接词、数字、百分号和冠词上，没有单一稳定的医学术语触发。

en.description: Mixed activation patterns: back/of phrases appear in several passages (body, cooking, and figurative uses), and upon plus an event appears twice; the rest are local words or topics in a statistical paper, PHP code, and HBV statements, with no clear unifying semantic feature.

patterns.name: Back/body-part phrases
patterns.context: Triggers fall near back/of, appearing in body-part references, cooking descriptions, or figurative causal expressions; the semantics are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, prose, cooking, financial news

patterns.name: Conditions or timing introduced by upon
patterns.context: upon is followed by events such as ingestion or storage, indicating the condition or time when something occurs.

patterns.name: Local words in conjunctions or comparative structures
patterns.context: Appears in a description of statistical methods; activations are scattered around conjunctions, articles, and phrases related to the homogeneity-of-variance assumption, with no stable single trigger substring.

patterns.name: PHP input stream and null
patterns.context: When discussing an empty file or input stream, example code reads the request body and returns null.

patterns.name: CSV concatenation code
patterns.context: A PHP loop concatenates row fields with delimiters and newline characters into a CSV string.

patterns.name: HBV and table reference
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of hepatitis B-related cases and cites a table.

5_2017.description: 激活模式混杂：多处出现 back/of 短语（身体、烹饪及比喻用法），两处出现 upon 加事件；其余为统计论文、PHP 代码与 HBV 表述中的局部词汇或主题，难以归为同一语义特征。

patterns.name: 背部身体部位短语
patterns.trigger: “on the right side of his body”“on the back of his head”“on the back of the neck”“coats the back of a metal spoon”“on the back of his election”中的 back；尤其是 “of his”“of the”
patterns.context: 触发落在 back/of 附近，出现在身体部位、烹饪描述或比喻性因果表达中；语义并不一致
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、散文、烹饪、新闻财经

patterns.name: upon 引出的条件或时间
patterns.context: upon 后接摄入、储存等事件，表示发生某事的条件或时间

patterns.name: 连接词或比较结构中的局部词汇
patterns.context: 出现在统计方法描述中，激活分散在连接词、冠词及方差齐性假设相关短语周围，未见稳定单一触发子串

patterns.name: PHP 输入流与 null
patterns.context: 讨论空文件或空输入流时，示例代码读取请求体并返回 null

patterns.name: CSV 拼接代码
patterns.context: PHP 循环中将行字段与分隔符、换行符拼接进 CSV 字符串

patterns.name: HBV 与表格引用
patterns.context: 报告乙肝相关病例比例，并引用表格

en.description: Primarily responds to the temporal adverb later introducing a subsequent event; also activates on the collocation fall out of, scattered code tokens, and conditional expressions introduced by upon. Code fragments show no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: later as a subsequent-time marker
patterns.context: A person, thing, or state is mentioned first, then later introduces what happens afterward; activation is concentrated on later.

patterns.name: fall out of collocation
patterns.context: Describes an object falling out of a frame, or something losing popularity or favor; activation falls on out.

patterns.name: Specific lexical fragments in program code
patterns.context: These fragments appear in code or command-line text; trigger locations are scattered, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Structural markers in code
patterns.context: Identifiers or HTML attributes appear in code text; activations fall on ordinary code tokens, apparently without consistent local semantics.

patterns.name: Event conditions introduced by upon
patterns.context: Describes biological effects that occur after ingestion.

5_2017.concept: 后续时间标记与偶发词元
5_2017.description: 主要对 later 这种引出后续事件的时间副词起反应；另对 fall out of 搭配，以及若干分散的代码词元和 upon 引导的条件表达有激活。代码片段间缺少明显共同语义。

patterns.name: later 后续时间标记
patterns.context: 叙述先提到某人、事物或状态，接着用 later 引出之后发生的事情；激活集中落在 later。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、历史叙述及新闻类文字

patterns.name: fall out of 搭配
patterns.context: 描述物件从框架中脱落，或某事物失去流行、受人青睐；激活落在 out。

patterns.name: 程序代码中的特定词法片段
patterns.context: 代码或命令行文本中出现这些片段；触发位置分散，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、编译器选项

patterns.name: 代码中的结构性标记
patterns.context: 代码文本中出现标识符或 HTML 属性；激活落在普通代码词元上，似乎没有一致的局部语义。

patterns.name: upon 引导的事件条件
patterns.context: 描述摄入后发生的生物学效应。

en.description: Primarily responds to later in narratives, especially when it introduces a subsequent event after the subject; it also activates strongly on when clauses introducing time or conditions, event conditions introduced by upon, and the patent formula will appreciate that.

patterns.name: Temporal adverb later
patterns.context: In accounts of people or events, it often follows a subject or relative pronoun and indicates what happens afterward; [1] is in “who later resigned,” [3] “she later said,” [4] “He later was,” [7] “who later fell out,” and [10] “who later added.”

patterns.name: Time or condition clauses introduced by when
patterns.context: Introduces the circumstances or conditions under which something happens; examples include “when I told him,” “when the patient was lying,” and “when variables …”.
patterns.domain: Personal recollection, medical case reports, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Conditional or temporal phrases introduced by upon
patterns.context: “upon ingestion” means at or after ingestion, followed by the biological effect.

patterns.name: Acknowledgment formula in patents
patterns.context: Appears in the conventional patent phrase “those skilled in the art will appreciate that …”, introducing something the reader is expected to understand.

5_2017.concept: 后续事件与时间条件引导
5_2017.description: 主要响应叙述中的 later，尤其是主语后引出后续事件；也对 when 引导的时间或条件从句、upon 引出的事件条件，以及专利套语 will appreciate that 有较强激活。

patterns.name: later 时间副词
patterns.context: 在人物或事件叙述中，常接在主语或关系代词之后，表示随后发生的事；[1]位于“who later resigned”，[3]“she later said”，[4]“He later was”，[7]“who later fell out”，[10]“who later added”。

patterns.name: when 引导的时间或条件从句
patterns.context: 引出某事发生时的情形或条件；见“when I told him”“when the patient was lying”“when variables …”。
patterns.domain: 口语回忆、医学病例、技术问答

patterns.name: upon 引导的条件或时间短语
patterns.context: “upon ingestion”表示摄入时或摄入后，后接生物作用结果。

patterns.name: 专利套语中的认可判断
patterns.context: 出现在“those skilled in the art will appreciate that …”这一专利惯用表达中，引出读者应理解的内容。

en.description: Activations are scattered: several passages activate on when clauses; others involve paper citation formats, numeric markers, figure captions, food or technical descriptions, and opinion words in news, without a common clear lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Words following when
patterns.context: Activation falls directly on when, followed by a conditional, temporal, or situational clause. The fragments alone do not establish a more specific syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical narratives, personal essays, educational articles, patent descriptions

patterns.name: Citation and reference markers
patterns.context: Dense reference markers occur next to parentheses and superscript symbols; activations are distributed across these formatting tokens.

patterns.name: Academic markers made of numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: A sequence of numbers and commas in a paper on election methods, followed by a contribution statement; the fragment is insufficient to determine what the numbers mean.
patterns.domain: Political or social science academic writing

patterns.name: Taste and texture in food descriptions
patterns.context: When describing lemon loaf cake, poppy seeds, and emergency food, activations occur in reader-directed food descriptions; no unified local trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Preservation descriptions of volatile compounds
patterns.context: Describes DMS volatilizing and being lost during storage; activations occur on prepositions expressing conditions or timing.
patterns.domain: Food science or product technical descriptions

patterns.name: Experimental figures and sample labels
patterns.context: In Western blot and RNA experiment results, activations fall on panel letters and caption formatting such as parentheses and commas.

patterns.name: Expression of opinion in economic news
patterns.context: After reporting retail employment data, quotes an economist’s judgment about whether growth is sustainable.

5_2017.description: 激活模式分散：多段在 when 条件从句处激活；其余涉及论文引用格式、数字标记、图注、食品或技术描述及新闻观点词，缺乏共同的明确词汇触发。

patterns.name: when 后的词语
patterns.context: 激活直接落在 when 上；后面接条件、时间或情境从句。仅凭片段难以确定是否有更具体的句法条件。
patterns.domain: 医学叙述、个人随笔、教育文章、专利说明

patterns.name: 引用与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 密集的参考文献标记与括号、上标符号相邻；激活分布在这些格式 token 上。

patterns.name: 数字及标点构成的学术标记
patterns.context: 选举方法论文中的数字与逗号序列，后接贡献陈述；片段不足以确认数字含义。
patterns.domain: 政治学或社会科学学术写作

patterns.name: 食物描述中的味道与口感
patterns.context: 描述柠檬蛋糕面包、罂粟籽及应急食品时，激活落在面向读者的食物描述中；未见统一的局部触发词。
patterns.domain: 烹饪或生活类网络文章

patterns.name: 挥发性成分的保存性描述
patterns.context: 描述 DMS 储存时挥发、损失的过程；激活位于表示条件或时点的介词。
patterns.domain: 食品科学或产品技术说明

patterns.name: 实验图表与样本标记
patterns.context: Western blot 和 RNA 实验结果说明中，激活落在图板字母及括号、逗号等图注格式上。

patterns.name: 经济新闻中的观点表达
patterns.context: 报道零售业就业数据后，引述经济学家对增长是否可持续的判断。

en.description: Mixed activation patterns: several passages activate on when (including within-word strings), along with notebook code, citation markers, JSON metadata, and scattered word fragments in narratives, case reports, and financial reporting; no unified semantics or stable syntactic feature is apparent.

patterns.name: when as a clause introducer
patterns.context: Introduces a temporal or conditional clause; activation falls on when itself, without necessarily requiring a fixed syntactic category.
patterns.domain: Prose including narratives, medical case reports, and patent descriptions

patterns.name: The string when inside English words
patterns.context: The letter sequence when appears inside words other than “when,” especially spellings like “whenever”; this may simply share a position with ordinary when activations.

patterns.name: Python/Jupyter code and output structure
patterns.context: Near interactive notebook code or output, often with parentheses, indexing, and newlines; activation does not correspond to a single punctuation mark.

patterns.name: Numbered citation markers
patterns.context: Literature citation anchors before the paper text, containing numbers, links, and citation attributes.

patterns.name: JSON field names and string punctuation
patterns.context: Key-value pairs, quotation marks, colons, and commas in JSON objects; activations are scattered across field content and structural punctuation.

patterns.name: Word fragments formed by tokenization
patterns.context: Activations fall on ordinary English words or tokens consisting of a space plus a word; there is no visible shared syntactic function within the passage.

patterns.name: Descriptive word fragments in case reports
patterns.context: Physical examination narrative following a medical history, including anatomical descriptions and changes in patient position.

patterns.name: News word fragments in business reporting
patterns.context: Sentences reporting quarterly results and analyst forecasts and identifying the source; activations are distributed across words and function words.

5_2017.description: 激活模式混杂：多段命中 when（含词内字符串），另有笔记本代码、引文标记、JSON 元数据，以及叙述、病例和财经报道中的分散词片段；看不出统一语义或稳定句法特征。

patterns.name: when 从句引导词
patterns.context: 引出时间或条件从句；激活落在 when 本身，未必要求固定句法类别。
patterns.domain: 叙述、医学病例、专利说明等散文

patterns.name: 英语词内部的 when 字符串
patterns.context: 字母串 when 出现在 “when” 以外的词中，尤其是 “whenever” 类拼写；此处也可能只是位置与普通 when 激活相似。

patterns.name: Python/Jupyter 代码与输出结构
patterns.context: 交互式笔记本代码或输出附近，常有括号、索引和换行；激活并非只对应某个单一标点。

patterns.name: 带编号的引用标记
patterns.context: 论文正文前的文献引用锚点，包含编号、链接和引用属性。

patterns.name: JSON 字段名与字符串标点
patterns.context: JSON 对象中的键值对、引号、冒号和逗号；激活分散在字段内容和结构标点上。

patterns.name: 分词形成的单词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英文词或空格加词的 token 片段上；段内没有可见的共同句法功能。

patterns.name: 病例中的描述性词语片段
patterns.context: 病史之后的体格检查叙述，包含解剖描述和患者体位变化。

patterns.name: 商业报道中的新闻词语片段
patterns.context: 报道季度业绩、分析师预测并注明消息来源的句子；激活分布于词语和功能词。

en.concept: Text structure boundaries and condition markers
en.description: The main pattern is when introducing temporal or conditional clauses, along with Jupyter input prompts; some code output and citation markers also activate. Several local activations in natural language show no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Conditional/temporal clauses introduced by when
patterns.context: when introduces a temporal or conditional clause followed by a subject and verb; activations cluster on when and nearby words, with some examples followed by subjects such as I or the patient.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including narratives, technical failure descriptions, patent texts, and clinical case reports

patterns.name: Jupyter input prompts
patterns.context: Appears in input-cell prompts in Jupyter/IPython interactive notebooks; activations occur around the prompt and its number.

patterns.name: Code symbols and output prompts
patterns.context: Near code, array indexing, or expressions; several passages contain input/output cell formatting, but the specific triggering symbols vary.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code Q&A and interactive Python output

patterns.name: Segmented citation markers
patterns.context: Paired literature citation markers appear before the text; activations fall on parentheses, numbers, and boundaries in the citation syntax.

patterns.name: Unclear partial phrases
patterns.context: These local activations occur in natural-language sentences or patent descriptions; the samples alone cannot establish whether they share a trigger condition with the when pattern or code-formatting pattern.
patterns.domain: Narrative articles, patent texts, clinical case reports

5_2017.concept: 文本结构边界与条件标记
5_2017.description: 主要模式是 when 引导时间或条件从句，以及 Jupyter 输入提示；部分代码输出和引用标记也有激活。若干自然语言局部激活未显示出统一触发条件。

patterns.name: when 引导的条件/时间从句
patterns.context: when 引出时间或条件从句，后接主语和动词；激活集中在 when 及邻近词，部分例子后续是 I / the patient 等主语。
patterns.domain: 叙述、技术故障描述、专利文本和临床病例等多种文体

patterns.name: Jupyter 输入提示
patterns.context: 出现在 Jupyter/IPython 交互式笔记本的输入单元格提示中，提示符及编号附近激活。

patterns.name: 代码符号与输出提示
patterns.trigger: "Out["、"]:"、冒号、括号及逗号等代码或笔记本格式符号
patterns.context: 代码、数组索引或表达式附近；多段含有输入/输出单元格格式，但具体触发符号不一致。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码问答与交互式 Python 输出

patterns.name: 分段引用标记
patterns.trigger: "[^22^](#acm20031-bib-10002){ref-type=\"ref\"}" 等带方括号、锚点和 ref-type 属性的标记
patterns.context: 正文前出现成对的文献引用标记，激活落在引用语法的括号、数字及标记边界。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central XML/HTML 转换文本

patterns.name: 部分短语未明
patterns.trigger: 未见稳定的独立触发子串；第 1 段含 "terrify"、"people"、"I remember"，第 7 段含 "note"，第 8 段含 "On examination"
patterns.context: 这些局部激活处于自然语言句子或专利描述中，不能仅凭样本确认它们与 when 模式或代码格式模式有共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 叙述性文章、专利文本、临床病例

en.concept: Heterogeneous patterns including when conditions and code prompts
en.description: Activations commonly occur on when clauses and Jupyter input prompts; other examples include many, medical orientation and temporal connectives, patent storage contexts, code numbers, and sporadic terms, with no single semantic regularity across corpora.

patterns.name: when conditions in code
patterns.context: In Python code, programming Q&A, medical narratives, or explanatory text, when introduces a condition or temporal clause; activation falls on when, often followed by an article or pronoun.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, medical papers, explanatory text

patterns.name: Jupyter input prompts
patterns.context: In Python/Jupyter interactive notebook code or output, activations cluster near the closing parenthesis, number, or colon in the input prompt.

patterns.name: Quantifier many
patterns.context: In ordinary narratives, many modifies plural nouns such as people or observers.

patterns.name: Orientation/position terms in medical text
patterns.context: When describing a physical examination after hernia repair, right refers to the right side of the body; the same sentence also mentions the patient lying on their side.

patterns.name: Temporal connective in the AF remodeling process
patterns.context: Describes atrial fibrillation triggering electrical remodeling and its progression; until introduces the endpoint at which remodeling is complete.

patterns.name: Temporal/conditional clauses in storage contexts
patterns.context: A volatile compound is rapidly lost during storage; upon storage indicates storage as the condition or time period.

patterns.name: Numeric tokens in code arrays
patterns.context: In an interactive Python example, activations also fall near prompt numbers, array indices, or numeric values; there is insufficient evidence for a more specific code semantics.

patterns.name: HTTP status code and connection error
patterns.context: A Java HttpURLConnection connection to a URL fails, producing a “503 Forbidden” error message; activations are distributed around the error text.

patterns.name: Unknown or weakly related local activations
patterns.context: These words occur respectively in narratives, political reporting, and explanations of medical mechanisms, without a clear semantic condition shared with the other highly activating triggers.

5_2017.concept: when 条件与代码提示符等异质模式
5_2017.description: 激活常见于 when 条件从句及 Jupyter 输入提示符；另见 many、医学方位与时间连接词、专利储存语境、代码数值和零散词项，跨语料缺少单一语义规律。

patterns.name: 代码中的 `when` 条件
patterns.context: Python 代码、编程问答、医学叙述或说明文字中，`when` 引出条件或时间从句；激活落在 `when` 上，后续常接冠词或代词。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、医学论文、说明性文字

patterns.name: Jupyter 输入提示符
patterns.context: Python/Jupyter 交互式笔记本代码或输出中，激活集中在输入提示符的右括号、编号或冒号附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、Python 代码

patterns.name: 众多/数量词 many
patterns.context: 普通叙述中，`many` 修饰 people、observers 等复数名词。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的方位/体位词
patterns.context: 描述疝修补术后体检时，`right` 指身体右侧；同句还提到患者侧卧。

patterns.name: AF 重塑过程中的时间连接词
patterns.context: 说明房颤引发电重塑及变化进展，`until` 引出达到完全重塑状态的终点。

patterns.name: 存储条件下的时间/条件从句
patterns.context: 挥发性成分在储存时快速损失；`upon storage` 表示储存这一条件或期间。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、食品风味说明

patterns.name: 代码数组中的数值 token
patterns.context: 交互式 Python 示例里，激活还落在提示符编号、数组索引或数值附近；未见足够证据确定更具体的代码语义。

patterns.name: HTTP 状态码及连接报错
patterns.context: Java HttpURLConnection 连接 URL 失败，出现“503 Forbidden”错误信息；激活分布在错误文本周围。

patterns.name: 未知或弱关联的局部激活
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在叙事、政治报道和医学机制说明中，未显示与其他高激活触发项一致的明确语义条件。
patterns.domain: 散文、报道、生物医学文本

en.concept: Heterogeneous textual cues without a unifying pattern
en.description: Activations are distributed across varied corpora: when is most prominent in two technical Q&A passages; the rest involve citation markers, code and logs, medical/scientific narratives, personal recollections, and insecticidal mechanisms in patents, with no consistent trigger word.

patterns.name: Conditional or temporal introducer when
patterns.context: When describing program execution or network requests, introduces the time at which a condition, observation, or attempt occurs; this is the clearest and strongest lexical trigger in the two passages.

patterns.name: Academic citations and citation markers
patterns.context: In academic paper excerpts, punctuation, line breaks, and citation numbers near reference markers are also often marked; they are not necessarily the same literal token.

patterns.name: Technical Q&A and code/log vocabulary
patterns.context: Program startup, connection errors, debugging logs, or interactive Python code appear; markers are distributed across the question narrative, error messages, and nearby code.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and code notebooks

patterns.name: Descriptions of change, symptoms, and disease in biomedicine
patterns.context: Medical or biological text describes diseases, diagnoses, symptoms, risks, or drug-related reactions; the specific marked words vary.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and grant project text

patterns.name: Attitudes and experiences in narratives
patterns.context: Personal recollection or dialogue describes people’s reactions to religious traditions.

patterns.name: Biopesticide mode of action
patterns.context: Patent background text describes the mechanism as a sequence in which ingestion of a toxin kills insect larvae.

5_2017.concept: 异质文本线索，难以统一
5_2017.description: 激活分布于多种语料：when 在两段技术问答中最突出；其余涉及引用标记、代码与日志、医学科学叙述、个人回忆及专利中的杀虫机制，触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 条件或时间引导词 when
patterns.context: 在描述程序运行或网络请求时，引出某个条件、观察或尝试发生的时点；这是两段中最强的明确词汇触发。

patterns.name: 学术引文与引用标记
patterns.context: 学术论文片段中，紧邻参考文献标记的标点、换行及引文编号也常被标记；不一定是同一字面 token。

patterns.name: 技术问答与代码/日志词汇
patterns.context: 出现程序启动、连接错误、调试日志或交互式 Python 代码；标记分布在问题叙述、错误信息和代码邻近处。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答与代码笔记

patterns.name: 生物医学中的变化、症状与疾病描述
patterns.trigger: «ion channel changes»、«overweight and obesity»、«ovarian cancer»、«heart failure»、«drug craving»、«relapse»
patterns.context: 医学或生物学文本描述疾病、诊断、症状、风险或药物相关反应；具体被标记的词并不统一。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及资助项目文本

patterns.name: 叙述中的态度与经历
patterns.context: 以个人回忆或对话说明人们对宗教传统的反应。

patterns.name: 生物杀虫剂作用过程
patterns.context: 专利背景文字按摄入毒素后杀死昆虫幼虫的过程描述机制。

en.description: Primarily responds to anatomy in biomedical text, including different collocations and morphological and surgical contexts; sporadic activation also occurs on deviations in statistical summaries, the irregularly split word form U-next…, stock-related words in financial Q&A, and the SQL field grid.

patterns.name: Anatomical term anatomy
patterns.context: anatomy appears in discussions of anatomical structures, tissue morphology, or surgical techniques; the term appears explicitly in segments 1 and 5–9, usually as a noun within a sentence.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, case reports, or surgical reports

patterns.name: Subword anatomy
patterns.context: The trigger occurs within the word anatomy; the complete word appears in segments 1 and 5–9, though tokenization sometimes splits it.

patterns.name: Mathematical terminology in an abstract
patterns.context: The abstract discusses asymptotic distributions, maximum deviations, and sample covariance matrices; there is no clear anatomy trigger word.

patterns.name: Split U-next word form
patterns.context: A tokenized, split word form appears at the beginning of the abstract, preceded by a single quotation mark; it does not fit the anatomical content of the other segments.

patterns.name: Stock-trading Q&A context
patterns.context: Asks whether company executives selling their shares is a warning sign; the strongly activated words are scattered through the sentence, with no anatomical trigger.

patterns.name: Database field identifier
patterns.context: The backtick-quoted field name `sys_objects_grid` in an SQL update statement; unrelated to the topics of the other segments.

5_2456.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的 anatomy（含该词的不同搭配和形态学、手术语境）；另有统计摘要中的 deviations、异常拆分词形 U-next…、金融问答中的股票词和 SQL 字段 grid 等零散激活。

patterns.name: 解剖学术语 anatomy
patterns.context: anatomy 出现在解剖结构、组织形态或手术技术等讨论中；段1、5—9都明确出现该词，通常是句中名词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、病例或手术报告

patterns.name: 子词 anatomy
patterns.trigger: «ana»…«tomy» 的词内片段；可见于 anatomy、Choroidal anatomy
patterns.context: 触发位置处在 anatomy 一词中；段1、5—9均出现完整词，分词边界有时拆开。

patterns.name: 抽象摘要中的数学术语
patterns.context: 摘要讨论渐近分布、最大偏差与样本协方差矩阵；没有明显的 anatomy 触发词。

patterns.name: 拆分的 U-next 词形
patterns.context: 摘要开头出现被分词拆开的词形，前有单引号；与其余段落的解剖学内容不相符。

patterns.name: 股票交易问答语境
patterns.context: 询问公司高管出售所持股票是否构成警讯；显著激活的词分散在句中，未见解剖学触发。

patterns.name: 数据库字段标识符
patterns.context: SQL 更新语句中的反引号包围字段名 `sys_objects_grid`；与其他段落主题无关。

en.description: The strong pattern is anatomy in medical text, especially near surgery, body structures, or tissue features; sporadic triggers also occur in news attribution, MD5 troubleshooting, firmware macros, academic terminology, and stock trading, with no common semantics evident.

en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments, formatting symbols, code identifiers, and a few semantic words; PubMed items often begin with “Differences in …”, while others concern pizza, stock-related Q&A, and device optimization. There is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word or subword-fragment boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on split subword fragments, especially at the beginning or within a word; word meaning is not stable across texts.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, medical text, and code

patterns.name: Pizza in a title-style phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a webpage HTML title and body, in a context about liking and frequently eating pizza.

patterns.name: Words and symbol sequences
patterns.context: A Q&A about whether investors should worry about company executives selling their own shares; activation is distributed across body text and formatting symbols.

patterns.name: Device-optimization statement
patterns.context: The sentence states that many devices can benefit from spatial optimization.

patterns.name: Hardware macros and identifiers
patterns.context: A code snippet consisting of macro definitions, hardware categories, and hexadecimal values.

5_2456.description: 激活分散在切分词片段、格式符号、代码标识符及少数语义词上；PubMed 多以“Differences in …”开头，另有披萨、股票问答和器件优化，缺乏统一语义触发。

patterns.trigger: [7]–[10] 中 «D»«ifferences»；[3] 中 leukemia 被拆为 Acute、lymphoblastic、leukemia；[1] 中大量短片段与符号
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词片段上，尤其是词首或词内边界；不同文本中没有稳定一致的词义

patterns.name: 标题式短语中的 Pizza

patterns.name: 词语与符号序列

en.description: Primarily sensitive to LaTeX/HTML markup and backslash commands, especially formulas, typesetting controls, and document structure; it also covers paper authors/citations and astrophysical measurement expressions.

patterns.name: Backslashes and control sequences in LaTeX/HTML source
patterns.context: Activation falls on backslashes, command names, and adjacent characters in source; command purposes vary, including HTML/CSS and mathematical typesetting.
patterns.domain: StackExchange webpage source and academic LaTeX, including code, titles, formulas, and body text

patterns.name: Document markup and formatting control
patterns.context: When source is in a formatting definition, document structure, or metadata section, activation covers markup, commands, and some adjacent characters.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula syntax
patterns.context: LaTeX formulas in mathematical papers or Q&A; local symbols and text around formulas can also activate.

patterns.name: Paper citations and proper nouns
patterns.context: Experiment names, citation markers, and author information in paper prose or document metadata; not fully identical to formula syntax.

patterns.name: Scientific units and numerical expressions
patterns.context: Scientific measurement expressions composed of quantities, exponents, and units in astrophysical text.

5_2456.description: 主要对 LaTeX/HTML 标记及反斜杠命令敏感，尤其是公式、排版控制与文档结构；还覆盖论文作者/引文和天体物理计量表达。

patterns.name: 文档标记与格式控制
patterns.context: 源码处于格式定义、文档结构或元数据区域时，激活覆盖标记、命令及部分相邻字符

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式语法

patterns.name: 论文引文与专名

patterns.name: 科学计量单位与数字表达

en.description: This neuron responds broadly to LaTeX and structured source syntax, especially backslash commands, braces, formula markers, and line breaks and indentation; it spans webpage code, typesetting Q&A, and mathematics and physics papers, and also responds to abstract labels and several domain-specific notations.

patterns.name: LaTeX commands and macro syntax
patterns.context: Activation clusters near commands, braces, math-mode markers, and typesetting control syntax in LaTeX source; contexts include body formulas, document structure, and custom macros.
patterns.domain: LaTeX, mathematical typesetting, and technical document source; StackExchange and ArXiv

patterns.name: Line-break and indentation control
patterns.context: In multiline code or document source, activation occurs near line breaks, tabs, indentation, and line beginnings; especially prominent in HTML/CSS and LaTeX code snippets.
patterns.domain: Formatted source code, code examples, and structured text

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula structure
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas or physical expressions, often alongside LaTeX math commands, variable subscripts and superscripts, and paired brackets.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and theoretical science papers

patterns.name: HTML/CSS selectors and style declarations
patterns.context: Source structure in HTML tags, CSS selectors, and style blocks; activation favors tags, selectors, and line-break/indentation syntax rather than natural language.

patterns.name: LaTeX macro definitions and file I/O examples
patterns.context: Document-source examples define commands and read files or process text line by line, with activation near command names and braced arguments.

patterns.name: Document heading hierarchy and layout adjustments
patterns.context: LaTeX commands set section hierarchy, color, and heading spacing; activation falls near structural commands and their arguments.

patterns.name: Scientific paper abstract opening
patterns.context: ArXiv text begins with an abstract field and its delimiter; activation occurs near the abstract label and opening punctuation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper dumps or structured abstract text

patterns.name: Quantum-state and operator notation

patterns.name: LaTeX 公式内的换行与间距

en.description: Strongly responds to sequences of structured markup symbols: one group consists of LaTeX math commands, grouping, and alignment symbols; another consists of HTML tags, closing markers, and whitespace entities. Both occur in text mixing different kinds of markup.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting commands
patterns.context: Backslash commands interleave with braces, subscripts, operators, and other elements in mathematical formulas or alignment environments; activation often falls on commands, delimiters, and nearby text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical papers

patterns.name: HTML markup and whitespace entities
patterns.context: HTML tags, attributes, and entities appear consecutively in webpage or source snippets, especially closing tags and repeated whitespace entities.

5_2456.description: 对结构化标记符号序列反应明显：一类是 LaTeX 数学命令、分组及对齐符号，另一类是 HTML 标签、闭合标记和空白实体；两类均见于混杂标记的文本。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令
patterns.context: 数学公式或对齐环境中，反斜杠命令与花括号、下标、运算符等交错出现；激活常落在命令、分隔符及其附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理与理论论文

patterns.name: HTML 标记与空白实体
patterns.context: 网页或源码片段中，HTML 标签、属性和实体连续出现，尤其是标签闭合及重复空白实体。

en.description: Activation clusters around structured markup and typesetting symbols: code borders, HTML tags/entities, LaTeX math commands and alignment symbols, and code identifiers and document fields. Multiple snippets share markup syntax such as angle brackets, slashes, and underscores.

patterns.name: Character borders, column separators, and alignment spaces
patterns.context: Repeated punctuation forms horizontal lines, slashes, and vertical bars in code or typeset text, accompanied by alignment spaces; the forms in [1]–[3] are highly similar.
patterns.domain: Github comments/source snippets, often with tables or ASCII-style layouts

patterns.name: HTML attributes and whitespace entities
patterns.context: Web markup snippets composed of HTML tags, attributes, or entities, often accompanied by link text or repeated whitespace entities.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting commands and formula alignment
patterns.context: Mathematical expressions contain backslash commands, subscripts/superscripts, and formula-environment alignment markers; triggering is distributed across differential equations and quantum mechanics formulas.

patterns.name: LaTeX typesetting hints and special spacing
patterns.context: LaTeX typesetting commands for controlling vertical spacing appear near formula text; this occurs only in this snippet.

patterns.name: Operator notation and symbol sequences in scientific text
patterns.context: When discussing a boson model, variable subscripts in math mode and nearby lattice-site operator notation appear; activation falls on symbol sequences and subword fragments.

patterns.name: Camel-case identifiers and field substrings in code
patterns.context: Source identifiers contain field and mixed-case word segments, embedded between HTML-style tags and code markup.

patterns.name: Camel-case attribute names in HTML/templates
patterns.context: Camel-case control identifiers and call expressions appear in event-handler attributes, surrounded by HTML tags.
patterns.domain: StackExchange webpage templates or frontend code

patterns.name: Document metadata and XML-style entities
patterns.context: Document headers or example configurations contain field names, titles, and escaped angle brackets; this does not match the preceding formula or code-identifier patterns.

5_2456.concept: 结构化标记与排版符号
5_2456.description: 激活集中于结构化标记与排版符号：代码框线、HTML 标签/实体、LaTeX 数学命令和对齐符，以及代码标识符、文档字段；多段共享尖括号、斜线、下划线等标记语法。

patterns.name: 字符框线、列分隔符与对齐空格
patterns.context: 代码或排版文本中出现由重复标点构成的横线、斜线和竖线，并伴随空格对齐；[1]–[3] 的形态高度相似。
patterns.domain: Github 注释/源码片段，常见于表格或 ASCII 风格布局

patterns.name: HTML 属性与空白实体
patterns.context: HTML 标签、属性或实体组成的网页标记片段，常伴随链接文本或重复空白实体。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令及公式对齐
patterns.context: 数学表达式中出现反斜线命令、上下标和公式环境对齐符；触发分布在微分方程及量子力学公式中。

patterns.name: LaTeX 排版提示词与特殊间距
patterns.context: 公式文本附近出现用于控制垂直间距的 LaTeX 排版命令；只见于该段。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的算符记号与符号串
patterns.context: 叙述玻色子模型时，数学模式内的变量下标及邻近格点算符记号出现；激活落在符号串和断词片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 凝聚态/量子物理文本

patterns.name: 代码中的驼峰标识符与 field 子串
patterns.context: 源码标识符含 field 及混合大小写词段，夹在 HTML 风格标签和代码标记之间。

patterns.name: HTML/模板中的驼峰式属性名
patterns.context: 事件处理器属性中出现驼峰命名的控件标识符和调用表达式，周围是 HTML 标签。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页模板或前端代码

patterns.name: 文档元数据与 XML 风格实体
patterns.context: 文档头部或示例配置包含字段名、标题和转义后的尖括号；不属于前述公式或代码标识符模式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文模板/文档元数据

en.concept: Markup languages and typesetting control symbols
en.description: Responds to structured markup and typesetting source text: webpage HTML tags, attributes, and repeated whitespace entities, as well as commands, delimiters, and spacing controls in LaTeX mathematical formulas. It also activates on a roff-style comment explaining vertical spacing in one snippet.

patterns.name: HTML markup and whitespace entities
patterns.context: Multiple whitespace entities occur near tags or list items in webpage source or webpage content dumps; not every snippet necessarily has both features.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting commands and formulas
patterns.context: Formulas and their layout markers for alignment, line breaks, and spacing are dense in mathematics papers or Q&A text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and StackExchange mathematics Q&A

patterns.name: Vertical-spacing notes in code comments
patterns.context: Comments and command examples resembling roff/man macros or typesetting source files.

5_2456.concept: 标记语言与排版控制符
5_2456.description: 响应结构化标记和排版源文本：网页 HTML 标签、属性与重复空白实体，以及 LaTeX 数学公式中的命令、定界符和间距控制；另对一段说明垂直间距的 roff 式注释激活。

patterns.name: HTML 标记与空白实体
patterns.trigger: HTML/XML 标签属性及连续的 « »；如 «class="divider">»、「ng-repeat」、「ng-class」和 «  »
patterns.context: 网页源码或网页内容转储中，标签、属性或列表项附近出现多个空白实体；未必每段都同时具备这些特征。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令与公式
patterns.trigger: 数学公式中的 LaTeX 控制序列、定界符和排版指令，如 «\frac»、«\mathcal»、«\Phi»、«\quad»、«\[»、«\)»
patterns.context: 数学论文或问答文本中，公式及其对齐、换行、间距等排版标记密集出现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文及 StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 代码注释中的垂直间距说明
patterns.context: 类似 roff/man 宏或排版源文件的注释及命令示例。

en.concept: Structured text markup and typesetting syntax
en.description: Primarily responds to markup syntax in structured text: HTML tags, attributes, whitespace entities and line breaks, as well as LaTeX math commands and symbols. CSS rules also occur. A single English promotional passage and some special snippets are difficult to explain with the same trigger.

patterns.name: HTML whitespace entities and layout padding
patterns.context: Whitespace entities, line-break tags, or blank lines are used for layout in HTML, especially near tag contents or code blocks; no specific domain is required.
patterns.domain: Webpage HTML, forum or code snippets

patterns.name: HTML tag and attribute syntax
patterns.context: Tags, attributes, closing tags, and interpolation in markup or template code; snippets 1, 3, and 9 also contain many whitespace entities.

patterns.name: Mathematical relations and symbolic expressions in LaTeX
patterns.context: Relation symbols, set/space notation, and variables are marked up with LaTeX in formulas or mathematical paper text; some snippets also mix in ordinary prose.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers, StackExchange mathematics answers

patterns.name: Web links and entity encoding
patterns.context: Link attributes or escaped characters such as quotes and angle brackets appear in HTML source.

patterns.name: Mixed HTML and LaTeX typesetting markup
patterns.context: Structured markup is embedded in plain text, with tags or backslash commands marking boundaries between code, formulas, and prose.

patterns.name: English webpage navigation and calls to action
patterns.context: Reader-facing webpage promotional copy prompts users to click a link to read news or offer help; no clear code trigger is evident.
patterns.domain: News promotional text in Enron emails

patterns.name: CSS declarations and pseudo-element selectors
patterns.context: A CSS rule block contains property-value declarations and browser-specific pseudo-element selectors for number input fields.

patterns.name: Special mathematical typesetting commands in documents
patterns.context: LaTeX commands for relation symbols or typesetting in a mathematics paper; adjacent to the primary relation-symbol pattern but with a more specialized use.

5_2456.concept: 结构化文本标记与排版语法
5_2456.description: 主要响应结构化文本里的标记语法：HTML 标签、属性、空白实体与换行，以及 LaTeX 数学命令和符号；另见 CSS 规则。单次英文推广文案与部分特殊片段难以由同一触发解释。

patterns.name: HTML 空白实体与排版填充
patterns.context: HTML 中用空白实体、换行标签或空行进行排版，尤其出现在标签内容或代码块附近；不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 网页 HTML、论坛或代码片段

patterns.name: HTML 标签及属性语法
patterns.context: 标记语言或模板代码中的标签、属性、闭合标签与插值；第 1、3、9 段同时有大量空白实体。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学关系与符号表达
patterns.context: 公式或数学论文文本中，关系符号、集合/空间记号和变量被 LaTeX 标记；部分段落也混有普通叙述。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、StackExchange 数学回答

patterns.name: 网页链接及实体编码
patterns.context: HTML 源码中出现链接属性或被转义的引号、尖括号等字符。

patterns.name: HTML 与 LaTeX 的混合排版标记
patterns.trigger:
«
»、«» 与换行，或公式附近的 «\» 命令
patterns.context: 纯文本中嵌有结构化标记，代码、公式和正文边界由标签或反斜线命令表示。

patterns.name: 英文网页导航与号召性语句
patterns.context: 面向读者的网页宣传文案，提示点击链接阅读新闻或参与帮助；未见明显代码触发。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的新闻推广文本

patterns.name: CSS 声明与伪元素选择器
patterns.context: CSS 规则块中以属性和值构成声明，并包含针对数字输入框的浏览器专属伪元素选择器。

patterns.name: 文档中的特殊数学排版命令
patterns.context: 数学论文中用于关系符号或排版的 LaTeX 命令；与主要关系符号模式相邻，但具体用途较特殊。

en.concept: Web markup and patent-solution lead-in phrasing
en.description: Activation primarily clusters around HTML source tags, attributes, entities, and template snippets; it also clusters around the patent-background phrasing “it would be advantageous to …” that introduces a desired solution. Web subpatterns include footers, navigation, tables, example descriptions, and player controls.

patterns.name: HTML markup and webpage templates
patterns.context: In webpage source, activation falls on HTML tag snippets, attributes, entities, and surrounding delimiters; common in template structures such as closing tags, table cells, footers, or navigation bars.
patterns.domain: Github webpage source, StackExchange page HTML

patterns.name: Advantageous-solution phrasing in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: A conventional patent-background phrase that, after reviewing prior-art drawbacks or problems, introduces the need to provide, have, or improve a device, technology, system, or material.

patterns.name: Copyright symbols in HTML
patterns.context: A copyright notice in a footer, where an HTML entity is followed by a company name and year.

patterns.name: External-link markup and download text in HTML
patterns.context: A link in a navigation list item points to an external site and displays download-link text after an icon marker.

patterns.name: Example description text and calendar interface
patterns.context: A footer example description introduces how to customize an event calendar interface, surrounded by paragraph tags.

patterns.name: Player time display elements
patterns.context: In player-control HTML, an element with timer semantics displays the current playback time and contains whitespace entities.

patterns.name: HTML skip-navigation link and navigation-end comment
patterns.context: A skip-to-top navigation link and its end comment appear in page source, followed by a navigation-spacing element.

5_2456.concept: 网页标记与专利方案引出语
5_2456.description: 激活主要集中于HTML源码的标签、属性、实体和模板片段；另在专利背景中集中响应“it would be advantageous to …”引出所需方案的句式。网页子模式包含页脚、导航、表格、示例说明和播放器控件。

patterns.name: HTML标记与网页模板
patterns.context: 网页源码中，激活落在HTML标签片段、属性、实体及其周围的分隔符；常见于闭合标签、表格单元格、页脚或导航栏等模板结构。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的有利方案措辞
patterns.context: 在回顾现有技术缺点或问题之后，引出需要提供、具有或改进某种装置、技术、系统或材料的专利背景惯用句式。

patterns.name: HTML中的版权符号
patterns.context: 页脚版权声明中，HTML实体后接公司名和年份。

patterns.name: HTML中的外链标记与下载文字
patterns.context: 导航列表项里，链接指向外部网站，并以图标标记后显示下载链接文字。

patterns.name: 示例说明文字与日历界面
patterns.context: 页脚示例描述介绍如何定制事件日历界面，周围含段落标签。

patterns.name: 播放器时间显示元素
patterns.context: 播放器控件HTML中，以带计时器语义的元素显示当前播放时间，含空白实体。

patterns.name: HTML跳过导航链接与导航结束注释
patterns.context: 页面源码中的跳转到顶部导航链接及其结束注释，随后出现导航间距元素。

en.description: Primarily responds to patent phrasing such as “would be … advantageous/desirable to,” which first states a problem and then proposes an ideal technical solution; it also responds to suggestions or invitations using wish to, and independently activates on HTML entities such as   and © in webpage source.

patterns.name: Advantageous/desirable solution phrasing
patterns.context: The preceding text points out problems or shortcomings in existing technology, followed by a proposal for a solution to obtain or improve something; strong activation clusters on the consecutive expression would be, advantageous, to.

patterns.name: wish to suggesting an action
patterns.context: may wish to introduces an action worth considering; activation clusters on wish to.

patterns.name: like to invitation or request
patterns.context: A news website prompt addressed to readers invites them to help the site.

patterns.name: HTML entity nbsp
patterns.context: Appears as a space entity in HTML markup; activation primarily falls on the entity’s character sequence and occurs in player controls, page layouts, or style code.

patterns.name: Footer copyright entity
patterns.context: A copyright-symbol entity in an HTML footer; the entity characters activate.

5_2456.description: 主要对“would be … advantageous/desirable to”这类先述问题、再提出理想技术方案的专利句式反应；也响应 wish to 的建议或邀请表达，并在网页源码中对  、© 等 HTML 实体有独立激活。

patterns.name: 有利/期望方案句式
patterns.trigger: “it would be advantageous to” / “it would be desirable and highly advantageous to” / “it would be advantageous to have”；另有 “Hence,” “Accordingly,” “Therefore” 引出的句子
patterns.context: 前文指出现有技术的问题或不足，随后提出希望获得或改进某种方案；强激活集中在 would be、advantageous、to 等连续表达上。

patterns.name: wish to 建议行动
patterns.context: 以 may wish to 引出建议考虑的行动，激活集中于 wish to。

patterns.name: like to 邀请或请求
patterns.context: 面向读者的新闻网站提示，邀请读者帮助网站。
patterns.domain: 网站新闻提示、面向用户的文案

patterns.name: HTML 实体 nbsp
patterns.context: HTML 标记中作为空格实体出现，激活主要落在实体的字符片段上；出现在播放器控件、页面布局或样式代码中。

patterns.name: 页脚版权实体
patterns.context: HTML 页脚中版权符号实体，实体字符获得激活。

en.concept: HTML markup and expressions of intention or suggestion
en.description: Primarily activates on closing tags, tag boundaries, and whitespace/greater-than entities in HTML code; it also activates in expressions of intention or suggestion such as wish to and you'd like to, followed by different action verbs.

patterns.name: HTML closing tags and tag boundaries
patterns.context: Repeated HTML/XML-style markup, especially closing tags and adjacent boundaries; often accompanied by line breaks, indentation, or nesting.
patterns.domain: HTML templates or code in Github

patterns.name: HTML whitespace entities
patterns.context: HTML entities occur near tag contents or attributes; across multiple snippets they co-occur with closing tags and line breaks.

patterns.name: wish to in suggestive contexts
patterns.context: wish is followed by a to-infinitive to express a suggestion, intention, or action readers may take; the following verbs vary.
patterns.domain: Formal expository writing such as abstracts, patent backgrounds, and popular-science articles

patterns.name: like to in polite requests
patterns.context: you'd like to forms a polite reader-facing offer, followed by help.
patterns.domain: News website copy or promotional email text

5_2456.description: 主要激活于 HTML 代码的结束标签、标签边界及空白/大于号实体；另在 wish to 与 you'd like to 等表达意愿或建议的结构中激活，后接不同动作动词。

patterns.name: HTML 标签闭合与标签边界
patterns.context: 反复出现的 HTML/XML 风格标记中，尤其是结束标签及其相邻边界；常伴随换行、缩进或嵌套结构。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML 模板或代码

patterns.name: HTML 空白实体
patterns.context: HTML 实体写在标签内容或属性附近；多段里与标签闭合、换行共同出现。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 HTML 代码

patterns.name: 建议语境中的 wish to
patterns.trigger: « wish»10« to»6« consider»4（3）；« wish»9« to»5« monitor»2（9）；« wish»9« to»6« build»5（10）
patterns.context: wish 后接 to 不定式，表达建议、意愿或读者可采取的行动；后续动词各不相同。
patterns.domain: 摘要、专利背景、科普文章等正式说明文

patterns.name: 礼貌请求中的 like to
patterns.context: you'd like to 构成面向读者的礼貌提议，后接 help。
patterns.domain: 新闻网站文案或邮件中的宣传文字

en.concept: Proper names and domain-specific subword fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across technical and medical terms, names and proper nouns, legal captions, and cryptocurrency terms. The shared feature is weak, mainly involving proper names or domain-specific subword fragments in multi-domain text.

patterns.name: Device, scientific, or technical terms
patterns.context: Specialized terms appear in technical or scientific text; activations fall on several tokens within the terms, with no consistent fixed grammatical position.
patterns.domain: Hardware code, patents, medical and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Personal names and name fragments
patterns.context: Activations appear when proper names or personal names are split into multiple subwords; contexts include a team name, a directory entry, and a producer field.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, bibliographic catalogs, wine lists

patterns.name: Specific proper names or entity strings
patterns.context: Code or data fields contain a proper name followed by an image URL; there is insufficient evidence to equate this pattern with general personal names.

patterns.name: Legal case names and dates
patterns.context: Formal fields such as organization names, court information, and dates appear in court case captions.

patterns.name: Cryptocurrency-related terms
patterns.context: Web content discusses mining rig setup, maintenance, and definitions of scams; activations concentrate within split terms.

5_2513.description: 激活分散在技术和医学术语、姓名与专名、法律抬头及加密货币词语中；共同点较弱，主要表现为多领域文本里的专名或领域词片段。

patterns.name: 器件、科学或技术术语
patterns.trigger: « bus»、«channel»、«Frequency»、«credit card identifiers»、«reader station»、«dietary Na»、«blood»、«ultrasound stethoscope»
patterns.context: 技术或科学文本中出现专门名词；激活落在术语内部的若干 token，未见一致的固定语法位置。
patterns.domain: 硬件代码、专利、医学与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 人名及姓名片段
patterns.context: 专名或姓名被拆分成多个子词时出现；上下文分别是球队名称、目录条目和生产者字段。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、书目目录、葡萄酒列表

patterns.name: 特定专名或实体字符串
patterns.context: 代码或数据字段中包含专有名称，后接图像 URL；未见足够证据与一般人名模式等同。

patterns.name: 法律案件名称与日期
patterns.context: 法院案件抬头中，组织名称、法院信息和日期等正式字段。

patterns.name: 加密货币相关用语
patterns.context: 谈论矿机设置、维护及诈骗定义的网页内容；激活集中在拆分的术语内部。

en.description: Activations are distributed across many unrelated proper names and word fragments: Rock/Rockwell, medical infections and fungi, an ultrasonic stethoscope, Armagnac, certificate markers, code comments, and the Italian national team. No unified trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Rockwell strings
patterns.context: Rock or rock combines with a subsequent word fragment in the names “Rock dormouse” and “Rockwell Automation”; capitalization varies.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia article titles and business names

patterns.name: Antifungal/infection-related medical text
patterns.context: Medical abstracts discuss severe burns and infections, antifungal activity, or ringworm treatment; activations are scattered across related terms.

patterns.name: Device name fragments
patterns.context: An abstract describes experience using an ultrasonic stethoscope; activations concentrate on the device name and its component fragments.

patterns.name: Alcohol name fragments
patterns.context: Producer information for alcoholic beverages contains the name Armagnac and repeated word fragments.

patterns.name: Certificate headers
patterns.context: The PEM-format BEGIN CERTIFICATE marker; activations occur on the tokenized certificate text and its boundary symbols.

patterns.name: Code comments and channel variables
patterns.context: A code comment introduces an expression, followed by a 2GHz channel frequency calculation; activations concentrate on English comment fragments and the split word channel.

patterns.name: Italian national team fragments
patterns.context: In the title “Italy national korfball team,” activations cover tokenized fragments of Italy, national, korfball, and team.

5_2513.description: 激活分布于多种互不相同的专名和词段：Rock/Rockwell、医学感染与真菌、超声听诊器、Armagnac、证书标记、代码注释及意大利国家队；看不出统一触发特征。

patterns.name: Rockwell 字符串
patterns.context: Rock 或 rock 与后续词片段组合，分别出现在名称“Rock dormouse”和“Rockwell Automation”中；大小写不一。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题及商业名称

patterns.name: 抗真菌/感染相关医学文本
patterns.trigger: « severe»10« burns»5；« infections»7；« antifungal»3；« three»9« nec»2«rot»5rophic fungi；« t»1«inea»1
patterns.context: 医学摘要中涉及严重烧伤及感染、抗真菌活性或癣治疗；激活点分散于相关词语。

patterns.name: 器械名称片段
patterns.context: 描述超声听诊器使用经验的摘要，激活集中在器械名称及其组成片段。

patterns.name: 酒类名称片段
patterns.context: 酒类生产者信息中出现 Armagnac（雅文邑）名称及重复词段。

patterns.name: 证书头部
patterns.context: PEM 格式证书的 BEGIN CERTIFICATE 标记；激活在分词后的证书字样及其边界符号。

patterns.name: 代码注释及信道变量
patterns.context: 代码注释介绍表达式，随后给出 2GHz 信道频率计算；激活集中在英文注释片段及被拆分的 channel。

patterns.name: 意大利国家队词段
patterns.context: “Italy national korfball team”标题中，激活覆盖 Italy、national、korfball 和 team 的分词片段。

en.concept: Terms and titles in scientific text
en.description: Activations occur in scientific titles and abstracts across multiple fields: medical diseases, treatments, and vaccines; environmental and materials research; scattering processes; plant pathogens and miRNA; and a passage of ontology bibliography. Some titles begin with «[»; no unified theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Abstract title opening marker
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of bracketed titles, followed by a medical or research topic; subsequent content varies.

patterns.name: Medical disease and treatment titles
patterns.context: Titles concern treatment, disease, patients, or medical interventions and often contain medical terminology; they cover different conditions, with no shared specific disease topic.

patterns.name: Biomedical research terminology
patterns.context: Research descriptions involve pathogens, vaccines, free radicals, or molecular biology entities; some occur in titles and others in abstract bodies.

patterns.name: Materials and processes in scientific titles
patterns.context: Focuses on objects and properties or processes involving soil, material luminescence, or molecular scattering; these belong to different scientific subfields.
patterns.domain: Environmental science, materials science, and physical chemistry

patterns.name: Formal ontology bibliographic information
patterns.context: Appears in bibliographic text about book titles, editors, publishers, and philosophy institutions, including ontology-related terminology.

patterns.name: Plant diseases and small RNAs
patterns.context: Describes plant health or disease, phytoplasma treatment, and identification of conserved or novel miRNAs.
patterns.domain: Plant pathology and molecular biology abstracts

5_2513.concept: 科研文本中的术语与题名
5_2513.description: 激活见于多领域科研题名和摘要：医学疾病、治疗与疫苗，环境和材料研究，散射过程，植物病原体及miRNA，也包括一段本体论书目。部分题名以«[»起始；未见统一主题。

patterns.name: 摘要标题起始标记
patterns.context: 出现在方括号式题名开头，后接医学或研究主题；其后的词语内容多样。

patterns.name: 医学疾病与治疗题名
patterns.context: 题名涉及治疗、疾病、患者或医疗干预，常出现医学术语；覆盖不同病种，未见共同的具体疾病主题。

patterns.name: 生物医学研究术语
patterns.context: 研究描述涉及病原体、疫苗、自由基或分子生物学对象；有些出现在题名，有些出现在摘要正文。

patterns.name: 科学研究题名中的材料与过程
patterns.context: 关注土壤、材料发光或分子散射等对象及其性质、过程；属于不同科学子领域。
patterns.domain: 环境科学、材料科学与物理化学

patterns.name: 形式本体论书目信息
patterns.context: 出现在书名、编者、出版社和哲学机构等书目文字中，包含本体论相关术语。

patterns.name: 植物病害与小分子 RNA
patterns.context: 描述植物健康或患病状态、植原体处理及保守或新型 miRNA 的鉴定。
patterns.domain: 植物病理学与分子生物学摘要

en.concept: Practice-related words and organic matter phrases
en.description: Activations concentrate on the phrases organic matter/carbon/liquids and on practicing describing scientific, athletic, or medical practice. There are also isolated triggers in academic research, medical professional contexts, and title separators.

patterns.name: organic matter phrases
patterns.context: organic is followed by a matter- or carbon-related noun, concerning organic matter in soil, water, or liquids
patterns.domain: Soil and environmental science, physical chemistry

patterns.name: Inflected form of practicing
patterns.context: practicing describes the professional, scientific, or athletic activities of physicians, academic science, science, or sport activity
patterns.domain: Medical, research, sports, and public health texts

patterns.name: Academic research and practice expressions
patterns.context: Discusses changes and responsibilities in research practice, science education, or academic work; practicing need not appear
patterns.domain: Research policy, science education, and academic commentary

patterns.name: Clinical and health professional contexts
patterns.context: Describes the practice, consultation, or educational work of doctors or healthcare providers; several passages also contain practicing
patterns.domain: Medicine, clinical care, and public health

patterns.name: academic as a homograph outside organic matter
patterns.context: academic modifies a medical institution or doctor, rather than research practice

patterns.name: Symbol in video titles
patterns.context: Appears as a title separator in an interview title; no clear semantic connection is evident

5_2513.concept: 实践相关词与有机物短语
5_2513.description: 激活集中于 organic matter/carbon/liquids 短语，以及 practicing 描述科研、体育或医疗实践；另有若干学术科研、医疗专业人士语境和标题分隔符的孤立触发。

patterns.name: organic matter 短语
patterns.context: organic 后接物质或碳相关名词，涉及土壤、水体或液体中的有机物
patterns.domain: 土壤与环境科学、物理化学

patterns.name: practicing 的分词形式
patterns.context: practicing 描述专业人士、科学家或运动参与者的实践活动，后接 physicians、academic science、science、sport activity 等
patterns.domain: 医学、科研、体育及公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 学术研究与实践表达
patterns.context: 讨论研究实践、科研教育或学术工作的变化与责任；不要求出现 practicing
patterns.domain: 科研政策、科学教育与学术评论

patterns.name: 临床与健康专业人士语境
patterns.context: 描述医生或医疗服务提供者的实践、咨询或教育工作；其中多段也有 practicing

patterns.name: 有机物之外的 academic 同形词
patterns.context: academic 修饰医疗机构或医生，而非科研实践

patterns.name: 视频标题中的符号
patterns.context: 出现在采访标题中，作为标题分隔符；没有明显的语义联系

en.description: Activations are distributed across scientific text and medical promotion, especially medical/biological terminology. Other local words, including organic, Because, and many, also trigger repeatedly, but the passages do not share a single unified meaning or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Organic matter and biomedical contexts
patterns.context: The word appears in a research title or body, concerning soil active organic matter, psychiatric disorder classification, or volatile organic compounds.
patterns.domain: Agricultural and biomedical abstracts, climate science

patterns.name: Causal statements introduced by Because
patterns.context: Appears after a statement of fact to introduce a reason or inference; both passages are medical abstracts.

patterns.name: many followed by quantities or categories
patterns.context: many is followed by receptors or plural categories such as medical and health professions.

patterns.name: Disease and medical topic vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical research titles or abstracts contain a high density of terms for organs, diseases, treatments, or physiological processes.

patterns.name: Fixed opening of project summaries
patterns.context: NIH project summaries begin with Project Summary, followed by an explanatory sentence.

patterns.name: Local phrases in truncated fragments
patterns.context: The context is truncated, and only local scientific expressions are discernible, making more specific trigger conditions difficult to determine.

patterns.name: 3D and medical learning software promotion
patterns.context: Introduces interactive anatomy software, course resources, and intended users.

patterns.name: Noun phrases in paper titles
patterns.context: Scientific titles consisting of noun phrases and containing terms related to soil, plants, and organic matter.

patterns.name: Gene delivery kinetics and effects
patterns.context: Discusses promoters, adenoviral vector delivery, and the effects of expression kinetics on efficacy and toxicity.

patterns.name: Greenhouse gas and pollutant reactions
patterns.context: Describes the indirect effects of CO on greenhouse gas lifetimes, oxidation, and ozone formation.

patterns.name: Clinical research institutions and psychiatric disorder classification
patterns.context: Introduces the organizational structure of a research center and lists major categories of psychiatric disorders.

patterns.name: Immune transcription factors and receptors
patterns.context: Describes how transcription factor families regulate immunity, inflammatory responses, and receptor activation.

5_2513.description: 激活分布于科研文本和医学宣传中，尤其涉及医学/生物学术语；另有 organic、Because、many 等局部词语重复触发，但各段缺乏单一统一词义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 有机物质及其生物医学语境
patterns.context: 该词出现在科研标题或正文中；涉及土壤活性有机质、精神疾病分类，或挥发性有机化合物。
patterns.domain: 农业与生物医学摘要、气候科学

patterns.name: Because 引导的因果论述
patterns.context: 出现在陈述事实后，用于引出原因或推论；两段均为医学摘要。

patterns.name: many 后接数量或类别
patterns.context: many 后接 receptors 或 medical and health professions 等复数类别。
patterns.domain: 免疫学摘要、医学教育宣传

patterns.name: 疾病与医学主题词汇
patterns.trigger: “Cholinergic modulation of sensory representations in the olfactory bulb”及“sick cell disease”“gallstones”等
patterns.context: 医学研究标题或摘要中密集出现器官、疾病、治疗或生理过程术语。

patterns.name: 项目摘要的固定开头
patterns.trigger: “Project Summary Because of their elevated frequency”
patterns.context: NIH 项目摘要以 Project Summary 开头，随后进入说明性句子。

patterns.name: 残缺片段中的局部词组
patterns.trigger: “their elevated frequency ability to self”及“Variations in the rates of neuropeptide synthesis and release are to be”
patterns.context: 上下文截断，只有局部科学表达可辨，难以确定更具体的触发条件。

patterns.name: 3D 与医学学习软件宣传
patterns.context: 介绍互动式解剖软件、课程资源及其适用人群。

patterns.name: 论文标题式名词短语
patterns.trigger: “Dynamics of soil active organic matter in Chinese fir plantations”
patterns.context: 以名词短语构成的科研标题，含土壤、植物与有机质术语。

patterns.name: 基因递送动力学与效果
patterns.context: 讨论启动子、腺病毒载体递送，以及表达动力学对疗效和毒性的影响。

patterns.name: 温室气体与污染物反应
patterns.context: 描述 CO 对温室气体寿命、氧化及臭氧形成的间接影响。

patterns.name: 临床研究机构与精神疾病分类
patterns.trigger: “Mental Health Clinical Research Center”及“organic mental syndrome”
patterns.context: 介绍研究中心的组织结构，并列出主要精神疾病类别。

patterns.name: 免疫转录因子与受体
patterns.context: 描述转录因子家族调控免疫、炎症反应及受体激活。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on you, both, and a few seemingly unrelated words. you occurs across conversational, legal, and narrative text; both often appears in coordination or comparison structures. The remaining isolated trigger words have no readily identifiable shared condition.

patterns.name: Second-person you
patterns.context: you appears in sentences as a subject or object; it is inactive in other passages, so not every occurrence triggers
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narrative, dialogue, and explanatory prose

patterns.name: Structures following both
patterns.context: both is followed by coordinated items, as in “both nocturnal and diurnal mammals” and “in both cases”

patterns.name: Other sporadic words
patterns.context: The words occur in different local syntactic contexts; there is insufficient evidence to identify a shared trigger condition

5_2513.description: 激活主要落在 you、both 及少数互不明显相关的词上。you 跨对话、法律和叙述文本出现；both 多见于并列或比较结构。其余孤立触发词难以归纳共同条件。

patterns.name: 第二人称 you
patterns.context: you 出现在句子中，充当主语或宾语；不同段落中也有非激活的 you，因而不是所有出现都会触发
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、对话及说明文

patterns.name: both 后的结构
patterns.context: both 后接并列项，如“both nocturnal and diurnal mammals”和“in both cases”

patterns.name: 其他零散词项
patterns.context: 各词出现在不同局部句法环境中；没有足够证据确定共同的触发条件
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、论坛文章、邮件

en.concept: Local English phrases and formatting patterns
en.description: The most stable pattern is the fixed English phrase “all sorts of,” which occurs across academic disciplines, literature, online discussions, and legal corpora. Other isolated patterns include code punctuation formatting, literary rhetoric about submission and freedom, dating safety, and courtroom date questions; the remaining activations in several passages have no clear explanation.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “all sorts of”
patterns.context: When the full phrase appears, activations concentrate on sorts; nearby all and of may also have weaker activations. It is followed by different nouns.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, discussions, legal texts

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting markers
patterns.context: Activations appear near punctuation, whitespace-control fields, and newline sequences in code or annotated text.

patterns.name: Semantics of submission, enslavement, and freedom
patterns.context: Didactic or rhetorical descriptions of submission, enslavement, freedom, and their opposites.

patterns.name: Safety and dating
patterns.context: Discusses feeling safe while dating, as well as discriminatory culture and protective measures.

patterns.name: “July 8” date and oral question-answer format
patterns.context: Testimony repeatedly asks about a specific date, including colloquial questions and date corrections.

patterns.name: No clear corresponding pattern
patterns.context: A mathematical physics explanation includes “perp,” “coordinates,” “definitions,” and “collects … excitations”; the available activation annotations are insufficient to assign it to the patterns above.

patterns.name: No clear corresponding pattern
patterns.context: Narrates a journey, hospitality, and purchases along the way; although “all sorts of” appears, it is assigned to the fixed phrase pattern.

patterns.name: No clear corresponding pattern
patterns.context: Apart from “all sorts of,” discusses a political two-party system and social tensions; no additional clear trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: No clear corresponding pattern
patterns.context: Legal text discusses transferring cases and appeals from nonfinal orders; no clear shared trigger pattern is apparent.

5_2513.concept: 英文局部词组与格式模式
5_2513.description: 最稳定模式是英文固定搭配“all sorts of”，跨学科、文学、网络讨论和法律语料出现。另有代码标点格式、屈从与自由的文学修辞、约会安全、庭审日期问答等孤立模式；若干段的其余激活无明确解释。

patterns.name: “all sorts of”固定搭配
patterns.context: 短语完整出现时，激活集中在 sorts，邻近的 all、of 也可能有较弱激活；后接不同名词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文、讨论、法律文本

patterns.name: 标点与格式化标记
patterns.context: 代码或标注文本中的标点、空格控制字段及换行等序列附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 屈从、奴役与自由的语义
patterns.context: 以训诫或修辞方式描写屈从、被奴役、自由及其反面。

patterns.name: 安全与约会
patterns.context: 讨论约会时是否感到安全，以及歧视性文化和保护机制。

patterns.name: “July 8”日期及口述问答格式
patterns.context: 证词中反复询问具体日期，包含口语化问答和日期纠正。

patterns.name: 未见明确对应模式
patterns.trigger: 未发现与其他段共享的明确触发子串
patterns.context: 数学物理说明中出现“perp”“coordinates”“definitions”“collects … excitations”等；现有激活标注不足以归入上述模式。

patterns.name: 未见明确对应模式
patterns.trigger: 未发现与其他段共享的明确触发子串
patterns.context: 叙述旅程、款待及沿途购买物品；虽有“all sorts of”，已归入固定搭配模式。

patterns.name: 未见明确对应模式
patterns.trigger: 未发现与其他段共享的明确触发子串
patterns.context: 除“all sorts of”外，讨论政治两党制及社会紧张；未见额外清晰触发模式。

patterns.name: 未见明确对应模式
patterns.trigger: 未发现与其他段共享的明确触发子串
patterns.context: 法律文本讨论移送案件及对非终局命令的上诉；未见明确共享触发模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to throughout followed by a time, geographic, or activity scope; it also responds to the legal expression in … behalf and to any modifying an entity. There are weaker activations in statements describing interests in multiple entities and their litigation histories.

patterns.name: throughout + scope/period
patterns.context: throughout is followed by a time period, geographic area, or activity scope; the pattern is not limited to legal contexts.
patterns.domain: Legal, encyclopedia, sports reporting, medical news

patterns.name: Making a statement or acting on someone’s behalf
patterns.context: In legal contexts, indicates acting, advocating, or presenting evidence for oneself or another; often uses the “in … behalf” structure.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, explanations of trial rights

patterns.name: any + scope or entity
patterns.context: any modifies a following noun and appears in negative, conditional, or general legal discussion.

patterns.name: Number of entities and their case histories
patterns.context: Describes a party’s interests in multiple entities and notes that some of them previously filed for bankruptcy.

5_2513.description: 主要响应 throughout 后接时间、地域或活动范围；也响应法律表达 in … behalf，以及 any 限定对象。另对描述持有多个实体权益及其诉讼经历的语句有较弱激活。

patterns.name: throughout＋范围/时段
patterns.trigger: «throughout»（如“throughout the five years”“throughout the proceedings”“throughout New Zealand”“throughout the season”“throughout Asia”）
patterns.context: “throughout”后接时间段、地域或活动范围；不局限于法律语境。
patterns.domain: 法律、百科、体育报道、医学新闻

patterns.name: 代表某人陈述或行事
patterns.trigger: “in your own behalf”“in his brother's behalf”“in his behalf”，以及“present evidence in your own behalf”
patterns.context: 法律语境中，表示为自己或他人利益行事、辩护或举证；常见“in … behalf”结构。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、庭审权利说明

patterns.name: any＋范围或对象
patterns.context: “any”限定后续名词，出现在否定、条件或概括性法律论述中。

patterns.name: 实体数量及其案件经历
patterns.trigger: “held interests in a number of entities”及“some of which have filed cases”
patterns.context: 描述当事人持有多个实体的权益，并交代其中一些实体曾申请破产。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in legal texts concerning litigants, obligations, and procedure, and often fall on expressions of importance/significance and low quantity/limited impact.
