patterns.context: 术语、名称或缩写后接括号中的解释、翻译或命名依据；也包括文中以引号标出的别称、定义。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学论文、科学论文

patterns.name: 引语及外语片段
patterns.trigger: "heller wunderbar gleichmäßig geführter Bass herrlich timbriert"；"Blood Oath"；"Little square of deception"
patterns.context: 叙述性文本中出现引号括起的外语、作品名或短语，往往随后继续解释或补充。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、艺术史及影视条目

patterns.name: 专利标题与正式文献引文
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中，以编号和作者引出带引号的专利标题或文献名称。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串与赋值表达式
patterns.context: 示例代码中出现引号包裹的字符串、变量赋值及函数调用；代码片段前有说明性文字。

patterns.name: 专名或缩写旁的标点及括号结构
patterns.context: 专名、缩写、实验条件或编号处夹有括号、引号、逗号等，可能包含信息密集的名词短语。

en.description: Activation concentrates on short newline-separated entries and title–body structures, and also appears in encyclopedia definitions, location templates, lists, advertisements, papers, and forum questions; the common feature is an entry boundary or opening in formatted text.

patterns.name: Repeated titles and entry openings
patterns.context: The first line is a title/name, followed by a blank line or newline, after which the same name appears again and the body begins

patterns.name: List entries and entry separators
patterns.context: Multiple items in a list or directory are arranged line by line, or a newline separates an entry from the body text

patterns.name: Encyclopedia location-entry template
patterns.context: A place name heading is followed by a brief introduction to its administrative division and geographic location

patterns.name: Encyclopedia categories and definitional phrasing
patterns.context: Introduces a language or dialect, followed by information about classification or affiliation

patterns.name: Definitions of chess terms
patterns.context: A definitional sentence explaining a chess tactic or rule

patterns.name: Accommodation advertisement format and prices
patterns.context: Rental prices are listed by night/week, followed by a description of vacation accommodation

patterns.name: Research gaps in scientific papers
patterns.context: An opening statement in a paper or report identifies an unresolved question

patterns.name: Medical and health articles and statements of evidence
patterns.context: Introduces a health issue, then discusses salt intake, cardiovascular risk, and research evidence

patterns.name: Forum discussion and subjective questions
patterns.context: Online discussion expresses personal observations through colloquial rhetorical questions or direct questions

5_2733.concept: 结构化文本的条目边界
5_2733.description: 激活集中在换行分隔的短条目及标题—正文结构，也见百科定义、地点模板、列表、广告、论文和论坛问句；共同点是格式化文本中的条目边界或开头。

patterns.name: 重复标题与条目开头
patterns.trigger: 标题或名称先以分词形式出现，换行后再次出现，如 «Tur»«ton»、«T»«az»«g»«ait»、«O»«uled» «R»«iy»«ah»、«M»«p»«ak»«with»«i»
patterns.context: 首行是标题/名称，后有空行或换行，随后再次出现同一名称并开始正文

patterns.name: 列表条目与条目分隔
patterns.trigger: 连续的条目名称及 «↵»，如疾病名称后反复出现 «syndrome»«↵»，以及 «Sleeps - Bedrooms - Bathrooms»
patterns.context: 列表或目录中多项内容按行排列，或条目与正文间有换行分隔
patterns.domain: 百科列表、商品/住宿信息

patterns.name: 百科地点条目模板
patterns.context: 地名标题后接行政区划与地理位置的简短介绍

patterns.name: 百科分类与定义句式
patterns.trigger: «is an extinct Australian Aboriginal dialect»、«Classification»、«is generally regarded as»
patterns.context: 介绍语言或方言，并接分类、归属等说明

patterns.name: 棋类术语释义
patterns.trigger: «Turton doubling»、«in chess»、«a piece moves along a line»
patterns.context: 解释棋类战术或规则的定义句

patterns.name: 住宿广告格式与价格
patterns.context: 按晚/周列出租价格，随后描述度假住宿

patterns.name: 科学论文中的研究缺口
patterns.trigger: «There is a fundamental gap in our understanding»
patterns.context: 论文或报告开篇陈述尚未解决的知识问题

patterns.name: 医学健康文章及证据陈述
patterns.trigger: «Should we eat less salt?»、«High blood pressure»、«overwhelming evidence»
patterns.context: 以健康问题引入，讨论盐摄入与心血管风险及研究证据

patterns.name: 论坛讨论及主观提问
patterns.trigger: «Is it just me or»、«Does timing play»、«Have you watched TV lately?»
patterns.context: 网络讨论中以口语化反问或直接提问表达个人观察

en.description: Primarily responds to moral and expressions related to moral values, knowledge, responsibility, and so on, covering [1–5] and [8–10]; it also activates on repeatedly paired and phrases in [6] and his character expressions in [1][7], the latter two having no clear connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Moral-related vocabulary
patterns.context: The word moral itself appears, or a compound beginning with moral, such as «moral commitment», «moral knowledge», «moral responsibility», «moral compass»; the word may be split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Ethics, political commentary, and general discussion

patterns.name: Paired coordinated and phrases
patterns.context: Adjacent or consecutive lists of fixed two-word phrases; not limited to moral contexts.

patterns.name: His possessives and character narration
patterns.context: A character or the pronoun his appears in narration or a phrase; this pattern has no clear connection to moral vocabulary.

5_2733.description: 主要响应 moral 及道德价值、知识、责任等相关表达，覆盖[1–5]、[8–10]；另在[6]反复成对的 and 短语、[1][7]的 his 人物表达中激活，后两者与主模式未见明确联系。

patterns.name: moral 相关词汇
patterns.context: 出现 moral 本身，或以 moral 开头的复合词，如 «moral commitment»、«moral knowledge»、«moral responsibility»、«moral compass»；词内部可能被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 伦理学、政治评论及一般论述

patterns.name: 成对并列的 and 短语
patterns.trigger: «and» 连接两项的反复列表，如 «hand and foot»、«Heaven and Hell»、«him and her»、«hills and valleys»
patterns.context: 相邻或连续列举形式固定的二项词组；并非只限于道德语境。
patterns.domain: 百科词条中的短语清单

patterns.name: his 所有格及人物叙述
patterns.context: 人物或代词 his 出现在叙述或短语中；此模式与 moral 词汇无明显共同点。

en.description: Activation is dispersed across medical, biological, and dietary texts: right/left contrasts, Failure phrasing, and local patterns involving image classification, antibody terminology, immune experiments, radiological descriptions, food cutting, and parasite-related diets.

patterns.name: Right-side or rightward directional terms
patterns.context: right appears in paired anatomical positions with left or in left-right movement parameters; nearby words often refer to body parts, limbs, or magnitude.
patterns.domain: Medical imaging cases, motor control research

patterns.name: Failure, absence, or inability to maintain
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or noun phrase, describes failure to understand a pathological mechanism, abnormal anatomical fusion, or inability to maintain normal physiological function.

patterns.name: Classification results and label colors
patterns.context: Tissue or images are divided into components, followed by color-based labels for each class.

patterns.name: CDR and variable-region terminology
patterns.context: In antibody sequences or patent claims, immunological abbreviations such as variable light and CDR occur nearby.

patterns.name: Immune signaling and experimental model terminology
patterns.context: A study plan on immune mechanisms describes signal dependence, cell models, and experimental resources; strong activation appears on available.

patterns.name: Clearly delineated structures in radiological imaging
patterns.context: Describes clearly defined, radiolucent bone regions in X-ray images.

patterns.name: Food cutting and child feeding safety
patterns.context: A food list describes how fruits or vegetables are cut and cooked, and how to prevent choking; raw modifies vegetables.
patterns.domain: Dietary guidance for families or children

patterns.name: Parasite exposure and raw-meat diets
patterns.context: Discusses how parasite exposure rates vary by region and population, and relates this to eating raw or lightly cooked meat.

5_2733.description: 激活分散于医学、生物学及饮食文本：右侧/左右对照、Failure句式，以及影像分类、抗体术语、免疫实验、放射描述、食物切分和寄生虫饮食等局部模式。

patterns.name: 右侧或右向的方位词
patterns.context: right 出现在与 left 成对的解剖位置或左右运动参数中；附近常有表示身体部位、肢体或幅度的词。
patterns.domain: 医学影像病例、运动控制研究

patterns.name: 失败、缺失或未能维持
patterns.context: 句首或名词短语开头，描述未能理解病理机制、解剖融合异常，或无法维持正常生理状态。

patterns.name: 分类结果及标签颜色
patterns.context: 组织或图像被划分为若干成分，随后用颜色为各类标注。

patterns.name: CDR 与可变区术语
patterns.context: 抗体序列或专利权利描述中，variable light 与 CDR 等免疫学缩写相邻。

patterns.name: 免疫信号与实验模型术语
patterns.context: 免疫机制研究计划中，描述信号依赖性、细胞模型与实验资源；可见较强激活落在 available。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 放射影像中的清晰界定
patterns.context: 描述 X 光影像中骨骼区域的边界清晰、透亮表现。

patterns.name: 食物切分与儿童进食安全
patterns.context: 食物清单描述水果或蔬菜如何切分、烹调，以及避免噎食；raw 修饰蔬菜。
patterns.domain: 面向家庭或儿童的饮食说明

patterns.name: 寄生虫暴露及生肉饮食
patterns.context: 讨论寄生虫接触率随地区和族群变化，并联系食用生肉或轻度烹熟肉类。
patterns.domain: 流行病学或医学背景介绍

en.concept: Word forms and positional uses of right
en.description: Activation is most concentrated on right: it is used both for sentence-final confirmation and to indicate direction or the right side of a chart; other sporadic activations occur on the medical field date, the medical term functional, blank table tabs, and the continuation prompt more.

patterns.name: Emphatic or right-side meaning of right
patterns.context: right appears in sentence-final questions as a confirmation tag (segments 1, 2, 3, 5); indicates a right turn in a list of directions (segment 6); or contrasts with left to indicate the right side of a chart (segment 7).
patterns.domain: Forum conversation, narrative, directions, scientific chart text

patterns.name: Date field in identity information
patterns.context: Appears in a list of patient identification fields, followed by of birth.

patterns.name: Term related to functional impairment
patterns.context: Appears in a parallel list of health-status domains, modifying impairment.

patterns.name: Blank spaces and tabs in numerical tables
patterns.context: Activation falls on tabs or blank columns in an aligned table consisting of numbers, currency, and codes.

patterns.name: Continuation prompt more
patterns.context: Appears in the parenthetical prompt “(more)”, indicating that additional content follows.

5_2733.description: 激活最集中于 right：既用于句末确认，也表示方向或图表右侧；其余零散落在医疗字段 date、医学术语 functional、表格空白制表符及续读提示 more 上。

patterns.name: 短语 right 的强调或右侧含义
patterns.context: right 出现在句末问句中，作为确认语气（段 1、2、3、5）；或在方向列举中表示右转（段 6）；或与 left 对照表示图表中的右侧（段 7）。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、叙述、路线说明、科学图表文字

patterns.name: 身份信息字段中的 date
patterns.context: 出现在患者身份识别信息的字段列表中，后接 of birth。

patterns.name: 功能障碍相关词
patterns.context: 出现在健康状态领域的并列列表中，修饰 impairment。

patterns.name: 数字表格中的空白与制表符
patterns.context: 数值、货币和代码构成的对齐表格中，激活落在制表符或空白列上。
patterns.domain: 能源市场数据表、电子邮件

patterns.name: more 的续读提示
patterns.context: 出现在“(more)”这一括号内提示中，表示还有后续内容。

en.description: Activation is dispersed across time expressions, multiple uses of right, numbers, lists, degree descriptions, and legal and medical terminology; several isolated local collocations also appear, with no single stable semantics that can be inferred.

patterns.name: time / temporal expressions
patterns.context: Activates in phrases describing duration, time spans, dates, or when something happens; the degree of nearby time-related terms varies by context.
patterns.domain: Medical research, parenting narratives, habit logs, service descriptions, legal documents

patterns.name: Semantic uses of right
patterns.context: Appears in moral judgments, correctness, or title/format descriptions; right-side direction is not an obvious shared condition.

patterns.name: Numbers or number sequences
patterns.context: Activates near numbers and their intervals, numbering, or quantitative information; number formats and contexts vary.
patterns.domain: StackExchange number puzzles, medical sample descriptions

patterns.name: Lists and coordination
patterns.context: Multiple nouns or actions are listed in sequence, often linked by commas, and, or similar connectors.
patterns.domain: Service promotions, personal logs, literary narratives

patterns.name: Degree, comparison, and appearance descriptions
patterns.context: Modifiers express comparison, degree, or appearance judgments; trigger positions are dispersed, with no consistent fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, beauty reviews, parenting narratives

patterns.name: Capacity and judgment in legal contexts
patterns.context: States the defendant's mental capacity, the nature of their actions, and their ability to distinguish right from wrong.

patterns.name: Medical tissue and physiological function
patterns.context: Describes choroidal tissue and its blood-flow function; activation occurs near medical terminology and tissue descriptions.

patterns.name: Local collocations not classifiable under the patterns above
patterns.context: Located respectively in a product list, a parenthetical image-position prompt, and a mention of a body part; there is insufficient evidence to infer a shared condition.
patterns.domain: Service promotions, beauty reviews, parenting narratives

5_2733.description: 激活分散于时间表达、right 的多义用法、数字、列举、程度描述及法律和医学术语；另有若干孤立局部搭配，无法归纳为单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: time / temporal expressions
patterns.context: 在描述持续时间、时间范围、日期或某事发生时的短语中激活；时间词附近的程度因语境而异。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、育儿叙述、习惯记录、服务说明、法律文书

patterns.name: right 的语义用法
patterns.context: 出现在道德判断、正确性或标题/格式说明中；右侧方向并非明显共同条件。
patterns.domain: 叙事、法律文书、音乐评论

patterns.name: 数字或数字序列
patterns.context: 数字及其间隔、编号或量化信息附近激活；数字形式和语境并不一致。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数字谜题、医学样本描述

patterns.name: 列举与并列
patterns.trigger: «fresh»6 fruits«,»3 juices«,»2 tea«,»2 coffee»；«other»1« habits»2；«you»3 dragged… and watched
patterns.context: 多个名词或动作连续列举，常由逗号、and 等连接。
patterns.domain: 服务宣传、个人记录、文学叙事

patterns.name: 程度、比较与外观描述
patterns.context: 修饰语表达比较、程度或外观评价；触发位置分散，未见统一固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、美妆评论、育儿叙述

patterns.name: 法律语境中的能力与判断
patterns.context: 陈述被告的精神能力、行为性质及辨别是非的能力。

patterns.name: 医学组织与生理功能
patterns.context: 介绍脉络膜组织及其血流功能，激活落在医学术语和组织描述附近。

patterns.name: 未能归入上述模式的局部搭配
patterns.context: 分别位于商品清单、括号中的图片位置提示、以及对某身体部位的提及；没有足够证据归纳共同条件。
patterns.domain: 服务宣传、美妆评论、育儿叙述

en.description: Activation is dispersed across table numbers and formatting symbols, code separators, IRC phrases, tumor fields, service descriptions, and parenting narratives; there is no single stable lexical trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers, separators, and alignment whitespace in tables/data fields
patterns.context: Numbers and units, percentages, or other values appear in columns, often with spaces, newlines, or punctuation; no particular domain is required

patterns.name: Repeated code comments and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Symbols appear as comments, separators, or alignment formatting in code or table-like text

patterns.name: Short words and chat markers in IRC conversations
patterns.context: Chat dialogue contains short colloquial words, questions, or actions/markers enclosed in asterisks; specific triggers vary

patterns.name: Tumor fields in cancer clinical tables
patterns.context: In clinical research tables, a field name is followed by grading or classification data

patterns.name: Parentheses and time/cost information in travel-service copy
patterns.context: Promotional or service descriptions include parenthetical information about conditions such as time and cost

patterns.name: Climbing stairs and safety equipment in parenting narratives
patterns.context: A family narrative mentions a young child's activities and installing safety gates

5_2733.description: 激活分散于表格数字与格式符号、代码分隔、IRC 短语，以及肿瘤字段、服务说明和育儿叙述；没有单一稳定的词义触发模式。

patterns.name: 表格/数据字段中的数字、分隔符与对齐空白
patterns.context: 数字与单位、百分比或其他数值成列出现，常伴随空格、换行或标点；不要求特定领域

patterns.name: 重复的代码注释与格式符号
patterns.context: 代码或类表格文本中，符号作为注释、分隔线或对齐格式出现

patterns.name: IRC 对话中的短词与聊天标记
patterns.context: 聊天对话中出现短小口语词、问句或星号括起的动作/标记；具体触发项并不一致

patterns.name: 癌症临床表格的肿瘤字段
patterns.context: 临床研究表格中，字段名后接分级或分类数据

patterns.name: 行程服务文案中的括号与时间费用信息
patterns.context: 宣传或服务说明中，括号内补充时间、费用等条件

patterns.name: 育儿叙述中的爬楼与安全用品
patterns.context: 家庭叙事提到幼儿活动及安装防护门

en.description: Activations are scattered across time words and their compound expressions, punctuation, subword fragments, heading formats, and capitalized words. The examples span multiple registers, and no single semantic pattern explains them all.

patterns.name: Time / duration expressions
patterns.context: Time units or time-related words appear in expressions about schedules, events, backups, and similar topics; “time” can appear alone or form “time machine”.
patterns.domain: Everyday narration, event planning, poetry, or commentary

patterns.name: Punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation such as commas, question marks, asterisks, or exclamation marks is directly marked; the trigger may be the punctuation itself rather than its meaning.
patterns.domain: Dialogue, web text, and general prose

patterns.name: Specific word forms or endings
patterns.context: Activations fall on whole words or substrings within words, including common endings and spelling fragments; several fragments cannot be explained by a shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Fiction, chat, poetry, and web text

patterns.name: Section headings and separators
patterns.context: Academic documents use section headings and heading formats made of lines of equal signs.

patterns.name: Capitalized emphasis or names
patterns.context: Capitalized words appear in media names or emphatic questions in parentheses.

patterns.name: Other sporadic content words
patterns.context: Marked spans occur in technical abbreviations or time-zone abbreviations; they may also be incidental responses to local portions of text.

5_2733.description: 激活分散在时间词及其复合表达、标点、词内片段、标题格式和大写词上；这些例子跨越多种语体，尚无单一语义模式能解释全部。

patterns.name: time / 时长表达
patterns.context: 时间单位或时间相关词出现在日程、事件、备份等表达中；「time」可单独出现，也可组成「time machine」
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、活动安排、诗歌或评论

patterns.name: 标点符号
patterns.context: 逗号、问号、星号或感叹号等标点被直接标记；触发可能与标点本身有关，而非语义
patterns.domain: 对话、网页文本及一般散文

patterns.name: 特定词形或词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或词内子串上，包含常见词尾及拼写片段；其中若干片段无法由共同词义解释
patterns.domain: 小说、聊天、诗歌及网页文本

patterns.name: 章节标题与分隔符
patterns.context: 学术文档以章节标题和等号线构成的标题格式

patterns.name: 大写强调或名称
patterns.context: 大写词出现在媒体名称或括号中的强调问句里

patterns.name: 其他零散内容词
patterns.context: 标记落在专业缩写或时区缩写中；也可能只是对文本局部的偶然响应

en.description: Activations are distributed across English prose, including possessives, determiners, and common function words, as well as subword fragments, formatting characters, and Greek fragments. No stable semantic pattern or single contextual condition is evident across corpora.

patterns.name: English possessive or determiner followed by a space
patterns.context: A space, punctuation mark, or unmarked text immediately follows the highlighted word. This occurs in different grammatical structures, so a specific syntactic condition cannot be identified.
patterns.domain: English prose such as forums, news commentary, religious discussion, and emails

patterns.name: Participle or contiguous subword boundaries within words
patterns.context: Activations focus on subword fragments in segmented words or specially formatted strings; the specific characters and word meanings differ across examples.
patterns.domain: Web text, Shakespearean verse, chat, and typesetting data

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or medial function words and punctuation
patterns.context: Common function words and punctuation appear in ordinary English sentences or dialogue, but adjacent contexts vary and no stable collocation is evident.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Greek words
patterns.context: In continuous Greek text, activations fall on segmented subword fragments, with no indication of semantics matching the English fragments.

5_2733.description: 激活分布于英文散文中的所有格、限定词和常见小词，也落在词内子词、格式字符及希腊语片段上；跨语料未见稳定语义或单一上下文条件。

patterns.name: 英文所有格或限定词后接空白
patterns.context: 高亮词之后紧跟空格、标点或未标记内容；在不同语法结构中都出现，不能确定具体句法条件
patterns.domain: 论坛、新闻评论、宗教讨论及邮件等英文散文

patterns.name: 分词或词内连续子词边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在被切分的词或特殊格式串的子词片段上；不同例子中的具体字符与词义并不一致
patterns.domain: 网页文本、莎士比亚诗句、聊天及排版数据

patterns.name: 句首或句中小词及标点
patterns.context: 普通英语句子或对话中出现常见功能词、标点，但相邻语境各异，未见稳定搭配
patterns.domain: 诗歌、IRC 对话、论坛文本

patterns.name: 希腊语词内片段
patterns.context: 希腊语连续文字中，激活落在被拆分的词片段上，未显示与英文片段相同的语义

en.description: Activations are scattered across in vivo/in vitro research expressions, medical terminology, function words and asterisked action markers in chat and fiction, narrative time words, and tab and space labels in code. There is no single stable triggering feature.

patterns.name: in vivo/in vitro phrases
patterns.context: Appears in research, experimental, or clinical descriptions, often contrasting in vivo and in vitro; activations focus on vivo and also cover vitro.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or medial function words
patterns.context: In spoken dialogue or narrative dialogue, activations fall on ordinary grammatical or discourse words; their positions and meanings vary.

patterns.name: Asterisk-enclosed symbols
patterns.context: In IRC dialogue, asterisks mark actions or nonverbal expressions; activations fall on the asterisks and adjacent content.

patterns.name: Components of academic terms
patterns.context: In medical or biological contexts, activations are scattered across technical nouns and modifiers, with no unified part of speech or root.

patterns.name: Words marking the passage of time
patterns.context: In narration, words describe an instantaneous reaction or buying time; their meanings do not clearly match the patterns in other passages.

patterns.name: Space labels
patterns.context: In code or annotation data, activations fall on tabs and labels related to spaces.

5_2733.description: 激活分散于体内/体外科研表达、医学术语、聊天与小说中的功能词和星号动作标记、叙事时间词，以及代码里的制表符和空格标签；没有单一稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: in vivo/in vitro 短语
patterns.context: 出现在研究、实验或临床描述中，常并列对比体内与体外；激活集中在 vivo，也覆盖 vitro。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、科研项目摘要

patterns.name: 句首或句中功能词
patterns.context: 口语对话、叙事对白中，激活落在普通语法词或语气词，具体位置和语义不一致。

patterns.name: 星号包围的符号
patterns.context: IRC 对话中，星号标记动作或非言语表达，激活在星号及其相邻内容。

patterns.name: 学术词语的成分
patterns.context: 医学或生物学语境，激活散布在专业名词及修饰语上，未见统一的单一词类或词根。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、项目摘要

patterns.name: 时间推进词
patterns.context: 叙事中描述瞬间反应或争取时间，激活词义与其他段落模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 空格标注
patterns.context: 代码或标注数据中，激活的是制表符及空格相关标签。
patterns.domain: GitHub 格式或语法标注数据

en.description: Activations are scattered across genres and word classes. Salient examples include sentence- or clause-initial Here, sentence-initial late, medial time/Enough/Him, and yours, *, and short word fragments in chat or at text endings. No stable semantic pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Here at line or clause boundaries
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or a new clause after a comma; in [4] followed by lies, in [5] by and in its immediate vicinity, and in [8] by 's another.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial time word late
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a sentence, followed by as about the beginning of our era.

patterns.name: Yourself / sign-off-style yours at sentence ends or across lines
patterns.context: Near the end of phrases or chat text, around markers or usernames; the triggering words vary.

patterns.name: Emphatic or summarizing words in main clauses
patterns.context: Occurs respectively in “it was time for…”, “Enough of woe…”, and “trust in Him”; meanings and syntactic positions differ.
patterns.domain: Political commentary, poetry, personal religious narrative

patterns.name: Participles / short word fragments in poetic lines or quotations
patterns.context: In poetic formatting or quotations, words are split into multiple tokens; strong activations fall on part of a word.

patterns.name: Conversational transitions and tone markers in IRC chat
patterns.context: Around questions, colloquial spellings, or emoticons in chat turns; strong activations also occur on “*” near line endings.

5_2733.description: 激活分散在多种文体与词类：显著例子包括句首/分句首的 Here、句首 late、句中 time/Enough/Him，以及聊天或结尾处的 yours、*、短词片段。未见能覆盖全部段落的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 行首或边界处的 Here
patterns.context: 在句首或逗号后的新分句开头；[4] 后接 lies，[5] 后接 and in its immediate vicinity，[8] 后接 's another。

patterns.name: 行首的时间词 late
patterns.context: 出现在句首，后接 as about the beginning of our era。

patterns.name: 句末或跨行的 yourself／署名式 yours
patterns.context: 短语或聊天文本末尾、标记或用户名附近；触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 主句中的强调或总结性词
patterns.context: 分别位于“it was time for…”，“Enough of woe…”，以及“trust in Him”中；词义与句法位置各异。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、诗歌、个人宗教叙述

patterns.name: 诗行或引文中的分词／短词片段
patterns.context: 诗歌排版或引文中，单词被分成多个 token；较强激活落在词的一部分。

patterns.name: IRC聊天中的对话衔接与语气标记
patterns.context: 聊天轮次中，问句、口语拼写或表情符号前后；主要激活也出现在行末附近的“*”。

en.description: Activations are scattered across words and phrases such as Here, yours, and now on, as well as IRC asterisks, fictional narration, and email phrasing. There is no unified trigger pattern spanning all passages.

patterns.name: Locative/deictic use of Here
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or clause, Here introduces a place, content, or what follows; it is sometimes preceded by a comma or line break.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “now on”
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence, From now on introduces a future action or manner of speaking.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “from here on out”
patterns.context: Means from this point onward when promising future action or continued provision of something.

patterns.name: Possession or attribution with yours
patterns.context: In a you/your context, indicates ownership or attribution; may refer to ownership of contract edits or handing a project over to someone.

patterns.name: Asterisks and abbreviations in IRC
patterns.context: Asterisk-enclosed action markers in chat logs, or an asterisk adjacent to the colloquial abbreviation am.

patterns.name: Negation and experiential endings after sermon
patterns.context: In fiction, discussion of having heard sermons and experience/ignorance; activations are distributed across a negation word and several word fragments.

patterns.name: Spirit/Man and sky imagery
patterns.context: A heading followed by text describing Manwe, the sky, and birds.

patterns.name: Plural and group narration
patterns.context: The narrator shifts from shared experience to speaking in the plural.

patterns.name: Yours and attribution of responsibility in email
patterns.context: Discusses draft edits, omitted markers, and attribution of responsibility.

patterns.name: Physical suffering and the soul
patterns.context: Juxtaposes bodily torment and the soul's suffering, then uses none to introduce an emphatic expression.

patterns.name: Uncertainty of judgment and introducing a quotation with Here
patterns.context: After discussing whether an academic question is solvable, Here introduces a full quotation.

patterns.name: Email request and project handoff
patterns.context: A conditional request for someone else to take over, improve, and release a project.

patterns.name: Colloquial spellings and action tone in IRC
patterns.context: Colloquial spellings, onomatopoeia/possible misspellings, and asterisked action markers in informal chat.

5_2733.description: 激活分散在 Here、yours、now on 等词句及 IRC 星号、小说叙述和邮件措辞上；没有覆盖全部片段的统一触发规律。

patterns.name: Here 的位置性/指示性用法
patterns.context: 句首或从句边界处用 Here 引出地点、内容或后文；有时前面带逗号或换行

patterns.name: now on 固定表达
patterns.context: 句首以 From now on 引出未来的行动或说话方式

patterns.name: from here on out 固定表达
patterns.context: 承诺未来将采取行动或继续提供某物时，表示从此以后

patterns.name: yours 所有权或归属
patterns.context: you/your 的语境中表示归属；可用于合同修改归属或把项目交给他人

patterns.name: IRC 中的星号与缩写
patterns.context: 聊天记录中星号包围的动作标记，或星号紧邻口语缩写 am

patterns.name: sermon 后的否定及经历词尾
patterns.context: 小说中谈论听过讲道与经验/无知，激活分布在否定词及若干词片段上

patterns.name: Spirit/Man 与天空意象
patterns.context: 标题及随后描写 Manwe、天空和飞鸟的文字

patterns.name: plural 及群体叙述
patterns.trigger: « our»1；« us»2；« From»5« now»9« on»4« I»1
patterns.context: 叙述者从共同经历转向以复数口吻发言

patterns.name: 邮件中的 yours 和责任归属
patterns.context: 讨论草稿修改、遗漏标记及责任归属

patterns.name: 身体痛苦与灵魂
patterns.trigger: « Physical»5« suffering»1；« the»3 torment« of»2« the»2« body»4；« none»9
patterns.context: 将身体折磨与灵魂受难并置，随后以 none 引出强调性表达

patterns.name: 判断不确定与 Here 引文引介
patterns.context: 讨论学术问题是否可解后，以 Here 引出完整引文

patterns.name: 邮件请求及项目交接
patterns.context: 提出由他人接手、完善并发布项目的条件性请求

patterns.name: IRC 口语拼写与动作语气
patterns.context: 非正式聊天中的口语拼写、拟声/可能的拼写错误及星号动作标记

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on here: it commonly appears in from here, also in the concatenated word nowhere (now+here) and the stage direction O, here she comes; back then also appears in a temporal recollection.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “from here”
patterns.context: “here” immediately follows “from”; it may be followed by on out, it is possible, you have to, or appear in narrative descriptions of movement or elaboration.
patterns.domain: Web text, fiction, Q&A, forums, and encyclopedia narration

patterns.name: Fixed expression “nowhere”
patterns.context: Now and here combine as nowhere in a rhetorical question about whether the Quran says something.

patterns.name: Fixed expression “nowhere”
patterns.context: Now and here combine as nowhere, followed by does the article say, indicating that the article does not mention an issue.
patterns.domain: Technical blog or forum article comment

patterns.name: “here” in a stage context
patterns.context: Standalone here appears in an address or cue, followed by a stage direction indicating that a character is about to appear; it does not contain from.

patterns.name: Past-time reference and recollection
patterns.context: Recollects a prior experience or level of knowledge; the preceding text discusses studying computer science during college.

5_2733.concept: here 的局部词形/短语特征
5_2733.description: 强激活主要落在 here：常见于 from here，也见于连写 nowhere（now+here）和戏剧提示语 O, here she comes；另有 back then 的时间回顾。

patterns.name: 固定表达“from here”
patterns.trigger: «from»5«here»9（有时中间有标点或标记，如 «From»4« here»9«,»4）
patterns.context: “here”紧接在“from”之后；后续可接 on out、it is possible、you have to，也可进入叙述中的地点移动或补充说明。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、小说、问答、论坛及百科叙述

patterns.name: 固定表达“nowhere”
patterns.context: Now 与 here 连写构成 nowhere，出现在关于《古兰经》是否说某事的反问语境中。

patterns.name: 固定表达“nowhere”
patterns.context: Now 与 here 连写构成 nowhere，后接 does the article say，表示文章中没有指出某问题。
patterns.domain: 技术博客或论坛文章评论

patterns.name: 舞台语境中的“here”
patterns.context: 独立的 here 位于呼唤或提示语中，后接人物即将出现的舞台指示；不含 from。

patterns.name: 过去时间指示与回顾
patterns.context: 回顾先前的经验或知识水平，前文谈及大学阶段学习计算机科学。

en.description: Activations mainly target here and fixed expressions containing it, especially from here, hereinafter, and herein below. These respectively indicate a current location/starting point, define a term below, or refer to what follows. Also includes from now on and standalone here.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase from here
patterns.context: “from here” occurs contiguously or with only light punctuation between the words; it may be followed by expressions of direction, time, scope, or action.

patterns.name: Legal definition with hereinafter
patterns.context: hereinafter appears with definitional language such as “referred to as” to introduce a term.

patterns.name: Reference to below with herein
patterns.context: herein below appears near patent figures or terminology explanations, referring to what follows.

patterns.name: Here meaning this place or current situation
patterns.context: Standalone here refers to the current place, situation, or point in the discussion; surrounding contexts vary.

patterns.name: Time transition with from now on
patterns.context: A fixed time phrase meaning starting now; appears before the narrator changes their manner of expression.

5_2733.description: 主要对 here 及其构成的固定表达激活，尤强于 from here、hereinafter、herein below；这些表达分别表示当前位置/出发点、下文定义或下文指代。也包括 from now on 与单独 here。

patterns.name: 固定短语 from here
patterns.context: “from here”连续出现，或中间只隔少量标点；后面可接方向、时间、范围或动作表达。
patterns.domain: 一般说明、叙事、论坛文字

patterns.name: hereinafter 法律定义
patterns.context: hereinafter 与“referred to as”等定义措辞相连，用于引入术语。

patterns.name: herein 下文指代
patterns.context: herein below 出现在专利图示或术语说明附近，指向下文。

patterns.name: here 表示此处或当前情形
patterns.context: here 单独出现，指当前地点、情形或论述位置；周围语境各异。

patterns.name: from now on 时间转换
patterns.context: 固定时间短语，表示从现在起；出现在叙述者转换表达方式之前。

en.description: Mainly responds to from in phrases such as “from here” and “from time to time”; it also activates on thee and mine in classical texts and him in religious contexts. These span multiple genres and cannot be fully reduced to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “from here” for transition or origin
patterns.context: The phrase indicates continuing, moving, or taking action from a current location, stage, or starting point; punctuation or a following direction word may intervene.
patterns.domain: Web narration, explanation, dialogue, and informal sports commentary

patterns.name: Temporal frequency phrase “from time to time”
patterns.context: A fixed time phrase meaning periodically or occasionally; in passage 1, the highest activation falls on the first “time”.

patterns.name: Second-person object pronoun in classical poetry
patterns.context: Appears in a lyric poem as an address to or object referring to a person being missed; connected to the surrounding “I think of …” construction.

patterns.name: Pronoun “him” in a religious context
patterns.context: Refers to Christ or the Son of God in religious expressions about death, resurrection, glory, and related themes.

patterns.name: Emphatic possessive in classical narrative
patterns.context: Reasserts ownership in a rhetorical question (“mine?”) and appears next to kinship terms such as “my brethren”.

5_2733.description: 主要响应“from here”及“from time to time”等from短语中的from；另在古典文本的thee、mine和宗教语境的him上激活，涵盖多种文体，不能完全归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: “from here”转移或起始表达
patterns.context: 短语表示从当前位置、阶段或出发点继续、移动或采取行动；中间可有标点或后续方向词。
patterns.domain: 网页叙述、说明、对话及非正式体育评论

patterns.name: “from time to time”时间频率短语
patterns.context: 固定时间短语表示周期性或不时发生；第1段的最高激活落在第一次“time”。

patterns.name: 古典诗歌中的第二人称宾格
patterns.context: 出现在抒情诗中，作为对所思念之人的称呼或宾语；与周围的“I think of …”句式相连。

patterns.name: 宗教语境中的代词“him”
patterns.context: 指向基督或上帝之子，处于死亡、复起、荣耀等宗教表述中。
patterns.domain: 基督教灵修或神学文字

patterns.name: 古典叙事中的强调性所有格
patterns.context: 以反问形式重申归属（“mine?”），并紧邻“my brethren”等亲属称呼。

en.concept: Varied uses of common function words
en.description: Activations are scattered across first-person reference, pronominal prepositional phrases, and adverbs or temporal expressions such as now, far, so, then, again, time, and Later. They occur across literary, religious, legal, sports, and everyday texts, with no single stable semantic pattern or register.

patterns.name: First person and self-reference
patterns.context: First-person pronouns appear in narration, inner monologue, or direct speech, often near emotion, relationships, or self-emphasis, though not in every passage.
patterns.domain: Fiction, poetry, religious texts, and online writing

patterns.name: Pronominal objects and “in” phrases
patterns.context: A preposition is followed by a pronoun, describing attribution, participation, or a state; passage 3 is in Christian discourse, while passage 7 narrates personal feelings.

patterns.name: Temporal or transitional adverb now
patterns.context: “Now” appears mid-sentence, followed by a quotation or explanation; in both examples in this set, the word itself is marked.

patterns.name: Emphatic degree or result words
patterns.context: Emphasizes degree, result, or recurrence in sports tactics and descriptions of the natural environment; the triggering words differ.

patterns.name: Temporal interval expression
patterns.context: A fixed phrase meaning intermittent recurrence; the surrounding text discusses caring for a sourdough starter.

patterns.name: Later in headings and directory-style text
patterns.context: In a chapter heading or table-of-contents entry, “Later” introduces a subsequent event.
patterns.domain: Book contents, historical or biographical text

5_2733.concept: 常见功能词的多样用法
5_2733.description: 激活散见于第一人称指称、代词介词短语及 now、far、so、then、again、time、Later 等副词或时间表达；跨文学、宗教、法律、体育与日常文本，未见单一稳定语义或文体。

patterns.name: 第一人称与自我指称
patterns.context: 第一人称代词在叙述、内心独白或直接引语中出现；常与情绪、关系或自我强调相邻，但并非每段都如此。
patterns.domain: 小说、诗歌、宗教文本及网络文字

patterns.name: 代词性宾语与“in”短语
patterns.context: 介词后接代词，描述归属、参与或状态；第3段处于基督教论述中，第7段为个人感受叙述。

patterns.name: 时间或转折副词 now
patterns.context: 句中出现“Now”，后接引语或说明；本组两例都标在该词上。
patterns.domain: 法律庭审陈述、小说对话

patterns.name: 强调性程度或结果词
patterns.context: 在运动战术、自然环境叙述中，强调程度、结果或重新发生；触发词各异。

patterns.name: 时间间隔表达
patterns.context: 固定短语中表示间歇性重复，周围谈及照料酵种。
patterns.domain: 日常生活、饮食相关文字

patterns.name: 标题与目录式文字中的 Later
patterns.context: 章节标题或目录条目中，以“Later”引出后续事件。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录、历史或传记文本

en.description: Activations are not uniform: multiple passages fall on first-person me/my/mine in self-reference or emphasis; others occur on words in far as and from time to time, and on home in at home. These belong to different collocations and contexts.

patterns.name: Emphatic or object use of the personal pronoun me
patterns.context: In first-person narration, the pronoun appears in emphatic, emotional, or self-referential positions; also includes speaking to others, religious narration, and general personal accounts.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase far as
patterns.context: The fixed collocation “as far as” limits the scope of a judgment; passage 6 contains the same collocation but with weaker activation.

patterns.name: Time word time
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed phrase “from time to time”, meaning occasionally or repeatedly.
patterns.domain: Everyday blog about caring for a sourdough starter

patterns.name: Location/place word home
patterns.context: Forms “at home” with “at” and is paired with “in colonies”, referring to locations covered by medicalized action.
patterns.domain: Medical history or public health academic discussion

5_2733.description: 激活分布不统一：多段落在第一人称 me/my/mine 的自我指涉或强调处；另有 far as、from time to time 中的词，以及 at home 的 home，分属不同搭配与语境。

patterns.name: 人称代词 me 的强调或宾语用法
patterns.trigger: «me»、«Me»，以及围绕其出现的所有格/复数形式 «my»、«mine»
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中，代词处于强调、情感表达或自我指涉位置；也包括对他人说话、宗教叙述和一般个人叙事。
patterns.domain: 文学、宗教、个人博客/论坛文本

patterns.name: 介词短语 far as
patterns.context: 固定搭配“as far as”，用于限定判断范围；段6也有同一搭配但激活较弱。

patterns.name: 时间词 time
patterns.context: 出现在“from time to time”这一表示偶尔、反复发生的固定短语中。
patterns.domain: 日常博客，谈论照料酵种

patterns.name: 方位/场所 home
patterns.context: 与“at”构成“at home”，并与“in colonies”并列，表示医疗化行动覆盖的地点。
patterns.domain: 医学史或公共卫生学术论述

en.description: Activates on multiple local cues: most prominently, pleaded in legal texts (especially pleaded guilty), oft in photosoft.* domain names, and the Exp/RegExp substring; also triggered by line breaks and formatting, code paths, name segmentation, and content from several specific webpages or cases.

patterns.name: Expand, Exp, and similar substrings
patterns.context: Occurs inside words or proper names, especially at word-initial capitalized fragments; examples include the segmentation of “Exponential,” “QRegExpValidator,” and “perspective.”

patterns.name: Legal phrase pleaded guilty
patterns.context: An admission-of-guilt expression in criminal judgments or accounts of legal facts; the word also activates in “pleaded not guilty” and in contradictory preceding or following judgment records.

patterns.name: Short domain suffix oft
patterns.context: In repeated “photosoft.[suffix]” strings, oft follows photos; followed by domain suffixes such as loan, biz, win, and club.

patterns.name: Line breaks and whitespace formatting
patterns.context: Multiple activations occur near line breaks, blank lines, or line-separated structures; often co-occurs with headings, lists, quotations, or webpage snippets, but is not a sufficient condition.
patterns.domain: Webpages, code, legal documents, and Q&A formatting

patterns.name: GitHub paths and gotest substring
patterns.context: In paths or repository identifiers, especially repeated gotestyourself; activations concentrate on the domain fragment and gotest.

patterns.name: binge eating in titles
patterns.context: A short title or podcast description includes a term related to an eating disorder, alongside a line break between title and body.

patterns.name: Segmentation within personal names
patterns.context: A personal name is split into multiple subword tokens; occurs in police reports or legal case accounts.

patterns.name: Web navigation and promotional copy
patterns.context: Web navigation links, section headings, and generic promotional language interspersed with line breaks.

patterns.name: Child pornography case descriptions
patterns.context: Legal documents describing related criminal facts and admitted charges.

patterns.name: Technical product descriptions
patterns.context: Webpage or product promotional copy describing a technical product growing or developing over the years.

patterns.name: Regular expression validator Q&A
patterns.context: A StackExchange question title or opening, containing a technical identifier.

patterns.name: Stun gun and confession accounts
patterns.context: A police press release recounts a suspect being stunned, surrendering, and confessing.

patterns.name: Ecstasy trafficking case
patterns.context: Case background in a legal document describes conspiracy and drug trafficking.

5_2830.concept: 局部字符串与排版线索
5_2830.description: 激活呈多种局部线索：最显著的是法律文本中的 pleaded（尤其 pleaded guilty）、域名 photosoft.* 中的 oft，以及 Exp/RegExp 子串；另受换行排版、代码路径、人名切分和若干特定网页或案件内容触发。

patterns.name: Expand、Exp 等子串
patterns.context: 出现在单词或专名内部，尤其是词首大小写片段；分别见于“Exponential”“QRegExpValidator”及“perspective”的切分。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、问答、网页标题

patterns.name: pleaded guilty 法律措辞
patterns.context: 刑事判决或法律事实叙述中，出现认罪表述；该词即使在“pleaded not guilty”与前后矛盾的判决记录中也会激活。

patterns.name: 短域名后缀 oft
patterns.context: 重复的“photosoft.[后缀]”字符串中，紧接 photos 后出现 oft；后接 loan、biz、win、club 等域名后缀。

patterns.name: 换行及空白排版
patterns.trigger: «↵»，以及标题或正文间的连续空行
patterns.context: 多段激活出现在换行、空行或分行结构附近；常与标题、列表、引文或网页片段共现，但并非充分条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、代码、法律文书及问答排版

patterns.name: GitHub 路径与 gotest 子串
patterns.context: 路径或仓库标识符中，尤其重复的 gotestyourself；激活集中于域名片段和 gotest。

patterns.name: 标题中的 binge eating
patterns.context: 短标题/播客简介中出现饮食障碍主题词，并伴随标题与正文的换行。

patterns.name: 人名内部切分
patterns.context: 人名被分成多个子词 token；出现在警务报道或法律案件叙述中。

patterns.name: 网页导航与宣传文案
patterns.trigger: “Follow via email”“Follow via RSS”“A Student’s Perspective”
patterns.context: 网页导航链接、栏目标题和通用宣传语交错，伴随换行。

patterns.name: 儿童色情案件描述
patterns.trigger: “use two fingers to spread open her labia”“child pornography”
patterns.context: 法律文书对相关犯罪事实及认罪罪名的描述。

patterns.name: 技术产品描述
patterns.context: 网页或产品宣传语描述逐年增长/发展的技术产品。

patterns.name: 正则表达式验证器问答
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题或提问开头，含技术类标识符。

patterns.name: 电击器及认罪叙述
patterns.context: 警方新闻稿转述嫌疑人被电击、投降并认罪。

patterns.name: Ecstasy 走私案件
patterns.context: 法律案件背景中描述共谋及毒品走私。

en.description: Activations span vehicles and driving technology, synchronization in two technical contexts, fragmentary words in titles or phrases, and lists of domain suffixes; there is no clear shared semantic theme, though vehicle passages are the most concentrated.

patterns.name: Vehicles and driving
patterns.context: Introductory statements about vehicles, driving, in-vehicle equipment, or vehicle safety systems; mostly patent background or technical text.
patterns.domain: Vehicle and transportation technology, patent background

patterns.name: Synchronization or bilateral synchronization
patterns.context: Describes bilateral synchronization of EEG discharges, or propagation delay differences in a synchronous (clock) circuit.

patterns.name: Fragmentary activation on specific words
patterns.context: A word within a complete word or phrase is split into consecutive tokens; occurs in title, growth-description, and podcast-title contexts.
patterns.domain: Entertainment titles, business descriptions, podcast copy

patterns.name: Domain lists and suffixes
patterns.context: Lists available domain extensions, repeatedly using the same domain stem with different suffixes.

5_2830.concept: none
5_2830.description: 激活分布于车辆与驾驶技术、两种技术语境中的同步，以及标题或短语的片段式词语和域名后缀列表；没有明显统一语义，车辆段最集中。

patterns.name: 车辆及驾驶
patterns.context: 车辆、驾驶、车载设备或车辆安全系统的介绍性陈述；多为专利背景或技术文本。
patterns.domain: 车辆与交通技术、专利背景

patterns.name: 同步或双侧同步
patterns.context: 描述 EEG 放电的双侧同步，或同步（时钟）电路中的传播延迟差异。
patterns.domain: 神经电生理、电子电路技术

patterns.name: 特定词语的片段式激活
patterns.context: 在完整词或短语中，词语被拆成连续 token；分别处于标题、增长描述和播客标题语境。
patterns.domain: 娱乐标题、商业描述、播客文案

patterns.name: 域名列表与后缀
patterns.context: 列举可用域名扩展时，重复出现同一域名主体及不同后缀。

en.description: Activations occur across several vehicle phrases, proper names or split words, synchronous in two distinct contexts, and isolated number sequences and quoted text; vehicle phrases are most concentrated, while the other patterns lack a shared semantic cue.

patterns.name: vehicles subword
patterns.context: Activations cluster around vehicles and its preceding modifiers; combinations include Many, Work, and Two wheel.
patterns.domain: Patent background, vehicles and work vehicles

patterns.name: Bromus name
patterns.context: The botanical Latin name Bromus madritensis is split into subwords, followed by a line break and another occurrence of Bromus.

patterns.name: Synchronous seizure EEG terminology
patterns.context: Describes bilateral synchronous interictal EEG discharges that persist after corpus callosotomy.

patterns.name: synchronous attribute in code
patterns.context: A method declaration in XML-style code has a synchronous attribute.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and BE/Y string
patterns.context: Activations occur around quotation marks, an English phrase, and the segmented spelling BEAUTY; both appear in the same passage, but their association is unclear.

patterns.name: Boeing brand name
patterns.context: Boeing is split into subwords, followed by a news-style sentence requesting that U.S. authorities allow something.

patterns.name: Numeric sequence
patterns.context: A continuous string of digits is followed by a line break and a math problem; the meaning of the digit sequence itself is unclear.

5_2830.concept: none
5_2830.description: 激活出现在多类车辆短语、若干专名或拆分词、两种不同语境的 synchronous，以及孤立数列和引号文本；车辆词组最集中，其余模式缺少统一语义线索。

patterns.name: vehicles 子词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 vehicles 及其前置限定语附近；有 Many、Work、Two wheel 等不同搭配。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，车辆与工作车辆

patterns.name: Bromus 名称
patterns.context: 植物学拉丁学名 Bromus madritensis 按子词拆分，名称后换行并再次出现 Bromus。

patterns.name: 同步发作 EEG 用语
patterns.context: 描述胼胝体切开后仍出现的双侧同步发作间期 EEG 放电。

patterns.name: 代码中的 synchronous 属性
patterns.context: XML 样式代码中，方法声明带有 synchronous 属性。

patterns.name: 引号与 BE／Y 字符串
patterns.context: 激活分布在引号、英文短语和分段拼写的 BEAUTY 周围，二者同段出现，关联不明。

patterns.name: Boeing 品牌名称
patterns.context: Boeing 被拆分为子词，后接请求美国当局允许某事的新闻式句子。

patterns.name: 数值序列
patterns.context: 一串连续数字后换行并出现数学问题；数字序列本身的含义不明。

en.description: Primarily responds to “You/you” in license texts that state rights, restrictions, or instructions for obtaining a copy; also responds to asterisks and line-break formatting in license notes and disclaimer terminology. It additionally activates on the forum interface phrase “You are currently viewing” and the title “Something There”; the latter two are of unclear relation to the main pattern.

patterns.name: You in Apache license statements
patterns.context: In the Apache license header, after a grant of permission or license conditions, addresses the file user in the second person to state rights, restrictions, or how to obtain a copy of the license; «You» is especially prominent at the start of the copy-acquisition sentence.
patterns.domain: Apache license copyright headers in GitHub source files

patterns.name: You in GNU licenses
patterns.context: After a license disclaimer or explanation, the sentence “You should have received a copy …” tells readers that they should have received a copy.
patterns.domain: GNU GPL disclaimers and license text in GitHub source files

patterns.name: There in a work title
patterns.context: The quoted work title “Something There,” followed by “in Herriman’s BE…”; activation falls on There within the title.
patterns.domain: Cultural or entertainment text in Pile-CC

patterns.name: You on forum pages
patterns.context: The site interface text “You are currently viewing all threads …” directly informs visitors about the current page state.
patterns.domain: Forum webpage interface/navigation text in Pile-CC

patterns.name: Fixed formatting and legal terminology in license text
patterns.context: In asterisks, line breaks, and formatting structures in legal disclaimers or license files; these markers co-occur with the You notice above, but there are also activations on formatting symbols and disclaimer wording.
patterns.domain: License comments and legal text in GitHub source code

5_2830.concept: 面向读者的第二人称告知语
5_2830.description: 主要在许可证文本向读者陈述权利、限制或提示获取副本时响应“You/you”，也响应许可证注释的星号换行格式及免责声明术语；另在论坛界面“You are currently viewing”及标题“Something There”中激活，后两者与主模式关系不明。

patterns.name: Apache 许可证声明中的 You
patterns.context: Apache 许可证头部中，许可授予或许可条件之后，以第二人称向文件使用者陈述权利、限制或如何获取许可证副本；«You» 在副本获取句开头尤其突出。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码文件中的 Apache 许可证版权头

patterns.name: GNU 许可证中的 You
patterns.context: 许可证免责声明或许可证说明之后，出现“You should have received a copy …”这一告知读者已应收到副本的句式。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码文件中的 GNU GPL 免责声明及许可证文本

patterns.name: 游戏作品名中的 There
patterns.context: 引号中的作品标题 “Something There”，且后接 “in Herriman’s BE…”；激活落在标题内的 There。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 中的文化或娱乐文本

patterns.name: 论坛页面中的 You
patterns.context: 站点界面文字“You are currently viewing all threads …”中，直接向访问者说明当前页面状态。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 中的论坛网页界面/导航文本

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的固定格式与法律术语
patterns.context: 法律免责声明或许可证文件的星号注释行、换行和排版框架中；这些标记与上述 You 告知句共同出现，但此处也对格式符号及免责声明措辞有激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码中的许可证注释和法律文本

en.description: All passages activate near second-person/user-directed expressions such as You or Who; the most stable pattern is You as the sentence-initial subject, followed by can, should, may, or are. License snippets recur, but the activation is not limited to license contexts.

patterns.name: You-led imperative-like clauses
patterns.context: Second-person You is the sentence-initial subject, introducing advice, ability, obligation, or a state; matches are not limited to a particular predicate.

patterns.name: You should in license disclaimer
patterns.context: In the asterisk-prefixed license comment lines at the end of a GNU GPL disclaimer.

patterns.name: You may after license terms
patterns.context: In Apache 2.0 license terms, explaining how to obtain a copy of the license.

patterns.name: You can in dialogue
patterns.context: Second-person statements directed at a reader or interlocutor; one discusses model deployment, another prediction difficulty.
patterns.domain: Github model descriptions, dynamic dialogue text

patterns.name: You in forum questions
patterns.context: A forum post invites participation and begins with an expression of willingness; strong activation falls on Who rather than You, possibly due to nearby text.

patterns.name: You are in page navigation
patterns.context: A forum page tells users what they are currently viewing.

5_2830.concept: 第二人称祈使与用户指向
5_2830.description: 所有段落都在 You 或 Who 等第二人称/面向用户表达附近激活；最稳定的是 You 作句首主语，后接 can、should、may、are。许可证片段重复出现，但同一激活并不限于许可证语境。

patterns.name: 祈使式 You 后续句
patterns.trigger: “You”分别处于“I/许可证说明”之后或对话中，后接“can”“should”“may”“are”等
patterns.context: 第二人称 You 作为句首主语，引出建议、能力、义务或状态；命中不局限于某种谓语
patterns.domain: 代码文档、对话、论坛文本

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明的 You should
patterns.context: GNU GPL 免责声明末尾，星号前缀的许可证注释行中

patterns.name: 许可证条款后的 You may
patterns.context: Apache 2.0 许可证条款中，说明可获取许可证副本

patterns.name: 对话中的 You can
patterns.trigger: “You can test and deploy”及“You can't always predict”
patterns.context: 面向读者或对话对象的第二人称陈述；一处谈模型部署，一处谈预测麻烦
patterns.domain: Github 模型说明、动态对话文本

patterns.name: 论坛提问中的 You
patterns.trigger: “Who will play along?”之前的“Who”以及其后的“I'll start”
patterns.context: 论坛帖子提出参与邀请并自愿开头；强激活落在 Who 而非 You，可能是邻近文本关联

patterns.name: 页面导航中的 You are
patterns.context: 论坛页面告知用户当前查看的内容

en.concept: which clauses and heterogeneous text markers
en.description: The most stable signal is which introducing a continuative clause in academic text; there are also sporadic activations on questions, code comments, mathematical symbols and LaTeX, optimization discussions, open-question titles, percentages, and several term fragments.

patterns.name: which relative clauses
patterns.context: which introduces a non-restrictive or explanatory clause that continues the preceding statement; occurs mid-sentence or sentence-initially.

patterns.name: Questions introduced by interrogative words
patterns.context: An interrogative word appears in a question title or direct question, followed by the question content.
patterns.domain: Book titles, academic paper question lists

patterns.name: Code comment prefix
patterns.context: At the beginning of a code line, followed by a natural-language comment.

patterns.name: Vertical bar in mathematical set notation
patterns.context: Appears in set-builder notation, indicating a condition or separating a condition.

patterns.name: LaTeX alignment environment in equations
patterns.context: The aligned environment and its labels and symbol commands in mathematical equations.

patterns.name: Statements about uncertainty and maxima
patterns.context: Discusses the global maximum of an optimization objective, iterative search, and its limitations.

patterns.name: Open-question titles
patterns.context: A title marks a question to be discussed below.

patterns.name: Percentage values
patterns.context: Percentages and nearby numbers occur in quantitative results descriptions.

patterns.name: Substrings within technical terms
patterns.context: A local fragment inside a word is marked, with no consistent syntactic function observed.

patterns.name: Ordinary words at activation boundaries
patterns.context: Marks occur on proper names, title words, or ordinary body-text words, with no clear shared condition.

5_2830.concept: which从句及异质文本标记
5_2830.description: 最稳定的信号是学术文本中 which 引出的承接性从句；另对问句、代码注释、数学符号与 LaTeX、优化讨论、开放问题标题、百分数和若干术语片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: which 关系从句
patterns.context: which 引出非限制性或解释性从句，承接前文陈述；出现在句中或句首

patterns.name: 疑问词引导的问题
patterns.context: 疑问词出现在问题标题或直接提问中，后续为问句内容
patterns.domain: 书籍标题、学术论文的问题列表

patterns.name: 代码注释起始符
patterns.context: 位于代码行开头，后接自然语言注释

patterns.name: 数学集合符号竖线
patterns.context: 出现在集合构造式中，表示满足条件或分隔条件

patterns.name: 公式中的 LaTeX 对齐环境
patterns.context: 数学公式的 aligned 环境及其标签、符号命令

patterns.name: 不确定性与最大值相关表述
patterns.context: 讨论优化目标的全局最大值、迭代搜索及其局限

patterns.name: 开放问题标题
patterns.context: 以标题标示后续待讨论的问题

patterns.name: 百分比数值
patterns.context: 百分数及其邻近数字出现在定量结果叙述中

patterns.name: 专业术语内部子串
patterns.context: 单词内部局部片段被标记，未见一致的句法功能

patterns.name: 激活边界处的普通词语
patterns.context: 标记分布在专名、标题词或普通正文词上，未显示明确共同条件

en.description: The signal is dispersed: the strongest occurrences of “together” are in two abstracts; the rest involve formula symbols, specific terminology, or medical/chemical descriptions, with no clear shared semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Combination or whole formation expressed by “together”
patterns.context: Occurs after multiple factors, components, or objects of comparison, connecting them to content they jointly form, evaluate, or compare; activation is strongest in two passages.

patterns.name: Minus sign in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Appears in a tunneling-rate formula, with the minus sign inside an exponent or fraction; may be related to mathematical formatting.

patterns.name: Ion exposure and altered synaptic plasticity
patterns.context: A hyphen links experimental exposure to an altered biological outcome, in a description of changes in synaptic plasticity.

patterns.name: Comparison of ECG results with prior reports
patterns.context: A relative pronoun introduces previously published findings, which are compared with ECG results from the current case.

patterns.name: Immunoliposomes
patterns.context: Listed alongside microorganisms and plant tissue cultures as one source for discovering anti-Candida drugs.

patterns.name: Field operator expression
patterns.context: Appears in a field-operator formula containing up/down arrows and a summation, marking the Hermitian conjugate operator.

patterns.name: Gel/emulsion formation in liquid-liquid extraction
patterns.context: A slash lists two types of formation to avoid, in the context of liquid-liquid extraction and immiscible liquids.

patterns.name: Gut commensal bacteria
patterns.context: Describes enterococci as commensals in the gastrointestinal tract that are usually less pathogenic.

patterns.name: Hyperalgesia-related findings
patterns.context: Appears alongside “allodynia,” describing pain abnormalities associated with nerve injury or inflammation and an experimental hypothesis.

5_2830.concept: none
5_2830.description: 信号分散：最强的“together”出现在两篇摘要；其余涉及公式符号、特定术语或医学/化学描述，缺少共同的明确语义触发模式。

patterns.name: “together”结构要求的组合或整体形成
patterns.context: 出现在多个因素、组成部分或比较对象之后，连接它们共同形成、评价或比较的内容；在两段中激活最强。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、PubMed 生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 数学公式中的负号
patterns.context: 出现在隧穿率公式中，负号位于指数或分式表达式内；该信号可能与数学排版有关。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、LaTeX 数学文本

patterns.name: 离子暴露与改变的突触可塑性
patterns.context: 连字符连接实验暴露与改变的生物学结果，处于对突触可塑性变化的描述中。

patterns.name: 心电图结果与既往报告的比较
patterns.context: 关系代词引出已发表的既往发现，并与当前病例的心电图结果进行比较。

patterns.name: 免疫脂质体
patterns.context: 作为发现抗念珠菌药物的来源之一，与微生物和植物组织培养并列。

patterns.name: 场算符表达式
patterns.context: 出现在含上下箭头和求和的场算符公式中，标记厄米共轭算符。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、LaTeX 数学文本

patterns.name: 液液萃取中的凝胶/乳液形成
patterns.context: 斜线并列两种需要避免的形成现象，语境为液液萃取及不互溶液体。

patterns.name: 肠道共生菌
patterns.context: 描述肠球菌是胃肠道内的共生生物，通常较少致病。

patterns.name: 痛觉过敏相关结果
patterns.context: 与“allodynia”并列，描述神经损伤或炎症相关的痛觉异常及实验假设。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on colons in academic text that introduce results, hypotheses, observations, or lists, often followed by numbering or items; also occurs on colons introducing formulas in mathematical text.

patterns.name: Colon after results or hypotheses
patterns.context: In academic text, a colon introduces results, hypotheses, or a subsequent list; nearby numbering or parentheses are common, such as “1)” “(1)” or “a)”.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, NIH research proposals, and other academic texts

patterns.name: Colon and formula structure in mathematical formatting
patterns.context: In mathematical papers, the colon occurs in an explanatory or formula-introducing context, near LaTeX environments and structured equations.

5_2830.concept: 学术文本中的引出性冒号
5_2830.description: 激活主要集中在学术文本中引出结果、假设、观察或列举的冒号，常接编号或项目；另见数学文中引出公式的冒号。

patterns.name: 结果或假设后的冒号
patterns.trigger: “shown that:”（[1][2]）、“showed that:”（[3]）、“showing that:” （[4]）、“hypothesize:”或“hypothesized that … of:”（[5][6]）、“hypothesized that:” （[7]）、“show:” （[8]）、“observed:” （[10]）中的“:”
patterns.context: 学术文本中，冒号引出结果、假设或后续列举；相邻位置常有编号或括号，如“1)” “(1)”或“a)”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、NIH 研究计划及其他学术文本

patterns.name: 数学排版中的冒号及公式结构
patterns.context: 数学论文中，冒号处在解释或引出公式的语境，邻近 LaTeX 环境与结构化公式。

en.concept: Code-structure punctuation and common continuation tokens
en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on `++) {` after a code loop increment and on closing punctuation; other activations include English function words, `em` inside medical drug names, colons in Q&A, and sporadic parentheses/HTML tags. These do not form a consistent single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: C/C-like code loop closure
patterns.context: The closing parenthesis after a loop counter increment in code, often immediately followed by the opening brace of the loop body; these markers activate most strongly across multiple passages.
patterns.domain: C, C++, Java, and other code in Github/StackExchange

patterns.name: Colon in code
patterns.context: Occurs in the request-example lead-in `And your request looks like:` and triggers the strongest activation; colons in other snippets may also occur in code or quotation structures, but the evidence is weaker.

patterns.name: English prepositions and common conjunctions
patterns.context: Common English function words in academic abstracts or papers; activation is unstable, and it is difficult to distinguish them from code tokens with the same form.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment in tenofovir/emtricitabine
patterns.context: Occurs inside a drug name in medical text about HIV/HBV prevention or treatment.

patterns.name: Unexplained local code punctuation/parentheses
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across Python-compatible code and HTML examples, and cannot be reliably unified with the loop-closure pattern or English function-word pattern.

5_2830.concept: 代码结构标点与常见续接 token
5_2830.description: 强激活主要落在代码循环递增后的 `++) {` 及闭合标点；另有英语功能词、医学药名内部的 `em`、问答中的冒号和零散括号/HTML 标签激活，未形成一致的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: C/类 C 代码循环闭合
patterns.context: 代码中循环计数器递增后的闭括号，常紧接循环体左花括号；这些标记在多段中激活最强。
patterns.domain: Github/StackExchange 中的 C、C++、Java 等代码

patterns.name: 代码中的冒号
patterns.context: 出现在请求示例引导语 `And your request looks like:`，触发强度最高；其他片段中冒号也可能出现在代码或引文结构中，但证据较弱。

patterns.name: 英语介词及普通连接词
patterns.context: 学术摘要或论文叙述中的常见英语功能词；触发不稳定，且与代码中的同形 token 难以区分。

patterns.name: tenofovir/emtricitabine 药物名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在 HIV/HBV 预防或治疗的医学文本中，嵌在药物名内部。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 未解释的代码局部标点/括号
patterns.trigger: `hasattr(pd, 'Timestamp'):` 中的括号与冒号，以及 ``、`` 等标签闭合
patterns.context: 激活点散落于 Python 兼容代码和 HTML 示例中，无法与循环闭合模式或英语功能词模式可靠统一。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、StackExchange 网页示例

en.description: Activations cover code for-loop headers and the start of loop bodies, as well as mathematical LaTeX equation environments, lead-ins adjacent to equations, and lists; there is also one report of a medical prevalence range and one series summation. The trigger forms are not entirely uniform.

patterns.name: for loops and loop-body starts
patterns.context: In C/C++, Java, and other code, the loop body begins after a counter or iteration condition; activations often fall near “for,” the iterator variable, or the closing parenthesis.

patterns.name: LaTeX structural commands in mathematical environments
patterns.context: Near environment boundaries, alignment, or piecewise equation structures in displayed mathematical formulas.

patterns.name: Formula transitions or introductions in mathematical text
patterns.context: Text before or after a formula introduces a test, condition, or example, adjacent to a displayed equation.

patterns.name: Expression of numerical or quantitative results
patterns.context: Reports prevalence estimates using ranges and percentages.

patterns.name: Listing a finite set of labels
patterns.context: Defines a finite set of labels and lists its members, then explains the label meanings or gives examples.

patterns.name: Summation series in English Q&A
patterns.context: Displays a series composed of powers or fractions, followed by a plain-language explanation.

5_2830.concept: 结构化表达边界与引入
5_2830.description: 激活涵盖代码 for 循环头及循环体起始，也涵盖数学 LaTeX 公式环境、公式邻接的引导语与列举；另有一例医学患病率区间报告和一例级数求和。不同触发形式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: for 循环及循环体起始
patterns.trigger: “for”以及循环头末尾的“++)”或“{”，尤其循环体前的“for (...) {”
patterns.context: 在 C/C++、Java 等代码中，循环计数或迭代条件后开始循环体；激活常落在“for”、迭代器变量或闭括号附近

patterns.name: 数学环境中的 LaTeX 结构命令
patterns.context: 数学展示公式的环境边界、对齐或分段公式结构附近
patterns.domain: 数学论文、问答中的 LaTeX

patterns.name: 数学文本中的公式转折或引入
patterns.context: 公式前后以文字引出检验、条件或示例，且与展示公式相邻

patterns.name: 数值或量化结果的表达
patterns.context: 以区间和百分比报告患病率估计

patterns.name: 有限标签集合的列举
patterns.context: 定义有限标签集并列出成员，随后说明标签含义或举例

patterns.name: 英文问答中的求和级数
patterns.context: 展示幂次或分数构成的级数，随后用口语文字解释

en.concept: Formulas and narrative structure in academic papers
en.description: Activations cluster around LaTeX formulas, numbering, and line breaks in ArXiv papers, and also occur in prose introducing conditions, conclusions, and examples; they involve terms from many fields and are difficult to group under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Formula boundaries and line breaks in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Activations often occur near the boundaries of LaTeX mathematical formulas, numbering, or alignment environments; formulas on different topics show the same behavior.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and theoretical science papers

patterns.name: Specific connectives in academic prose
patterns.context: These words occur in the body of papers, introducing conclusions, conditions, formulas, or examples; trigger positions vary, making them difficult to group under a single lexical item.

patterns.name: Sentence-final colon before a mathematical formula
patterns.context: The colon occurs in academic prose, followed by label examples and mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Source-representation terminology in physics
patterns.context: The terms occur in descriptions of field equations containing source terms, near formula references.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase in a cosmology abstract
patterns.context: Occurs in an abstract describing the standard structure-formation paradigm; it is uncertain whether this is independent of the formula-typesetting pattern.

patterns.name: Curve-dynamics terminology
patterns.context: Discusses connections between curve motion and the mKdV and sine-Gordon equations.

patterns.name: Boundary-condition statements
patterns.context: Lists boundary positions and electric-field conditions, then introduces results and numbered formulas.

patterns.name: Example of a small label set in a formula
patterns.context: Introduces a finite label set and gives an example later; activations cluster around the labels and example.

patterns.name: Explanation of topological invariants
patterns.context: Explains a quantity on the right-hand side of a formula and the space it belongs to, adjacent to a numbered formula.

patterns.name: Local activations not sufficiently explained by shared lexical items
patterns.context: Appears as formula conditions in the respective papers; apart from formula typesetting and academic style, no stable shared semantic trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: Different branches of mathematics and science

5_2830.concept: 学术论文中的公式与叙述结构
5_2830.description: 激活主要聚集在 ArXiv 论文的 LaTeX 公式、编号与换行附近，也见于引出条件、结论和示例的正文；另涉及多种领域术语，难以归成统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数学排版中的公式边界与换行
patterns.context: 激活常出现在 LaTeX 数学公式、编号或对齐环境的边界附近；不同主题的公式都出现此现象。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论科学论文

patterns.name: 论文叙述中的特定连接词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在论文正文中，引出结论、条件、公式或示例；触发位置各异，难以归为单一词项。

patterns.name: 数学公式前的句末冒号
patterns.context: 冒号位于学术叙述中，后接标签示例及数学记号。
patterns.domain: 机器学习／序列标注论文

patterns.name: 物理领域的源表示术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在含源项的场方程说明中，附近有公式引用。

patterns.name: 宇宙学摘要中的介词短语
patterns.context: 出现在摘要中，描述标准结构形成范式；是否与公式排版模式独立不确定。

patterns.name: 曲线动力学相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论曲线运动与 mKdV、sine-Gordon 方程之间的联系。

patterns.name: 边界条件陈述
patterns.context: 列出边界位置及电场条件，随后引出结果和编号公式。

patterns.name: 公式中的小型标签集合示例
patterns.context: 介绍有限标签集，并在后文给出示例；激活集中在标记及示例附近。
patterns.domain: 机器学习／序列标注论文

patterns.name: 拓扑不变量解释
patterns.context: 解释公式右侧的量及其所属空间，紧邻编号公式。

patterns.name: 无法由共同词项充分解释的局部激活
patterns.context: 在各自论文中作为公式条件出现；除公式排版和学术文体外，未见稳定的共享语义触发因素。

en.concept: Narrative text adjacent to mathematical formulas
en.description: The samples share mathematical text and formula typesetting. Activations often fall on explanatory transitions, condition descriptions, and LaTeX structural markers near formulas; specific triggers are sporadic, and the syntax and topics of different passages are not consistent.

patterns.name: Explanatory transitions after formulas
patterns.context: Ordinary English phrases connecting results, explanations, or subsequent formulas in mathematical derivations, especially prepositions or conjunctions such as that, in, as, and via.
patterns.domain: Explanatory text in mathematics papers and mathematical Q&A

patterns.name: that in mathematical text
patterns.context: Occurs in constructions such as “we show that,” “obtain that,” and “have that,” introducing a proposition or conclusion; activations fall on that in multiple contexts.

patterns.name: Introduction of boundary or interval conditions
patterns.context: Describes boundary, interval, or parameter conditions satisfied by mathematical objects, often near a formula or citation.
patterns.domain: Mathematical analysis, mathematical physics, and related papers

patterns.name: Specific LaTeX markers in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Activations occur near displayed formulas and their numbering or alignment structures; sometimes accompanied by textual transitions before or after the formula.

patterns.name: Small words, phrases, or local wording in mathematical contexts
patterns.context: Activations lie on local transitions or explanatory expressions in mathematical prose, but the specific syntax and meaning differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Mathematical texts in probability, analysis, physics, algebra, and other fields

patterns.name: Adjacency to special functions or symbolic expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur near complex formulas; there is insufficient evidence of a stable preference for any particular symbol or function.

5_2830.concept: 数学公式邻近的叙述文本
5_2830.description: 样本共同特点是数学文本及公式排版。激活多落在公式邻近的说明性衔接语、条件描述和 LaTeX 结构标记上；具体触发词分散，且不同段的句法与主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 公式后的解释性衔接语
patterns.trigger: “we show that”“we can obtain that”“we have that”“An explicit formula … is described in”“via the maps”
patterns.context: 数学公式推导中，连接结果、解释或后续公式的普通英文短语，尤其是 that、in、as、via 等介词/连词处。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与数学问答中的说明性文字

patterns.name: 数学文本中的 that
patterns.context: 出现在“we show that”“obtain that”“have that”等引出命题或结论的结构中；在多个上下文里激活落在 that。

patterns.name: 边界或区间条件的引出
patterns.context: 描述数学对象满足的边界、区间或参数条件，附近常接公式或引用。
patterns.domain: 数学分析、物理数学及相关论文

patterns.name: 数学公式中的特定 LaTeX 标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在展示公式及其编号、对齐结构附近；其中有时伴随公式前后的文字衔接。
patterns.domain: 以 LaTeX 排版的数学论文

patterns.name: 数学语境中的小词、短语或局部措辞
patterns.trigger: “the law”“at some point”“in the case”“in terms of”“as follows”
patterns.context: 激活位于数学叙述的局部连接或说明性表达，但各段具体句法结构和含义不同。
patterns.domain: 概率、分析、物理及代数等数学文本

patterns.name: 特殊函数或符号表达式邻接
patterns.context: 复杂公式附近出现激活；未见足够证据表明对某一特定符号或函数有稳定偏好。

en.description: Activations cluster in ArXiv LaTeX mathematical text: after prose introduces or explains a result, it switches to a displayed formula, with backslash environment/label commands, math delimiters, and line breaks; some examples also involve citations or statements of prior results.

patterns.name: Highlighting commands in LaTeX math environments
patterns.context: Near mathematical formulas or derivations, especially when aligned or gathered environments begin after a line break, or when a formula is given a label; backslash commands occur alongside following braces, environment names, and related structures.
patterns.domain: LaTeX source code of ArXiv mathematics and theoretical physics papers

patterns.name: Prose lead-ins before formulas
patterns.context: The prose indicates that a conclusion, formula, or expression is to follow, then a comma, period, line break, or displayed formula appears; there is no fixed word, and the position is typically syntactic, introducing mathematical content.
patterns.domain: Main text of ArXiv academic papers

patterns.name: Assertions near citations
patterns.context: Discusses prior results or empirical observations, often near literature citations, and may be followed by a displayed formula.

patterns.name: Boundary between LaTeX math markers and prose
patterns.context: Inline or displayed math boundaries abut prose, often involving variables, parameters, or boundary conditions; these tokens have weak semantics in isolation.

patterns.name: Paragraph/line-break structure before displayed formulas
patterns.context: A prose paragraph ends or a new paragraph begins, followed immediately by a displayed formula, formula environment, or label; activations may also favor this layout structure.

patterns.name: Literature citations and academic statements after formulas
patterns.context: Citation parentheses occur in statements of prior results, theorems, or observations, sometimes near mathematical expressions; the specific field varies.

5_2830.concept: 学术公式排版边界
5_2830.description: 激活集中于 ArXiv LaTeX 数学文本：正文引出或说明结果后切换到展示公式，出现反斜杠环境/label 命令、数学分隔符和换行；部分例子还伴随引用或已有结果陈述。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学环境中的高亮命令
patterns.context: 数学公式或推导附近，尤其是换行后开始 aligned、gathered 等环境，或给公式添加 label；反斜杠命令与紧随其后的花括号、环境名等结构共同出现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与理论物理论文的 LaTeX 源码

patterns.name: 公式前的正文引导语
patterns.context: 正文说明某结论、公式或表达式将出现，随后接逗号、句号、换行或展示公式；并非固定单词，通常是引出数学内容的句法位置。

patterns.name: 引用附近的断言表达
patterns.context: 论述已有结果或经验观测，附近常有文献引用，随后可能接展示公式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文（数学、物理等）

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学标记与正文交界
patterns.context: 行内数学或展示数学的边界紧邻正文，内容常涉及变量、参数或边界条件；单独看这些 token 的语义较弱。

patterns.name: 行间公式前的段落/换行结构
patterns.context: 正文段落结束或转入新段后，紧接展示公式、公式环境或 label；激活也可能偏向这类版面结构。

patterns.name: 公式之后的文献引用与学术陈述
patterns.context: 引用括号位于已有结果、定理或观测的陈述中，有时靠近数学表达式；具体领域并不固定。

en.concept: LaTeX mathematical typesetting boundaries in papers
en.description: All passages come from ArXiv papers. Activations cluster in LaTeX formula blocks and their boundaries: mathematical environments, line breaks, alignment, labels, formula references, and explanatory text near formulas; there are also local patterns involving figure captions, quantum states, and domain terminology.

patterns.name: Start of a LaTeX math environment
patterns.context: At the start of a formula, derivation, or mathematical expression, often immediately following a line break and preceding an aligned environment; activations fall on mathematical markers, environment markers, or nearby tokens.
patterns.domain: LaTeX typesetting in ArXiv mathematics and science papers

patterns.name: Standalone formula numbers and labels
patterns.context: Numbered labels near formula blocks, followed by a line break and a formula environment.

patterns.name: Transition from theorem prose to a formula
patterns.context: After a theorem or exposition, the text transitions to a proof/derivation beginning with a displayed formula; these words are also activated.

patterns.name: Figure captions and figure references
patterns.context: Markdown-like image syntax, figure captions, or image filenames near mathematical formulas.
patterns.domain: Figure and table markers in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Mathematical relation markers in formulas
patterns.context: In scientific exposition before or after formulas, appears near parameter conditions, limits, equation explanations, or citation notes; triggers are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Formula lead-in with citation
patterns.context: Introduces a specific theoretical case with a literature citation, then breaks to an aligned formula.

patterns.name: Quantum-state notation and quantum-number constraints
patterns.context: Angular-momentum state notation and quantum-number ranges, followed by a literature citation and formula.

patterns.name: Alignment and line breaks in multiline formulas
patterns.context: Within multiline aligned formulas, marks alignment points, formula-line endings, or unnumbered lines; activations include these typesetting markers.

patterns.name: Equation-number references
patterns.context: The prose refers to a previously numbered equation, followed by a figure marker or formula.

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: At line breaks between formulas, paragraphs, or structural text; occurs repeatedly across passages, with activation strength varying by context.

patterns.name: Generic mathematical symbols in formulas
patterns.context: Inside scientific formulas, adjacent to variables, differential operators, or terms; not a symbol specific to one field.

5_2830.concept: 论文LaTeX数学排版边界
5_2830.description: 所有片段均来自ArXiv论文，激活集中于LaTeX公式块及其边界：数学环境、换行、对齐、标签、公式引用和公式邻近的说明文字；另有图注、量子态及领域术语等局部模式。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学环境起始
patterns.context: 公式、推导或数学表达式开始处，常紧接换行及 aligned 环境；激活落在数学标记、环境标记或其附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与科学论文的 LaTeX 排版

patterns.name: 独立公式编号与标签
patterns.context: 公式块附近的编号标签，后接换行和公式环境。

patterns.name: 定理后的正文转入公式
patterns.context: 定理或论述文字之后转入证明／推导，并以展示公式开头；这些词本身也有激活。

patterns.name: 图注与图形引用
patterns.context: 数学公式邻近的 Markdown/类 Markdown 图片语法、图题或图文件名。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文中的图表标记

patterns.name: 公式中的数学关系标记
patterns.context: 在公式前后的科学论述中，出现在参数条件、极限、方程解释或引用说明附近；触发分布不完全一致。

patterns.name: 带引用的公式前置说明
patterns.context: 介绍特定理论情形并附文献引用，随后换行进入 aligned 公式。

patterns.name: 量子态符号与量子数约束
patterns.context: 角动量态符号及量子数范围，后跟文献引用和公式。

patterns.name: 多行公式中的对齐与换行
patterns.context: aligned 多行公式内部，标出对齐点、公式行结束或不编号；激活位置包括这些排版标记。

patterns.name: 方程编号引用
patterns.context: 正文中引用已编号方程，接着出现图形标记或公式。
patterns.domain: 科学论文 LaTeX 正文

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 公式、段落或结构性文本之间的换行处；多段反复出现，且激活强弱随上下文变化。

patterns.name: 公式内通用数学符号
patterns.context: 科学公式内部，邻近变量、微分算子或运算项；本身不是单一特定领域符号。

en.description: Strong activations mainly occur at boundaries in structured content: the start of LaTeX formulas or formula environments in papers, and line breaks and indentation in code; a possible commonality is that these mark mathematical or program structure.

patterns.name: Start of a formula or math environment
patterns.context: High activations often occur at the start of mathematical formulas, alignment environments, or formula labels, usually near LaTeX math symbols, variables, or theorem statements.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical papers

patterns.name: Line breaks and indentation in code blocks
patterns.context: Activations fall on line breaks in source code, especially inside if/else branches or statement blocks, with indentation and code punctuation nearby.

5_2830.concept: 结构化内容边界
5_2830.description: 强激活主要出现在结构化内容的边界：论文中的 LaTeX 公式或公式环境起始，以及代码中的换行和缩进位置；共同点可能是标记数学或程序结构的边界。

patterns.name: 公式或数学环境起始
patterns.context: 高激活常出现在数学公式、对齐环境或公式标签开始处，附近通常有 LaTeX 数学符号、变量或定理陈述。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论论文

patterns.name: 代码块中的换行与缩进
patterns.context: 激活落在源代码的换行处，尤其是 if/else 分支或语句块内部，前后有缩进和代码标点。

en.concept: Environment and block markers in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to displayed formula environments, formula citations, and surrounding typesetting markers in LaTeX academic text; also responds to paper-section prose, preamble configuration, scientific notation, and if statements, comments, and block structures in code patches.

patterns.name: LaTeX math environments and formula typesetting
patterns.context: In mathematics papers or scientific text, enters displayed formulas or array/alignment environments, often with line breaks and mathematical commands; activations often fall on environment commands or adjacent markers.
patterns.domain: LaTeX academic text from ArXiv and PubMed Central

patterns.name: Paper structure and section prose
patterns.context: The body introduces the organization of a paper, section locations, or references to sections, alongside section transitions and paragraph/line-break markers.

patterns.name: C/C++ conditional statements and code blocks
patterns.context: Conditionals, code-block endings, comments, and indentation occur in code or diffs; activations are distributed near statement keywords and formatting markers.

patterns.name: Formula lead-ins and derivation transitions
patterns.context: The academic prose first introduces a formula or result, then a displayed math environment follows; may also be adjacent to boundary conditions, citations, or model descriptions.
patterns.domain: ArXiv and PubMed Central scientific papers

patterns.name: Section headings and formula-content cues
patterns.context: Short mathematical topic labels occur in aligned formulas, followed by parameter relations or formula terms.

patterns.name: LaTeX preamble and document start
patterns.context: The source-file preamble configures packages and layout before the document begins, then continues with array environments.

patterns.name: Formula references, figures, and scientific notation
patterns.context: Formula or figure references, model diagrams, and physical/mathematical notation occur where scientific paper prose connects to formulas.

5_2830.concept: 结构化文本中的环境与块标记
5_2830.description: 主要响应 LaTeX 学术文本中的显示公式环境、公式引述及其周边排版标记；另响应论文章节叙述、导言区配置、科学记号，以及代码补丁中的 if、注释和块结构。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学环境与公式排版
patterns.context: 数学论文或科学文本中进入显示公式、数组/对齐环境，常伴随换行及数学命令；激活常落在环境命令或相邻标记上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv、PubMed Central 的 LaTeX 学术文本

patterns.name: 论文结构与章节叙述
