patterns.trigger: 「This article is organised as follows」「In the next section」「Section」
patterns.context: 正文介绍文章组织、章节位置或引用章节，伴随章节交接及段落/换行标记。

patterns.name: C/C++ 条件语句与代码块
patterns.context: 代码或 diff 中出现条件判断、代码块结束、注释及缩进；激活分布在语句关键字和格式标记附近。

patterns.name: 公式前的引述与推导衔接
patterns.context: 学术正文先引出公式或结果，随后接显示数学环境；也可能与边界条件、引用或模型说明相邻。

patterns.name: 章节标题与公式内容提示
patterns.context: 对齐公式中出现简短的数学主题标签，后接参数关系或公式项。

patterns.name: LaTeX 导言区与文档开始
patterns.context: 源文件导言区配置宏包、版面后开始正文，并继续排版数组环境。

patterns.name: 公式引用、图示及科学记号
patterns.context: 公式或图表引用、模型图示及物理/数学记号出现在科学论文正文与公式衔接处。

en.concept: Mixed local lexical and formatting patterns
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to that in hypothetical sentences, and also activates on Delta in formulas, code indentation and control structures, and a few academic discourse words, superscript symbols, and reporting expressions; these patterns have no uniform source or semantics.

patterns.name: Hypotheses or research propositions introduced by that
patterns.context: that is followed by a declarative research hypothesis, proposition to be tested, or causal claim; common in project abstracts and also seen in paper prose. The word is often preceded by hypothesis/hypotheses or expressions about testing or uncertainty.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts, grant texts, and papers

patterns.name: Delta in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In a formula environment, Delta is part of a mathematical symbol in a color-difference formula; it is not a natural-language hypothetical construction.
patterns.domain: Mathematical formulas in biomedical methods or measurement papers

patterns.name: Indentation and whitespace in code diffs
patterns.context: Leading spaces, tabs, and other whitespace on added or modified lines in code patches are marked; the context is usually code statements or comments.

patterns.name: Code control structures or pointer-related tokens
patterns.context: In C/C++-style code, control-flow conditions, parentheses, or variable names are activated; these examples have no clear single semantic relation.

patterns.name: Superscript symbols in mathematical notation
patterns.context: A passage begins in a mathematical typesetting context, with a superscript and formula delimiters; it later transitions to an introduction of the paper's structure.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper text and mathematical typesetting

patterns.name: Discourse connective In
patterns.context: In at the beginning of a sentence or clause introduces the following explanation; it can introduce a description of paper organization or biomedical discussion, with no more specific shared semantics.

patterns.name: here reporting research results
patterns.context: Used with we report in academic prose to refer to findings reported in the current paper.

patterns.name: however expressing contrast or qualification
patterns.context: however occurs in an academic sentence to introduce a qualification of the preceding result or argument.

5_2830.concept: 混合的局部词形与格式模式
5_2830.description: 主要对假设句中的that强烈响应，也激活公式Delta、代码缩进与控制结构，以及少数学术篇章词、上标符号和报道用语；这些模式来源与语义并不统一。

patterns.name: that 引出的假设或研究命题
patterns.context: that 后接陈述性研究假设、待验证命题或因果主张；常见于项目摘要，也见于论文正文。该词前常出现 hypothesis/hypotheses 或测试、未知等表述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、基金项目文本及论文

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 Delta
patterns.context: 公式环境中，Delta 作为数学符号的一部分，出现在色差计算公式里；不是自然语言里的假设句式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法或测量论文中的数学公式

patterns.name: 代码差异中的缩进与空白
patterns.context: 代码补丁中新增或修改行的前导空格、制表符等空白被标记；上下文通常是代码语句或注释。

patterns.name: 代码控制结构或指针相关 token
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中，控制流条件、括号或变量名被激活；这些例子没有明显共享的单一语义关系。

patterns.name: 数学模式中的上标符号
patterns.context: 段首处于数学排版上下文，出现上标及公式定界符；后文转入论文结构介绍。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文文本及数学排版

patterns.name: 篇章衔接词 In
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头的 In 引出后文说明；可用于论文组织介绍，也可用于生物医学论述，缺少更具体的共享语义。

patterns.name: 报道研究结果的 here
patterns.context: 学术叙述中与 we report 连用，指当前论文报告的发现。

patterns.name: 转折或保留语气的 however
patterns.context: however 位于学术句子中，引出对前述结果或论述的限定。

en.description: Primarily responds to that clauses introducing propositions, results, or reasons in sentences, especially in scientific and legal text; it also responds to initialization/close calls in one code patch and a formula passage describing a small-wavenumber power law.

patterns.name: Introduction of a hypothesis or proposition
patterns.context: In academic argumentation or legal reasoning, that introduces a proposition, explanation, result, or reason; it often occurs at a clause boundary in a long sentence.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, mathematics/physics papers, judicial opinions

patterns.name: Initialization call in a code diff
patterns.context: A code patch adds an initialization call, comments out a header file, and contrasts with a deleted close call; the activation is near the code-edit passage.

patterns.name: Wavenumber notation in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: A text label and mathematical notation in a formula environment describe a power-law relation in the small-wavenumber regime.

5_2830.concept: 命题从句引出
5_2830.description: 主要响应句中引出命题、结果或论证理由的 that 从句，尤见科研与法律文本；另对一段代码补丁中的初始化/关闭调用及一段描述小波数幂律的公式片段有响应。

patterns.name: 假设或命题引出
patterns.context: 在学术论证或法律推理中，that 引出命题、解释、结果或理由；常出现在较长句子的从句边界。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、数学/物理论文、司法意见

patterns.name: 代码差异中的初始化调用
patterns.context: 代码补丁中新增初始化调用、注释掉头文件，并与删除的关闭调用形成差异；激活落在代码编辑片段附近。

patterns.name: 数学公式的波数标记
patterns.context: 公式环境中以文字标签和数学记号描述小波数区间的幂律关系。
patterns.domain: 物理论文、LaTeX 数学公式

en.description: Primarily responds to that, especially in the reason clause introduced by rationale is that in NIH research abstracts; it also responds to that in hypotheses, patent causal explanations, and mathematical conclusions.

patterns.name: that introducing a research rationale clause
patterns.context: In academic research plans, after stating research aims, hypotheses, or prior work, that introduces the research rationale or expected significance; it is sometimes followed by clauses beginning with once/how.

patterns.name: Variant expression of a research rationale
patterns.context: In research abstracts, rationale introduces the research rationale, followed by an account of understanding a biological process.

patterns.name: that in hypothesis sentences
patterns.context: States multiple hypotheses being tested, with that introducing their content.

patterns.name: that in causal explanations
patterns.context: Patent background text explains the reason for a change in friction characteristics.

patterns.name: that in mathematical derivations
patterns.context: In technical discussion of image restoration and hyperparameter selection, that introduces a conclusion about the optimal choice.

5_2830.concept: that 从句引导词
5_2830.description: 主要响应 that，尤其是 NIH 研究摘要中 rationale is that 引出的理由从句；也响应假设、专利因果解释及数学结论中的 that。

patterns.name: 研究理由从句引导词
patterns.trigger: «that»10，前接“The rationale is”或“The rationale for the proposed research is”
patterns.context: 学术研究计划中，在陈述研究目标、假设或前期工作后，用 that 引出研究理由或预期意义；常紧接 explaining/understanding/once 等内容

patterns.name: 研究理由的变体表达
patterns.trigger: «that»9，前接“The rationale for this work is”
patterns.context: 研究摘要中由 rationale 引出研究理由，后接对某生物学过程的理解

patterns.name: 假设句中的 that
patterns.context: 陈述正在检验的复数假设，that 引出假设内容

patterns.name: 原因解释中的 that
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中说明摩擦特性变化的原因

patterns.name: 数学推导中的 that
patterns.context: 图像恢复及超参数选择的技术论述中，that 引出关于最优选择的结论

en.description: Primarily responds to that introducing an explanation or proposition in copular constructions in scientific text, especially research rationales (rationale is that), and also hypotheses (hypothesis is/are/were that).

patterns.name: that after research rationale
patterns.context: In research plans or project descriptions, that follows rationale is and introduces the research basis, significance, or subsequent explanation; sometimes followed by clauses beginning with once/how.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter research grant application text

patterns.name: that after a hypothesis statement
patterns.context: In scientific text, that follows a copular construction with hypothesis(s) and introduces a proposition to be tested.
patterns.domain: Research grant applications or research papers

5_2830.concept: 科研陈述中的补语 that
5_2830.description: 主要响应科研文本中由系词结构引出解释或命题的 that，尤其是研究理由（rationale is that），也包括假设（hypothesis is/are/were that）。

patterns.name: 研究理由后的 that
patterns.trigger: “The rationale for the proposed research is that”及“The rationale is that”；被标记的触发词为“that”
patterns.context: 研究计划或项目说明中，that 紧接 rationale is，引出研究依据、重要性或后续解释；有时接 once/how 等从句
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 科研资助申请文本

patterns.name: 假设陈述后的 that
patterns.trigger: “the central hypothesis is that”、“hypotheses being tested are that”、“hypotheses to be tested were that”；被标记的触发词为“that”
patterns.context: 科研文本中，that 紧接 hypothesis(s) 的系词结构，引出待检验的命题
patterns.domain: 科研资助申请或研究论文

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: Park at the beginning, abstract headings and Conclusions, fragments within technical terms, and contexts such as fast-food branding, interview identities, legal rulings, and French models. No stable semantic trigger covers all samples.

patterns.name: Park at the beginning
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on Park at the start of the segment; the following contexts differ: “Park fast Blog” and “Park Bit-”.

patterns.name: Paper title/abstract opening marker
patterns.context: A bracket and title-opening subword fragment in PubMed abstracts; the title topics differ.

patterns.name: Conclusion section marker
patterns.context: A Conclusions heading or transition in an abstract, possibly including preceding title content.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts; also legal text

patterns.name: Fragments within English technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on split word fragments with inconsistent meanings and contexts; the first passage also contains the web context “Park fast Blog”.
patterns.domain: Mixed: web, medical abstracts, French academic text

patterns.name: Fast-food brand recognition
patterns.context: Discusses children's recognition of fast-food restaurant brands and compares them with other food brands.

patterns.name: Identity and interaction in interviews
patterns.context: Researchers reflect on their identities and relationships and interactions during interviews with student participants.

patterns.name: Legal amounts and ruling terminology
patterns.context: A legal ruling lists monthly amounts and time periods and mentions the court's findings of fact and legal conclusions.

patterns.name: French academic expression and model description
patterns.context: A French paper introduces a new model for formal methods; activation is distributed across multiple French word fragments.

patterns.name: Chinese bioanalytical standards in a medical abstract
patterns.context: Discusses China's new CFDA BMV policy and related conference conclusions.

5_2969.description: 激活模式分散：开头的 Park、摘要标题与 Conclusions、专业词内部片段，以及快餐标识、访谈身份、法律判决和法语模型等语境；未见覆盖全部样本的稳定语义触发器。

patterns.name: Park 开头
patterns.trigger: «Park»；第 1 段紧接 «fast»，第 2 段紧接 « Bit»
patterns.context: 激活集中在片段开头的 Park；后续上下文不同，分别是“Park fast Blog”与“Park Bit-”。

patterns.name: 论文标题/摘要起始标记
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要中方括号及标题开头的词片段；这些标题主题并不相同。

patterns.name: 结论段落标记
patterns.context: 摘要中出现 Conclusions 标题或段落转折，可能包括前置的标题内容。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要；另见法律文本

patterns.name: 英文专业词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词片段上，词义和语境不统一；第 1 段还包含 Park fast Blog 的网页上下文。
patterns.domain: 混合：网页、医学摘要、法语学术文本

patterns.name: fast food 标识识别
patterns.trigger: fast« food» restaurant« logos»；« food» logos
patterns.context: 讨论儿童对快餐餐馆标识的识别，并与其他食品标识比较。

patterns.name: 访谈中的身份与互动主题
patterns.trigger: « Black» lesbian» researcher»；« self»-disclosure»、« empathy»、« rapport»
patterns.context: 研究者反思自身身份及与学生参与者访谈中的关系和互动。

patterns.name: 法律金额与判决用语
patterns.context: 法律判决中列示按月金额与时间段，并提及法院的事实认定和法律结论。

patterns.name: 法语学术表达与模型描述
patterns.context: 法语论文介绍一种用于形式化方法的新模型；激活分布在多个法语词片段。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的中国生物分析规范
patterns.trigger: « regulated» bioanalytical practice»；« new» BMV policy»；« Conclusions»
patterns.context: 讨论中国 CFDA 新 BMV 政策及相关会议结论。

en.description: Strong activation often falls on «ici», and also occurs on «Park», the «[» in PubMed abstracts, the French ending «ées», «le» in parliamentary text, and «Calculate» in math problems; the trigger words appear in markedly different contexts.

patterns.name: «ici» in French sentences
patterns.context: The token ici appears in French sentences; it may mean “here” or emphasize the current subject of discussion.
patterns.domain: French academic abstracts, European Parliament speeches, and math problems

patterns.name: Park at the beginning
patterns.context: The segment starts with Park, followed by a place, name, or related phrase.

patterns.name: PubMed abstract opening marker
patterns.context: A bracketed marker at the beginning of a PubMed abstract, followed by a title or abstract text.

patterns.name: French ending «-ées»
patterns.context: A feminine plural ending with an accent mark in French text; nearby tokens are split into multiple subword fragments.

patterns.name: «le» in French parliamentary discourse
patterns.context: The article le appears before a formal title or noun phrase in parliamentary speeches; these segments also contain «ici».

patterns.name: «Calculate» in probability problems
patterns.context: The instruction word Calculate appears at the start of a math problem or solution step.

5_2969.description: 强激活常落在 «ici»，也见于 «Park»、PubMed 摘要的 «[»、法语词尾 «ées»、议会文本的 «le» 及数学题的 «Calculate»；各触发词上下文差异明显。

patterns.name: 法语句中 «ici»
patterns.context: 词元 ici 在法语句子中出现；既可能表示“这里”，也可能用于强调当前讨论对象。
patterns.domain: 法语学术摘要、欧洲议会发言及数学题目

patterns.name: Park 开头
patterns.context: 片段以 Park 开头，后续接地点、名称或相关词组。

patterns.name: PubMed 摘要起始标记
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要开头的方括号标记，后接标题或摘要文本。

patterns.name: 法语词尾 «-ées»
patterns.context: 法语文本中带重音符号的复数阴性词尾，邻近词元被切分为多个子词。

patterns.name: 法语议会语篇 «le»
patterns.context: 议会发言中冠词 le 出现在正式称谓或名词短语之前；同时这些片段也含有 «ici»。

patterns.name: 概率题中的 «Calculate»
patterns.context: 数学概率题中，指令词 Calculate 出现在题目或解题步骤开头。

en.concept: Specific tokens and subword triggers in segments
en.description: Activation is scattered across text types: Park at the start of web pages or entries, call in code and math contexts, call in phone-related emails, and occasional name subwords, confidentiality notices, mathematical symbols, and technical terms. call is a recurring cross-genre cue, but its position and usage vary, so it does not explain all patterns.

patterns.name: Local activation after the name Park
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the context segment; following content varies: [1] continues with “fast Blog…Driving”, [2] with “Bit-na…Park Bit-”.

patterns.name: call in code
patterns.context: Appears in imperative code comments such as “call this when…” and in technical text describing how to execute a closure.
patterns.domain: GitHub code comments, HackerNews programming discussions

patterns.name: call in academic text
patterns.context: In math papers or Q&A, call introduces the naming or classification of a transformation, filter, or object.
patterns.domain: ArXiv math papers, StackExchange math Q&A

patterns.name: call in emails
patterns.context: Business emails mention a conference call or suggest calling someone; here “call” refers to a phone call.

patterns.name: Subword within the name Yamagu­chi
patterns.context: When a name is tokenized into pieces, activation falls on the final subword of the name.

patterns.name: CONFIDENTIAL label and attorney-client privilege notice
patterns.context: A confidentiality/attorney-client work-product disclaimer preceding the email body; “conference call” appears later in the same passage.

patterns.name: ij in matrix notation
patterns.context: Appears in matrix-element subscripts in mathematical expressions; matrix dimensions and exponentiation also occur nearby.

patterns.name: Park-fast web label and driving word
patterns.context: The segment begins with Park, contains a line break and Tag:, and is followed by Driving.

patterns.name: Self-intersecting elements and tetgen in code
patterns.context: Code and comments related to temporary paths discuss extracting self-intersecting element IDs and calling tetgen when an error occurs.

patterns.name: Negative values and anti- prefix in math text
patterns.context: After a formula, the text explains that some values are negative and introduces the name of a transformation; the final word is truncated.

patterns.name: Math filter objects and Supp
patterns.context: Formulas and text concerning quotient cycles, filters, and the support of modules.

patterns.name: Pre-dispatch and closure trees
patterns.context: Discusses runtime pre-dispatch, generating closure trees, and calling a top-level closure.

patterns.name: schedule and reminders in emails
patterns.context: Discusses schedules, deadlines, and a reminder to call in advance.

patterns.name: Certificate/label and biographical-entry structure
patterns.context: An entry or page segment begins with a name, followed by a line break and another name or entry fragment.

5_2969.concept: 片段中的特定词元与子词触发
5_2969.description: 激活分散于多类文本：Park 开头的网页/词条、代码与数学语境中的 call、电话邮件中的 call，以及少量姓名子词、保密声明、数学符号和技术术语。call 是跨文体重复线索，但触发位置与用法不统一，无法解释全部模式。

patterns.name: Park 名称后的局部激活
patterns.context: 在上下文片段开头出现；后续内容各异：[1] 接“fast Blog…Driving”，[2] 接“Bit-na…Park Bit-”。

patterns.name: 代码中的 call
patterns.context: 出现在命令式代码注释“call this when…”以及说明如何执行闭包的技术文本中。
patterns.domain: Github 代码注释、HackerNews 编程讨论

patterns.name: 学术文字中的 call
patterns.context: 数学论文或问答中，call 引出对变换、过滤或对象的命名/分类。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 邮件中的 call
patterns.context: 商务邮件提及电话会议，或建议致电联系他人；此处“call”是电话相关用法。

patterns.name: Yamagu­chi 姓名内部子词
patterns.context: 人名被分词切开时，激活落在名字末尾子词上。

patterns.name: CONFIDENTIAL 标记与律师特权声明
patterns.context: 邮件正文前的保密/律师客户工作成果免责声明；同段随后出现“conference call”。

patterns.name: 矩阵符号中的 ij
patterns.context: 数学表达式的矩阵元素下标中出现；同时附近有矩阵维度与幂运算。

patterns.name: Park-fast 网页标签与驾驶词
patterns.context: 片段以 Park 开头，含换行和 Tag:，随后出现 Driving。

patterns.name: 代码中自相交元素与 tetgen
patterns.context: 临时路径相关代码及注释，讨论提取自相交元素 ID，并在 tetgen 报错时调用。

patterns.name: 数学文本中的负值及 anti- 前缀
patterns.context: 公式后说明某些值为负，并引出一种变换的名称；末尾词被截断。

patterns.name: 数学过滤对象与 Supp
patterns.context: 关于循环商、过滤及模的支撑集的公式与文字说明。

patterns.name: 预先派发与闭包树
patterns.context: 讨论运行时预先派发、生成闭包树并调用顶层闭包。

patterns.name: 邮件中的 schedule 与提醒
patterns.context: 讨论存储计划、截止日期及提前致电提醒。

patterns.name: 证书/标签与人名条目结构
patterns.context: 词条或页面片段开头带有名称，后接换行及另一名称/词条片段。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: Park at the beginning, Page in technical paths, recommendations and reviews, calls and durations in business emails, “last rinse” in a patent, and “studying” in a research abstract all show local strong activation. The rest is mostly sporadic word fragments or formatting signals, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Park at the start
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the beginning of a segment or recurs after a line break; following forms vary, such as “fast” and “Bit”.

patterns.name: Page in a title or navigation path
patterns.context: Appears in the Windows configuration path “Security Page >> Site to Zone Assignment List”.

patterns.name: Recommendation or review language
patterns.context: The author recommends content to readers or says that something is interesting; also seen in “find this interesting” and “recommend learning about”.

patterns.name: Calls and time expressions
patterns.context: Recalls a past meeting or time spent, often using past tense and duration expressions.

patterns.name: “last rinse” collocation
patterns.context: Refers to adding fabric softener during the final rinse of a standard laundry cycle.

patterns.name: Research goals and exposure studies
patterns.context: Describes research on pollutants and reproductive-related targets, using purpose or methods phrasing.

patterns.name: Question mark after a percentage
patterns.context: A question mark immediately follows a percentage in a web-text segment; surrounding text is semantically incomplete.

patterns.name: Year abbreviations and purchase recommendations
patterns.context: Asks whether to buy an old computer and requests recommendations for 80s/90s models.

patterns.name: Unclear local word-fragment activation
patterns.context: Appears near URLs, usernames, or tokenized proper names; no stable semantic trigger can be determined from the segment.
patterns.domain: Forum text, URLs, and proper names

patterns.name: Unclear disclaimer and confidentiality marker
patterns.context: A confidentiality and attorney-client privilege notice at the start of an email; it is unclear whether activation is triggered by its content, formatting, or following body text.

patterns.name: Other unclear local activation
patterns.context: Each instance is embedded in text on a different topic; the available segments do not establish a shared trigger.

5_2969.description: 激活模式分散：开头的“Park”、技术路径中的“Page”、推荐评价、商务邮件中的通话与耗时、专利的“last rinse”及研究摘要中的“studying”均有局部强激活；其余多为零散词片或格式信号，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 通话与时间表达

patterns.name: 百分比后的问号

patterns.name: 不明的局部词片激活

patterns.name: 不明的其他局部激活

en.description: Activation is scattered across distinct string fragments such as cycl, Park, and corpor, as well as a status word in a Chinese translation; each depends on different word forms or local contexts, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: cycl string
patterns.context: Appears within words, often continuing into chemical names or words related to encyclopedia entries; activation centers on this substring and does not require sentence-initial position or specific semantics.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, encyclopedia categories, web articles

patterns.name: Park-initial string
patterns.context: Begins an adjacent word or name, followed by forms such as “fast” or “Bit-na”; there is no clearer shared semantic context.

patterns.name: corpor string

patterns.name: Status word in a Chinese translation
patterns.context: Appears in a Chinese software-interface translation inside msgstr quotes and indicates a stopped state; token activation is split within the word.

5_2969.description: 激活分散于 cycl、Park、corpor 等不同字符串片段，以及一条中文译文中的状态词；各自依赖不同的词形或局部语境，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: cycl 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在词内部，常接续形成化学名或百科条目相关词；激活集中于该子串，不要求句首或特定语义。

patterns.name: Park 开头字符串

patterns.name: corpor 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在「corporation」「corporate」等词内部；HackerNews 讨论企业、劳动或创业语境。

patterns.name: 中文译文中的状态词
patterns.context: 出现在 msgstr 引号内的中文软件界面译文，表示停止状态；词内 token 分段激活。

en.description: Strong activation concentrates on subword fragments “dev” and occasional “cycl”, “rac”, and “conv” across different languages and formats; the fragments occur in Portuguese, Italian, code, and URLs, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-internal “dev” fragment
patterns.context: Appears inside verb forms, followed by different endings such as “dev»idamente” and “dev»o”; it is not an independent word.

patterns.name: cyclops in a Java package name
patterns.context: Located in a lowercase, dot-separated Java package declaration and followed by “ops”.

patterns.name: rac in an English headline
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the hyphen-separated headline word “racist”.

patterns.name: conv in an English URL path
patterns.context: Appears in a URL path as part of the English word “convince”.

patterns.name: Italian verb devo
patterns.context: The same substring as in Portuguese, but here it forms the Italian first-person verb “devo”.

5_2969.description: 强激活集中在不同语言和格式中的子词片段“dev”及偶发的“cycl”“rac”“conv”；各片段分属葡语、意语、代码与网址等语境，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾“dev”片段
patterns.context: 出现在动词形式内部，后接不同词尾，如“dev»idamente”“dev»o”；不是独立词。

patterns.name: Java 包名中的 cyclops
patterns.context: 位于小写点分隔的 Java package 声明中，后接“ops”。

patterns.name: 英文标题中的 rac
patterns.context: 出现在连字符分隔的新闻标题词“racist”开头。

patterns.name: 英文网址路径中的 conv
patterns.context: 出现在 URL 路径中，构成英文词“convince”。

patterns.name: 意大利语动词词尾 devo
patterns.context: 与葡萄牙语相同的子串，但这里构成意大利语第一人称动词“devo”。

en.description: Six English passages highlight be in different contexts, often in the formal disclaimer phrase “be an offer”, and also with complements such as parsed, empty, and paid; one Spanish philosophy passage highlights fragments related to “conflict/solutions”.

patterns.name: be in email disclaimers
patterns.context: In formal email disclaimers, immediately follows “intended to” or “not intended to” and is followed by “an offer (or an acceptance)”; repeated across multiple passages.

patterns.name: be parsed in a code comment
patterns.context: Occurs in “cannot be parsed”, describing a data-parsing failure.

patterns.name: be empty in an error message
patterns.context: Appears in “cannot be empty” in a PHP warning about an empty filename.

patterns.name: be paid in legal text
patterns.context: Appears in “cannot be paid out” in a legal discussion of whether funds can be paid from the treasury.

patterns.name: Word fragments in a Spanish conflict discussion
patterns.context: A Spanish philosophical discussion concerns conflict and its possible sources and solutions; activation is distributed across word fragments and phrases.

5_2969.description: 6段英语文本在不同语境中突出 be，常见于正式免责声明的“be an offer”，也见 parsed、empty、paid 等补语；另有1段西语哲学文本突出“冲突/解决方案”相关词片。

patterns.name: 邮件免责声明中的 be

patterns.name: 错误消息中 be empty

patterns.name: 法律文本中 be paid

patterns.name: 西班牙语冲突讨论中的词片

en.concept: Spanish word forms and internal subwords
