patterns.domain: 西班牙语议会文本、网络文章、哲学书目与广播列表

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语技术问答或一般论述中，单词被子词切分，激活散布于多种词语
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 代码分隔符与括号
patterns.trigger: «]).»、«++;»、«↵»、«(»相关的文本上下文；另有“Removido o parênteses”
patterns.context: 代码片段结束或换行附近，紧接着出现葡萄牙语编辑说明；触发位置可能与标点、括号或行边界有关
patterns.domain: StackExchange 的代码与编辑说明

patterns.name: 西班牙语口语指令及软件名
patterns.context: IRC 对话中讨论 live CD，并指示安装 TestDisk 软件包

en.concept: Code-related word forms in technical text
en.description: Responds strongly mainly to “código” in Portuguese technical Q&A, including HTTP status codes, code modification, validation, scripts, and image-processing code; also responds weakly to “cumplimiento” in Spanish place-name/radio directories and policy texts.

patterns.name: “código” in Portuguese code contexts
patterns.context: “código” appears in Portuguese technical Q&A and may mean code, verification code, or error code; usually near code explanations, debugging, or instructions.

patterns.name: Spanish place names and radio call-sign lists
patterns.context: Multiple place names listed line by line, followed by call signs and FM frequencies.

patterns.name: Compliance terms in formal Spanish policy texts
patterns.context: Formal statements in the context of EU agreements, social issues, and regulations.

5_2969.concept: 技术文本中的代码相关词形
5_2969.description: 主要对葡语技术问答中的“código”强烈响应，涵盖HTTP状态码、代码修改、验证、脚本及图像处理代码等语境；另对西语地名—电台目录和政策文本中的“cumplimiento”有较弱响应。

patterns.name: 葡语代码中的“código”
patterns.context: 葡语技术问答中出现“código”，可指代码、验证码或错误代码；通常处于代码解释、调试或操作说明附近。

patterns.name: 西语地名与广播呼号列表
patterns.trigger: «San»、«And»、«Vic»等地名片段，以及相邻的电台呼号和频率
patterns.context: 多个地名逐行列举，后接呼号、FM频率。

patterns.name: 西语正式政策文本中的履约词
patterns.context: 欧盟协议、社会层面及法规语境中的正式陈述。

en.description: Activations often fall on code type names, generics, and declaration keywords, and also on in-word fragments in Portuguese/Spanish and policy texts; there are also isolated contexts involving HTTP, SMTP, editing notes, and C++ virtual functions, with no unified trigger condition apparent.

patterns.name: Code type names and declarations
patterns.context: Activations often fall on type names or generic parameters in code; examples include Java/C# declarations, as well as the Spanish “par” fragment in a CSV context, so the trigger is not limited to code.
patterns.domain: Mostly StackExchange code Q&A, plus Spanish text

patterns.name: HTTP error status code context
patterns.context: In Portuguese discussions of AJAX requests and HTTP responses, the activation falls on the word “código”.

patterns.name: In-word Spanish fragments
patterns.context: Multiple activation fragments occur within Spanish words or near word boundaries, involving content, code, sorting, and results; some occur in programming problem descriptions.

patterns.name: Java declarations and generic code
patterns.context: Activations occur in code blocks containing class member declarations, access modifiers, and generic type definitions; the exact positions of the fragments vary.

patterns.name: Spanish in SMTP configuration errors
patterns.context: After an SMTP connection failure message, the activation falls within “probablemente” (probably) in a Spanish explanation of possible causes.

patterns.name: Bracket-related code descriptions in editing notes
patterns.context: A Portuguese edit log mentions removing brackets near ViewBag.Ferias.Count; the activation is concentrated within “parênteses” (brackets).

patterns.name: In-word fragments in EU policy texts
patterns.context: In formal Spanish policy discussion, activations occur within “importancia” (importance) and “cumplimiento” (compliance, fulfillment).

patterns.name: C++ virtual function declarations
patterns.context: In a pure virtual function declaration in an abstract base class, the activation falls on the virtual keyword; the same passage also includes modifiers such as public, const, and noexcept.

5_2969.description: 激活多落在代码类型名、泛型及声明关键字，也出现在葡萄牙语/西班牙语词内片段和政策文本中；另有 HTTP、SMTP、编辑说明与 C++ 虚函数等孤立语境，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码类型名与声明
patterns.context: 激活常落在代码中的类型名或泛型参数；可见于 Java/C# 等声明，也有 CSV 语境中的西班牙语“par”片段，触发并非只限于代码。
patterns.domain: 以 StackExchange 代码问答为主，另有西班牙语文本

patterns.name: HTTP 错误状态码语境
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中讨论 AJAX 请求及 HTTP 响应时，激活落在“代码”一词。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 多个激活片段位于西班牙语词内部或词界附近，涉及内容、代码、排序和结果；其中部分处于编程问题描述中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 西班牙语编程问答

patterns.name: Java 声明与泛型代码
patterns.context: 类成员声明、访问修饰符和泛型类型定义的代码块中出现激活；不同片段具体落点不一。

patterns.name: SMTP 配置错误中的西班牙语
patterns.context: SMTP 连接失败提示之后，西班牙语解释可能原因时，激活落在“probablemente”（可能）一词内部。

patterns.name: 编辑说明中的括号相关代码描述
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语编辑记录提及移除 ViewBag.Ferias.Count 附近的括号，激活集中在“parênteses”（括号）词内。

patterns.name: 欧盟政策文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语正式政策论述中，激活出现在“importancia”（重要性）和“cumplimiento”（遵守、履行）词内。

patterns.name: C++ 虚函数声明
patterns.context: 抽象基类的纯虚函数声明中，激活落在 virtual 关键字；同段还出现 public、const、noexcept 等修饰。

en.concept: Object-oriented member declarations and accessor syntax
en.description: Mainly responds to public/protected member declarations and property accessors in object-oriented code; two other examples activate on in-word Spanish fragments, with no clear connection to code patterns.

patterns.name: Java/C# class member declarations
patterns.context: Class definitions and method or event member declarations in code examples; common in StackExchange Q&A, with access modifiers and types, names, or parameters.

patterns.name: Properties and getter/setter
patterns.context: Defines or demonstrates object properties and accessors, often alongside public, a field type, and a property name.

patterns.name: In-word substrings in foreign-language text
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within Spanish words rather than whole words; they occur in parliamentary text and in UI labels in template code, respectively.

5_2969.concept: 面向对象成员声明及访问器语法
5_2969.description: 主要响应类中 public/protected 成员声明及属性访问器等面向对象代码语法；另有两例激活于西班牙语词内片段，未显示与代码模式的明确联系。

patterns.name: Java/C# 类成员声明
patterns.trigger: public class、public static void、public event、protected virtual void
patterns.context: 代码示例中的类定义、方法或事件成员声明；常见于 StackExchange 问答，包含访问修饰符及类型、名称或参数。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、面向对象代码

patterns.name: 属性与 getter/setter
patterns.context: 定义或展示对象属性及访问器，常伴随 public、字段类型和属性名。

patterns.name: 外语词内子串
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语单词的内部片段，而非完整词；分别出现在议会文本与模板代码中的界面标签。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语议会文本、网页模板

en.concept: Member and function declaration syntax in programming languages
en.description: Mainly responds to C# class method declaration structure, especially modifiers, return types, and parameter parentheses; also responds to member signatures in C# XML. Activations also occur on C/C++ include directives, extern function prototypes, and GNU asm section declarations.

patterns.name: C# method declarations
patterns.context: Occurs in C# class member declarations, commonly following the sequence of access modifier, optional modifier, return type, method name, and parameter list; activations may also fall on the method name or near parentheses in the declaration.

patterns.name: C# XML documentation member signatures
patterns.context: XML documentation describing class members and C# constructor signatures.

patterns.name: C/C++ preprocessor directives
patterns.context: Header inclusion directives in C or C++ code.

patterns.name: C function prototypes
patterns.context: C/C++ code declaring a function with extern, followed by a parameter list and semicolon; the same passage also contains context about an array-summing function.

patterns.name: GNU extension assembly and section names
patterns.context: C code uses GNU asm to specify the text section containing a symbol; activations involve the asm declaration and section-name string.

5_2969.concept: 编程语言中的成员与函数声明语法
5_2969.description: 主要响应 C# 类成员的方法声明结构，尤其修饰符、返回类型及参数括号；也响应 C# XML 中的成员签名。另对 C/C++ 的 include 指令、extern 函数原型及 GNU asm 节声明有激活。

patterns.name: C# 方法声明
patterns.trigger: «public»、«protected»、«internal»、«virtual»、«static»、«void»、«int» 等修饰符或返回类型，常接方法名和 «(»
patterns.context: 处于 C# 类成员声明中，常见访问修饰符、可选修饰符、返回类型、方法名及参数列表的顺序；激活也可落在声明中的方法名或括号附近。

patterns.name: C# XML 文档成员签名
patterns.context: XML 文档中描述类成员及其 C# 构造函数签名。

patterns.name: C/C++ 预处理指令
patterns.context: C 或 C++ 代码中的头文件包含指令。

patterns.name: C 函数原型
patterns.context: C/C++ 代码中以 extern 声明函数，后接参数列表和分号；同段还包含数组求和函数的上下文。

patterns.name: GNU 扩展汇编与节名
patterns.context: C 代码通过 GNU asm 指定符号所属的文本节；激活涉及 asm 声明及节名字符串。

en.description: Activations concentrate on structural boundaries in code declarations, especially the closing of method-signature parameter lists and the subsequent return type, separator, or method-body start; also observed in Objective-C property/interface declarations, constructor metadata signatures, and class declarations in XML configuration questions.

patterns.name: End of method declaration signatures
patterns.context: Occurs in method or function declarations, usually at the end of the parameter list; activations may fall on the closing parenthesis, return-type marker, or start of the declaration body
patterns.domain: Source code and API documentation in various programming languages

patterns.name: Objective-C property and interface declarations
patterns.context: In Objective-C declarations, property modifiers, types, and variable lists, or interface/instance variable declarations

patterns.name: Constructor bytecode signatures
patterns.context: Constructor signatures end with a parameter list and return marker; includes JVM bytecode descriptors or .NET member signature XML

patterns.name: Class declarations in XML configuration
patterns.context: A C# window class declaration occurs in the context of a question about serializing an object to XML

5_2969.description: 激活集中在代码声明的结构边界，尤其是方法签名参数列表闭合及其后的返回类型、分隔符或方法体起始；另见 Objective-C 属性/接口声明、构造器元数据签名和 XML 配置问题中的类声明。

patterns.name: 方法声明签名结尾
patterns.trigger: 方法参数列表闭合后的“)”及紧随其后的“:”或“{”，例如“toString(): string”“loadUserByUsername(string $username): \Magento\User\Model\User”“RemoveSFT(SFT toRemove)”和“Bitmap LoadFromFile(...)”
patterns.context: 处于方法或函数声明中，通常在参数列表结束处；激活可能落在闭括号、返回类型标记或声明体开始位置
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的源代码及 API 文档

patterns.name: Objective-C 属性与接口声明
patterns.trigger: “@property (nonatomic, assign) float x, y, z;”及“@interface ... { NSIndexSet *selectedIndexes;”
patterns.context: Objective-C 声明中，属性修饰符、类型和变量列表，或接口/实例变量声明

patterns.name: 构造器字节码签名
patterns.trigger: “.method public constructor <init>(ILjava/lang/Exception;)V”及 XML 中“method public ... .ctor()”
patterns.context: 构造器签名以参数列表和返回标记结束；包含 JVM 字节码描述符或 .NET 成员签名 XML
patterns.domain: 反编译输出、字节码/程序集元数据

patterns.name: XML 配置中的类声明
patterns.context: 序列化对象到 XML 的问题背景中，出现 C# 窗口类声明

en.description: Mainly sensitive to function parentheses, declaration modifiers, documentation tags, and indentation; also includes localized patterns for property declarations, external symbols, test lifecycle methods, and PHP field assignments. Overall, it is oriented toward structured source code and API documentation.

patterns.name: Closing function-call parentheses
patterns.context: A closing empty-argument pair of parentheses appears after a function name or parameter list, or marks the end of a parameter list; mostly at code declarations or call sites.
patterns.domain: Source code and API documentation in various programming languages

patterns.name: Property declarations and modifiers
patterns.context: Declares a property in an Objective-C class or interface, often followed by a type and property name.

patterns.name: Tags and type descriptions in documentation comments
patterns.context: Tags in documentation comments mark return values, parameters, or links, often alongside a type or API name.

patterns.name: Access control and function declarations
patterns.context: Visibility modifiers appear in class member function declarations, often followed by a function name, parameter list, or return type.
patterns.domain: PHP, C#, Java, and other code

patterns.name: Code indentation whitespace
patterns.context: Indentation whitespace at the start of code blocks or comment lines is marked; common in formatted source code.

patterns.name: C/C++ external symbol declarations
patterns.context: Numerical computing code declares external functions or symbols, often with types, pointer parameters, and underscore suffixes.
patterns.domain: C/C++ numerical computing / Fortran interoperability code

patterns.name: Objective-C test lifecycle methods
patterns.context: Test classes contain setup/teardown lifecycle methods and superclass calls.

patterns.name: Object-oriented field assignments and stringification methods
patterns.context: A PHP class method assigns an instance field, followed by a string-conversion method declaration.

5_2969.description: 主要对代码中函数括号、声明修饰符、文档标签及缩进格式敏感；另有属性声明、外部符号、测试生命周期方法和 PHP 字段赋值等局部模式。整体偏向结构化源代码及 API 文档。

patterns.name: 函数调用括号闭合
patterns.context: 函数名或参数列表后出现闭合的空参数括号，或参数列表的结束括号；多为代码声明或调用处。
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的源代码与 API 文档

patterns.name: 属性声明及修饰符
patterns.context: Objective-C 类或接口中声明属性，常紧跟类型和属性名。

patterns.name: 文档注释中的标签与类型说明
patterns.context: 文档注释内用标签标注返回值、参数或链接，常伴随类型或 API 名称。
patterns.domain: 代码注释 / API 文档

patterns.name: 访问控制及函数声明
patterns.context: 类成员函数声明中出现可见性修饰符，常接函数名、参数列表或返回类型。

patterns.name: 代码缩进空白
patterns.context: 代码块或注释行起始处的缩进空白被标记；常见于格式化源代码。

patterns.name: C/C++ 外部符号声明
patterns.context: 数值计算代码中声明外部函数或符号，且常有类型、指针参数及下划线后缀。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 数值计算 / Fortran 互操作代码

patterns.name: Objective-C 测试生命周期方法
patterns.context: 测试类中出现 setup/teardown 生命周期方法及父类调用。

patterns.name: 面向对象字段赋值与字符串化方法
patterns.context: PHP 类方法中给实例字段赋值，随后声明字符串转换方法。

en.description: Mainly responds to declarative structures in code: C/C++ external symbol declarations, Objective-C property declarations, and C# HTTP GET routes/handlers; also responds to PHP test classes and @var comments. The patterns span different languages but all appear as declarations or comments.

patterns.name: External symbol declarations
patterns.context: Declares functions or variables with external linkage in C/C++ headers or source code, often with types, pointers, arrays, or assembly symbol names
patterns.domain: Systems programming, encoder/filesystem code, Fortran numerical libraries, and StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Objective-C property declarations
patterns.context: Declares properties in Objective-C classes or protocols, followed by a type and property name

patterns.name: HTTP GET routes and handlers
patterns.context: C# Web API uses attributes to mark GET endpoints and declare handler methods

patterns.name: PHP test classes and documentation comments
patterns.context: PHPUnit test class declarations and PHPDoc type comments for their members

5_2969.description: 主要响应代码中的声明性结构：C/C++ 外部符号声明、Objective-C 属性声明、C# HTTP GET 路由/处理器；另对 PHP 测试类及 @var 注释有响应。模式分属不同语言，但都以声明或注释形式出现。

patterns.name: 外部符号声明
patterns.trigger: «extern»；«extern» 后接类型、返回类型或变量声明
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件或源代码中声明外部链接的函数、变量，常伴随类型、指针、数组或汇编符号名
patterns.domain: 系统编程、编码器/文件系统代码、Fortran 数值库及 StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: Objective-C 属性声明
patterns.trigger: «@»«property»，常与 «(» 属性修饰符 «)» 连用
patterns.context: Objective-C 类或协议中声明属性，后接类型和属性名
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Cocoa/Objective-C 代码

patterns.name: HTTP GET 路由与处理器
patterns.trigger: «[»«Http»«Get»，以及 «[»«Route»；附近有 GET 路径、控制器方法
patterns.context: C# Web API 中用特性标注 GET 端点并声明处理方法
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 ASP.NET 问答代码

patterns.name: PHP 测试类及文档注释
patterns.context: PHPUnit 测试类声明及其成员的 PHPDoc 类型注释
patterns.domain: Github 上的 PHP 测试代码

en.description: Mainly responds to member declarations in code: properties and their modifiers, public methods/return types; also covers GET routes, Go composite-type syntax, and JavaDoc links. Patterns span multiple languages.

patterns.name: C# property declarations and accessors
patterns.context: Objective-C property declarations and their modifiers; also occurs in a Q&A about adding a public property to a UITableViewCell.

patterns.name: C# public methods and return types
patterns.context: C#-style public method or class member declarations, often alongside a return type, parameters, or XML documentation comments.

patterns.name: HTTP routes and GET endpoint annotations
patterns.context: GET route annotations or attributes for Web API endpoints, near public methods that handle requests.

patterns.name: Go composite types and map indexing
patterns.context: Go code declares slices, anonymous structs, or map types; activations fall on multiple tokens in the type syntax.

patterns.name: Named type declarations or references
patterns.context: A type name appears in a method return type, property type, or pointer declaration; partially overlaps with property/public member patterns.

patterns.name: Link markers in documentation
patterns.context: JavaDoc comments use link syntax to reference a type; this occurs only in this passage, and its relation to other patterns is uncertain.

5_2969.description: 主要响应代码中的成员声明：属性及其修饰符、public 方法/返回类型；也覆盖 GET 路由、Go 复合类型语法和 JavaDoc 链接。模式横跨多种语言。

patterns.name: C# 属性声明与访问器
patterns.trigger: `@property`、`public property`、`public static`，以及属性参数中的 `nonatomic`、`readonly`、`retain`、`strong`
patterns.context: Objective-C 属性声明及其修饰符；也出现在关于如何为 UITableViewCell 添加 public property 的问答中。

patterns.name: C# 公共方法及返回值类型
patterns.trigger: `public String getId()`、`public IActionResult GetBuildingsBySearch`、`public classUser Get(int id)`、`public static Bitmap LoadFromFile`
patterns.context: C# 风格的 public 方法或类成员声明，常伴随返回类型、参数或 XML 文档注释。

patterns.name: HTTP 路由与 GET 端点标注
patterns.context: Web API 端点的 GET 路由注释或属性，附近有处理请求的公开方法。

patterns.name: Go 复合类型与 map 索引
patterns.context: Go 代码中声明切片、匿名结构体或 map 类型；激活落在类型语法的多个 token 上。

patterns.name: 命名类型声明或类型引用
patterns.context: 类型名出现在方法返回类型、属性类型或指针声明中；与属性/公开成员模式部分重叠。

patterns.name: 文档中的链接标记
patterns.context: JavaDoc 注释中用链接语法引用类型；只出现于该段，是否与其他模式相关不确定。

en.concept: Type and declaration syntax in programming languages
en.description: Mainly responds to declarative structures in source code: properties, interfaces, types, fields, method/callback signatures, and access modifiers; spans Objective-C, Go, Java, and C++, with an emphasis on type annotations and API structures.

patterns.name: Types and properties in Objective-C declarations
patterns.context: Near property modifiers, inheritance, instance variables, and type names in Objective-C headers or class declarations.

patterns.name: Type names and type API documentation
patterns.context: Documentation comments link to type definitions or are followed by declarations of public type accessors.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, Java APIs and comments

patterns.name: Struct fields and string types in Go tests
patterns.context: A test case constructs a struct whose fields include an options type and an expected query-parameter map.

patterns.name: Generics and error types in Objective-C callback signatures
patterns.context: A block callback in a method parameter receives a query object, a nullable array of results, and an error object.

patterns.name: Java access modifiers and interface declarations
patterns.context: Near Java interface or method declarations, including visibility modifiers and array types.

patterns.name: C++ destructors and base-class-qualified calls
patterns.context: A class implementation contains a destructor, an override marker, or a member type qualified with a base-class scope.

5_2969.concept: 编程语言中的类型与声明语法
5_2969.description: 主要响应源码中的声明性结构：属性、接口、类型、字段、方法/回调签名及访问修饰符；跨 Objective-C、Go、Java、C++，偏向类型标注与 API 结构。

patterns.name: Objective-C 声明中的类型与属性
patterns.context: Objective-C 头文件或类声明中，尤其属性修饰符、继承、成员变量与类型名附近。

patterns.name: 类型名与类型 API 文档
patterns.context: 文档注释链接到类型定义，或紧随注释声明公开类型访问器。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码，Java API 与注释

patterns.name: Go 测试中的结构体字段与字符串类型
patterns.context: 测试用例构造结构体，字段包含选项类型及预期查询参数映射。

patterns.name: Objective-C 回调签名中的泛型与错误类型
patterns.context: 方法参数中的块回调，回调接收查询对象、可空结果数组和错误对象。

patterns.name: Java 访问修饰符与接口声明
patterns.context: Java 接口或方法声明附近，包含可见性修饰符及数组类型。

patterns.name: C++ 析构函数与基类限定调用
patterns.context: 类实现中出现析构函数、override 标记或基类作用域限定的成员类型。

en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and mathematical symbols, English and Russian subword fragments, quotation openings, and line breaks and numbering in legal citations. They span languages and styles, with diverse trigger positions and no apparent unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Numbers and mathematical problem symbols
patterns.context: Near numbers, minus signs, operators, and numeric expressions in math problem text; some activations fall on numeric fragments.
patterns.domain: Math problems, sequences, and arithmetic (DM Mathematics)

patterns.name: Fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across different English words and their subword fragments; no stable part of speech or fixed syntactic position is apparent.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including web text, email, abstracts, and patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Cyrillic letters or word fragments
patterns.context: In Russian text, activations are distributed across contiguous character fragments within a word.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and colloquial sentence fragments
patterns.context: The first-person plural contraction after a quotation mark and its opening; the sentence expresses positive collective evaluation.

patterns.name: Line breaks and legal citation numbers
patterns.context: At line breaks and the immediately following reporter citation numbers and court names.

5_2976.concept: none
5_2976.description: 激活分布在数值和数学符号、英俄语词片段、引语开头以及法律引文的换行与编号处。跨语种、跨文体且触发位置多样，未显现统一的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 数字与数学题符号
patterns.context: 数字、负号、运算符与数学题文本中的数值或表达式附近；部分激活落在数字片段上。
patterns.domain: 数学题、数列与算术（DM Mathematics）

patterns.name: 英文单词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在不同英文词及其子词片段上；看不出稳定的词类或固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、论文摘要、专利背景等多种文体

patterns.name: 俄文字母或词片段
patterns.context: 俄语文本中，激活分布在一个词的连续字符片段上。

patterns.name: 引号及口语句片段
patterns.context: 引号后的第一人称复数缩写及其开头；句子表达积极的集体评价。
patterns.domain: 引语或口语化网页文本

patterns.name: 换行与法律引文编号
patterns.context: 换行处及其后紧邻的报告集引文编号和法院名称开头。

en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and punctuation, Russian subwords, English phrase fragments, proper names containing Kart, statistical terminology, and legal citation formatting; no single semantic theme or domain explains all examples, suggesting a mixture of tokenization morphology and local formatting cues.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur around digit strings, numbers, or numbers adjacent to punctuation; sometimes a numeric fragment itself is split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Math text, legal citations, and other mixed text

patterns.name: Russian Cyrillic fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur when Russian words are tokenized into Cyrillic letters or letter fragments.

patterns.name: English abbreviations and common word fragments
patterns.context: In English phrases, activations fall on quotation marks, word beginnings, or internal subword fragments; the two passages differ semantically.

patterns.name: Karting / Kartli tokenization in proper names
patterns.context: Proper names contain the letter sequence Kart, which is split into subword tokens; the contexts are track names and personal or geographic names, respectively.

patterns.name: Technical terminology and statistical method fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur when statistical methods or model terminology appear in scientific abstracts; unmarked ordinary words provide a comparison.

patterns.name: Formatted fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Activations occur around volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, page numbers, and line-break formatting in court case citations.

5_2976.concept: 分词片段与格式线索
5_2976.description: 激活分布于数字与标点、俄语子词、英文短语片段、含 Kart 的专名、统计术语及法律引文格式；没有单一语义或领域能解释全部样本，可能混合了分词形态与局部格式线索。

patterns.name: 数字及数字边界
patterns.context: 数字串、编号或数字与标点相邻时激活；有时数字片段本身被拆分成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 数学文本、法律引文及其他混合文本

patterns.name: 俄语西里尔字母片段
patterns.context: 俄语单词内部被分词为西里尔字母或字母片段时激活。

patterns.name: 英文缩写及常见词片段
patterns.trigger: «“»、«We»、«'re»、« come»、« away»、« the»；«H»、«urry»、« and»、« sign»、« as»
patterns.context: 英文短语中，激活落在引号、词首或词内子词片段上；两段语义内容不同。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Karting / Kartli 分词
patterns.context: 专名中含有 Kart 字母序列，且该序列被拆成子词 token；上下文分别是赛道名称和人名地名。

patterns.name: 技术术语与统计方法片段
patterns.context: 科学摘要中出现统计方法或模型术语时激活；未标记的普通词提供对照。
patterns.domain: PubMed 计算机网络/统计摘要

patterns.name: 法律引文中的格式化片段
patterns.context: 法院判例引文的卷号、报告集缩写、页码和换行格式附近激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers, hyphens/slashes, punctuation, and internal subword fragments, often in compound words, quantity expressions, and paragraph-opening headings; no stable domain or lexical preference is apparent.

patterns.name: Hyphens and dashes
patterns.context: Hyphens or slashes occur in compound words, dates, or range markers, such as “exercise-based”“siloxane-based”“mid-ocean”“16th-century”“20-year”, and “Eddy/wind”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; paper titles, patents, encyclopedias, medical literature, etc.

patterns.name: Numbers and digit strings
patterns.context: Numbers, numeric fragments, or numbers adjacent to units/time expressions; the format of the first passage’s digit string is unclear, the fifth passage is a quantity problem, and the ninth expresses a duration in years.
patterns.domain: Legal text, math problems, medical literature, and other text

patterns.name: Tokenized internal word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-initial or internal subword fragments, with no consistent meaning across the words; often related to token boundaries, proper names, or compound words.

patterns.name: Punctuation and sentence-final marks
patterns.context: Periods, question marks, exclamation marks, or commas; some occur at sentence ends, others within lists or between proper names.
patterns.domain: Legal excerpts, math problems, web copy, encyclopedias, and paper titles

patterns.name: Unclassified local word fragments
patterns.context: The contiguous word fragments in passage 4 occur in a statement about filament-associated actin-binding proteins; this passage alone does not establish an independent semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Text openings or heading-like opening words
patterns.context: Several different types of words occur at paragraph beginnings or heading openings; their meanings and styles differ, with no common context.

5_2976.concept: 文本符号与子词片段
5_2976.description: 激活分散在数字、连字符/斜线、标点及词内子词片段上，常见于复合词、数量表达和段首标题；未显示稳定的领域或词义偏好。

patterns.name: 连字符与破折号
patterns.context: 连字符或斜线出现在复合词、年代或区间标记中，如 “exercise-based”“siloxane-based”“mid-ocean”“16th-century”“20-year”，以及 “Eddy/wind”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；论文标题、专利、百科、医疗文献等

patterns.name: 数字与数字串
patterns.context: 数字、数字片段或数字与单位/时间表达相邻；第1段数字串格式不明，第5段为数量题，第9段为年限表达。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、数学题、医学文献及其他文本

patterns.name: 被切分的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词的开头或内部子词片段，词本身并无一致语义；常与分词边界、专名或复合词有关。

patterns.name: 标点及句末符号
patterns.context: 句号、问号、感叹号或逗号；有的位于句末，有的处于列举或专名之间。
patterns.domain: 法律片段、数学题、网页文案、百科及论文标题

patterns.name: 无明确归类的局部词片段
patterns.context: 第4段这些连续词片段出现在关于丝状相关肌动蛋白结合蛋白的陈述中，不能仅凭此段确定独立语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 文本开头或标题式起始词
patterns.context: 段首或标题起始位置出现若干不同类型的词；词义和文体不一致，缺少共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 专利、论文标题、网页文案

en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers and range formats, proper names and internal fragments of ordinary words, and also occur in line-break indentation, patent titles, medical dosage procedures, mathematical symbols, shipping, architecture, and market commentary; these contexts lack stable semantic commonality.

patterns.name: Numbers, identifiers, and range formats
patterns.context: Identifiers, ranges, doses, or expressions formed from numbers, hyphens, or mathematical symbols; activations fall on numbers and formatting symbols.

patterns.name: Word fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Fragments within proper names or abbreviations are tokenized and activated, often in entity names, place names, or ship names; no consistent lexical condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activations occur within ordinary English words, possibly corresponding to subword tokenization; the examples span different meanings, so a shared morphological condition cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Titles and layout whitespace
patterns.context: Strong activations occur around line breaks, indentation, and book titles, possibly indicating sensitivity to layout or title regions.

patterns.name: Standard patent headings
patterns.context: The heading words themselves are activated in standard section titles at the beginning of patent text.

patterns.name: Dosage and experimental procedure descriptions
patterns.context: Clinical studies describe treatment doses, patient handling, and sampling procedures; some activations fall on quantity words or experimental terminology.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and relational words
patterns.context: Relational words, variables, punctuation, and numbers occur together in formulas or short mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: Shipping and vessel narratives
patterns.context: Historical shipping narratives involve ship names and contexts related to vessels and propellers; activations are concentrated mainly on fragments of ship names.

patterns.name: Architectural feature descriptions
patterns.context: Encyclopedic descriptions of churches or building exteriors cover layout, towers, buttresses, and stone; only individual word fragments are activated.

patterns.name: Geopolitics and market commentary
patterns.context: Commentary predicts market reactions and discusses the situation in the Middle East, energy demand, and prices; activations fall on tokenized English word fragments.

5_2976.concept: 混合的格式与子词片段
5_2976.description: 激活分散在数字与范围格式、专名和普通词内部子词，也见于换行缩进、专利标题、医学剂量流程、数学符号、航运、建筑及市场评论；各处缺乏稳定语义共性。

patterns.name: 数字、编号与范围格式
patterns.context: 数字、连字符或数学符号构成的编号、范围、剂量或表达式；激活落在数字及格式符号上。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、数学文本

patterns.name: 专名中的词段
patterns.trigger: Montreal« Can»«adi»«ens»；« H»«SA»；« O»«AR»；«OS»«WE»«GO»；« Mah»…；« Cal»cutta
patterns.context: 专有名称或缩写内部的词段被切分激活，常见于实体名称、地名或船名；未见一致的词义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、历史新闻

patterns.name: 英文词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在普通英文词内部，可能对应子词切分；这些例子跨不同词义，无法确认共同词法条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学摘要、评论、百科

patterns.name: 标题与版面空白
patterns.context: 换行、缩进及书籍标题附近出现强激活，可能对排版或标题区域敏感。

patterns.name: 专利固定标题
patterns.context: 专利正文开头的标准章节标题中，标题词本身被激活。

patterns.name: 剂量与实验流程表述
patterns.trigger: «six» dose levels« ranging»« from»；«treated»；«serial blood» sampling
patterns.context: 临床研究中描述治疗剂量、患者处理和采样流程；部分激活在数量词或实验术语上。

patterns.name: 数学符号与关系词
patterns.context: 公式或简短数学表达式中，关系词、变量、标点和数字相邻出现。

patterns.name: 航运与船舶叙述
patterns.context: 历史性航运叙述中，船名及船舶、螺旋桨相关语境；激活主要集中在船名片段。

patterns.name: 建筑构件描述
patterns.context: 教堂或建筑外观的百科式描述，涉及布局、塔楼、扶壁与石材；只有个别词段激活。

patterns.name: 地缘政治与市场评论
patterns.context: 评论中预测市场反应，讨论中东局势、能源需求与价格；激活落在被拆分的英文词片段。

en.concept: WE substrings and heterogeneous text fragments
en.description: Activations occur across heterogeneous text, notably uppercase WE strings, numbers and legal citation formatting, as well as proper-name subwords, email reminder openings, and book-title layout; strongly activated tokens have no unified meaning.

patterns.name: WEQA abbreviation
patterns.context: The WE substring within uppercase letter strings, followed by varying letters; sometimes spanning word boundaries or appearing in different capitalization forms.

patterns.name: Numbers and citation formatting
patterns.context: Years, volume and page numbers, and adjacent numbers and punctuation in legal case citations.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Proper names such as personal and team names are split into multiple subword tokens; strong activation is not fixed to the same fragment.

patterns.name: Email reminder wording
patterns.context: Begins with “Reminder, that today's …” followed by a meeting notice.

patterns.name: Book-title layout
patterns.context: A title follows multiple line breaks and indentation, and its words are split into subwords.

5_2976.concept: WE 子串及异质文本片段
5_2976.description: 激活分布在多种异质文本中：显著包括大写 WE 字符串、数字及法律引文格式，也包括专名子词、邮件提醒开头和书名排版；各处强激活 token 并无统一词义。

patterns.name: WEQA 缩写
patterns.context: 大写字母串中的 WE 子串，后续字母各不相同；有时跨单词边界或大小写形式出现。

patterns.name: 数字与引文格式
patterns.context: 年份、卷页号及法律判例引文中的数字和标点相邻。
patterns.domain: 百科年表、法律判例引文

patterns.name: 专名的子词片段
patterns.context: 人名、队名等专名被切分成多个子词 token；强激活并不固定在同一词段。

patterns.name: 邮件提醒措辞
patterns.context: 以“Reminder, that today's …”开头，后接会议通知语句。

patterns.name: 书名排版
patterns.context: 多行换行与缩进后出现标题，标题词被拆分成子词。

en.description: Activations fall mainly on tokenized fragments of various proper names or words: Mar, Poe, Raza, WEB, and Moe; they occur in legal, biographical, forum, and blog text, with no unified semantic or grammatical condition apparent.

patterns.name: Mar fragment in names
patterns.context: A name or proper noun is tokenized into a fragment beginning with Mar; a nearby May date is common but not required.

patterns.name: Poe fragment in a parenthetical name
patterns.context: A parenthetical gives a person’s maiden name or alias, in a format such as “(Poe)”.

patterns.name: Raza in a racial slogan
patterns.context: A quoted “La Raza” slogan appears, activating the tokenized Raza fragment.

patterns.name: WEB in a web topic phrase
patterns.context: The uppercase word “WEB” appears in parentheses in a discussion about choosing a study topic.

patterns.name: Moe in a bar proper name
patterns.context: In the proper name “Moe Bar”, Moe is activated after tokenization.

patterns.name: Unexplained activations
patterns.context: The shown highlights do not exhibit the name, word-form, or proper-name fragments above; there is insufficient evidence to assign them to another pattern.

5_2976.concept: 分词片段检测
5_2976.description: 激活主要落在多种专名或词语的分词片段上：Mar、Poe、Raza、WEB、Moe；分布于法律、传记、论坛与博客文本，未见统一语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Mar 片段
patterns.context: 名字或专名被分词切成以 Mar 开头的片段；附近常有 May 日期，但并非必要。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、人物传记、体育报道

patterns.name: 括号姓名的 Poe 片段
patterns.context: 括号内给出人物婚前姓或别名，格式如“(Poe)”。

patterns.name: 种族口号中的 Raza
patterns.context: 引号内出现“拉拉萨”口号，分词的 Raza 片段激活。

patterns.name: 网页主题词中的 WEB
patterns.context: 括号内以大写字母拼写“WEB”，谈论选择学习主题。

patterns.name: 酒吧专名中的 Moe
patterns.context: 专名“Moe Bar”中，Moe 被分词后激活。

patterns.name: 未解释的激活
patterns.trigger: 无可确认的共同触发子串
patterns.context: 所示高亮未呈现上述姓名、词形或专名片段；缺乏足够证据归入其他模式。

en.concept: Proper names and internal word substrings
en.description: Activations often fall on tokenized substrings within proper names, institution names, citations, and identifiers; examples include Arabic place and personal names, legal citations, political institutions, hospital locations, academic authors, and Spanish words, with no stable single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Tokenized substrings in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized proper names or internal word substrings, across contexts including personal names, place names, institutions, legal identifiers, and Spanish words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, primarily encyclopedias, legal texts, academic abstracts, and parliamentary text

patterns.name: Lists of place names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of geographic locations, administrative regions and populations, or lists of places and institutions; activations often fall on internal fragments of proper names.

patterns.name: Arabic and Middle Eastern names
patterns.context: Names of Arab figures, regimes, cities, or regions; includes both historical military narratives and modern geographic descriptions.
patterns.domain: Middle Eastern history and geography encyclopedias

patterns.name: Legal case citations and litigation wording
patterns.context: Occurs in court opinions, case citations, or litigation documents, including case numbers, procedural terminology, and judge abbreviations.

patterns.name: Political institutions and election descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of party performance, parliamentary elections, or political biographies; activations concentrate on fragments of institution names, parliament names, and related proper nouns.

patterns.name: Accented characters within Spanish words
patterns.context: In Spanish sentences, activations fall on words containing accented characters or nearby fragments; the passage discusses unemployment, regions, and textile factories.

patterns.name: Authors and taxonomic names in academic literature
patterns.context: Research abstracts cite authors, years, and parasitological names; activations fall on internal fragments of author names.

5_2976.concept: 专名及词内子串
5_2976.description: 激活多落在专名、机构名、引文及编号内部的分词子串；覆盖阿拉伯地名与人物、法律引证、政治机构、医院地名、学术作者和西班牙语词，未见稳定的单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 专名中的分词子串
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标注的专名或词内子串上；涉及人名、地名、机构、法律编号及西班牙语词等多种上下文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，主要是百科、法律、学术摘要和议会文本

patterns.name: 地名与专名列举
patterns.context: 出现在地理位置介绍、行政区与人口说明、地点或机构清单中；激活往往落在专名的内部片段。

patterns.name: 阿拉伯及中东相关名称
patterns.context: 阿拉伯人物、政权、城市或地区名称；既有历史军事叙述，也有现代地理介绍。

patterns.name: 法律案件引证与诉讼措辞
patterns.trigger: 「deny a certificate of probable cause to appeal」「Roll«ins» v. Holland」「C/ A No. 84-012-E」「Report and Recommendation」「R& R」
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见、案件引证或诉讼程序文书中，包含案件编号、程序术语和法官缩写。

patterns.name: 政治机构与选举表述
patterns.context: 出现于政党得票表现、议会选举或政治人物生平；激活集中在机构名、议会名及相关专名片段。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内重音字符
patterns.context: 西班牙语句子中，激活落在含重音字符的词或其邻近片段；段落谈失业、地区与纺织厂。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语发言

patterns.name: 学术文献中的作者与分类名
patterns.trigger: 「Kawamoto et al.」「Nijhout」「P. berghei」「P. gallinaceum」「Bishop and McConnachie」
patterns.context: 研究摘要中引用作者、年份及寄生虫学名，激活落在作者姓名的内部片段。

en.concept: Local word fragments and boundaries in text
en.description: Activations span multiple languages and styles, often occurring on the English infinitive “to” and the following verb, and repeatedly on internal character fragments in proper names, loanwords, or Romance-language words; Spanish and Portuguese preposition “de” is another trigger.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker “to” and following verb
patterns.context: In English, “to” precedes a verb or verbal expression; sometimes activation falls on the following verb or a neighboring word.
patterns.domain: English narratives, history, persuasive writing, personal essays, sports reporting, and travel itineraries

patterns.name: Accented characters or variant spellings within proper names
patterns.context: Fragments within personal names, place names, or proper names contain diacritics, variant characters, or token boundaries; the marked character is often embedded within a word.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia, Portuguese text, and Spanish academic text

patterns.name: Character fragments within Spanish words
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal character fragments in ordinary Spanish words or proper names, rather than English infinitive constructions.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Portuguese administrative publication information
patterns.context: Activations occur in institution, personnel, or administrative names, alongside catalog-style information such as publication numbers and job titles.
patterns.domain: Portuguese publication copyright pages or institutional information

patterns.name: Internal letters or token-boundary markers
patterns.context: Activations fall within proper names or loanwords; some markers correspond to tokenized letter sequences or transliterations.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia entries on bands, history, and literature

patterns.name: Short function word “de”
patterns.context: Appears as a preposition in Romance-language text, sometimes near punctuation or numbers.
patterns.domain: Spanish academic text, Portuguese publication information

5_2976.concept: 文本中的局部词片段与边界
5_2976.description: 激活跨多种语言与文体，常见于英语不定式“to”及其后动词，也反复落在专名、外来词或罗曼语词语的词内字符片段；另有西语、葡语介词“de”触发。

patterns.name: 不定式标记“to”及其后续动词
patterns.trigger: «to»，包括“to meet”“to prominence”“to study”“to work”“to Tripoli”“to thinking”“to give”等
patterns.context: 英语中“to”位于动词或动词性表达之前；有时激活落在后续动词或相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 英语叙述、历史、劝说文字、个人随笔、体育报道及地名行程

patterns.name: 专名内部的重音字符或异体拼写
patterns.context: 人名、地名或专名中带变音符号、异体字符或分词边界的片段，标记字符常嵌在词内。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科、葡语文本及西语学术文本

patterns.name: 西语词内字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语普通词或专名的词内字符片段，而非英语不定式结构。

patterns.name: 葡语行政出版信息中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在机构、人员或行政名称中，并伴随出版物编号、职位等目录式信息。
patterns.domain: 葡语出版物版权页或机构信息

patterns.name: 词内字母或分词边界标记
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或外来词内部，部分标记对应被拆分的字母序列或转写形式。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科中的乐队、历史与文学条目

patterns.name: 短功能词“de”
patterns.context: 在罗曼语文本中作为介词出现，附近可能有标点或数字。
patterns.domain: 西语学术文本、葡语出版信息

en.concept: Courts and procedural wording in legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to courts, jurisdiction, and legal collocations in legal documents, commonly in procedural narratives, opinions, and statutory citations; two isolated activation patterns involve work-related email wording and a Polish place-name subword.

patterns.name: Court and judicial jurisdiction references
patterns.context: Court names, court levels, or jurisdictional language appear in legal text; activations fall on court, of, and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Opinions, statutes, and other legal documents

patterns.name: “of” in legal phrases
patterns.context: Fixed legal constructions or noun phrases, especially those describing rights, jurisdiction, courts, or decisions; the word court need not appear.
patterns.domain: Insurance provisions, child welfare statutes, and case law

patterns.name: Legal procedure and litigation-stage terms
patterns.context: Describes procedural actions such as seeking relief from a court, withdrawing a guilty plea, going to trial, or appealing.

patterns.name: Quoted text or opinion lead-ins in legal text
patterns.context: Quotes the reasoning of a decision, statutory text, or a court finding; commonly occurs near quotation marks, square brackets, and judicial discussion.

patterns.name: Phrase before finalize in email
patterns.context: Work emails contain phrases about advancing or completing work; this differs from the legal context of the other activation fragments.

patterns.name: Subword within a place name
patterns.context: A subword fragment of a Polish village or administrative-area name; no clear legal context is apparent.

5_2976.concept: 法律文书中的法院与程序措辞
5_2976.description: 主要响应法律文书中的法院、管辖权及法律固定搭配，常见于程序叙述、判词和法规引文；另有邮件工作措辞与波兰地名子词两类孤立激活。

patterns.name: 法院及司法管辖表述
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现法院称谓、法院层级或管辖权表述；激活落在 court、of 及其附近词上。
patterns.domain: 判决、法规及其他法律文书

patterns.name: 法律短语中的 of
patterns.trigger: «of»（如“hazard assumed by the insurer; or”“court of competent jurisdiction”“decree of any court”）
patterns.context: 法律句式中的固定搭配或名词短语，尤其是描述权利、管辖、法院或判决时；不一定要求出现 court。
patterns.domain: 保险条款、儿童福利法规及判例法

patterns.name: 法律程序及诉讼阶段词语
patterns.context: 描述请求法院救济、撤回认罪答辩、审判或上诉等程序行为。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引语或判词引出语
patterns.context: 引述判决理由、法条文字或法院认定；常见于引号、方括号及判决论述附近。

patterns.name: 邮件中 finalize 前的短语
patterns.context: 工作邮件中表达推进或完成工作的语句；与其他激活片段的法律语境不同。

patterns.name: 地名内部子词
patterns.context: 波兰村名或行政区名称的子词片段；未见明显法律语境。

en.description: Most legal passages activate on judicial institution phrases of the form “court of …”; other sporadic patterns include internal fragments in place names/addresses, a philosophical collocation, and research-institution abbreviations, with no contextual feature that unifies them.

patterns.name: Legal phrase “court of …”
patterns.context: In legal text, court is followed by of and a modifier such as jurisdiction, court of record, or court of appeal; it directly triggers activation across multiple passages.
patterns.domain: Case law, statutes, and judicial procedural documents

patterns.name: Specific spelling fragments in place names
patterns.context: Internal fragments in place names or institutional addresses are activated, including Lublin, Rokitno, Brno, Rīga, and Rokhlin; there is no consistent semantic context.
patterns.domain: Geographic entries, academic addresses, quantum information papers

patterns.name: Relational phrase in discussion
patterns.context: A fixed phrase expressing a difference in some respect, in philosophical discussion comparing experience and belief.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in regulatory agency abbreviations
patterns.context: Near names and abbreviations of research misconduct investigators and funding agencies.

5_2976.concept: 混合的词片段与法律搭配检测
5_2976.description: 多数法律段落在“court of …”司法机构短语中激活；另有地名/地址词内片段、哲学固定搭配及科研机构缩写等零散模式，未见能统一解释它们的上下文特征。

patterns.name: 法律短语“court of …”
patterns.trigger: « court»« of»；« court»« of»« competent» jurisdiction；« court»« of»« record»；« court»« of»« appeals»
patterns.context: 法律文本中 court 后接 of 及管辖权、记录法院、上诉法院等限定语；在多个段落中直接触发
patterns.domain: 判例、法规及司法程序文书

patterns.name: 地名中的特定拼写片段
patterns.context: 地名或机构地址中的词内片段被激活，包括 Lublin、Rokitno、Brno、Rīga，以及 Rokhlin；没有一致的语义上下文
patterns.domain: 地理条目、学术地址、量子信息论文

patterns.name: 论述中的关系词组
patterns.context: 比较经验与信念的哲学论述中，表示某方面差异的固定搭配

patterns.name: 监管机构缩写中的词内片段
patterns.context: 科研不端调查及资助机构名称、缩写附近
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与机构报告

en.description: Activations are scattered across prepositions and citation markers in legal documents, the I in the forum abbreviation FWIW, and capitalized names and page numbers in book indexes; no single meaning or semantic theme runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Prepositional collocations in legal contexts
patterns.context: Prepositions, articles, and common legal phrases in legal sentences; activation falls on these words or their constituent parts.

patterns.name: Square brackets and word-initial letters in citations
patterns.context: Editorial insertions marked with square brackets in case citations, especially forms replacing the initial letter, such as [W]here and [W]hen.

patterns.name: The letter I in the abbreviation FWIW
patterns.context: Forum replies use FWIW (for what it’s worth) to introduce a personal view or additional explanation; activation is concentrated on the I in the abbreviation.

patterns.name: Names and alphanumeric strings in indexes
patterns.context: Book-index-style formatting, with capitalized names mixed with page numbers, periods, and line breaks; activation is distributed across name characters and numbers.

5_2976.concept: none
5_2976.description: 激活分散于法律文书的介词与引文标记、论坛缩写 FWIW 中的 I，以及书籍目录里大写人名和页码；没有单一词义或语义主题贯穿全部段落。

patterns.name: 法律语境中的介词搭配
patterns.context: 法律句子中介词、冠词及常见法律短语；激活落在这些词或短语的组成部分上。

patterns.name: 引文中的方括号及词首
patterns.context: 判例引文中用方括号标示的编辑性插入，尤其是 [W]here、[W]hen 这类替换句首字母的形式。

patterns.name: FWIW 缩写中的字母 I
patterns.context: 论坛回复中以 FWIW（for what it’s worth）引出个人看法或补充说明；激活集中于缩写里的 I。

patterns.name: 目录或索引中的人名及字母数字混排
patterns.trigger: «IE»、«ENA»、«HA»、«W»、«I» 等名字内部片段；邻近页码如 «399»、«408»
patterns.context: 书籍目录式排版，人物姓名大写并与页码、点号和换行混排；激活分布在姓名字符及数字上。

en.concept: Specific string fragments and proper names
en.description: Activations are scattered across several kinds of strings: the I in the name Williams, forms of Google, fragments of proper names such as Rokhlin/Rajski, Ripley, and Rokstone, and punctuation and numbers in legal citations; no unified semantics or stable contextual condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Near I/IA in names
patterns.context: The I in the capitalized surname Williams is marked; it appears in book indexes, case parties, or lists of judges.

patterns.name: Rokhlin/Rajski proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Names of researchers associated with distance metrics are listed in quantum information geometry papers; the names are marked as split subwords.

patterns.name: Google stem and derived forms
patterns.context: In forms such as Google, Googling, or Google’s, the marked activations are concentrated on character fragments within the word; mentions involve search or the company.

patterns.name: Ripley place-name fragment
patterns.context: The county name Ripley is split into marked fragments in descriptions of U.S. community locations.

patterns.name: Rokstone business-name fragment
patterns.context: Rokstone appears in the names of real estate agents and their company.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting in legal citations
patterns.context: Commas, periods, or number fragments are marked in case citations, name suffixes, volume and page information, and legal-text formatting.

5_2976.concept: 特定字符串片段与专名
5_2976.description: 激活分散在多类字符串：Williams 姓名中的 I、Google 词形、Rokhlin/Rajski、Ripley、Rokstone 等专名片段，以及法律引文中的标点和数字；未见统一语义或稳定上下文条件。

patterns.name: 人名中 I/IA 附近
patterns.context: 大写姓氏 Williams 中的 I 被标记；出现在书籍目录、判例当事人或法官名单中。

patterns.name: Rokhlin/Rajski 专名片段
patterns.context: 量子信息几何论文中列举距离度量相关研究者姓名，名字被分词拆开标记。

patterns.name: Google 词干及派生形式
patterns.context: Google、Googling 或 Google’s 等词形中，标记集中在词内的字符片段；提及搜索或公司。

patterns.name: Ripley 地名片段
patterns.context: 美国社区地点描述中，县名 Ripley 被拆分标记。

patterns.name: Rokstone 商业名称片段
patterns.context: 房地产经纪人及其所在公司名称中出现 Rokstone。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的标点与格式
patterns.context: 判例引文、姓名后缀、卷页信息及法律文本格式中，标记逗号、句点或数字片段。

en.description: Activations often fall on split fragments within names, place names, and foreign-language or specialized words; punctuation and common words also appear. They span corpora and contexts, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of the string Williams
patterns.context: When the letter string in a capitalized name, surname, or title is split into subwords, activation falls on the letter I; the surrounding characters are usually also letters in a name.
patterns.domain: Book indexes and legal case texts

patterns.name: Rans- string in legal citations
patterns.context: The letter sequence R, ans appears within proper names, including an attorney’s name and a place name.

patterns.name: Fragments in French hyphenated words
patterns.context: In French expressions, the “à-fait” portion joined by a hyphen is marked as split fragments.

patterns.name: q and R fragments in quantum terminology
patterns.context: Scientific papers contain mathematical notation for qubits and author names.

patterns.name: Openings of English conditional clauses
patterns.context: English quotations in legal citations use “when” to introduce a conditional clause, with the quotation marked by square brackets.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Wisconsin place names
patterns.context: Place names in attorneys’ addresses are split into multiple subword fragments.

patterns.name: Scattered punctuation and general word fragments
patterns.context: These fragments occur in names, addresses, citations, French text, or general legal prose, with no consistent local semantic or grammatical condition.

5_2976.concept: 分词片段与专名字符
5_2976.description: 激活多落在被切分的姓名、地名及外文或专业词的内部片段，也见标点和常用词；跨语料、跨语境，未见稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 字母串 Williams 的内部片段
patterns.context: 大写人名或姓名、标题中的字母串被分词切开时；激活落在字母 I 上，周围通常也是姓名字母
patterns.domain: 书籍目录与法律判例文本

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 Rans- 字母串
patterns.context: 专名中出现字母序列 R、ans，分别见律师姓名和地名

patterns.name: 法语连字符词尾片段
patterns.context: 法语表达中，连字符连接的“à-fait”部分被拆分标记

patterns.name: 量子术语中的 q 与 R 片段
patterns.context: 科学论文中出现量子比特的数学排版及作者姓名

patterns.name: 英语条件从句的开头
patterns.context: 法律引文中方括号标示的英文引语，以“when”引出条件从句

patterns.name: 威斯康星地名的内部片段
patterns.context: 律师地址中的地名被拆分成多个子词片段

patterns.name: 散见标点与通用词片段
patterns.context: 这些片段出现于姓名、地址、引文、法语文本或一般法律叙述中，缺少一致的局部语义或语法条件
patterns.domain: 多种文体，主要为法律文本

en.description: Strong activations often occur on sentence-initial capital W in legal quotations (We, Where, When), and also appear in legal word fragments, names, and within book titles; the latter categories have no unified contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial capital W in legal quotations
patterns.context: A sentence-initial word following a quotation mark or square bracket starts with capital W, commonly in quoted judicial opinions; the token is marked on W or the beginning of We/Where/When.

patterns.name: Other word-initial or internal fragments in legal texts
patterns.context: In legal contexts, the marker falls within or at the beginning of ordinary words; there is no stable shared word form or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Word fragments in names or titles
patterns.context: In index-like bibliographic text, activation falls on split fragments of names or titles.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names
patterns.context: The name Vodnoy appears in prose, with the marker concentrated within the name.

5_2976.concept: 法律文本中的词首/词片段
5_2976.description: 强激活多见于法律文本引文中句首大写 W（We、Where、When），也散见于法律词语片段、姓名和书名内部；后几类缺少统一上下文模式。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的句首大写 W
patterns.context: 引号或方括号后的句首词以大写 W 开始，常见于裁判意见引用；token 标记落在 W 或 We/Where/When 的开头

patterns.name: 法律文本中其他词首或词内片段
patterns.context: 法律语境中标记落在普通词的内部或词首；没有稳定的共同词形或句法位置

patterns.name: 姓名或标题中的词片段
patterns.context: 目录式书目文字中的人名或书名，激活落在被拆分的姓名、标题片段中

patterns.name: 人名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 正文叙述中出现人名 Vodnoy，标记集中在名字内部

en.concept: Internal and boundary fragments of in
en.description: Most passages activate on in within hyphenated compounds, commonly brother-in-law, President-in-Office, and Attorney-In-Charge. Other independent triggers include letters in index names, letters within Slovak words, and punctuation boundaries in legal citations.

patterns.name: in in hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on in in the middle of hyphenated compounds, usually with a hyphen on either side; capitalization varies.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, parliamentary records, novels, and encyclopedia prose

patterns.name: Letter fragments in index names
patterns.context: In index entries consisting of capitalized names, spaces, and page numbers, activation falls on letter fragments within names; this differs from the compound-word pattern.

patterns.name: Letters within Slovak words
patterns.context: Activation falls on letters with diacritics or letter fragments within Slovak words, in continuous parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Punctuation and quotation boundaries in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation occurs near punctuation, square brackets, and quotation boundaries in legal citations or bracketed editorial markers; it is not evidently part of the hyphenated in pattern.

5_2976.concept: in 的词内及边界片段
5_2976.description: 多数段落在连字符复合词中间的 in 激活，常见于 brother-in-law、President-in-Office、Attorney-In-Charge。另有目录姓名字母、斯洛伐克语词内字母，以及法律引文标点边界等独立触发。

patterns.name: 连字符复合词中的 in
patterns.context: 激活集中在连字符复合词中间的 in，且通常前后都有连字符；大小写可变。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、议会记录、小说及百科叙述

patterns.name: 目录姓名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 姓名以大写字母、空格和页码组成的目录条目中，激活落在姓名内部的字母片段；与复合词模式不同。

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语词内字母
patterns.context: 激活落在斯洛伐克语词语内部的带变音符号字母或字母片段，出现在连续的议会发言文本中。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的标点与引号边界
patterns.context: 激活出现在法律引文或方括号编辑标记附近的标点、方括号及引号边界；并非显然属于连字符 in 模式。

en.description: The most stable pattern is the hyphenated brother-in-law, especially the hyphen and the in/law fragments. Other hyphenated words include Attorney-In-Charge and tout-à-fait. The remaining activations are scattered across French words, names, place names, and fragments within English words, without a unified condition.

patterns.name: brother-in-law compound
patterns.context: In expressions of kinship, activation is concentrated on the hyphen and word fragments such as in/law; the context refers to someone’s in-law.
patterns.domain: Legal, encyclopedia, novel, and parliamentary prose

patterns.name: Other hyphenated words or fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on hyphens and the word segments they connect, not necessarily in kinship terms; includes compounds spanning word boundaries.

patterns.name: Fragments within French words
patterns.context: Letter fragments in the middle of common French words are marked; the example also contains a hyphenated compound, but activation here is within a word.

patterns.name: Fragments within names
patterns.context: Activation occurs within names in a list, rather than in an obvious hyphenated compound.

patterns.name: Fragments within French place names
patterns.context: Letters within a place name in a French biographical entry are marked.

patterns.name: Fragments within English words
patterns.context: An ordinary English spelling fragment in an attorney’s name is marked; the same sentence also contains Attorney-In-Charge.

patterns.name: Fragments within Office
patterns.context: A part of a person’s name is marked in political speech; the nearby text contains President-in-Office.

patterns.name: Fragments within day
patterns.context: The initial letter fragment of the word day is marked in novel dialogue.

5_2976.concept: 连字符复合词，尤其 brother-in-law
5_2976.description: 最稳定模式是带连字符的 brother-in-law，尤其连字符及 in/law 片段；另有 Attorney-In-Charge、tout-à-fait 等连字符词。其余激活散见法语词、人名、地名及英文词内片段，缺乏统一条件。

patterns.name: brother-in-law 复合词
patterns.context: 在亲属关系表达中，激活集中于连字符及 in/law 等词内片段；语境提及某人的姻亲。
patterns.domain: 法律、百科、小说、议会发言

patterns.name: 其他被连字符拆分的词或词段
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符及连字符连接的词段，未必是亲属词；包括跨词边界的复合表达。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 法语普通词中间的字母片段被标记；该例同时含连字符复合词，但此处激活在词内。

patterns.name: 人名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在名单中的人名内部，而非明显的连字符复合词。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件收件人/联系人名单

patterns.name: 法语地名内部片段
patterns.context: 法语人物简介中的地名内部字母被标记。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段
patterns.context: 律师姓名中的普通英文拼写片段被标记；同一句另有 Attorney-In-Charge。

patterns.name: Office 词内片段
patterns.context: 政治发言中人名的一部分被标记；邻近文本含 President-in-Office。

patterns.name: day 词内片段
patterns.context: 小说对话中 day 一词的开头字母片段被标记。

en.description: All fragments activate in kinship terms such as brother-in-law, son-in-law, or sister-in-law, especially around the local spelling of the hyphen, in, and law; they occur across legal, encyclopedia, and novel texts.

patterns.name: Hyphen and preposition in in kinship compounds
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the hyphen, in, and nearby law in compound kinship terms, including brother/sister/son-in-law and possessive forms such as “brother-in-law's”.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, encyclopedia biographies, and novel narratives

5_2976.concept: 姻亲称谓的拼写模式
5_2976.description: 全部片段都在 brother-in-law、son-in-law 或 sister-in-law 等姻亲称谓中激活，尤其集中于连字符、in 和 law 的局部拼写；跨法律、百科与小说文本。

patterns.name: 姻亲复合词中的连字符与介词 in
patterns.context: 激活集中在亲属称谓复合词的连字符、in 及 law 附近；既有 brother/sister/son-in-law，也有带所有格修饰的“brother-in-law's”。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、百科人物介绍及小说叙事

en.concept: Connectors and phrase components in legal and kinship compounds
en.description: Primarily responds to hyphen-connected kinship terms or titles, especially brother-in-law; also responds to of in the fixed legal phrase Court of Appeals and the semicolon in tl;dr.

patterns.name: brother-in-law hyphenated phrase
patterns.context: The kinship term brother-in-law occurs in narrative or legal fact text; activation is concentrated on the hyphen and in, with strength annotations varying by tokenization.

patterns.name: father-in-law kinship term
patterns.context: The kinship term father-in-law occurs in testimony describing headaches before and after an accident.

patterns.name: Attorney-In-Charge title spelling
patterns.context: In an attorney signature on a formal legal document, hyphens connect the title words.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation in a court name
patterns.context: In a full court name, Court is followed by of and then Appeals; activation falls on of.
patterns.domain: Decision titles or encyclopedia entries on judicial appointments

patterns.name: tl;dr link text
patterns.context: A web comment uses tl;dr to point to a summary link.

5_2976.concept: 法律及亲属复合词中的连接符与短语成分
5_2976.description: 主要响应由连字符连接的亲属称谓或职衔词，尤其 brother-in-law；也响应固定法律短语 Court of Appeals 中的 of，以及 tl;dr 中的分号。

patterns.name: brother-in-law 连字符词组
patterns.context: 亲属称谓 brother-in-law 出现在叙述或法律事实文本中；激活集中在连字符和 in，强度标注因分词而异
patterns.domain: 小说、判决事实、百科人物传记

patterns.name: father-in-law 亲属称谓
patterns.context: 亲属称谓 father-in-law 出现在关于事故前后头痛的证词叙述中

patterns.name: Attorney-In-Charge 职衔拼写
patterns.context: 正式法律文件的律师署名中，连字符连接职衔词

patterns.name: 法院名称固定搭配
patterns.context: 法院全称中 Court 后接 of，并继续出现 Appeals；激活落在 of
patterns.domain: 判决标题或司法任命百科条目

patterns.name: tl;dr 链接文本
patterns.context: 网页评论中以 tl;dr 指向摘要链接

en.description: The most stable pattern is the kinship term in-law, especially the hyphen before law; there is also a strong response to & in AT&T. Remaining activations are scattered across punctuation, abbreviations, hyphenated words, phone numbers, and a few word fragments.

patterns.name: in-law in kinship terms
patterns.context: Occurs after a kinship noun to form a compound term; activation is concentrated on the hyphen before law, and sometimes also on in or the hyphen.

patterns.name: Company name AT&T
patterns.context: & occurs between AT and T to form a company name; both occurrences activate strongly.
patterns.domain: Business emails, technology forums, legal documents

patterns.name: Sentence punctuation and abbreviation marks
patterns.context: Activation occurs at punctuation positions, including periods, commas, and periods within abbreviations; the semantics and genres of the surrounding text vary.
patterns.domain: Novels, business emails, forums, legal documents, encyclopedias

patterns.name: Hyphenated compounds and phone formatting
patterns.context: Appears respectively in hyphen-linked travel service terms and in parentheses and number formatting in phone numbers; distinct from in-law in kinship terms.

patterns.name: English abbreviations and apostrophe forms
patterns.context: The apostrophe is represented by a special marker in contracted forms such as we’ve or we’re; this occurs only here.

patterns.name: Local word fragments
patterns.context: These markers fall at different positions in Ardennes, Baudin, and came to; there is no stable shared context, so they are difficult to group as a common semantic trigger pattern.

5_2976.concept: 复合词边界与标点
5_2976.description: 最稳定模式是亲属称谓 in-law，尤其 law 前的连字符；另对 AT&T 的 & 有强响应。其余激活散见标点、缩写、连字符词、电话号码及少数词片段。

patterns.name: 亲属称谓中的 in-law
patterns.context: 出现在亲属关系名词后构成复合称谓；激活集中在 law 前的连字符，部分也落在 in 或连字符上。

patterns.name: 公司名 AT&T
patterns.context: & 位于 AT 与 T 之间，构成公司名称；两处均强烈激活。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、科技论坛、法律文书

patterns.name: 句读与缩写标点
patterns.context: 激活出现在句号、逗号及缩写内部句点等标点位置，所在词句语义和文体不一。
patterns.domain: 小说、商务邮件、论坛、法律文书、百科

patterns.name: 连字符复合词与电话格式
patterns.context: 分别出现在连字符连接的旅行服务词语、电话号码括号与数字格式中；与亲属称谓中的 in-law 不同。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件中的旅行信息

patterns.name: 英语缩写及撇号词形
patterns.context: 撇号位置以特殊标记呈现，位于 we’ve 或 we’re 一类缩写形式中；仅此处出现。

patterns.name: 局部词片段
patterns.context: 这些标记分别落在 Ardennes、Baudin、came to 等不同词形位置，未见稳定共同上下文，难以归为同一语义触发模式。

en.description: Activations are mainly scattered across punctuation and formatting symbols (periods, hyphens, &, HTML entities, and email-header delimiters), as well as several common words and number formats. Semantics and registers vary widely, with no unified content theme.

patterns.name: English abbreviations and their periods
patterns.context: Near English abbreviations or periods; the trigger falls on the period itself, and examples vary in usage.

patterns.name: Hyphens within English words
patterns.context: Hyphens connect words or phrases; passage [2] contains split today, while passages [3] and [9] contain in-law compounds.

patterns.name: AT&T string
patterns.context: Near the & symbol in the brand name AT&T; both passages mention the company.

patterns.name: HTML entities and special-character markers
patterns.context: A component of an HTML numeric character entity in web text.

patterns.name: Email addresses and path delimiters
patterns.context: Email headers or escaped recipient paths, with activations distributed across symbols such as slashes, @, equals signs, and underscores.

patterns.name: Hyphen in a French word
patterns.context: The hyphen in the French expression au-delà.

patterns.name: Spaces between words and short function words
patterns.context: Activation falls on common words and spaces between words, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Novels, legal texts, French parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Numbers in date and time formats
patterns.context: Numbers, colons, or slashes form time and date formats; activation occurs only on some adjacent punctuation.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation in novels
patterns.context: A period is followed by a space and a new sentence; it is unclear whether activation targets the period, the space, or the sentence boundary.

patterns.name: Words in poetic lines
patterns.context: Common function words or the hyphenated spelling tonight in poetic lines; there is no distinctive semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric combination in a biological proper name
patterns.context: In the histone variant name H2A.Z, activation falls on the number and period.

5_2976.concept: 标点与格式边界
5_2976.description: 激活主要散布于标点与格式符号（句点、连字符、&、HTML实体及邮件头分隔符），也包括若干常见词和数字格式；语义和语域跨越较大，未见统一内容主题。

patterns.name: 英文缩写及其句点
patterns.context: 英文缩写或句点标点附近；触发落在句点本身，例子用途不一
patterns.domain: 生物医学、小说、商务邮件

patterns.name: 英语词内的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接词语或词组；段[2]为拆分的 today，段[3]和[9]为 in-law 复合词

patterns.name: AT&T 字符串
patterns.context: 品牌名 AT&T 中的 & 符号附近；两段都出现该公司名

patterns.name: HTML 实体及特殊字符标记
patterns.context: 网页文本中 HTML 数字字符实体的组成部分

patterns.name: 电子邮件地址和路径分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件头或转义后的收件人路径，激活分布于斜杠、@、等号和下划线等符号

patterns.name: 法语词间连字符
patterns.context: 法语表达 au-delà 中的连字符

patterns.name: 词间空格及短功能词
patterns.trigger: « to»、« in»-«law»、« of»、« see»、« ne»、« va»
patterns.context: 激活落在常见词及词间空格上，未见稳定的语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 小说、法律文本、法语议会文本

patterns.name: 日期与时间格式中的数字
patterns.context: 数字、冒号或斜杠构成时间及日期样式；激活只在部分相邻标点上

patterns.name: 小说叙事中的句末标点
patterns.context: 句点后接空格和新句；无法确定激活是否针对句点、空格或句界

patterns.name: 诗歌行文中的词语
patterns.context: 诗行中的常见虚词或拼写带连字符的 tonight；没有独特语义触发条件

patterns.name: 生物学专名中的字母数字组合
patterns.context: 组蛋白变体 H2A.Z 名称中，激活落在数字和句点
